name: 3/4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Rest your fingertips behind your head without pulling on your neck.
Tighten your abdomen and curl your torso upward, stopping short of sitting fully upright.
Lower your back and shoulders to the floor under control.
description: A partial sit-up that curls the torso toward the thighs, working the abs with help from the hip flexors.

name: 45-Degree Roman Chair Side Bend
instructions: Position yourself sideways on a 45-degree Roman chair with your hip against the pad and your feet secured on its supports.
Rest your hands lightly behind your head and keep your chest facing forward.
Lower your torso sideways toward the floor without twisting.
Use the side of your abdomen to lift your torso back into line with your legs.
Finish your repetitions, then turn around and repeat on the other side.
description: A supported side bend that works the obliques as the torso lowers sideways and returns to line with the legs.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your bent knees above your hips, and rest your fingertips lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and turn your right shoulder toward your left knee while extending your right leg.
Switch sides, bringing your left shoulder toward your right knee as your left leg extends.
Continue alternating smoothly without pulling on your head or letting the extended leg drag on the floor.
description: An alternating crunch that combines torso rotation with a pedaling leg motion to work the abs and obliques.

name: All-Fours Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your abdomen gently tightened.
Bend one knee and reach back with the hand on that side to hold your ankle.
Keep the other hand and knee on the floor as you gently bring the heel toward your buttock.
Hold a comfortable stretch without forcing your back to arch, then release the ankle.
Repeat on the other side.
description: A kneeling stretch that brings one heel toward the buttock to stretch the front of the thigh.

name: Alternating Heel Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Reach your arms toward your heels, palms facing inward, and lift your shoulders slightly.
Bend sideways through your torso to reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Move across to reach your left heel with your left hand.
Alternate sides while keeping your hips still and your shoulders lifted.
description: A side-to-side abdominal movement that works the obliques while the shoulders stay lifted off the floor.

name: Seated Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit on a flat bench beneath a high cable handle with your feet planted.
Hold the handle in one hand with that arm extended overhead, and keep the other hand resting beside you.
Pull your working elbow down toward your side while keeping your torso steady.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arm extends again.
Complete your repetitions and switch arms.
description: A seated pulldown uses one high cable handle while the other arm rests beside the body. The lats and elbow flexors pull the handle downward.

name: Standing Ankle Circles
instructions: Stand upright and shift your weight onto one leg.
Lift the other foot just clear of the floor.
Move the lifted foot in slow circles from the ankle while keeping the knee relatively still.
Circle in the opposite direction, then switch feet.
description: A standing ankle mobility drill that moves one foot through a controlled circle.

name: Archer Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a wide grip and your palms facing away from you.
Tighten your abdomen and pull your torso toward one hand, bending that elbow more than the opposite elbow.
Rise until your upper chest approaches the working hand without craning your neck.
Lower to the centered hanging position under control.
Complete your repetitions, then work toward the other hand.
description: A wide-grip pull-up shifts the body toward one hand, with greater elbow bend on that side. The lats and biceps lift the body.

name: Archer Push-Up
instructions: Set your hands wide on the floor and extend your legs behind you in a straight-arm plank.
Keep both palms planted and tighten your abdomen.
Shift toward one hand as you bend that elbow and lower your chest, keeping the other arm nearly straight.
Press through the bent arm to return to the center.
Repeat toward the opposite hand.
description: A wide-hand push-up that shifts the chest over one arm while the other stays nearly straight, working the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: Hanging Knee Raise with Ab Straps
instructions: Secure a pair of ab straps to an overhead bar and place your upper arms in the loops.
Hold the straps with bent elbows and let your legs hang below you.
Tighten your abdomen and draw both knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis upward slightly.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
description: A knee raise performed with the upper arms supported in hanging straps, working the abs and hip flexors.
aliases: Arm Slingers Hanging Bent Knee Legs

name: Hanging Straight-Leg Raise with Ab Straps
instructions: Place your upper arms in ab straps secured to an overhead bar and hold the straps with your elbows bent.
Let your legs hang together and steady your torso.
Raise both legs with the knees nearly straight, curling your pelvis upward as your feet approach the overhead bar.
Lower your pelvis and legs slowly to the hanging position without swinging.
description: A full straight-leg raise in upper-arm straps lifts the feet toward the overhead bar. The hip flexors raise the legs and the abs curl the pelvis upward.

name: Standing Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and reach both arms overhead.
Bend your torso toward one side, then continue the arm sweep down toward your feet.
Move through the forward bend and up the other side to return overhead.
Keep both feet planted and use a comfortable range rather than forcing your hands to the floor.
Repeat the circle in the opposite direction.
description: A standing mobility movement that sweeps the arms and torso through a broad circle with both feet planted.

name: Straight-Leg Sit-Up with Forward Reach
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms stretched overhead.
Gently tighten your abdomen and curl your torso up while keeping your legs on the floor.
Continue into a seated forward reach, bringing your hands toward your feet through a comfortable range.
Lower your torso slowly and return your arms overhead until your back rests on the floor.
description: A straight-leg sit-up starts with the arms overhead and finishes with a forward reach toward the feet, working the abs and hip flexors.

name: Kneeling Machine-Assisted Chest Dip
instructions: Select the machine assistance and grip both dip handles.
Place both knees on the moving pad and support yourself with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower your chest between the handles.
Stop at a comfortable depth, then press through the handles to raise your body.
Keep your knees on the pad as it travels with you.
description: A dip performed with the knees on an assistance pad, working the chest, triceps and shoulders with reduced bodyweight resistance.

name: Partner-Guided Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and steady your body.
Have a partner stand beside you with one hand at your side and the other near the fronts of your knees.
Tighten your abdomen and raise your knees toward your chest while your partner helps steady and guide the movement.
Lower your legs under control while your partner maintains contact.
Keep the movement smooth and communicate how much help you need.
description: A hanging knee raise with a partner guiding the legs and steadying the torso, working the abs and hip flexors.

name: Hanging Knee Raise with Partner Pushdown
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your legs together.
Have a partner stand in front of you where they can reach your knees.
Raise your bent knees toward your chest without swinging.
Let your partner apply a light, controlled downward push to your knees.
Resist the push as you lower your legs, then raise your knees for the next repetition.
description: A hanging knee raise in which a partner pushes the raised legs downward and the exerciser controls their descent. The abs and hip flexors coordinate the movement.
aliases: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise with Throw Down

name: Partner-Assisted Lying Calf Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg resting on the floor.
Have your partner lift and support the other leg with its knee comfortably straight.
Ask the partner to support your heel and gently bring the forefoot toward your shin until you feel a calf stretch.
Hold a comfortable position without bouncing, then release slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
description: A calf stretch performed on the back while a partner supports a raised leg and gently draws the toes toward the shin.

name: Partner-Assisted Knees-To-Chest Glute Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and bend both knees toward your torso.
Have your partner kneel near your feet and support your bent legs.
Keep your shoulders relaxed as the partner gently brings your thighs toward your chest.
Hold a comfortable stretch, then let the partner ease the legs away.
Keep communicating so the stretch stays gentle.
description: A lying stretch in which a partner moves the bent legs toward the torso to stretch the glutes.

name: Partner-Assisted Figure-Four Glute Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.
Have your partner support the uncrossed leg while keeping the crossed ankle in place.
Let the partner gently bring the supporting thigh toward your chest while your shoulders and arms stay relaxed on the floor.
Hold at a comfortable stretch, then ease out of the position.
Uncross your legs and repeat on the other side.
description: A partner-supported figure-four stretch that targets the glutes and deep hip rotators.
aliases: Assisted Lying Gluteus and Piriformis Stretch

name: Lying Leg Raise and Hip Lift with Partner Pushdown
instructions: Lie on your back with your partner standing behind your head and hold their ankles for support.
Lift both legs toward your partner, allowing your knees to bend.
Curl your pelvis a short distance from the floor as your feet approach your partner's hands.
Have the partner apply a gentle downward push to your lower legs.
Lower your pelvis and legs under control, stopping before your lower back arches, then repeat.
description: Raise both legs and curl the pelvis upward toward a partner, then control the partner-guided lowering. The abs and hip flexors lift the legs while the abs control the pelvic curl.
aliases: Assisted Lying Leg Raise with Lateral Throw Down
Lying Leg Raise with Partner Lateral Pushdown

name: Lying Leg Raise with Partner Pushdown
instructions: Lie on your back with your partner standing behind your head and hold their ankles.
Keep your legs together and raise them toward your partner, allowing your knees to bend and your hips to curl slightly off the floor.
Have the partner apply a gentle forward and downward push to your lower legs.
Lower your hips and lengthen your legs as you slow the descent, stopping before your feet reach the floor.
Raise your legs again without swinging or lifting your shoulders.
description: A lying leg raise and small hip curl bring the legs toward a partner. The partner adds a gentle downward push while the exerciser controls the return with the abs and hip flexors.
aliases: Assisted Lying Leg Raise with Throw Down

name: Seated Medicine Ball Twist and Partner Pass
instructions: Sit facing your partner with your knees bent, feet lifted from the floor and torso leaning back slightly.
Hold the medicine ball with both hands and turn your shoulders to bring it beside your hip.
Rotate back toward your partner and pass the ball to them.
Keep your abdomen tightened and your feet raised as your partner passes the ball back.
Catch with both hands and continue the turn-and-pass sequence.
description: A seated rotation and medicine-ball pass performed with a partner, working the obliques and abs.

name: Kneeling Machine-Assisted Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Select the machine assistance and grip the close parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Place both knees on the assistance pad and lower yourself until your arms are extended.
Pull your elbows toward your ribs to lift your chest toward the handles.
Lower under control until your arms extend again, keeping your knees on the moving pad.
description: A pull-up using parallel handles and a knee assistance pad, working the lats and elbow flexors.

name: Partner-Resisted Prone Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and your thighs resting on the floor.
Have your partner kneel beside your lower legs and hold one ankle.
Bend that knee to bring your heel toward your buttock while the partner applies gentle opposing pressure.
Straighten the knee slowly against the partner’s controlled resistance.
Finish your repetitions and repeat with the other leg.
description: A single-leg curl performed face down while a partner provides resistance at the ankle, working the hamstrings.

name: Partner-Assisted Prone Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and your head resting comfortably on your arms.
Have a partner kneel beside your legs and support one ankle.
Keep your thigh on the floor while your partner bends the knee and gently brings the heel toward your buttock.
Hold a comfortable stretch, then let the partner slowly straighten the leg.
Repeat on the other side.
description: A face-down quadriceps stretch in which a partner bends one knee and gently brings the heel toward the buttock.

name: Partner-Assisted Prone Quadriceps Stretch with Thigh Lift
instructions: Lie face down with your arms supporting your head.
Have your partner bend one knee and support the thigh just above that knee.
Keep your pelvis on the floor while the partner gently lifts the bent thigh a small distance.
Hold a comfortable stretch in the front of your thigh without forcing your lower back to arch.
Let the partner lower and straighten the leg, then switch sides.
description: A partner stretch that combines a bent knee with a small lift of the thigh to stretch the rectus femoris, one of the quadriceps muscles.

name: Kneeling Machine-Assisted Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Select the assistance level and hold the wide overhead handles with your palms facing away from you.
Place both knees on the moving pad and lower until your arms extend.
Pull your elbows down to raise your chest toward the handles.
Lower slowly, keeping your knees supported by the pad throughout.
description: A wide-grip pull-up performed with the knees on an assistance pad, working the lats, upper back and elbow flexors.

name: Partner-Assisted Chest Stretch Against Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a stable exercise ball and your legs in front of you.
Place your hands behind your head and open your elbows to the sides.
Have your partner stand behind the ball and gently guide your elbows backward.
Keep your ribs relaxed and hold a comfortable stretch across your chest.
Let the partner release the pressure slowly.
description: A seated chest stretch with the upper back supported by a stability ball and a partner gently drawing the elbows backward.
aliases: Assisted Seated Pectoralis Major Stretch with Stability Ball

name: Partner-Assisted Side-Lying Adductor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your lower leg resting on the floor.
Have your partner support the upper leg near the ankle and thigh.
Keep the upper knee comfortably straight while the partner lifts that leg away from the lower leg.
Hold a gentle inner-thigh stretch without rolling your pelvis backward.
Lower the leg with support, then repeat lying on your other side.
description: A side-lying stretch in which a partner raises the upper leg to stretch the inner thigh.

name: Sit-Up with Partner Foot Support
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Rest your fingertips lightly behind your head and ask your partner to hold your feet steady.
Curl your torso toward your thighs without pulling on your neck.
Lower your back to the floor slowly while your partner maintains foot support.
description: A floor sit-up with a partner anchoring the feet, working the abs and hip flexors.

name: Platform-Assisted Close-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Select the machine assistance and grip the inner overhead handles.
Step onto the moving foot platform and keep both feet supported.
Start with your arms extended, then pull your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly as the platform travels down with you.
Keep your torso steady and maintain foot contact throughout.
description: A pull-up using the inner machine handles while a moving platform supports the feet, working the back and elbow flexors.

name: Platform-Assisted Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Set the machine assistance and grasp the outer overhead handles with your palms facing away from you.
Stand with both feet on the moving platform and extend your arms.
Draw your elbows down and lift your chest toward the handles.
Lower your body under control while the platform continues to support your feet.
description: A wide-grip pull-up with the feet supported on a moving assistance platform, working the lats and upper back.

name: Partner-Resisted Towel Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand upright and hold one end of a towel with both hands behind your head.
Have your partner stand behind you and hold the other end with gentle tension.
Keep your upper arms pointing upward as you straighten your elbows against the towel resistance.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring your hands behind your head again.
Coordinate with your partner so the resistance stays smooth.
description: An overhead elbow extension against a towel held by a partner, working the triceps.

name: Kneeling Machine-Assisted Triceps Dip
instructions: Choose the assistance level and grip the dip handles beside your body.
Place both knees on the pad and keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower your body between the handles without shrugging your shoulders.
Press down through your hands to straighten your arms and rise.
Keep your knees supported throughout.
description: An upright dip with the knees on a moving assistance pad, emphasizing the triceps with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Kneeling Machine-Assisted Wide-Grip Chest Dip
instructions: Select the assistance and place both knees on the moving pad.
Hold the wider dip handles and lean your torso slightly forward.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest between the handles to a comfortable depth.
Press through both hands to rise, keeping your knees on the pad.
description: A wide-hand dip performed on an assistance machine, working the chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Astride Jumps
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together and arms beside your body.
Make a small jump to land with your feet apart while raising your arms outward.
Jump again to bring your feet together and lower your arms.
Continue the together-and-apart rhythm, landing with softly bent knees.
description: An upright jumping drill that alternates the feet together and apart while the arms open to the sides.

name: Step-Back Toe Reach with Knee Lift
instructions: Stand upright, then step one foot back diagonally while bending the supporting knee.
Reach the opposite hand toward the front foot as your torso tips forward.
Push through the front foot to stand tall and bring the rear knee forward and upward.
Lower the lifted foot and switch sides for the next rear step, opposite-hand reach and knee lift.
Continue alternating at a steady pace while keeping your balance.
description: A rhythmic stepping drill that combines a rear step and opposite-hand foot reach with a rising knee lift.

name: Stability Ball Back Extension
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with your abdomen and hips supported and your feet planted behind you.
Rest your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your chest until your torso forms a line with your legs, keeping your neck in line with your back.
Lower your chest around the ball under control.
description: A face-down back extension over a stability ball, working the lower back while the hips and legs stabilize the body.

name: Parallel-Bar Back Lever Hold
instructions: Grip the parallel bars securely and move into the face-down back-lever position with your arms extended behind your torso.
Bring your straight legs together and tighten your abdomen and glutes.
Hold your body horizontal without letting your hips sag or bending your elbows.
Exit the hold under control before you lose body alignment.
description: A face-down horizontal hold with the hands gripping parallel bars behind the body, requiring strong shoulder support and whole-body tension.

name: Standing Bench-Supported Lat Stretch
instructions: Stand facing an incline bench and place both hands on the raised backrest.
Step back and push your hips backward, leaning your torso forward until your arms extend in front of you.
Let your chest sink gently between your arms while keeping your feet planted and knees soft.
Hold a comfortable stretch along the sides of your back, then stand upright slowly.
description: A standing forward-leaning stretch with the hands supported on a raised bench, stretching the lats and shoulders.

name: Backward Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and clear space behind you.
Bend your hips and knees and prepare your arms for the jump.
Push through both feet to jump a short distance backward.
Land on both feet with your knees and hips bending to absorb the landing.
Regain balance before repeating.
description: A two-foot jump that travels backward, using the quadriceps, glutes and calves for takeoff and landing.

name: Two-Foot Balance Board Stance
instructions: Place the balance board on a flat, clear surface.
Step onto it with both feet spaced evenly across the board.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and hold your arms out as needed for balance.
Make small weight shifts to keep the board level, then step off under control.
description: A balance exercise performed with both feet on a wobble board, requiring small adjustments through the ankles and legs.

name: Single-Arm Band Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold one end in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Keep one hand beside your thigh and curl the other toward your shoulder without moving its upper arm.
Lower the working hand slowly until its elbow is nearly straight.
Finish the repetitions, then switch arms while keeping your torso steady.
description: Curl one band handle while the other hand stays beside the thigh. The band beneath the feet resists the working arm as the biceps bend the elbow.

name: Band Alternating Single-Leg V-Up
instructions: Secure the bands to a low anchor beyond your feet and fasten the foot attachments.
Recline with your legs extended in front of you and your arms open to the sides.
Raise one straight leg and curl your torso toward it, reaching the opposite hand toward that foot while keeping the other arm extended out to the side.
Lower that leg with control and switch to the opposite leg and hand, keeping your upper back lifted.
Keep the unused leg extended and avoid crossing your legs.
description: An alternating V-up against foot-attached bands, combining a single-leg lift with an opposite-hand reach to work the abs and hip flexors.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up with Thigh Support
instructions: Secure the assistance band to the pull-up bar and position its lower loop beneath your lower thighs.
Grip the bar with your palms facing away from you and lift your feet clear of the floor.
Pull your elbows down to bring your chin toward bar height without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms extend while the band continues to support your legs.
description: A pull-up using a band under the lower thighs to reduce bodyweight resistance while the lats and arms pull upward.

name: Band-Assisted Kneeling Ab-Wheel Rollout
instructions: Attach a resistance band securely to a low anchor behind you and to the ab wheel’s axle or attachment point.
Kneel facing away from the anchor and hold both wheel handles.
Tighten your abdomen and roll the wheel forward, extending your hips while keeping your back from sagging.
Roll back toward your knees under control as the band assists the return.
description: A kneeling ab-wheel rollout with a rear-anchored band pulling the wheel back toward the knees, challenging abdominal control.

name: Band Bench Press
instructions: Secure the band beneath a stable flat bench so both ends rise beside your chest.
Lie on the bench with your feet planted and hold one handle in each hand.
Press both hands upward over your chest until your arms extend.
Lower your hands slowly to chest level while keeping your wrists aligned with your forearms.
description: A flat-bench chest press using band resistance from below the bench, working the chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Band Bent-Over Hip Extension
instructions: Secure a band to a low anchor in front of you and attach the other end around one ankle.
Face the anchor, stand on the other leg and lean forward from your hips with your arms extended ahead.
Keep your torso still and move the attached leg backward from the hip.
Return that foot forward slowly without letting the band pull you off balance.
Complete your repetitions, then switch ankles.
description: A standing single-leg hip extension against a low anchored band, working the glutes while the torso stays tilted forward.

name: Band Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Attach the bands to a low anchor beyond your feet and secure the foot attachments.
Lie on your back with your fingertips behind your head and lift your shoulders slightly.
Bend one knee toward your chest while turning the opposite shoulder toward it and extending the other leg.
Switch the leg and shoulder positions in a controlled pedaling motion.
Keep your lower back steady and avoid pulling on your neck.
description: An alternating bicycle crunch with bands attached at the feet, working the abs, obliques and hip flexors against added resistance.

name: Seated Close-Grip Band Pulldown
instructions: Secure the bands to a high anchor and sit on a stable seat facing the handles.
Plant your feet and hold the handles close together with your arms extended upward.
Pull your elbows down beside your torso, bringing the handles toward your upper chest.
Let your arms extend upward slowly without lifting off the seat.
description: A seated pulldown using closely spaced handles, working the lats and biceps.

name: Band-Resisted Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place the band across your upper back and secure its ends beneath your palms.
Set your hands close together below your chest and extend your legs into a straight plank.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to lower your chest toward your hands.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms against the band.
Keep your abdomen tight and your body aligned throughout.
description: A close-hand push-up with a band across the upper back, emphasizing the triceps while also working the chest and shoulders.

name: Seated Band Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a stable seat with your knees apart and feet planted.
Secure the band low beneath the working-side foot and hold its handle with your palm facing up.
Lean forward and brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder without lifting your elbow away from the thigh.
Lower slowly, then repeat on the other arm.
description: A one-arm curl with the upper arm braced against the thigh, using a resistance band to work the biceps.

name: Seated Close-Grip Band Pulldown with Steady Torso
instructions: Fix the bands overhead and sit on a stable seat with both feet on the floor.
Hold the close handles above you and keep your torso upright with a slight natural lean.
Draw both elbows downward to bring the handles near your upper chest.
Extend your arms back up slowly while keeping the same torso position.
description: A close-grip band pulldown performed with the torso held steady, working the lats and biceps.
aliases: Band Fixed Back Close Grip Pulldown

name: Seated Underhand Band Pulldown
instructions: Anchor the bands overhead and sit facing them on a stable seat.
Take the handles with your palms facing toward you and extend your arms upward.
Keep your torso steady as you pull your elbows down and bring your hands toward your upper chest.
Return your arms upward slowly while keeping your feet planted.
description: A seated pulldown with palms facing toward the body, working the lats and biceps.

name: Single-Arm Band Front Raise
instructions: Secure the band to a low anchor behind you and stand facing away from it.
Hold the handle beside your thigh with your palm facing backward and keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm forward toward shoulder height without leaning backward.
Lower the handle slowly, then complete the same movement with the other arm.
description: A forward shoulder raise with one arm against a band anchored low behind the body, emphasizing the front of the shoulder.

name: Band Front Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold one handle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your palms facing your thighs and your elbows slightly bent.
Raise both arms forward toward shoulder height without swinging your body.
Lower your hands slowly to your thighs.
description: A two-arm forward raise with a band under the feet, working the front of the shoulders.

name: Band Glute Bridge with Plate Anchors
instructions: Secure the band across your hips with its ends anchored beneath stable weight plates beside you.
Lie on your back, bend your knees and plant your feet while holding the plates steady.
Press through your feet and raise your hips against the band, keeping your upper back on the floor.
Stop when your torso and thighs form a line without arching your lower back.
Lower your hips slowly while keeping the band and plates secure.
description: A floor glute bridge against a band across the hips, working the glutes with support from the hamstrings.

name: Standing Band Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it with your feet apart.
Hold the handle in both hands at the middle of your chest and step far enough away to create tension.
Tighten your abdomen and press your hands straight forward without turning toward the anchor.
Pause briefly, then bring your hands back to your chest under control.
Turn to face the other direction and repeat.
description: An anti-rotation press that challenges the abs and obliques to keep the torso still against a sideways band pull.

name: Band Bent-Knee Jackknife Sit-Up
instructions: Secure bands to a low anchor beyond your feet and attach them around your ankles.
Lie on your back with your legs extended and arms alongside your body.
Curl your torso upward while bending both knees toward your chest and reaching your hands alongside your legs.
Extend your legs and lower your torso together under control.
Keep tension in your abdomen as you return to the long starting position.
description: A jackknife movement against foot-attached bands that brings the knees and chest together, working the abs and hip flexors.

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Band Pulldown
instructions: Fix the band to a high anchor and kneel on one knee facing it, with the other foot planted ahead.
Reach one arm upward to hold the handle and lean slightly toward the anchor.
Pull your elbow down beside your torso without twisting your hips.
Extend the arm slowly toward the anchor again.
Finish your repetitions, then change the working arm and kneeling side.
description: A single-arm pulldown from a half-kneeling position, working the lats and biceps.

name: Kneeling Band Twisting Crunch
instructions: Secure the band high behind you and kneel facing away from the anchor.
Hold the handles beside your head with your elbows bent.
Curl your chest down toward your thighs while turning one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Return upward slowly without pulling mainly with your arms.
Finish the repetitions, then repeat the diagonal crunch toward the other side.
description: A kneeling crunch with a diagonal turn against a high band anchor, working the abs and obliques.

name: Prone Band Hip Internal Rotation
instructions: Attach the band to one ankle and secure its other end low to the opposite side of that leg.
Lie face down and bend the working knee so the lower leg points upward.
Keep your pelvis and thigh on the floor as you rotate at the hip to move the foot outward against the band.
Return the foot toward its starting position slowly without changing the bend in your knee.
Switch the ankle attachment and repeat on the other side.
description: A resisted hip-rotation exercise performed face down with one knee bent. The foot moves outward while the thigh stays supported, working the hip internal rotators.

name: Band Lying Straight-Leg Raise
instructions: Secure bands to a low anchor beyond your feet and fasten the ankle attachments.
Lie on your back with your legs together and fingertips resting behind your head.
Tighten your abdomen and lift both legs toward vertical with your knees nearly straight.
Lower slowly only as far as you can keep your lower back controlled against the floor.
description: A two-leg raise against bands anchored beyond the feet, working the hip flexors while the abs stabilize the pelvis.

name: Single-Arm Band Curl with Raised Upper Arm
instructions: Anchor the band around shoulder height and stand with the anchor beside your working side.
Hold the handle in one hand and extend that arm out to the side with your palm facing up.
Keep the upper arm steady as you bend your elbow and bring your hand toward the side of your head.
Extend your elbow slowly to return the handle toward the anchor.
Complete the repetitions, then turn around to work the other arm.
description: A single-arm biceps curl holds the upper arm out to the side at shoulder height with the band anchored beside the body.
aliases: Band One Arm Overhead Biceps Curl

name: Single-Arm Band Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a stable raised platform and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Hold a band handle in one hand with the band anchored low in front of you.
Keep most of your weight over the front foot as you bend both knees and lower your hips.
Push through the front foot to stand back up while maintaining band tension.
Finish the set, then switch legs and the working-side grip.
description: A split squat with the rear foot elevated and a band held in one hand, working the quadriceps and glutes of the front leg.
aliases: Band One Arm Single Leg Split Squat

name: Standing Single-Arm Low Band Row
instructions: Secure the band to a low anchor in front of you and hold its handle in one hand.
Set a staggered stance, bend your knees slightly and tip your torso forward.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip while keeping your shoulders level.
Extend the arm toward the anchor slowly.
Repeat on the other side.
description: A one-arm row from a low anchor, working the lats and upper back while the torso stays stable.
aliases: Band One Arm Standing Low Row

name: Floor-Seated Single-Arm Band Press with Rotation
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at about seated chest height.
Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hold the handle beside one side of your chest.
Press that hand forward as your torso turns gently toward the opposite side.
Bend the elbow and rotate back to the starting position under control.
Repeat using the other arm.
description: A seated one-arm chest press with a torso turn, working the chest, triceps and obliques.
aliases: Band One Arm Twisting Chest Press

name: Floor-Seated Single-Arm Band Row with Rotation
instructions: Anchor the band in front of you near seated chest height.
Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hold the handle in one hand.
Pull your elbow backward and turn your shoulders toward the working side as the handle approaches your ribs.
Reach forward and turn back toward the anchor under control.
Complete the set and switch hands.
description: A one-arm seated row that adds a torso turn toward the pulling side, working the upper back, lats and obliques.
aliases: Band One Arm Twisting Seated Row

name: Band Pull-Through
instructions: Secure the band to a low anchor and stand facing away from it.
Reach between your legs and hold the band with both hands, then step forward to create tension.
With soft knees, push your hips back and let your hands travel between your thighs.
Press through your feet and straighten your hips to stand tall.
Push your hips backward again slowly without rounding your back or leaning backward at the top.
description: A hip hinge with a band pulled between the legs from behind, working the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Straight-Leg Band Press Sit-Up
instructions: Secure the band behind your head and lie on your back with both legs extended.
Hold the handles above your chest with your arms extended.
Curl your torso up toward sitting while directing your hands forward in front of your chest.
Lower your torso slowly and let your arms return above your chest.
Keep your heels on the floor and control the band throughout.
description: A straight-leg sit-up combined with a forward band press, working the abs with the chest and shoulders.

name: Standing Band Reverse Fly
instructions: Fix the band at chest height and stand facing the anchor.
Hold a handle in each hand with your arms extended forward and elbows softly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides while drawing your shoulder blades together.
Return your hands forward slowly without shrugging or leaning back.
description: A rear-shoulder fly against a front-anchored band, working the rear deltoids and upper back.

name: Seated Band Wrist Extension
instructions: Sit on a stable seat and secure the band low in front of the working foot.
Hold the band handle with your palm facing down and rest that forearm on your thigh, leaving the hand free beyond your knee.
Keep the forearm still and lift your knuckles upward by extending your wrist.
Lower the hand slowly, then repeat with the other wrist.
description: A forearm-supported wrist extension with band resistance, working the muscles on the back of the forearm.

name: Seated Band Hip Internal Rotation
instructions: Secure a band low on the inner side of the working leg and fasten it around that ankle.
Sit with both knees bent and the working knee held in place above the seat edge.
Rotate that thigh inward so the foot moves outward, away from the anchor, without swinging the knee sideways.
Bring the foot back slowly, then repeat with the other leg.
description: Rotate one thigh inward while seated, moving the foot outward against a band. This works the muscles that turn the hip inward.

name: Seated Band Trunk Rotation
instructions: Secure a band beside you around the height of your hands when seated.
Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hold the band with both hands in front of your torso.
Keep your hips facing forward and turn your chest and hands away from the anchor.
Return slowly, then turn around to work the other side.
description: Turn the torso against a band while sitting with the legs extended. The obliques work as the body rotates away from the anchor.

name: Split-Stance Band Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and secure the middle of the band beneath that foot.
Hold one handle beside each shoulder with your elbows bent and your palms facing forward.
Tighten your abdomen and press both hands overhead without leaning back.
Lower the handles to shoulder height with control.
description: Press both band handles overhead from a split stance. This movement works the shoulders and triceps.

name: Band Shrug
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hold the ends at your sides with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears without bending your elbows or rolling the shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
description: Raise and lower the shoulders while holding a band under the feet. This short movement works the upper trapezius.

name: Single-Arm Band Side Triceps Extension
instructions: Secure a band around shoulder height to one side and hold its handle in the farther hand.
Raise that upper arm out to the side and bend your elbow so your hand is near your shoulder.
Keep the upper arm steady and straighten the elbow, moving your hand away from the anchor.
Bend the elbow slowly to return, then change arms.
description: Straighten one elbow out to the side against a band. The upper arm stays raised while the triceps extend the elbow.

name: Single-Leg Band Calf Raise on a Step
instructions: Secure the band low in front of a stable step and hold the handle at your side.
Place the ball of the working foot on the step with the heel free, and lift the other foot clear.
Keep the working knee nearly straight and push through the ball of the foot to raise your heel.
Lower the heel slowly through a comfortable range, then change legs.
description: Raise the heel of one foot from a step while holding a band for added resistance. The calf of the supporting leg lifts and lowers the body.

name: Single-Leg Band Toe Raise on a Step
instructions: Secure a band low in front of a stable low step and hold the handle at your side.
Balance on one leg with the heel supported near the step edge and the front of the foot free to move.
Keep the heel supported and pull the toes and forefoot upward toward your shin.
Lower the forefoot slowly, then repeat with the other leg.
description: Lift the front of one foot with the heel supported on a low step. This reverse calf raise works the tibialis anterior at the front of the lower leg.
aliases: Band Single Leg Reverse Calf Raise

name: Band Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Place the middle of a band under your front foot and hold its handles at your sides.
Rest the top of the other foot on a stable platform behind you, leaving enough space to lower between your feet.
Bend the front knee and lower your hips, keeping the front heel planted.
Push through the front foot to stand, then switch legs after completing the repetitions.
description: Bend and straighten the front leg with the rear foot supported on a platform. A band under the front foot adds resistance for the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Band Squat with Handles at Shoulders
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Bring the handles to your shoulders and keep them there throughout the movement.
Bend your hips and knees to lower into a squat, keeping your heels down and knees moving in line with your feet.
Press through your feet to return to standing.
description: Squat with a band under the feet and its handles held at shoulder height. The movement works the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Band Squat to Row
instructions: Anchor a band in front of you around chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step back until the band is taut, then squat with your arms reaching toward the anchor.
Stand up and pull the handles toward the sides of your ribs, drawing your elbows back.
Extend your arms toward the anchor as you lower into the next squat.
description: Combine a squat with a standing band row. The legs lift the body before the upper back and arms draw the handles toward the torso.

name: Standing Band Crunch
instructions: Secure a band high behind you and stand facing away from the anchor.
Hold the band beside your head with your elbows bent and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your hips fairly still and curl your ribs toward your pelvis, bringing your upper body forward.
Uncurl slowly to the starting position without leaning backward.
description: Curl the torso forward against a band anchored overhead. The abdominal muscles shorten as the ribs move toward the pelvis.

name: Standing Band Rear Delt Row
instructions: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand tall with your arms reaching forward and upward toward the anchor.
Pull your elbows out and back, bringing the handles toward your upper chest without shrugging.
Reach toward the anchor again with control.
description: Pull a high-anchored band toward the upper chest with the elbows out. This row works the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Standing Band Twisting Crunch
instructions: Anchor a band high behind you and stand facing away from it with your feet apart.
Hold the band beside your head and keep your knees softly bent.
Curl your upper body forward and turn one shoulder toward the opposite hip without pulling on your neck.
Return slowly, then perform the movement toward the other side.
description: Curl and turn the torso against an overhead band. This diagonal crunch works the abdominals and obliques.

name: Band Step-Up
instructions: Put one foot fully on a stable platform and secure the band beneath that foot.
Hold the handles beside your shoulders while the other foot rests on the floor.
Push through the elevated foot to stand on the platform, letting the trailing leg hang behind you.
Lower the trailing foot back to the floor with control, then repeat on the other side.
description: Step onto a raised platform against band resistance while the other leg remains free. The working leg uses the quadriceps and glutes to lift the body.

name: Band Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold a handle in each hand beside your legs.
Keep a small, steady bend in your knees and lower your torso forward, letting your hands travel down close to your legs.
Lower only as far as you can control without bouncing or pulling yourself deeper.
Drive your hips forward and raise your torso to standing, keeping your arms long.
description: Raise the torso from a forward bend against a band under the feet. The hamstrings, glutes and back extensors control the movement.

name: Band Straight-Back Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold its handles with your arms long beside your thighs.
Soften your knees slightly and keep that bend as you push your hips backward.
Lower your torso and handles while keeping your back shape steady, stopping before your back begins to round.
Press through your feet and bring your hips forward to stand tall.
description: Hinge at the hips with a small knee bend while holding a band under the feet. A steady back position keeps the movement focused on the hips and hamstrings.
aliases: Band Straight Back Stiff Leg Deadlift

name: Band Straight-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet close together and hold a handle in each hand.
Keep your legs nearly straight without forcing the knees backward, and lower your torso forward as your hands travel down your legs.
Use a controlled range and avoid bouncing at the bottom.
Raise your torso back to standing with your arms long and the band close to your legs.
description: Lift the torso from a forward bend with the legs nearly straight and the band under the feet. The hamstrings and back extensors work through the movement.

name: Single-Arm Band Twisting Overhead Press
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you and hold its handle in one hand near your shoulder.
Stand with your feet apart, knees slightly bent and your body turned somewhat toward the anchor.
Push through your legs and turn away from the anchor as you press that hand upward and across into an overhead position.
Bend your elbow and turn back under control, then change sides.
description: Turn the body and press one band handle upward from a low anchor. The shoulders and triceps press while the legs and trunk help drive the movement.

name: Band Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hold the band ends at your sides with your arms straight and your body tall.
Keep your knees nearly straight and raise both heels as high as you can control.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
description: Rise onto the balls of both feet while holding a band under the feet. The calves lift and lower the heels.
aliases: Band Two Legs Calf Raise - (Band Under Both Legs) V. 2

name: Seated Underhand Band Pulldown with Torso Lean
instructions: Anchor the band high in front of a sturdy seat and sit with your feet on the floor.
Hold both handles with your palms facing you and your arms reaching up toward the anchor.
Pull your elbows down beside your ribs as you lean back slightly, bringing the handles toward your upper chest.
Extend your arms and return your torso upright slowly.
description: Pull high band handles toward the upper chest while sitting and leaning back slightly. The palms-up grip involves the lats and biceps.

name: Band-Resisted V-Up
instructions: Anchor a band low beyond your feet and fasten it securely around both ankles.
Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead.
Raise your legs and upper body together, reaching your hands toward your feet as you balance on your hips.
Lower your torso, arms and legs slowly toward the starting position.
description: Lift the legs and torso together into a V shape with a band resisting the feet. The abdominals and hip flexors lift the body from the floor.

name: Overhead Band Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band to one side around chest height and stand sideways to it with your feet apart.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your chest and gently tighten your abdomen.
Press your hands upward until your arms are overhead, keeping your hips and chest facing forward.
Bring your hands back to your chest with control, then face the other direction.
description: Raise the hands overhead while resisting a band pulling from the side. The trunk muscles keep the body facing forward during the arm movement.

name: Seated Single-Arm Band Wrist Curl
instructions: Secure a band low in front of a sturdy seat and hold the handle in one hand.
Sit with that forearm resting on your thigh, palm up and wrist just beyond the knee. Use your other hand to steady the arm.
Keep your forearm still and bend your wrist to bring the handle upward.
Lower the handle slowly by extending your wrist, then change hands.
description: Curl one wrist upward with the forearm supported on the thigh. The band loads the wrist flexors in the forearm.

name: Anchored Band Y-Raise
instructions: Secure the band low in front of you and hold a handle in each hand with your arms down.
Stand tall with your knees relaxed and your abdomen gently tightened.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and raise your arms forward and outward into a Y shape overhead.
Lower your hands slowly toward your thighs without leaning your torso backward.
description: Lift both arms into a wide overhead Y against a low-anchored band. This works the shoulders and muscles that rotate the shoulder blades upward.

name: Single-Arm Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold the center of a light barbell in one hand with your palm facing forward.
Let your arm hang beside your body and balance the bar level.
Bend your elbow to curl the bar toward your shoulder without swinging your torso.
Lower the bar slowly, then change hands.
description: Curl a barbell with one hand gripping its center. The biceps bend the elbow while the forearm controls the balance of the long bar.

name: Barbell Front Squat to Bench
instructions: Set a stable flat bench behind you and hold the bar across the fronts of your shoulders.
Cross your arms over the bar to steady it, keep your elbows lifted and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart in front of the bench.
Bend your hips and knees until you sit lightly on the bench, keeping tension through your legs and torso.
Push through both feet to stand without rocking backward on the bench.
description: Squat to a bench while holding the barbell across the fronts of the shoulders. The bench defines the bottom position while the quadriceps and glutes lift the body.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench beneath the racked bar with your feet firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift it clear of the rack and steady it above your chest with your shoulder blades supported on the bench.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your chest without bouncing it.
Press the bar upward until your arms are straight, then return it securely to the rack when finished.
description: Press a barbell above the chest while lying on a flat bench. The chest, triceps and front shoulders work together to raise the bar.

name: Barbell Back Squat to Bench
instructions: Position a stable flat bench behind you and hold the bar across your upper back, below the neck.
Grip the bar firmly and stand in front of the bench.
Bend your hips and knees to sit lightly on the bench with your feet planted.
Gently tighten your abdomen and press through both feet to stand without rocking.
description: Lower into a seated touch on a bench with a barbell across the upper back. The quadriceps and glutes drive the return to standing.

name: Barbell Bent-Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your head supported and your feet on the floor.
Hold a barbell above your chest with a palms-away grip about shoulder-width apart.
Lower your upper arms behind your head as you bend your elbows, keeping your ribs from lifting sharply.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, then bring the bar back above your chest as you straighten your elbows.
description: Move a barbell behind the head and back above the chest while lying on a flat bench. The chest and lats move the upper arms while the triceps help straighten the elbows.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with a palms-back grip just wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips backward and lean forward while keeping your back shape steady.
Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen by driving your elbows behind you.
Lower the bar until your arms are straight while keeping the same torso angle.
description: Pull the barbell toward the torso while holding a forward hip hinge. The upper back and lats row the weight with help from the biceps.

name: Barbell Curl with Arm Blaster
instructions: Fit the arm blaster against your torso and rest the backs of your upper arms against it.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing forward and your arms extended down.
Bend both elbows to curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms against the support.
Lower the bar slowly without leaning backward.
description: Curl a barbell while an arm blaster supports the upper arms against the torso. The support limits upper-arm movement during the biceps curl.

name: Barbell Clean and Press
instructions: Stand close to the bar with your feet about hip-width apart, then bend your hips and knees to grip it just outside your legs.
Tighten your abdomen and push through your feet to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs.
As the bar passes your thighs, extend your hips and knees, then turn your elbows under it to receive it on the fronts of your shoulders with a small knee bend.
Stand upright and press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it to your shoulders, then guide it down past your thighs and back to the floor by bending your hips and knees.
description: Lift a barbell from the floor to the fronts of the shoulders, then press it overhead. This combines a leg-and-hip-driven clean with an upper-body press.

name: Barbell Clean-Grip Front Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on the fronts of your shoulders, with your fingers under the bar and elbows pointing forward.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend your knees and hips to lower between your feet, keeping your heels planted and elbows lifted.
Push through both feet to stand.
description: Squat with the bar resting on the fronts of the shoulders and the elbows lifted in a clean grip. The quadriceps and glutes extend the knees and hips to stand.

name: Barbell Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and take a palms-away grip around shoulder width or slightly narrower.
Unrack the bar and hold it above your chest with your wrists stacked over your forearms.
Lower it toward your chest, keeping your elbows closer to your sides than in a wide-grip press.
Press the bar back up without bouncing, then return it to the rack after the set.
description: Press a barbell from a flat bench with a narrower hand position. The triceps work with the chest and front shoulders to straighten the arms.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with your palms facing forward and your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms close to your sides and let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without swinging your body or moving your elbows far forward.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Bend both elbows to raise a barbell from the thighs toward the shoulders. The biceps do the main lifting while the forearms maintain the grip.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand close to the bar with your feet about hip-width apart and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Bend your hips and knees and grip the bar just outside your legs with your arms straight.
Tighten your abdomen and push through the floor, raising your hips and shoulders together while keeping the bar close.
Stand tall without leaning backward, then push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the bar to the floor.
description: Lift a barbell from the floor by extending the hips and knees. The glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps and back muscles work together to raise and steady the load.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured by its supports.
Grip the racked bar with your palms facing away and hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Unrack it and lower it toward your lower chest with your forearms supporting the bar.
Press upward until your arms are straight without bouncing off your chest.
Return the bar securely to the rack before releasing it.
description: Press a barbell above the chest with the head lower than the hips on a decline bench. The chest and triceps drive the press.

name: Barbell Decline Bent-Arm Pullover
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie with your head lower than your hips.
Hold the bar above your chest with a palms-away grip about shoulder-width apart.
Move your upper arms behind your head while bending your elbows, stopping before your ribs or back lift excessively.
Bring your arms forward and straighten your elbows to return the bar above your chest.
description: Lower a barbell behind the head with bent elbows on a decline bench. Bring it back over the chest using the chest, lats and triceps.

name: Barbell Decline Close-Grip Triceps Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and hold a bar above your chest using a narrow palms-away grip.
Bend your elbows and let your upper arms lower slightly, guiding the bar toward your face and upper chest.
Stop short of contact and keep your elbows directed forward rather than spreading them wide.
Straighten your elbows and raise your upper arms to return the bar to its starting position.
description: Lower a close-grip bar toward the face and upper chest while lying on a decline bench. The elbows bend and the upper arms move slightly as the triceps control the press.
aliases: Barbell Decline Close Grip to Skull Press

name: Barbell Decline Straight-Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and hold a bar above your chest with a palms-away grip.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and hold that angle as you lower the bar behind your head.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range without lifting your ribs off the bench.
Pull your arms forward to bring the bar back above your chest.
description: Move a barbell in an arc behind the head while keeping a small, steady elbow bend on a decline bench. The chest and lats move the upper arms through the arc.

name: Barbell Decline Wide-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and grip the racked bar wider than shoulder width.
Lift the bar over your chest, keeping your shoulder blades supported.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your chest under control, keeping your wrists above your forearms.
Press the bar upward and return it to the rack after the set.
description: Use a wide grip to press a barbell from a decline bench. The chest works with the triceps and shoulders to move the bar.

name: Barbell Decline Wide-Grip Pullover
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and your head below your hips.
Hold a barbell above your chest with your hands wider than shoulder width and palms facing away.
Maintain a small elbow bend as you lower the bar behind your head through a comfortable shoulder range.
Bring your arms forward to return the bar above your chest without arching your back.
description: Perform a pullover on a decline bench with a wide grip. The chest and lats move the arms from behind the head back over the torso.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows and slide them backward, drawing the bar upward close to your body.
Stop when you can no longer raise the bar without lifting your elbows forward or shrugging.
Lower the bar along the same close path and let your elbows return beside your torso.
description: Curl a barbell close to the torso while moving the elbows backward. This changes the path of the bar compared with a regular biceps curl.

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Hold a barbell across your upper back, keeping it off your neck.
Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold the bar firmly.
Keep your knees nearly straight and rise onto the balls of both feet.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
description: Lift both heels from the floor with a barbell across the upper back. The calves raise and lower the body against the added load.

name: Barbell Chest-Held Squat
instructions: Hold a light barbell against the front of your shoulders with your palms facing forward and elbows bent below it.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and keep the bar close to your chest.
Bend your hips and knees to lower into a squat, keeping your heels on the floor.
Press through both feet to stand without letting the bar move away from your torso.
description: Squat while holding a barbell at the front of the shoulders with the elbows below the bar. The quadriceps and glutes lift the body while the arms support the front load.

name: Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing your body.
Keep a small, fixed bend in your elbows and gently tighten your abdomen.
Raise the bar forward until your arms reach about shoulder height without swinging or leaning back.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.
description: Raise a barbell in front of the body to shoulder height. The front shoulders lift the arms while the torso stays steady.

name: Lying Barbell Front Raise and Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and hold a barbell above your upper thighs with your palms facing your legs.
Keep a small, steady bend in your elbows as you raise the bar over your chest.
Continue the arc behind your head within a comfortable shoulder range, keeping your torso supported.
Reverse the arc to return the bar toward your thighs without resting or bouncing it on your body.
description: Move a barbell from near the thighs through an overhead arc while lying on a bench. The shoulders, chest and lats control the long arm movement.

name: Barbell Cross-Arm Front Squat
instructions: Set the bar on the fronts of your shoulders and cross your arms over it to steady it with your hands.
Lift your elbows forward and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat by bending your hips and knees, keeping your heels planted and chest lifted.
Push through both feet to stand.
description: Squat with a barbell on the fronts of the shoulders and the arms crossed over it. The quadriceps and glutes raise the body while the high elbows keep the bar supported.

name: Barbell Deep Back Squat
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, below your neck, and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest lifted and gently tighten your abdomen as you bend your knees and hips.
Lower your hips below knee height only as far as you can keep your heels down and control your back position.
Push through both feet to stand.
description: Lower into a deep squat with a barbell across the upper back. The quadriceps and glutes extend the legs to return to standing.

name: Barbell Deep Back Squat, Rear View
instructions: Stand with the bar across your upper back and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Keep the bar level and your knees tracking in the same direction as your feet as you lower your hips.
Continue into a controlled deep squat with both heels planted.
Press evenly through both feet to stand.
description: This rear view shows a deep barbell back squat. Both legs work together as the quadriceps and glutes lower and raise the body.

name: Barbell Deep Back Squat, Side View
instructions: Hold a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bend your hips and knees to lower, keeping the bar balanced over your feet.
Descend into a deep squat only as far as your heels stay planted and you can control your torso.
Extend your hips and knees together to stand.
description: This side view shows the hip and knee motion in a deep barbell back squat. The quadriceps and glutes drive the return to standing.

name: Barbell Zercher Squat
instructions: Hold a barbell in the bends of both elbows.
Keep your forearms raised and the bar close to your torso, standing with your feet apart.
Bend your hips and knees to squat between your feet while keeping the bar steady in your elbows.
Push through both feet to stand.
description: Squat with a barbell cradled in the bends of the elbows. The front load challenges the trunk while the quadriceps and glutes move the legs.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Position a light barbell securely across your hip crease before placing your hands on the floor beside you. Keep your hands on the bar instead if it will not stay stable.
Gently tighten your abdomen and press through your feet to lift your hips until your torso and thighs form a line.
Lower your hips under control without overextending your lower back.
description: Lift the hips from the floor with a light barbell across the hip crease and the hands on the floor beside you. The glutes extend the hips while the upper back stays down.

name: Barbell Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and both heels supported on a stable flat bench.
Place the barbell across your hip crease and hold it steady with both hands.
Press your heels into the bench and lift your hips, keeping your upper back on the floor.
Stop when your hips line up with your torso and thighs, then lower slowly.
description: Lift the hips with both heels supported on a bench and the upper back on the floor. The barbell adds resistance across the hips for the glutes and hamstrings.
aliases: Barbell Glute Bridge Two Legs on Bench (Male)

name: Barbell Good Morning
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back and your feet about hip-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and tighten your abdomen.
Push your hips backward as you lower your torso, keeping your back shape steady and the bar secure.
Stop at a range you can control, then bring your hips forward to stand without leaning backward.
description: Hinge forward at the hips with a barbell across the upper back. The hamstrings, glutes and back muscles control the forward lean and return.

name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and grip the racked bar with your hands wider than shoulder width.
Unrack a manageable load and steady it above your upper chest.
Bend your elbows out to the sides and lower the bar toward the base of your neck, stopping before it contacts your neck.
Press the bar upward under control and rack it securely after the set.
description: Lower a barbell toward the upper chest near the base of the neck with the elbows flared. This chest press uses a higher bar path than a standard bench press.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
instructions: Stand just in front of a barbell on the floor with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and hips to grip the bar behind your legs with your arms straight.
Push through your feet to stand, letting the bar travel close behind your calves and thighs.
Bend your knees and hips to lower the bar back toward the floor without rounding forward.
description: Lift a barbell held behind the legs by straightening the knees and hips. This behind-the-body squat works the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Barbell High-Bar Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on the muscular upper back just below your neck and grip it firmly.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat while keeping your chest lifted, heels down and knees aligned with your feet.
Press through both feet to stand.
description: Squat with the bar positioned high on the upper back. The quadriceps and glutes work together as the knees and hips bend and straighten.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench beneath the rack with your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders with your palms facing away.
Unrack it and lower it toward your upper chest, keeping your shoulder blades supported.
Press upward until your arms are straight, then rack the bar after the set.
description: Press a barbell from an incline bench. The chest, front shoulders and triceps raise the bar above the upper torso.

name: Barbell Incline Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and take a palms-away grip around shoulder width or slightly narrower.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your upper chest with your wrists supported over your forearms.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to lower the bar toward your upper chest.
Press it back up smoothly and return it to the rack when finished.
description: Press from an incline bench with the hands close together. The triceps assist the chest and shoulders throughout the press.
aliases: Barbell Incline Close Grip Bench Press

name: Barbell Incline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Take a secure grip on the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with your palms facing toward your head.
Hold the bar above your upper torso and lower it toward your chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Press upward under control without letting the bar roll in your hands.
description: Press a barbell while reclined on an incline bench with the palms facing toward the head. This reverse grip changes the arm position while the chest, triceps and shoulders press.

name: Barbell Chest-Supported Incline Row
instructions: Lie face down along an incline bench with your chest against the pad and your feet braced on the floor.
Hold a barbell below you with your palms facing back and arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, driving your elbows back while keeping your chest on the pad.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms extend again.
description: Row a barbell while lying face down against an incline bench. The bench supports the torso while the upper back, lats and biceps pull.

name: Barbell Incline Serratus Reach
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet supported on the floor and a barbell held above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and the bar balanced over your shoulders.
Reach the bar slightly higher by moving your shoulders forward off the pad, without turning it into an elbow press.
Let your shoulder blades settle back against the bench under control.
description: Reach a barbell upward by moving the shoulder blades while keeping the elbows straight. The serratus anterior helps move the shoulder blades forward around the rib cage.

name: Barbell Jefferson Squat
instructions: Stand astride a barbell with one foot in front of the shaft and the other behind it, using a comfortable slightly turned stance.
Bend your knees and hips to take the bar with one hand in front and the other behind your body.
Keep your arms straight and press through both feet to stand, lifting the bar between your legs.
Lower the bar under control and keep the same stance for the repetitions, then change which foot is forward.
description: Lift a barbell from a straddled stance with one hand in front of the body and one behind. The legs extend while the trunk keeps the offset load controlled.

name: Barbell Jm Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and hold the bar above your chest with a close palms-away grip.
Bend your elbows forward as you lower the bar toward the upper chest near your chin, letting the upper arms lower somewhat.
Stop before the bar contacts your face or neck and keep the movement controlled.
Straighten your elbows to return the bar above your chest.
description: Lower a barbell toward the upper chest and chin with a close grip and deeply bent elbows. The JM press blends a triceps extension with a short pressing movement.

name: Barbell Jump Squat
instructions: Set a light barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar firmly and lower into a controlled squat.
Extend your hips, knees and ankles to jump straight upward while keeping the bar against your back.
Land on both feet with your knees and hips bending to absorb the landing, then regain control before the next jump.
description: Jump from a squat with a barbell across the upper back. The legs drive the jump and absorb the landing while the bar stays secure.

name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Take a barbell onto your upper back and stand with your feet close to hip width.
Step out to one side and bend that knee, sending your hips back while keeping the other leg straight.
Keep the bar level and the stepping foot flat as you lower into the side lunge.
Push through that foot to return to standing. Complete the set on that side, then switch legs.
description: Step sideways into a lunge while holding a barbell across the upper back. The stepping leg bends while the other leg stays straighter.

name: Barbell Low-Bar Back Squat
instructions: Hold the bar across the rear shoulders below the top of the upper back with a firm grip.
Stand with your feet apart and tighten your abdomen to support your torso.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat, allowing a controlled forward torso lean while keeping your heels down.
Drive through both feet to stand without letting your hips rise much faster than your chest.
description: Squat with the bar resting lower on the upper back, across the rear shoulders. The torso leans forward as the hips and knees bend.

name: Barbell Forward Lunge
instructions: Hold a barbell across your upper back and stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
Take a controlled step forward and bend both knees, lowering the back knee toward the floor.
Keep the front foot planted and your torso steady as you lower.
Push through the front foot to return to the start. Complete the set with the same leg, then switch legs.
description: Step forward into a lunge with the barbell across the upper back, then return to standing. The front leg uses the quadriceps and glutes to control the descent and push back.

name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension behind Head
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and hold a barbell above your chest with your palms facing away.
Bend your elbows to guide the bar behind the top of your head, allowing the upper arms to angle back slightly.
Stop within a comfortable elbow and shoulder range without letting the bar strike the bench.
Straighten your elbows and return the bar above your upper chest.
description: Bend the elbows to lower a barbell behind the head while lying on a flat bench. The triceps straighten the arms to bring the bar back above the upper body.
aliases: Barbell Lying Back of the Head Tricep Extension

name: Barbell Close-Grip Bench Press with Tucked Elbows
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and grip the racked bar with your palms toward your feet and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it above your chest.
Lower the bar toward the lower chest with your elbows kept close to your sides and your wrists stacked over your forearms.
Press up smoothly, then return the bar to the rack when finished.
description: Press a barbell from a flat bench with a narrow grip and elbows close to the torso. The triceps work with the chest and front shoulders.

name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension with Arms Angled Back
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold a barbell with a close palms-away grip.
Angle your upper arms back toward your head and keep them in that position.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, stopping before it touches the bench or floor.
Straighten your elbows along the same angled path without bringing your upper arms forward over your chest.
description: Extend the elbows while keeping the upper arms angled toward the head. The bar stays behind the upper body throughout this triceps extension.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher on Rack Bench
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and take a palms-away grip about shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar above your upper chest with your elbows pointing upward.
Keep your upper arms steady as you bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, stopping short of contact.
Straighten your elbows to lift the bar, then return it securely to the rack after the set.
description: Bend and straighten the elbows with a barbell above the face while lying on a flat rack bench. The triceps control the bar through this short arc.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit in front of a stable flat bench with your upper back against its edge and your knees bent.
Position a barbell across your hip crease and hold it steady with both hands.
Keep your feet flat and press through them to lift your hips until your torso and thighs form a line, with your upper back supported on the bench.
Lower your hips slowly in front of the bench without sliding your shoulders off it.
