description: Raise the hips with the upper back supported on a bench and a barbell across the hip crease. The glutes extend the hips while the feet stay on the floor.

name: Barbell Prone Flat-Bench Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your chest supported and your feet on the floor.
Hold a barbell below the front of the bench with your palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms hanging down as you curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the arms hanging below a flat bench while lying face down. The bench supports the torso while the biceps bend the elbows.

name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension to Forehead
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and hold a bar above your upper chest using a palms-away grip.
Keep your elbows directed upward and your upper arms steady.
Bend your elbows to bring the bar toward your forehead without touching it.
Straighten your elbows under control to return the bar above you.
description: Lower a barbell toward the forehead by bending the elbows. The upper arms remain nearly upright as the triceps straighten the arms again.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and plant your feet on the floor.
Hold a barbell above your upper chest with a close palms-away grip and straight arms.
Keep the upper arms nearly still while you bend your elbows, lowering the bar just above your forehead.
Straighten your arms slowly without swinging the bar or letting it contact your head.
description: Extend the elbows from a bent position above the forehead while lying on a bench. This movement works the triceps with the torso supported.
aliases: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension Skull Crusher

name: Barbell Narrow-Stance Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and stand with your feet closer than shoulder width.
Keep your feet planted and tighten your abdomen.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat, letting your knees follow the direction of your feet.
Press through both feet to stand without allowing your heels to lift.
description: Squat with a narrower-than-usual foot position and the barbell across the upper back. The quadriceps and glutes bend and straighten the legs.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row
instructions: Secure one end of a barbell in a landmine anchor and stand beside the loaded end.
Push your hips back and lean forward with your knees slightly bent, gripping the shaft near the weight with the nearer hand.
Keep your torso steady and pull the bar toward your hip by driving your elbow back.
Lower until your arm extends, then change sides.
description: Row the loaded end of an anchored barbell with one hand. The upper back and lats pull while the other end stays fixed near the floor.
aliases: Barbell One Arm Bent over Row

name: Single-Arm Barbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your free hand on the floor beside you.
Hold the center of a light barbell in one hand above your chest, balancing it level with your wrist over your elbow.
Bend the elbow close to your side until your upper arm lightly meets the floor.
Press the bar up again without twisting your torso, then change arms.
description: Press a light barbell with one hand while lying on the floor with the legs extended. The triceps and chest press while the forearm controls the bar balance.

name: Single-Arm Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
instructions: Stand beside the center of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees and grip the center of the bar with the hand nearest it.
Tighten your abdomen and push through both feet to stand, keeping the bar level and your shoulders even.
Lower the bar to the floor with control, then switch sides.
description: Lift a barbell beside the body with one hand while both legs extend. The offset load also challenges the trunk to resist leaning sideways.

name: Single-Arm Barbell Snatch
instructions: Stand over the bar with your feet apart and grip its center with one hand, palm facing toward you.
Bend your hips and knees, tighten your abdomen and lift the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees forcefully, then guide the elbow upward as the bar rises.
Move under the bar and bend your knees to receive it overhead with your working arm straight.
Stand tall with the bar balanced, then lower it under control and repeat on the other side.
description: Lift a barbell from the floor to a one-arm overhead position in a continuous explosive movement. The legs and hips drive the bar while the shoulder and grip control the catch.

name: Barbell Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Take the bar onto your upper back and stand in front of a stable flat bench.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you, with the front foot far enough forward to lower between your legs.
Bend the front knee and lower your hips while keeping that heel planted.
Push through the front foot to stand, then change legs.
description: Squat on the front leg with the rear foot resting on a bench and a barbell across the upper back. The front quadriceps and glutes do most of the lifting.

name: Barbell Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell overhead using a wide grip.
Keep your elbows straight and the bar balanced over the middle of your feet.
Bend your hips and knees to lower into a squat without letting the bar drift forward.
Push through both feet to stand while maintaining the overhead position.
description: Squat while keeping a barbell overhead with a wide grip. The legs move the body while the shoulders and trunk stabilize the bar.

name: Kneeling Barbell Wrist Extension over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest both forearms on its pad with your wrists just beyond the edge.
Hold a light barbell with your palms facing down.
Keep your forearms against the bench and lift the backs of your hands by extending your wrists.
Lower the bar through a controlled wrist movement without lifting your forearms.
description: Raise a barbell with palms facing down while the forearms rest on a bench. The wrist extensors lift the hands without moving the elbows.
aliases: Barbell Palms Down Wrist Curl over a Bench

name: Kneeling Barbell Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest your forearms on the pad with your wrists beyond its edge.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing up and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your forearms still and curl your hands upward toward your forearms.
Lower the bar slowly as your wrists extend.
description: Curl the wrists with the palms up and forearms supported on a bench. The wrist flexors raise and lower the barbell.
aliases: Barbell Palms Up Wrist Curl over a Bench

name: Barbell Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand over the bar with your feet apart and bend your hips and knees until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing back and hands just wider than shoulder width.
Keep your torso angle steady and pull the bar toward your upper abdomen.
Lower it to the floor and let it settle before beginning the next pull.
description: Row a barbell from the floor with the torso close to horizontal. Each repetition starts from a settled bar while the upper back, lats and biceps pull.

name: Barbell Bench Pin Press
instructions: Place a flat bench inside a power rack and set the safety pins so the bar starts above your chest.
Lie on the bench with your feet planted and grip the bar with your palms facing away.
Press the bar off the pins until your arms are straight, keeping your shoulders supported.
Lower it gently onto the pins and let it settle before the next press.
description: Press a barbell upward from safety pins while lying on a flat bench inside a rack. The pins limit the bottom of the pressing range.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and adjust your position so the backs of your upper arms rest on the pad.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up and arms nearly straight.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without lifting your upper arms from the pad.
Lower slowly to the starting position without forcing your elbows straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the upper arms supported on a preacher pad. The biceps bend the elbows while the pad limits upper-arm movement.

name: Barbell Decline Sit-Up to Overhead Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back holding a barbell near your chest.
Tighten your abdomen and raise your torso from the bench.
As you sit upright, press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Bring the bar back toward your chest as you lower your torso onto the bench under control.
description: Sit up from a decline bench while pressing a barbell overhead. This combination uses the abdominals and hip flexors for the sit-up and the shoulders and triceps for the press.

name: Barbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Lie face down against an incline bench with your feet securely supported near the base of the bench.
Hold a barbell below your shoulders with your palms facing forward.
Keep your chest against the pad and curl the bar upward without swinging your upper arms.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the torso supported face down on an incline bench. The arms hang below the shoulders as the biceps bend the elbows.

name: Barbell Pullover with Feet on Bench
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your knees bent and both feet resting on the bench.
Hold a barbell above your chest with your palms facing away and a small bend in the elbows.
Keep that elbow angle as you lower the bar behind your head within a comfortable range.
Bring the bar back above your chest without lifting your ribs or hips from the bench.
description: Perform a pullover with both feet resting on the bench and the knees bent. The chest and lats control the bar as it moves behind the head and back above the torso.

name: Barbell Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold a barbell above your chest.
Grip the bar with your palms facing away and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your chest, keeping your shoulders supported.
Press the bar upward until your arms are straight without bouncing it off your chest.
description: Lower a barbell toward the chest and press it back up while lying on a flat bench. The chest and triceps raise the bar.

name: Barbell Rack Pull
instructions: Set a barbell on the supports of a power rack around knee height or slightly below.
Stand close, bend your hips and knees slightly and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Tighten your abdomen and extend your hips and knees to stand tall without leaning back.
Push your hips back and lower the bar gently onto both supports before the next repetition.
description: Lift a barbell from elevated safety supports to standing. The shorter deadlift range works the hips and back while the bar stays close to the legs.

name: Barbell Behind-The-Back Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your thighs with your palms facing backward.
Keep your torso upright and the bar close to the backs of your legs.
Bend your elbows and draw them backward and upward, raising the bar toward the back of your waist.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: Pull a barbell upward behind the hips while standing upright. The rear shoulders and upper back move the elbows backward as they bend.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with a palms-back grip wider than shoulder width.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back and lean forward until your torso is nearly horizontal.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest while lifting your elbows out to the sides.
Lower the bar under control without changing your torso angle.
description: Row a barbell toward the upper chest with the elbows spread wide. The rear shoulders and upper back move the arms outward and back.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and land on the ball of that foot.
Bend both knees while keeping the front foot flat and your torso steady.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions, then change legs.
description: Step backward into a lunge with a barbell across the upper back. The front quadriceps and glutes control the lowering and return.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge from Step
instructions: Stand on a stable low step with a barbell across your upper back.
Reach one foot backward off the step and place its toes on the floor.
Bend both knees to lower, keeping the foot on the step fully planted.
Push through the elevated front foot to bring the rear foot back onto the step.
Complete the repetitions, then change legs.
description: Step backward off a low platform into a lunge while carrying a barbell across the upper back. The elevated front foot increases the available lowering range.

name: Seated Barbell Wrist Extension on Thighs
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold a light barbell with your palms down.
Lean forward and rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just beyond your knees.
Keep your forearms still and lift the backs of your hands toward your forearms.
Lower the bar slowly by letting your wrists bend downward.
description: Extend the wrists with the forearms resting on the thighs and palms facing down. The forearm muscles raise the bar through a small arc.

name: Barbell Reverse Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and grip the racked bar around shoulder width with your palms toward your head.
Unrack the bar with a secure grip and hold it above your chest.
Lower toward your chest with your elbows close to your body, keeping the bar from rolling in your hands.
Press upward and rack the bar securely after the set.
description: Press a barbell from a flat bench with a narrow palms-toward-head grip. The triceps, chest and shoulders work together during the press.

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing your body.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso and wrists in line with your forearms.
Bend both elbows to raise the bar toward your shoulders without swinging your back.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the palms facing down. The elbow flexors lift the bar while the forearms maintain the overhand grip.

name: Barbell Underhand Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with your palms facing forward and your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back and lean forward while keeping your back shape steady.
Pull the bar toward your abdomen with your elbows traveling close to your sides.
Lower it slowly until your arms extend without changing your torso angle.
description: Row a barbell toward the abdomen with an underhand grip and a forward hip hinge. The upper back, lats and biceps pull the bar close to the body.
aliases: Barbell Reverse Grip Bent over Row

name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and secure your legs in its supports.
Take a firm grip on the racked bar slightly wider than shoulder width, with your palms facing your head.
Unrack it and lower it toward your chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar upward under control and return it securely to the rack.
description: Press a barbell on a decline bench using a palms-toward-head grip. The chest, triceps and shoulders move the bar while the legs stay secured.
aliases: Barbell Reverse Grip Decline Bench Press

name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Incline Bench Press from Rack
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet supported and take a reverse grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your palms facing your head and hold the bar securely as you lift it from the rack.
Lower it toward your upper chest with your elbows near your sides.
Press it upward without letting it roll in your hands, then return it to the rack.
description: Press from an incline bench with a reverse grip. The palms face toward the head while the chest, shoulders and triceps lift the bar.
aliases: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Press

name: Barbell Underhand Chest-Supported Incline Row
instructions: Lie face down against an incline bench with your feet braced on the floor.
Hold the bar below your shoulders using an underhand grip with your palms facing forward.
Keep your chest on the pad and draw your elbows back to pull the bar toward your upper abdomen.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: Row with the chest supported on an incline bench and the palms facing forward. The lats, upper back and biceps pull the bar toward the torso.
aliases: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Row

name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and hold the bar above your chest with your palms toward your head.
Keep your grip secure, wrists steady and upper arms nearly upright.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead without touching it.
Straighten the elbows to lift the bar back to the start.
description: Extend the elbows while holding a barbell with the palms facing toward the head. The triceps work through the same bending and straightening motion with a reverse grip.

name: Barbell Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms resting on the pad.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down and let your arms extend nearly straight.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without lifting your upper arms off the pad.
Lower it slowly while keeping your wrists steady.
description: Curl a barbell on a preacher bench with a palms-down grip. The elbow flexors raise the bar while the forearms control the grip and wrist position.

name: Seated Barbell Wrist Extension over Bench
instructions: Sit astride a flat bench and lean forward with your forearms resting on its pad and wrists extending beyond the end.
Hold a light barbell with your palms facing down.
Raise your hands by extending your wrists while keeping your elbows and forearms supported.
Lower the bar through the same small wrist arc.
description: Lift a barbell by extending the wrists with the forearms supported on a flat bench. The palms stay down throughout this forearm movement.
aliases: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl over Bench

name: Kneeling Barbell Rollout
instructions: Kneel on the floor and grip a barbell fitted with round plates that can roll freely.
Place the bar under your shoulders and gently tighten your abdomen.
Roll it forward, letting your hips and arms extend only as far as you can prevent your lower back from sagging.
Pull the bar back toward your knees while keeping your torso controlled.
description: Roll a barbell forward from the knees while keeping the trunk controlled. The abdominals resist the body sagging as the arms reach farther away.

name: Barbell Rollout with Knees on Bench
instructions: Kneel near the end of a stable flat bench with a barbell and round plates on the floor in front of it.
Grip the bar with both hands and hold your abdomen firm.
Roll the bar forward along the floor as your body lengthens from your knees, stopping before your lower back sags.
Draw the bar back toward the bench with control.
description: Roll a barbell along the floor while kneeling on an elevated bench. The longer reach challenges the abdominals to keep the trunk from sagging.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a barbell against the fronts of your thighs with your feet about hip-width apart.
Keep a small knee bend and push your hips backward as you lower the bar close to your legs.
Stop when you can no longer push your hips back without rounding your back or bending your knees further.
Press through your feet and bring your hips forward to stand tall.
description: Lower a barbell along the legs by pushing the hips back, then stand again. The hamstrings and glutes control this hip hinge.

name: Seated Barbell Behind-Neck Press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet firmly planted and hold a barbell above your head using a wide palms-forward grip.
Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower the bar behind your head through a comfortable shoulder range.
Keep your head neutral and avoid pushing your neck forward to clear the bar.
Press upward until your arms are straight without arching your lower back.
description: Press a barbell overhead from behind the head while seated on a bench. The shoulders and triceps lift the bar with the torso upright.
aliases: Barbell Seated behind Head Military Press

name: Seated Barbell Front-And-Back Overhead Press
instructions: Sit against an upright bench backrest with your feet planted and hold the bar in front of your shoulders using a wide palms-forward grip.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it behind your head only as far as your shoulders allow without forcing your neck forward.
Press it overhead again and lower it to the front of your shoulders to continue the sequence.
description: Alternate lowering a barbell in front of and behind the head while pressing overhead from a seated position. The shoulders and triceps work through both pressing paths.

name: Seated Barbell Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet on the floor beneath your knees.
Rest a barbell across your thighs just above the knees and steady it with your hands.
Keep the balls of both feet on the floor and raise your heels.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
description: Lift the heels while seated with a barbell across the thighs. The forefeet remain on the floor as the calves raise the load.

name: Seated Barbell Calf Raise on Weight Plate
instructions: Sit on a flat bench and place the balls of both feet on a stable flat weight plate with the heels free.
Rest a barbell across your thighs above the knees and hold it steady.
Push through the forefeet to raise your heels as high as you can control.
Lower your heels slowly through a comfortable range below the plate edge.
description: Raise and lower the heels with the forefeet elevated on a weight plate. A barbell across the thighs provides the calf-raise resistance.

name: Seated Barbell Close-Grip Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with your feet planted and hold a barbell overhead with a close grip.
Keep your upper arms beside your head and your abdomen gently tightened.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head without dropping your upper arms.
Straighten your elbows to return the bar overhead.
description: Bend and straighten the elbows behind the head while seated and holding the bar with a close grip. The triceps raise the bar overhead.
aliases: Barbell Seated Close Grip behind Neck Triceps Extension

name: Seated Barbell Close-Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit near the end of a flat bench with your feet wide apart and lean forward.
Hold a barbell with your palms up and hands close together, resting your upper arms against your inner thighs.
Keep your arms braced and bend your elbows to curl the bar upward.
Lower it slowly without lifting your torso or swinging the bar.
description: Curl a barbell between the legs with the upper arms braced against the inner thighs. This seated close-grip curl limits upper-arm movement.

name: Barbell Seated Good Morning
instructions: Sit on a stable flat bench with your feet apart and planted, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Tighten your abdomen and keep the bar securely in place.
Lean your torso forward from the hips through a comfortable range while keeping your hips on the bench.
Raise your torso back upright without rocking or leaning backward.
description: Lean forward from the hips while seated with a barbell across the upper back, then return upright. The hip extensors and back muscles control the loaded torso.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet apart and firmly on the floor.
Hold the bar at the front of your shoulders with a palms-forward grip just wider than shoulder width.
Press it overhead while keeping your abdomen firm and avoiding a backward lean.
Lower it slowly to the front of your shoulders.
description: Press a barbell from the front of the shoulders while sitting upright on a bench. The shoulders and triceps lift the bar without leg drive.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit tall on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold a barbell overhead with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and your torso steady.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head within a comfortable range.
Straighten the elbows to raise the bar without arching your lower back.
description: Lower a barbell behind the head and straighten the elbows while sitting on a flat bench. The triceps work while the upper arms stay raised.

name: Seated Barbell Trunk Rotation
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet planted and a light barbell across your upper back.
Hold the bar steady and keep your hips facing forward.
Turn your chest slowly to one side through a comfortable range without pulling yourself farther with the bar.
Return to the center under control. Complete the repetitions, then turn toward the other side.
description: Turn the torso to one side and return with a barbell across the upper back. The hips remain seated while the obliques control the rotation.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing back.
Keep your elbows straight and your torso upright.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears without rolling them or bending your arms.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
description: Raise the shoulders with a barbell held in front of the thighs. The upper trapezius lifts and lowers the shoulder blades.

name: Barbell Side Bend with Bar on Shoulders
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and rest a light barbell across your upper back, holding it with both hands.
Keep your hips facing forward and knees relaxed.
Bend your torso to one side through a comfortable range without turning your chest.
Return upright under control. Complete the repetitions, then repeat on the other side.
description: Bend the torso sideways with a light barbell across the shoulders. The obliques control the side bend and return.

name: Barbell Side-To-Side Squat
instructions: Hold a barbell across your upper back and take a wide stance.
Shift your hips toward one foot, bending that knee while straightening the other leg.
Keep both feet in place and move your hips across to bend the opposite knee.
Continue shifting side to side under control without standing fully upright between sides.
description: Shift from one bent leg to the other in a wide squat stance. The bar stays across the upper back as the quadriceps, glutes and adductors control the lateral movement.

name: Barbell Stationary Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand in a wide stance with a barbell across your upper back and both feet planted.
Shift your hips toward one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower through a controlled range with the bar level and your chest lifted.
Push through the bent leg to return to the upright wide stance, then work the other side.
description: Lower toward one leg from a fixed wide stance, then return to the center. The working knee bends while the opposite leg remains straighter.

name: Barbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs and shift your weight onto one foot.
Keep a small bend in that knee and lift the other foot clear.
Push the working hip back as your torso lowers and the free leg reaches behind, keeping the bar close to the standing leg.
Return to standing with control, then switch legs.
description: Hinge forward on one leg while the other leg reaches behind you. The working hamstrings and glutes control the hinge while the torso and rear leg move together.

name: Barbell Rear-Foot-Supported Split Squat
instructions: Hold the bar across your upper back and stand a stride in front of a stable flat bench.
Place one foot on the bench behind you and keep the front foot flat on the floor.
Bend both knees to lower your hips, allowing the rear knee to move down toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to rise, then switch legs.
description: Lower into a split squat with the rear foot on a flat bench. The front quadriceps and glutes extend the leg while the barbell stays across the upper back.

name: Seated Alternating Leg Raise with Overhead Barbell
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hold a light barbell overhead with both arms straight.
Keep your torso lifted and your abdomen gently tightened.
Raise one straight leg from the floor without rocking your torso, then lower it slowly.
Raise the other leg and continue alternating while keeping the bar steady.
description: Lift one straight leg at a time while sitting on the floor and holding a barbell overhead. The hip flexors raise the legs while the abdominals and shoulders stabilize the position.

name: Seated Alternating Leg Raise with Overhead Barbell
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with both legs straight and hold the bar overhead with a comfortable two-hand grip.
Keep your elbows straight and the bar balanced above you.
Lift one leg while the other remains low, keeping your hips on the floor.
Lower that leg and lift the other, continuing without swinging your back.
description: Hold a light barbell overhead while alternately lifting the extended legs from a floor-seated position. The hip flexors lift each leg while the trunk and shoulders remain steady.

name: Barbell Skier
instructions: Hold a light barbell with both hands, bend your knees and lean forward from your hips.
Let your arms hang beside your legs and keep your torso angle steady.
Keep your elbows nearly straight as you lift the bar backward behind your hips.
Lower it slowly to the hanging position without jumping or changing your hip position.
description: Sweep a barbell behind the hips with straight arms while holding a bent-over stance. The rear shoulders and lats extend the arms behind the body.

name: Barbell Speed Squat
instructions: Hold a manageable barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Tighten your abdomen and lower into a squat with control.
Push firmly through both feet to stand quickly without jumping or losing the bar position.
Regain a steady upright position before lowering into the next repetition.
description: Perform a back squat with a controlled descent and a quick, forceful rise. The quadriceps and glutes accelerate the body upward while the feet remain planted.

name: Barbell Straddle Split Squat
instructions: Straddle a barbell in a split stance with one foot forward and one back.
Grip the bar with one hand in front of your torso and one behind, keeping your arms straight.
Bend both knees to lower into a split squat while holding the bar between your legs.
Push through your feet to rise without changing the stance, then change which leg is forward.
description: Bend both legs from a split stance while holding the barbell between them. One hand grips the bar in front and the other behind the body.

name: Barbell Kneeling Squat
instructions: Kneel upright with your knees about hip-width apart and hold a barbell securely across your upper back.
Keep your abdomen gently tightened and your torso controlled.
Bend at the hips to sit back toward your heels without lifting your knees.
Squeeze your glutes to bring your hips forward and return to tall kneeling.
description: Lower the hips toward the heels and extend them again while kneeling with a barbell across the upper back. The glutes drive the hip extension while the knees stay on the floor.

name: Barbell Jump Onto Step with Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand facing a stable low step with a light barbell held securely across your upper back.
Lower into a squat and jump forward onto the step, landing on both feet with your knees bent.
Stand under control, then step one foot backward from the platform to the floor.
Bring the other foot back to the floor in front of it and bend both knees into a reverse-lunge position.
Push through the front foot to stand, reset in front of the step and change the lead leg on the next sequence.
description: Jump onto a low step with a barbell across the upper back, then step back off into a lunge. This combination uses the legs for jumping, landing and lowering into the lunge.
aliases: Barbell Squat Jump Step Rear Lunge

name: Standing Barbell Rollout
instructions: Stand behind a barbell fitted with round rolling plates, then bend forward from your hips to grip it on the floor.
Keep your feet planted and your abdomen tight as you roll the bar away from your feet.
Extend only as far as you can control without letting your lower back sag or knees touch the floor.
Pull the bar back toward your feet as your hips rise to the bent-over starting position.
description: Roll a barbell forward from a bent-over standing start into a long plank position. The abdominals resist the body sagging while the toes and rolling bar support it.

name: Barbell Behind-The-Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your thighs with your palms facing backward and a secure finger grip.
Keep your elbows straight and upper arms close to your sides.
Bend your wrists to curl the bar upward behind you without bending your elbows.
Lower the bar slowly without opening your hands enough to lose it.
description: Curl the wrists with a barbell held behind the hips. The wrist flexors raise the bar while the arms hang straight.

name: Standing Barbell Bradford Press
instructions: Stand tall with a wide grip and the bar at the front of your shoulders.
Press the bar upward just far enough to clear the top of your head, keeping some bend in your elbows.
Lower it behind your head through a comfortable range without pushing your neck forward.
Lift it back over your head and lower to the front of your shoulders.
description: Move a barbell from the front of the shoulders to behind the head by pressing it just high enough to clear the head. The elbows remain bent at the top of this shoulder movement.

name: Barbell Calf Raise on Block
instructions: Hold a barbell across your upper back and place the balls of both feet on a stable low block.
Let your heels hang clear while keeping your knees nearly straight.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels.
Lower your heels slowly through a comfortable range below the block edge.
description: Raise the heels with the forefeet on a low block and a barbell across the upper back. The calves work through a greater range than a floor calf raise.

name: Barbell Close-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with your palms forward and hands closer than shoulder width.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs with your upper arms beside your torso.
Curl the bar upward without swinging your body or pushing your elbows far forward.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the hands closer together than in a standard curl. The biceps bend the elbows while the forearms hold the bar.

name: Barbell Standing Close-Grip Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and hold the bar in front of your shoulders using a close palms-forward grip.
Keep your elbows directed forward and your abdomen firm.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight without bending your knees to drive it up.
Lower it slowly to shoulder level.
description: Press a barbell overhead with the hands closer than shoulder width and elbows forward. The shoulders and triceps lift the bar while the legs stay still.
aliases: Barbell Standing Close Grip Military Press

name: Barbell Standing Concentration Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and bend your knees and hips to lean forward.
Hold a barbell with both palms up and brace your upper arms against your inner thighs.
Keep that support as you bend both elbows to curl the bar upward.
Lower slowly without lifting your torso.
description: Curl a barbell with both hands from a bent-over stance, bracing the upper arms against the inner thighs. This position limits swinging during the biceps curl.

name: Barbell Front Raise to Overhead
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold a light barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing back.
Keep a small, steady elbow bend and gently tighten your abdomen.
Raise the bar forward and continue overhead only as far as you can without leaning backward.
Lower along the same arc with control.
description: Raise a barbell from the thighs through a forward arc until it is overhead. The shoulders lift the arms while the trunk remains steady.
aliases: Barbell Standing Front Raise over Head

name: Barbell Calf Raise on Step
instructions: Take a barbell across your upper back and step onto a stable low platform with your forefeet supported and heels free.
Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet.
Lower the heels slowly below the step edge within a comfortable range.
description: Lift the heels with both forefeet supported on the edge of a low step. A barbell across the upper back adds resistance for the calves.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and hold a barbell overhead using a comfortable close grip.
Keep your upper arms near your head and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar behind your head without moving your torso.
Straighten your elbows to lift the bar overhead again.
description: Bend and straighten the elbows with a barbell overhead while standing. The triceps move the bar behind the head and back up.

name: Standing Barbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing back.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso and your wrists in line with your forearms.
Bend your elbows to raise the bar without swinging your hips.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the palms facing down. The elbow flexors lift the bar while the forearms maintain the overhand grip.

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back and both feet flat on the floor.
Keep your knees nearly straight and hold the bar steady.
Press through the balls of your feet to lift your heels.
Lower your heels back to the floor under control.
description: Raise and lower the heels on the floor with a barbell across the upper back. The calves lift the body onto the balls of the feet.
aliases: Barbell Standing Rocking Leg Calf Raise

name: Standing Barbell Trunk Rotation
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and place a light barbell across your upper back.
Hold the bar securely and keep your knees relaxed.
Turn your chest to one side through a comfortable range without forcing the rotation.
Return to the center under control. Complete the repetitions, then turn toward the other side.
description: Turn the torso to one side and return with a light bar across the upper back. The obliques control the turn while the bar remains supported on the shoulders.

name: Barbell Wide-Grip Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a wide grip and palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows near your sides and your wrists steady.
Curl the bar toward your chest without leaning backward.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Curl a barbell with the hands wider than shoulder width and palms facing up. The biceps bend both elbows while the torso stays upright.
aliases: Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl

name: Barbell Standing Wide-Grip Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and hold the bar at the front of your shoulders with your hands wider than shoulder width.
Gently tighten your abdomen and keep your wrists above your forearms.
Press upward until your arms are straight, without using a knee dip to drive the bar.
Lower with control to the front of your shoulders.
description: Press a barbell overhead with a wide grip and elbows directed out to the sides. The shoulders and triceps lift the bar while the legs remain still.

name: Barbell Wide-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall with the bar hanging in front of your thighs and your hands wider than shoulder width.
Turn your palms forward and keep a secure grip.
Bend both elbows to curl the bar upward without swinging your torso.
Lower the bar slowly to the starting position.
description: Lift a barbell by bending the elbows with a wide palms-up grip. The upper arms stay close to the body as the biceps move the load.

name: Barbell Step-Up Onto Bench
instructions: Stand facing a stable flat bench with a barbell held securely across your upper back.
Place one whole foot on the bench and push through it to rise.
Bring the trailing foot onto the bench and stand tall.
Step back down with control. Complete the set with the same leg leading, then switch legs.
description: Step onto a flat bench while holding a barbell across the upper back. The leading leg lifts the body until both feet are on the bench.

name: Barbell Bent-Knee Good Morning
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Gently tighten your abdomen and move your hips backward as you bend your knees.
Lower your torso through a range you can control while keeping the bar secure.
Extend your hips and knees to return to standing without leaning backward.
description: Hinge forward with a barbell across the upper back while bending the knees. The glutes and hamstrings extend the hips to bring the torso upright again.

name: Barbell Straight-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your feet about hip-width apart.
Keep your knees nearly straight without forcing them backward.
Move your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs, stopping at a range you can control.
Extend your hips to return upright without pulling the bar away from your body.
description: Lower and raise a barbell by hinging at the hips with the knees nearly straight. The hamstrings and glutes control the movement while the back supports the torso.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance over the bar with your toes turned outward.
Bend your hips and knees and grip the bar with both hands between your legs.
Gently tighten your abdomen and push through your feet to stand, keeping the bar close.
Move your hips back and bend your knees to return the bar to the floor under control.
description: Lift a barbell from the floor in a wide stance with the hands inside the legs. The glutes, quadriceps and adductors extend the hips and knees together.

name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Stand with the bar at the front of your shoulders, your elbows forward and feet about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees into a front squat while keeping the bar supported.
Push through both feet to stand and continue that drive into an overhead press.
Lower the bar to your shoulders under control before beginning the next squat.
description: Combine a front squat with an overhead press in one continuous rise. The legs drive the bar upward before the shoulders and triceps finish the press.

name: EZ Bar Upright Row
instructions: Stand holding the angled sections of an EZ bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing back.
Keep the bar close as you lift your elbows out to the sides.
Raise through a comfortable range toward the upper chest without forcing your elbows higher.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: Lift an EZ bar in front of the torso by leading with the elbows. The shoulders and upper trapezius raise the arms while the elbows bend.

name: Barbell Upright Row to Face Level
instructions: Stand holding a light barbell near your upper abdomen with an overhand grip and your elbows bent.
Lift the bar close to your body while moving your elbows outward.
Continue only through a comfortable range as your forearms turn upward and the bar approaches face level.
Reverse the movement slowly and lower the bar toward your upper abdomen.
description: Lift a barbell from near the upper abdomen toward face level with the elbows bent and out to the sides. The forearms turn upward near the top, adding shoulder rotation to the high row.

name: Barbell Close-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs with your hands close together and palms facing back.
Lift your elbows outward while keeping the bar near your body.
Stop at a comfortable height near the upper chest without shrugging the bar into your chin.
Lower with control to straight arms.
description: Raise a barbell with a close grip while the elbows move outward. The shoulders and upper trapezius lift the arms as the bar travels close to the torso.

name: Barbell Wide-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and grip the bar wider than shoulder width.
Lift the bar from the rack and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your chest without bouncing.
Press it upward until your arms are straight, keeping your hips on the bench.
description: Press a barbell from the chest with a wide hand position while lying on a flat bench. The chest and triceps lift the bar as the upper back stays supported.

name: Barbell Wide Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and take a wide grip with your palms facing toward your head.
Keep your thumbs around the bar and lift it from the rack over your chest.
Lower with control, keeping the bar balanced over your forearms.
Press back above your chest without lifting your hips from the bench.
description: Press a barbell on a flat bench using a wide palms-up grip. The chest and triceps move the bar while the wrists and hands keep it secure.
aliases: Barbell Wide Reverse Grip Bench Press

name: Barbell Wide-Stance Back Squat
instructions: Hold the bar across your upper back and set your feet wide with your toes turned slightly outward.
Tighten your abdomen and bend your hips and knees, allowing your knees to follow your toes.
Lower through a controlled range while keeping both feet planted.
Push through your feet to stand upright.
description: Squat with the feet wider than shoulder width and a barbell across the upper back. The quadriceps and glutes extend the knees and hips from the lowered position.

name: Barbell Wide-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and take a palms-back grip wider than shoulder width.
Raise your elbows out to the sides while keeping the bar close.
Lift only to a comfortable height near the upper chest, without forcing the shoulders upward.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.
description: Lift a barbell with the hands spaced wide and elbows moving outward. The shoulders and trapezius raise the arms as the elbows bend.

name: Seated Barbell Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Sit astride a flat bench and lean forward to rest both forearms on it with your hands just beyond the end.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing up and keep a secure finger grip.
Bend your wrists to raise the bar without lifting your forearms.
Lower slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
description: Curl the wrists with the forearms supported on a flat bench and palms facing up. The wrist flexors lift the bar while the elbows and forearms stay supported.
aliases: Kneeling Barbell Wrist Curl over Bench

name: Seated Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet planted and your forearms along your thighs.
Hold the bar with your palms up and let your hands extend just beyond your knees.
Curl your wrists upward without lifting your forearms.
Lower slowly while maintaining your grip on the bar.
description: Curl a barbell with the palms up while the forearms rest on the thighs. The wrists move through the curl while the rest of the arms stay supported.

name: Barbell Zercher Squat with Hands Clasped
instructions: Stand with a barbell resting securely in the bends of your elbows and clasp your hands in front of you.
Keep the bar close to your torso and take a comfortable squat stance.
Bend your hips and knees to lower with your feet planted.
Push through both feet to stand without letting the bar roll away from your body.
description: Squat while holding a barbell in the bends of the elbows with the hands clasped together. The front-held load stays close to the torso as the legs lower and raise the body.

name: Standing Toe Touch with Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and arms by your sides.
Bend forward through a comfortable range and reach toward your toes with your knees relaxed.
Return to standing and sweep both arms overhead without forcing your lower back into an arch.
Lower your arms and repeat the sequence smoothly.
description: Bend forward toward the toes, then stand and sweep both arms overhead. This moving stretch combines a forward fold with an upward reach.

name: Battle Rope Alternating Waves
instructions: Face a secure battle rope anchor and hold one rope end in each hand.
Set your feet apart, bend your hips and knees slightly and gently tighten your abdomen.
Raise one hand as you lower the other to send alternating waves toward the anchor.
Continue the alternating motion while keeping your stance steady, then slow the ropes to stop.
description: Create alternating waves in two rope ends while holding a shallow squat. The shoulders and arms move rapidly while the legs and trunk steady the body.

name: Bear Crawl with Raised Hips
instructions: Start on your hands and feet with your hips raised and your knees bent.
Support your weight through your palms and the balls of your feet, keeping your knees off the floor.
Move one hand and the opposite foot forward a short distance while keeping your abdomen gently tightened.
Advance the other hand and foot and continue alternating with controlled steps.
description: Crawl forward on the hands and feet with the hips raised and knees off the floor. Opposite arms and legs advance together while the trunk stays controlled.

name: Partner-Assisted Seated Chest Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs in front of you, knees comfortably bent and hands resting behind your head.
Have a partner stand behind you and hold your elbows gently.
Ask the partner to ease your elbows backward until you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest, without pulling on your neck.
Hold briefly while breathing normally, then have the partner release the pressure slowly.
description: A partner gently draws the elbows backward while the hands rest behind the head. The seated position keeps the body supported during the chest stretch.

name: Bench Dip with Knees Bent
instructions: Sit on the edge of a stable flat bench with your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips just off the edge, keeping your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips through a comfortable range close to the bench.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and rise.
description: Lower and raise the body in front of a bench while the knees remain bent. The triceps straighten the elbows as the hands and planted feet support the body.

name: Bench Dip with Legs Extended
instructions: Sit at the edge of a stable flat bench and grip the edge beside your hips.
Move your hips just in front of the bench and extend your legs with your heels on the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body close to the bench through a comfortable range.
Straighten your arms to raise your hips again without changing your foot position.
description: Perform a dip with the hands on a bench and heels on the floor. The extended legs distinguish this variation from the bent-knee bench dip.

name: Single-Leg Hip Extension on Bench
instructions: Place both hands and one knee on a stable flat bench, leaving the other leg free beside it.
Gently tighten your abdomen and keep your hips facing the bench.
Extend the free leg backward and straighten it until it is roughly in line with your torso, without arching your lower back.
Bend and lower that leg to the starting position, then switch sides.
description: Extend one leg backward while the hands and opposite knee rest on a flat bench. The glutes lift the working thigh while the torso stays supported.

name: Bench-Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Stand beneath an overhead pull-up bar with a stable bench close enough to place one foot on it.
Grip the bar with both hands and keep one foot planted on the bench.
Bend your elbows and pull upward, pressing through the supported foot as needed.
Lower slowly while keeping the foot on the bench, then change the supporting leg.
description: Perform a pull-up with one foot on a bench to help support the body. The back and arms pull upward while the leg supplies only the assistance needed.

name: Lying Bent-Knee Trunk Rotation
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides.
Lift both feet and bend your hips and knees so your knees are above your hips.
Keep your knees together as you lower both legs toward one side through a comfortable range.
Bring the knees back through the center and lower them toward the other side without forcing floor contact.
description: Rotate both bent legs from side to side while lying on the back. The obliques control the rotation as the arms and upper back remain on the floor.

name: Seated Leg-Resisted Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and knees apart.
Place one hand beneath the opposite thigh near the knee with your palm facing upward.
Keep your upper arm close to your body and bend the elbow to lift that leg, allowing the foot to leave the floor.
Lower the leg slowly with the arm, then change sides.
description: Curl one arm while supporting the opposite leg under the knee. The leg provides bodyweight resistance for the biceps instead of a dumbbell.

name: Close-Grip Inverted Biceps Row
instructions: Set a fixed bar low enough to grasp while lying underneath it and hold it with your hands close together, palms toward your face.
Extend your legs and support your heels on the floor, keeping your hips raised.
Bend your elbows to draw your upper body toward the bar without letting your hips sag.
Straighten your arms slowly to lower your body.
description: Pull the body toward a low fixed bar with a close palms-up grip and heels on the floor. The bent elbows draw the face toward the bar while the torso and legs stay aligned.

name: Close-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grip an overhead pull-up bar with your hands close together and palms facing away from you.
Let your arms extend while keeping your feet clear and your torso steady.
Pull upward by bringing your elbows down, lifting as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly to extended arms.
description: Pull upward from an overhead bar with the hands close together. The lats and elbow flexors lift the body while the legs stay clear of the floor.

name: Floor Bodyweight Triceps Extension
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your legs straight, toes planted and palms flat in front of your elbows.
Gently tighten your abdomen to keep your hips aligned with your shoulders and heels.
Press through both palms and straighten your elbows together to lift your forearms from the floor.
Bend both elbows with control until the forearms rest on the floor again.
description: Lift from the forearms to the palms while holding a straight-body plank. The triceps straighten both elbows together as the feet stay on the floor.

name: Bodyweight Wide-To-Narrow Squat Jump
instructions: Begin with your feet wide and lower into a squat.
Push through both feet to jump upward, bringing your feet closer together in the air.
Land softly with your knees bending to absorb the landing.
Move your feet back to the wide stance and lower into the next squat under control.
description: Jump from a wide squat and land with the feet closer together before returning to a wide squat. The quadriceps, glutes and calves drive the jump and control the landing.

name: Bench-Supported Side Plank
instructions: Place one forearm across a stable flat bench with the elbow below your shoulder.
Extend both legs to the side and stack your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your shoulders, hips and feet form a straight line and hold while breathing normally.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
description: Hold a side plank with the lower forearm on a flat bench and the feet on the floor. The obliques keep the hips lifted while the supporting shoulder steadies the upper body.

name: Kneeling Floor Triceps Extension
instructions: Kneel and place your palms on the floor in front of you with your arms extended.
Keep your knees down and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend both elbows to lower your forearms toward the floor, keeping your hands in place.
Press through your palms to straighten both elbows and raise your upper body.
description: Bend and straighten both elbows with the knees on the floor. The triceps raise the upper body from supported forearms to straight arms.

name: Side-Lying Bodyweight Biceps Curl
instructions: Lie on one side with your knees bent and legs together.
Hook the lower hand beneath the lower thigh near the knee and rest your other hand on the upper leg.
Keep your legs supported as you bend the lower elbow and draw your upper torso toward your knees.
Lower your torso with control, then repeat on the other side.
description: Use the lower arm to draw the upper body toward the bent legs while lying on one side. The hand holds beneath the thigh as elbow flexion raises the torso.

name: Bodyweight Squat-Position Row on Wall Bars
instructions: Face secure wall bars and grip the vertical sides at about chest height.
Set your feet near the base and lower into a squat, leaning back with your arms extended.
Keep the squat position as you bend your elbows to draw your chest toward the bars.
Straighten your arms slowly to lean back again without standing up.
description: Row the body toward fixed wall bars while remaining in a squat. The back and biceps pull as the legs hold the lowered position.

name: Bodyweight Squat-Position Towel Row
instructions: Loop a sturdy towel around a secure wall-bar rung and hold one end in each hand.
Place your feet near the wall bars and lower into a squat with your arms extended and torso leaning back.
Maintain that squat as you bend your elbows and draw your chest toward the anchor.
Extend your arms slowly to lean back without releasing the towel.
description: Pull the body toward a towel looped around fixed wall bars while holding a squat. The towel provides a handhold while bodyweight supplies the resistance.

name: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
Keep your knees nearly straight and your weight spread across the balls of your feet.
Lift both heels as high as you can while remaining balanced.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
description: Lift the heels from the floor while standing unsupported. The calves raise the body onto the balls of both feet.

name: Single-Arm Bodyweight Row on Vertical Post
instructions: Face secure wall bars and grasp one vertical side with one hand at about chest height.
Place your feet near the base and lean backward with the working arm straight and your body aligned.
Bend that elbow close to your side to pull your chest toward the handhold.
Straighten the arm slowly to lean back, then switch arms.
description: Lean back from a fixed vertical post and pull the body toward it with one arm. The hand uses a palms-in grip as the elbow moves close to the torso.
aliases: Bodyweight Standing Close-Grip One Arm Row

name: Bodyweight Row on Vertical Posts
instructions: Stand facing secure wall bars and grip the two vertical sides at chest height.
Keep your feet near the base and lean backward with both arms extended.
Bend your elbows beside your ribs and draw your chest toward the posts.
Extend your arms slowly to return to the leaning position.
description: Pull the body toward fixed wall bars using both vertical side posts. A palms-in grip keeps the elbows close to the torso during the row.

name: Single-Arm Bodyweight Row on Wall-Bar Rung
instructions: Grip a secure horizontal wall-bar rung with one hand around chest height.
Keep both feet near the base and lean backward with your working arm extended.
Bend your elbow to pull your chest toward the rung while keeping your body aligned.
Lower back to the leaning position slowly and switch arms.
description: Row the body toward a fixed horizontal rung with one hand. The back and biceps pull while the feet stay planted and the other arm rests behind the body.

name: Single-Arm Bodyweight Towel Row
instructions: Loop a sturdy towel around a secure wall-bar rung and hold both ends firmly in one hand.
Plant your feet near the wall bars and lean back with the working arm straight.
Bend your elbow to pull your torso toward the anchor without twisting your body.
Extend the arm slowly to lean back again, then repeat with the other arm.
description: Pull the body toward a fixed towel anchor using one arm. The towel supplies a handhold while the back and biceps move bodyweight.
aliases: Bodyweight Standing One Arm Row (With Towel)

name: Bodyweight Row on Wall-Bar Rung
instructions: Face secure wall bars and grip a horizontal rung around chest height with both hands.
Keep your feet near the base and lean backward with your arms straight.
Bend your elbows to draw your chest toward the rung without sagging at the hips.
Extend your arms slowly to return to the backward lean.
description: Lean back from a fixed horizontal rung and pull the chest toward it with both arms. The upper back and biceps move the body while the feet remain planted.

name: Bodyweight Towel Row
instructions: Loop a sturdy towel around a secure wall-bar rung and hold one end in each hand.
Plant your feet near the wall bars and lean back until your arms are extended.
Bend both elbows to pull your chest toward the anchor, keeping your hips in line with your body.
Straighten your arms slowly to return to the leaning position.
description: Row the body toward a towel anchored around a wall-bar rung. Both arms pull while the torso and legs stay aligned.

name: Lying Knee Tuck
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and palms on the floor.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly and hold your extended legs just above the floor.
Bend your knees and draw them toward your torso without swinging your pelvis upward.
Extend your legs back out slowly, keeping them only as low as you can control.
description: Draw both knees inward from a low straight-leg position while lying on the back. The hip flexors move the thighs while the abdominals stabilize the torso.

name: Step-Down Landing with Single-Leg Balance
instructions: Stand on a stable low platform near its edge.
Move off the edge and land on one foot on the floor, bending that knee and hip to absorb the landing.
Keep the other foot clear and steady yourself without immediately hopping again.
Step back onto the platform and repeat with the other landing leg.
description: Leave a low platform and land on one foot, then stabilize the body. The quadriceps, glutes and calves absorb the landing while the hip muscles control balance.
aliases: Box Jump Down with One Leg Stabilization

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bring one knee diagonally toward the opposite elbow.
Return that foot to the starting position without dropping your hips.
Bring the other knee across and continue alternating at a controlled pace.
description: Drive alternate knees toward the opposite elbow from a high plank. The hip flexors move each leg while the abdominals and shoulders support the body.

name: Burpee Without Push-Up
instructions: Stand with your feet apart, then bend your hips and knees to place both hands on the floor.
Jump both feet back into a high plank with your arms straight.
Jump your feet back toward your hands and lift your torso.
Jump upward with your arms overhead, then land softly and reset before repeating.
description: Move from standing to a high plank, bring the feet back in and jump upward. This burpee variation keeps the arms straight during the plank phase.

name: Forearm Plank Pike
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your elbows below your shoulders and toes on the floor.
Keep your forearms planted and lift your hips toward the ceiling, keeping your legs nearly straight.
Pause briefly at a height you can control without shifting your elbows.
Lower your hips slowly until your body returns to a straight plank.
description: Raise the hips from a forearm plank to form an inverted V, then return to the plank. The abdominals control the trunk while the hip flexors fold the body upward.

name: Seated Butterfly Stretch with Forward Lean
instructions: Sit on the floor, bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees open to the sides.
Hold your feet and sit tall before leaning forward a little from the hips.
Stop at a comfortable inner-thigh stretch without bouncing or forcing the knees down.
Breathe normally, then ease back upright and release the position.
description: Sit with the soles together and knees open, then lean forward gently. The position stretches the inner thighs while the hands hold the feet.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Press with Opposite-Arm Hold
instructions: Stand between two low cable pulleys and hold one handle in each hand at shoulder level.
Keep your abdomen firm and your feet planted.
Press one handle overhead until that arm is straight, keeping the other handle at your shoulder.
Lower the working handle to shoulder level under control.
Complete the repetitions, then switch arms.
description: Press one cable handle overhead while holding the other at shoulder level. The low cable loads the working shoulder and triceps.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley and hold its handle in one hand behind your head.
Point the working elbow upward and use your other hand to support that upper arm.
Keep the upper arm steady as you straighten the elbow to raise the handle overhead.
Bend the elbow slowly to lower the handle behind your head, then switch arms.
description: Straighten one elbow overhead against a cable from behind the body. The other hand steadies the working upper arm.

name: Cable-Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a padded bench facing away from the high pulley, with your ankles securely held beneath the machine rollers.
Hold the cable bar across your upper back and keep your hips extended and abdomen firm.
Lean forward from your knees, keeping your shoulders, hips and knees aligned as the cable assists you.
Bend at the knees to return upright with control, using a range that you can manage.
description: Lower the straight body forward from the knees while a high cable helps support the torso. The hamstrings control knee extension and pull the body back to tall kneeling.

name: Cable Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit facing the high pulley with your feet planted and thighs held beneath the support pads.
Grip the wide bar with your palms facing forward and hands wider than shoulder width.
Keep your chest lifted and pull the bar toward your upper chest by bringing your elbows down.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms extend, keeping your torso controlled.
description: Pull a wide bar from overhead toward the upper chest while seated. The lats lower the upper arms as the elbows bend.

name: Cable Flat Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and hold one handle in each hand.
Lie back with your feet planted and bring the handles beside your chest with elbows bent.
Press both handles above your chest until your arms are straight.
Lower the handles slowly to chest level while keeping your back and hips supported.
description: Press two cable handles above the chest while lying on a flat bench. Low pulleys load the chest and triceps through the pressing movement.

name: Cable Close-Grip Curl
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to a low cable pulley and stand facing it.
Grip the bar with your palms up and hands closer than shoulder width.
Keep your upper arms beside your body as you curl the bar toward your chest.
Lower slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.
description: Curl a low-cable bar with the hands close together and palms facing up. The biceps bend the elbows while the upper arms remain beside the torso.

name: Seated Single-Arm Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench facing a low cable pulley with your knees apart and feet planted.
Hold the handle palm up and brace the working upper arm against the inside of that thigh.
Bend your elbow to curl the handle toward your shoulder without lifting your upper arm from the thigh.
Lower slowly and repeat on the other side.
description: Curl a low cable handle with the upper arm braced against the inner thigh. The seated support limits movement of the upper arm while the biceps lift the handle.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high cable pulley and kneel with one foot forward and the other knee on the floor.
Rest the working upper arm against the inside of the raised knee and hold the handle with the elbow bent.
Keep that support as you straighten your elbow and press the handle downward.
Let the elbow bend slowly, then repeat on the other side.
description: Straighten one elbow while bracing the upper arm against the raised knee. A high cable supplies resistance as the hand moves downward.

name: Standing Crossed-Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Stand between two high cable pulleys and take the opposite-side handle in each hand so the cables cross above you.
Start with your arms extended overhead and your feet planted.
Bring your elbows down toward your sides as the handles separate and approach shoulder level.
Let your arms rise slowly back to the crossed overhead position.
description: Pull two crossed high cables down toward the shoulders while standing. The lats lower the arms from a crossed overhead start.

name: Bent-Over Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys and hold the opposite-side handle in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back and lean forward, letting your arms hang beneath your shoulders.
Keep a small steady bend in your elbows as you raise both arms outward to about torso level.
Lower the handles slowly beneath your chest without lifting your torso.
description: Open the arms out to the sides from a bent-over position using crossed low cables. The rear deltoids move the upper arms while the upper back controls the shoulder blades.

name: Standing Cable High-To-Low Fly
instructions: Set two cable pulleys around shoulder height and stand between them holding one handle in each hand.
Keep your feet planted, torso upright and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep the handles downward and inward until your hands meet in front of your hips.
Open your arms back to the sides slowly without changing the bend in your elbows.
description: Bring the arms from an open shoulder-height position down together in front of the hips. The chest draws the upper arms inward while the elbows stay slightly bent.

name: Standing Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley and hold its bar with your palms up at about shoulder width.
Start with the bar in front of your thighs and elbows nearly straight.
Curl the bar toward your chest without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly until your arms extend again.
description: Curl a bar attached to a low pulley with both palms facing up. The biceps bend the elbows while the torso and upper arms stay steady.

name: Dual-Cable Deadlift
instructions: Stand between two low cable pulleys with a handle in each hand at your sides.
Bend your hips and knees to lower while keeping your arms straight and chest lifted.
Push through both feet to extend your knees and hips until you stand upright.
Lower again with control, keeping the handles close to your sides.
description: Stand up from a low bent-knee position while holding a low cable handle at each side. The glutes and legs extend the hips and knees as the arms remain straight.

name: Cable Decline Bench Fly
instructions: Position a decline bench between low cable pulleys and secure your legs in its supports.
Lie with your head lower than your hips and hold one handle in each hand above your chest.
Open your arms out to the sides through a comfortable range, keeping a small steady elbow bend.
Sweep the handles together above your chest without turning the movement into a press.
description: Bring two cable handles together above the chest while lying on a decline bench. The chest moves the arms through an arc while the elbows hold a small bend.

name: Single-Arm Cable Decline Bench Press
instructions: Set a decline bench beside a low cable pulley and secure your legs in the bench supports.
Lie with your head below your hips and hold the handle beside your chest with one elbow bent.
Press the handle above your chest without turning your torso.
Lower slowly to chest level, then repeat with the other arm.
description: Press one cable handle above the chest while lying on a decline bench. The chest and triceps move the working arm as the torso stays supported.

name: Cable Decline Bench Press
instructions: Place a decline bench between two low pulleys and secure your legs in its supports.
Lie back with your head lower than your hips and hold one handle beside each side of your chest.
Press the handles above your chest until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the handles slowly while keeping your torso supported.
description: Press two cable handles above the chest from a decline bench. The chest and triceps extend the arms while the legs remain secured on the bench.

name: Chest-Supported Cable Wide-Grip Row
instructions: Place an incline bench facing the cable pulley and sit with your chest against its raised back pad and feet planted.
Grip a wide bar with your palms facing down and extend your arms toward the pulley.
Keep your chest against the pad as you pull the bar toward your upper torso with your elbows out.
Straighten your arms slowly without lifting away from the pad.
description: Row a wide cable bar toward the chest while leaning against an inclined bench pad. The pad supports the torso as the upper back and rear shoulders pull the elbows backward.

name: Cable Drag Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low pulley and take a palms-up grip on its straight bar.
Begin with your arms extended and the bar close to your thighs.
Bend your elbows and draw them backward as you slide the bar upward close to your torso.
Lower the bar slowly while allowing the elbows to return beside your body.
description: Curl a cable bar close to the torso while the elbows move backward. The biceps bend the elbows as the bar follows the front of the body.

name: Floor-Seated Wide-Grip Cable Row
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable pulley with your legs extended and knees slightly bent.
Brace your feet against the machine supports and grip the wide bar with your palms down.
Keep your torso lifted as you pull the bar toward your upper abdomen with your elbows moving outward.
Extend your arms slowly to return the bar toward the pulley.
description: Pull a wide cable bar toward the torso while sitting on the floor. The upper back draws the elbows backward as the feet brace in front.

name: Single-Arm Cable Front Raise
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with its handle in one hand beside your thigh.
Keep your torso upright and your free arm relaxed.
Raise the working arm forward to about shoulder height without swinging or bending the elbow farther.
Lower slowly and repeat with the other arm.
description: Raise one cable handle forward to shoulder height. The front of the shoulder lifts the arm while the elbow keeps a small bend.

name: Cable Bar Front Raise
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold its bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing back.
Keep your feet planted and elbows nearly straight.
Raise the bar forward to shoulder height without leaning backward.
Lower it slowly along the same arc.
description: Lift a cable bar forward from the thighs to shoulder height. Both shoulders raise the arms while the bar stays level.

name: Dual-Cable Front Raise
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys with a handle in each hand and your arms down beside you.
Keep a small steady bend in your elbows and gently tighten your abdomen.
Lift the handles forward and inward until your hands are in front of your shoulders.
Lower slowly to the open starting position beside your hips.
description: Raise two low-cable handles forward and slightly inward until they are near shoulder height. The shoulders lift both arms while the torso remains upright.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable pulley and stand facing it.
Hold one rope end in each hand with your palms facing each other and arms extended.
Bend your elbows to curl the rope upward without moving your upper arms forward.
Lower slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.
description: Curl a rope attachment with the palms facing each other. The elbow flexors raise the hands while the upper arms remain beside the torso.

name: Leaning Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing away with one foot forward.
Hold the rope behind your head and lean your torso forward, keeping your abdomen firm.
Keep your upper arms beside your head as you straighten both elbows to reach forward.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring the rope behind your head again without changing your stance.
description: Extend the elbows forward from a pronounced forward lean with the cable behind the head. The triceps straighten the arms while the upper arms remain aligned with the torso.
aliases: Cable High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension

name: Kneeling Cable High Row with Close Grip
instructions: Attach a close-grip handle to a high cable pulley and kneel facing it.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other and extend your arms toward the pulley.
Keep your torso steady as you pull toward your upper chest, bringing your elbows down beside your ribs.
Let your arms extend slowly back toward the high pulley.
description: Pull a close-grip handle down toward the upper torso while kneeling in front of a high pulley. The lats and upper back draw the elbows backward and downward.

name: Standing Cable Hip Adduction
