instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand sideways with the working leg closest to the machine.
Hold the machine lightly for balance and lift the strapped foot clear of the floor.
Keep the working knee nearly straight as you draw that leg inward across the front of the standing leg.
Return slowly outward and repeat on the other side.
description: Move one leg inward across the body against a low cable. The inner-thigh muscles draw the working thigh toward the standing leg.

name: Cable Incline Bench Press
instructions: Place an incline bench between two low cable pulleys and hold one handle in each hand.
Recline against the bench with your feet planted and handles beside your upper chest.
Press upward and inward until your arms are straight above your chest.
Lower slowly while keeping your back and hips against the bench.
description: Press two cable handles above the upper chest while reclining on an incline bench. The chest, shoulders and triceps move the handles while the bench supports the torso.

name: Chest-Supported Cable Row
instructions: Place an incline bench facing the pulley and sit with your chest against the angled pad and feet planted.
Grip the bar with both palms down and extend your arms toward the cable.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, moving your elbows backward close to your sides.
Extend your arms slowly while maintaining chest contact with the pad.
description: Pull a cable bar toward the lower chest with the torso supported on an incline bench. The elbows stay near the body as the back and biceps perform the row.

name: Cable Incline Bench Fly
instructions: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys and recline with your feet planted.
Hold one handle in each hand and bring them above your upper chest.
Open your arms outward through a comfortable range without changing your elbow bend.
Bring the handles together above your chest along the same arc.
description: Sweep two cable handles together above the chest while reclining on an incline bench. The chest moves the upper arms while the elbows keep a small bend.

name: Cable Incline Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Position a stability ball between two low cable pulleys and hold one handle in each hand.
Recline your upper back on the ball with your feet planted wide enough for balance and hips slightly lower than your shoulders.
Keep a small bend in your elbows as you open your arms out to the sides.
Sweep the handles together above your chest while keeping the ball and torso steady.
description: Perform a cable fly while reclining on a stability ball with the hips lower than the shoulders. The chest moves the arms while the trunk and legs steady the ball.

name: Incline-Bench Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Position an incline bench in front of a high cable pulley so the cable comes from above and behind your head, then recline and plant your feet.
Hold the bar with both palms facing away and begin with your arms raised above your head.
Keep a small steady elbow bend as you sweep the bar down toward your thighs.
Let the cable draw your arms upward slowly while your back stays supported.
description: Sweep a cable bar from above the head toward the thighs while reclining on an incline bench. The lats extend the shoulders while the elbows remain nearly straight.

name: Cable Incline-Bench Triceps Extension
instructions: Place an incline bench facing away from a low cable pulley with a bar attached.
Recline with your feet planted and hold the bar above your head using a comfortable two-hand grip.
Keep your upper arms steady as you bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your elbows to raise the bar again without lifting your back from the pad.
description: Bend and straighten the elbows with the upper body supported on an incline bench. A low cable behind the bench loads the triceps as the bar moves behind the head and upward.

name: Standing Cable Twisting Crunch
instructions: Stand facing away from the pulley with your feet apart and hold the attachment beside one shoulder using both hands.
Keep your knees relaxed and the attachment close to your shoulder.
Curl and turn your torso forward and diagonally downward without throwing your arms or straightening your elbows.
Return upright slowly, then set up on the other side.
description: Fold and turn the torso forward while holding a cable attachment beside one shoulder. The abdominals and obliques move the trunk while the elbows remain bent.

name: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Kickback
instructions: Face a low cable pulley and hold its handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and lean forward from your hips, resting your free hand on the front thigh for support.
Keep the working upper arm beside your torso and straighten that elbow to move the handle backward.
Bend the elbow slowly without dropping the upper arm, then switch sides.
description: Straighten one elbow backward while holding a bent-over stance. The triceps move the cable handle while the upper arm stays beside the torso.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope ends beside your head and keep both knees planted.
Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, bringing your elbows downward without pulling mainly with your arms.
Uncurl slowly to the starting position while keeping the rope at your head.
description: Curl the torso toward the thighs while kneeling in front of a high pulley. The abdominals flex the trunk while the hands keep the rope beside the head.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Face Pull
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and face it with one knee on the floor and the opposite foot forward.
Hold one rope end in each hand and extend your arms toward the pulley.
Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends so your hands finish beside your head and elbows point outward.
Extend your arms slowly, then change the forward leg between sets.
description: Pull a high cable rope toward the face with the elbows moving outward. The rear shoulders and upper back move the arms while the half-kneeling stance steadies the torso.
aliases: Cable Kneeling Rear Delt Row (With Rope) (Male)

name: Bench-Supported Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Kneel facing away from a high pulley with a flat bench in front of you.
Hold the cable bar and lean forward to rest your upper arms on the bench, starting with your elbows bent.
Keep your upper arms supported as you straighten the elbows to reach the bar forward.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring the bar back toward your head.
description: Straighten both elbows with the upper arms resting on a flat bench. The high cable pulls from behind as the triceps extend the arms forward.

name: Standing Crossed-Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand between two high pulleys and take the opposite-side handle in each hand so the cables cross.
Raise your arms forward and across at about face level, keeping a small bend in the elbows.
Sweep both arms down and outward toward your hips without bending the elbows into a row.
Return slowly to the crossed raised position.
description: Sweep crossed high-cable handles from in front of the face down to the sides of the hips. The lats lower the upper arms while the elbows remain nearly straight.
aliases: Cable Lat Pulldown Full Range of Motion

name: Seated Cable Rope Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit facing a high pulley with your feet planted and thighs beneath the machine supports.
Hold one rope end in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Pull the rope toward your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and slightly backward.
Allow your arms to extend overhead slowly while keeping your torso steady.
description: Pull a rope attachment from overhead toward the upper chest while seated. The lats lower the arms as the elbows bend beside the body.

name: Cable V-Bar Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the high-pulley station with your thighs secured beneath the pads and feet planted.
Grip the V-bar with your palms facing each other and arms extended overhead.
Keep your chest lifted and pull the handle toward your upper chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Let the handle rise slowly without swinging your torso.
description: Pull a close V-bar handle from overhead toward the upper chest. The palms face each other as the lats and biceps move the handle.

name: Dual-Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys and hold the opposite-side handle in each hand so the cables cross in front of you.
Keep your torso upright and elbows slightly bent.
Lift both arms outward to about shoulder height without shrugging or leaning.
Lower the handles slowly back in front of your hips.
description: Raise both arms out to the sides using crossed low cables. The shoulders lift the arms while the elbows keep a slight bend.

name: Standing Cable Low-To-High Fly
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys in a staggered stance with a handle in each hand beside your hips.
Keep your torso upright and a small steady bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms forward and upward until the handles meet in front of your upper chest.
Lower slowly along the same arcs without changing your stance.
description: Sweep two low-cable handles upward and together in front of the upper chest. The chest and front shoulders raise and bring the arms inward.

name: Seated Close-Grip Cable Row
instructions: Sit on the cable-row bench and place your feet on the supports with your knees slightly bent.
Grip the close handle with your palms facing each other and extend your arms.
Keep your torso lifted as you pull the handle toward your abdomen, bringing your elbows backward beside your ribs.
Extend your arms slowly without collapsing your chest.
description: Pull a close-grip cable handle toward the abdomen while seated with the feet braced. The back and biceps draw the elbows alongside the torso.

name: Lying Cable Curl with Raised Elbows
instructions: Place a flat bench with its foot end toward a low cable pulley and lie on your back with your feet planted.
Hold the cable bar with both palms up, starting with it above your thighs.
Bend your elbows to curl the bar toward your forehead, allowing your elbows to rise while your torso stays on the bench.
Lower the bar and elbows slowly to the starting position.
description: Curl a cable bar toward the forehead while lying on a flat bench. The elbows rise as the bar approaches the head, combining elbow flexion with forward upper-arm movement.

name: Lying High-Cable Close-Grip Curl
instructions: Place a flat bench beneath a high pulley and lie on your back with your feet planted.
Take a close palms-up grip on the bar and extend your arms above your chest toward the pulley.
Keep your upper arms raised as you bend your elbows to bring the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten your elbows slowly to return the bar upward.
description: Curl a high cable bar toward the forehead while the upper arms point upward. The flat bench supports the body as the biceps bend the elbows.

name: Lying Cable Rope Pullover
instructions: Place a flat bench with its head end toward a low cable pulley and attach a rope.
Lie on your back with feet planted and hold the rope ends above your chest.
Keep a small steady elbow bend as you let your arms travel behind your head through a comfortable range.
Pull the rope forward over your chest without bending your elbows into a triceps extension.
description: Sweep a rope attachment from behind the head to above the chest while lying on a flat bench. The lats and chest move the upper arms while the elbows remain nearly straight.
aliases: Cable Lying Extension Pullover (With Rope Attachment)

name: Cable Flat Bench Fly
instructions: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys and hold one handle in each hand.
Lie on your back with feet planted and handles above your chest, palms facing each other.
Open your arms out to the sides only as far as you can control without changing the elbow bend.
Sweep the handles together above your chest.
description: Open and close the arms above the chest while lying between two low cable pulleys. The chest moves the arms through wide arcs with a small steady elbow bend.

name: Floor-Lying Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted, with the cable pulley above and behind your head.
Grip the curved cable bar with both hands and hold it above your chest.
Keep your upper arms raised as you bend your elbows to bring the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten your elbows slowly to return the bar above your chest.
description: Bend and straighten both elbows while lying on the floor with a cable bar above the chest. The triceps lift the bar as the upper arms remain raised.

name: Standing Cable Chest-Height Fly
instructions: Set two cable pulleys around chest height and stand between them with one foot forward.
Hold a handle in each hand with arms open and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep both handles together in front of your chest without changing the elbow bend.
Open your arms slowly back to the starting position.
description: Bring two cable handles together at chest height from an open-arm position. The chest draws the upper arms inward while a staggered stance steadies the body.

name: Single-Arm Bent-Over Cable Row
instructions: Face a low pulley with one foot forward and hold its handle in the opposite hand.
Push your hips back and lean forward, resting your free hand on the front thigh.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs with your elbow close to your side and torso steady.
Extend the working arm slowly, then switch sides.
description: Row a low cable handle toward the ribs while holding a bent-over staggered stance. The back and biceps move one arm as the other hand supports the torso on the thigh.
aliases: Cable One Arm Bent over Row

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley and hold its handle in one hand with your palm forward.
Keep your elbow beside your torso and your wrist steady.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder without leaning backward.
Lower slowly and repeat with the other arm.
description: Curl one low-cable handle toward the shoulder with the palm facing up. The biceps bend the elbow while the upper arm stays beside the torso.

name: Single-Arm Cable Decline Bench Fly
instructions: Set a decline bench beside a low cable pulley and secure your legs in the bench supports.
Lie back with your head below your hips and hold the handle above your chest in one hand.
Keep a slight elbow bend as you open the arm outward through a comfortable range.
Bring the handle back above your chest without rotating your torso, then switch arms.
description: Sweep one cable handle above the chest while lying on a decline bench. The chest brings the working upper arm inward while the torso remains supported.
aliases: Cable One Arm Decline Chest Fly

name: Single-Arm Cable Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Position a stability ball beside a low pulley and hold its handle in one hand.
Recline with your upper back on the ball, feet planted and hips lifted to form a nearly level torso.
With a small steady elbow bend, open the working arm out to the side.
Sweep the handle above your chest while keeping your hips level, then repeat with the other arm.
description: Perform a one-arm cable fly with the upper back supported on a stability ball. The chest moves the arm while the legs and trunk keep the hips lifted and body level.
aliases: Cable One Arm Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Single-Arm Cable Incline Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Hold a low-cable handle in one hand and recline your upper back on a stability ball.
Plant both feet with your hips lower than your shoulders so your torso is inclined.
Keep a small bend in the working elbow as you open that arm out to the side.
Bring the handle above your upper chest with control, then switch arms.
description: Sweep a cable handle above the upper chest while reclining at an incline on a stability ball. The chest moves the working arm while the trunk holds the body steady.
aliases: Cable One Arm Incline Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Single-Arm Cable Incline Bench Press
instructions: Place an incline bench beside a low cable pulley and take the handle in one hand.
Recline against the pad with feet planted and the handle beside your upper chest.
Press upward until the arm is straight above your chest, keeping your torso facing upward.
Lower the handle slowly and repeat with the other arm.
description: Press one cable handle above the upper chest while reclining on an incline bench. The chest, shoulders and triceps lift the handle while the back stays supported.

name: Single-Arm Cable Incline Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Hold a low-cable handle in one hand and recline with your upper back on a stability ball.
Plant your feet and keep your hips below your shoulders, with the handle beside your upper chest.
Press upward until the arm is straight without letting your torso roll toward the cable.
Lower slowly and repeat with the other arm.
description: Press one cable handle while reclining at an incline on a stability ball. The chest and triceps extend the arm while the trunk and feet steady the body.
aliases: Cable One Arm Incline Press on Exercise Ball

name: Single-Arm Bent-Over Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Stand with a shoulder-height pulley beside and slightly behind the working arm.
Hold the handle, bend your hips and knees, and rest your free hand on the front thigh.
Keep a small steady elbow bend as you bring the handle forward and diagonally across your body.
Open the arm slowly back toward the pulley and repeat on the other side.
description: Sweep one cable handle inward and downward across the body from a bent-over stance. The chest draws the upper arm across while the other hand rests on the thigh.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to a low pulley and hold its handle in the hand farther from the machine.
Begin with the handle in front of your hips and the cable crossing your body.
Keep a slight elbow bend as you raise that arm out to the side to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat on the other side.
description: Raise one arm outward to shoulder height against a low cable running across the front of the body. The shoulder lifts the arm while the torso remains upright.

name: Seated Single-Arm Cable Preacher Curl
instructions: Position a preacher bench facing a low pulley and sit with your chest close to the pad.
Hold the handle palm up and rest the working upper arm along the pad.
Curl the handle upward without lifting your upper arm.
Lower slowly until the elbow is nearly straight, then switch arms.
description: Curl a low cable handle with the upper arm resting on a preacher pad. The pad supports the arm as the biceps bend and straighten the elbow.

name: Single-Arm Cable Chest Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Recline with your upper back on a stability ball beside a low cable pulley.
Plant both feet and lift your hips until your torso is nearly level, holding the handle beside your chest.
Press above your chest until the working arm is straight, keeping both hips level.
Lower with control and repeat with the other arm.
description: Press one cable handle with the upper back on a stability ball and hips raised. The chest and triceps move the handle while the trunk keeps the body from rotating.
aliases: Cable One Arm Press on Exercise Ball

name: Standing Single-Arm Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and hold its handle in one hand with your arm raised.
Keep your feet planted, your torso upright and a small bend in the working elbow.
Sweep your arm downward until your hand reaches the front of your thigh, keeping the elbow bend steady.
Let the arm return upward slowly without leaning backward.
Complete the set, then repeat with the other arm.
description: Pull one high cable handle down toward your thigh while keeping the elbow nearly straight. The lats move the upper arm downward against the cable resistance.

name: Seated Single-Arm Cable Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable pulley.
Hold its handle with your palm facing down and support your upper arm along the pad.
Bend the elbow to curl upward without lifting the upper arm or bending the wrist back.
Lower slowly to a nearly straight elbow and repeat with the other arm.
description: Curl a low cable handle with a palms-down grip while the upper arm rests on a preacher pad. The elbow flexors lift the handle while the forearms maintain the reverse grip.
aliases: Cable One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Cable High Row
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable pulley and take its handle in one hand.
Reach upward toward the cable with your working arm extended.
Keep your torso steady as you bend the elbow and pull the handle toward the side of your chest.
Extend slowly back toward the pulley, then switch arms.
description: Pull one handle from a high pulley toward the chest while kneeling. The back and biceps draw the elbow downward and backward while the torso stays upright.
aliases: Cable One Arm Straight Back High Row (Kneeling)

name: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and hold its single handle with your palm facing down.
Start with the working elbow bent and upper arm close to your side.
Straighten that elbow to press the handle down toward your thigh without moving your shoulder.
Bend the elbow slowly to return and repeat with the other arm.
description: Straighten one elbow to press a high-cable handle toward the thigh. The triceps move the forearm while the upper arm stays beside the torso.

name: Standing High-Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand between two high pulleys with a handle in each hand.
Raise your upper arms out to the sides around shoulder height and turn your palms upward.
Keep your upper arms lifted as you bend both elbows to bring the handles toward the sides of your head.
Straighten the elbows slowly without lowering your upper arms.
description: Curl two high cable handles toward the sides of the head with the upper arms held outward. The biceps bend the elbows while the shoulders maintain the raised arm position.

name: High-Cable Biceps Curl Seated on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball between two high pulleys with your feet planted apart.
Hold one handle in each hand and raise your upper arms out to the sides around shoulder height, palms up.
Bend both elbows to bring the handles toward your head while keeping the ball and upper arms steady.
Extend your elbows slowly to return.
description: Curl two high cable handles toward the head while sitting upright on a stability ball. The biceps move the forearms while the upper arms stay out to the sides.
aliases: Cable Overhead Curl on Exercise Ball

name: Standing Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from it.
Hold one rope end in each hand behind your head, with your elbows pointing upward.
Gently tighten your abdomen and straighten your elbows to raise your hands overhead.
Bend the elbows slowly to lower the rope behind your head without leaning backward.
description: Extend both elbows overhead with a rope attached to a low pulley behind the body. The triceps raise the hands while the upper arms remain near the head.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row with Rotating Grip
instructions: Stand facing a cable pulley, bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips.
Hold its handle in one hand with the palm facing down and rest your free hand on your thigh.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, turning the working palm upward as your elbow bends.
Extend the arm and turn the palm downward under control, then repeat with the other arm.
description: Row one cable handle toward the ribs while rotating the palm upward. The back pulls the upper arm behind the body while the other hand rests on the thigh.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable pulley and rest your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the cable bar with palms facing upward and begin with elbows nearly straight.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower the bar slowly without forcing the elbows straight.
description: Curl a cable bar while both upper arms rest on a preacher pad. The pad supports the arms as the biceps bend the elbows.

name: Cable Chest Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Position a stability ball between two low cable pulleys and hold one handle in each hand.
Rest your upper back on the ball, plant both feet and lift your hips to support a nearly horizontal torso.
Start with elbows bent beside your chest and press the handles upward toward each other.
Lower the handles slowly while keeping the ball and hips steady.
description: Press two cable handles above the chest with the upper back supported on a stability ball. The chest and triceps press while the trunk and hips hold the body steady.

name: Cable Rope Pull-Through
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from it with your feet apart.
Hold the rope ends between your legs and step forward to take up the cable slack.
Keep a small knee bend as you push your hips backward and let the rope travel between your thighs.
Press through your feet and bring your hips forward to stand tall without leaning backward.
description: Stand up from a hip hinge while holding a cable rope between the legs. The glutes and hamstrings extend the hips against the low cable behind the body.

name: Wide-Grip Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your feet planted and your hips steady on the seat.
Take a wide palms-forward grip on the bar and begin with arms extended overhead.
Keep your torso mostly upright as you pull the bar toward your upper chest, bringing your elbows down.
Allow the bar to rise slowly until your arms are extended again.
description: Pull a wide cable bar down in front of the chest while seated. The lats draw the upper arms toward the body as the elbows bend.

name: Wide-Grip Behind-The-Neck Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your feet planted.
Take a wide palms-forward grip on the bar and begin with arms overhead.
Pull the bar down behind your head only through a comfortable shoulder range, keeping your neck relaxed and avoiding bar contact with it.
Extend your arms slowly to return the bar overhead.
description: Pull a wide cable bar down behind the head while seated. The lats lower the upper arms as the elbows bend to either side.

name: Seated High-Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench facing a high cable pulley with feet planted and hold the bar with palms facing you.
Reach upward toward the cable, keeping your upper arms raised in front of you.
Bend your elbows to draw the bar toward your forehead, allowing the elbows to lower while keeping the upper arms raised in front of you.
Extend the elbows slowly to return the bar upward.
description: Curl a high cable bar toward the head while sitting beneath the pulley. The biceps bend the elbows with the upper arms raised in front of the body.

name: Cable Bar Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley and take a palms-down grip on its bar.
Bring your elbows beside your torso and start with them bent.
Straighten both elbows to press the bar toward your thighs without swinging your shoulders.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the bar upward.
description: Press a high cable bar down by straightening both elbows. The triceps move the forearms while the upper arms stay beside the torso.

name: Standing Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and hold its bar with palms facing down.
Begin with arms reaching forward and upward and a small bend in both elbows.
Keep that elbow bend steady as you draw the bar down toward your thighs.
Let the bar rise slowly without leaning backward or turning the movement into a triceps pushdown.
description: Pull a high cable bar down toward the thighs with the elbows nearly straight. The lats move the upper arms downward while the torso stays steady.

name: Cable Rope Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold one rope end in each hand with palms facing each other and elbows bent beside your body.
Straighten your elbows to lower your hands toward the outside of your thighs.
Bend the elbows slowly to return while keeping your upper arms still.
description: Push the ends of a high cable rope downward by straightening both elbows. The triceps work while the upper arms remain close to the torso.

name: Seated Cable Rear-Delt Row
instructions: Sit at a low cable row station with feet braced and hold one handle in each hand.
Begin with arms extended toward the pulley and your torso upright.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, opening your elbows out to the sides.
Extend your arms slowly without rocking your torso.
description: Row two cable handles toward the upper chest with the elbows spread outward. The rear shoulders and upper back move the upper arms behind the torso.

name: Cable Rope Face Pull
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable pulley and stand facing it with a steady stance.
Hold one end in each hand and reach toward the pulley.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating your hands and bringing your elbows out to the sides.
Extend the arms slowly to return without leaning back to move the weight.
description: Pull a high cable rope toward the face with the elbows wide. The rear shoulders and upper back move the arms while the hands separate beside the head.

name: Single-Arm Cable Side Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand side-on to a pulley set around shoulder height and hold its handle in the farther hand.
Raise your working upper arm out to the side and bend the elbow to bring your hand near the shoulder.
Keep the upper arm lifted and straighten the elbow to move the handle outward to the side.
Bend the elbow slowly to return, then repeat on the other side.
description: Straighten one elbow outward to the side while the upper arm stays raised. The triceps extend the arm against a cable crossing from the opposite side.

name: Cable Behind-The-Neck Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station with feet planted and thighs secured beneath its pads.
Hold the bar with a wide palms-forward grip and extend your arms overhead.
Pull the bar behind your head through a comfortable shoulder range without pushing your head forward or pressing the bar against your neck.
Return the bar overhead slowly.
description: Pull a wide cable bar down behind the head while seated. The lats draw the upper arms down as the elbows bend outward.

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
instructions: Secure the low cable attachment around your feet and lie on your back with your feet toward the pulley.
Place your hands on the floor beside you and bend your hips and knees so your legs are raised.
Curl your pelvis upward to bring your bent knees toward your chest, keeping your upper back on the floor.
Lower your pelvis slowly and return the legs to the starting position without letting the cable pull you abruptly.
description: Curl the pelvis off the floor with a low cable attached around the feet. The abs roll the lower trunk upward while the knees stay bent.

name: Cable Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low pulley and hold its bar with a palms-down grip.
Begin with arms nearly straight and elbows close to your sides.
Bend the elbows to lift the bar toward your chest without swinging your upper arms.
Lower the bar slowly while keeping wrists aligned with your forearms.
description: Curl a low cable bar with palms facing down. The elbow flexors and forearms lift the bar while the upper arms remain beside the torso.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Pushdown with Arm Blaster
instructions: Attach a curved bar to a high pulley and fit the arm blaster so its pad supports your upper arms.
Stand facing the cable and hold the bar with palms facing upward.
Keep your upper arms against the pad as you straighten your elbows to lower the bar toward your thighs.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the bar upward.
description: Press a curved cable bar downward with palms facing up and the upper arms supported by an arm blaster. The triceps straighten the elbows against the high cable.
aliases: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (Sz-Bar) (With Arm Blaster)

name: Single-Arm Cable Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low pulley and take its handle in one hand with your palm facing down.
Begin with the arm nearly straight and keep your working elbow beside your torso.
Bend the elbow to lift the handle toward the front of your shoulder.
Lower slowly without bending the wrist, then repeat with the other arm.
description: Curl a low cable handle with one palm facing down. The elbow flexors and forearms lift the handle while the upper arm stays beside the body.

name: Cable Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low pulley and rest your upper arms on its pad.
Hold the bar with palms facing down and begin with elbows nearly straight.
Curl the bar upward while keeping the upper arms supported and wrists aligned.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbows straight.
description: Curl a low cable bar with palms facing down while the upper arms rest on a preacher pad. The elbow flexors lift the bar and the forearms maintain the grip.

name: Seated Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench facing a low pulley and hold its bar with palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs with your hands extending beyond your knees.
Keep the forearms still and lift your knuckles upward by extending your wrists.
Lower your hands slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
description: Lift the backs of the hands against a low cable while the forearms rest on the thighs. The forearm muscles extend the wrists without moving the elbows.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and take a palms-up grip on the bar.
Bring your upper arms beside your torso with the elbows bent.
Straighten both elbows to lower the bar toward your thighs without moving your shoulders.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
description: Lower a high cable bar with palms facing upward by straightening both elbows. The triceps move the forearms while the upper arms stay beside the body.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit beneath a high cable pulley with feet planted and take a palms-toward-you grip on its bar.
Begin with arms extended overhead and torso upright.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest, bringing your elbows down in front of your sides.
Extend your arms slowly to return the bar overhead.
description: Pull a cable bar from overhead toward the chest with palms facing you. The lats draw the upper arms down while the biceps bend the elbows.
aliases: Cable Reverse-Grip Straight Back Seated High Row

name: Seated Crossed-Rope Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a low cable row station with feet braced and knees slightly bent.
Hold the opposite rope ends so your forearms cross in the forward-reaching position.
Pull your elbows backward and separate your hands toward the sides of your waist, bringing your torso upright.
Reach forward slowly and let the forearms cross again as you lean forward from your hips with control.
description: Row a cable rope from a forward reach with the forearms crossed. The back and arms pull the rope ends apart toward the waist as the torso returns upright.

name: Seated Low-Cable Rope Row
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with feet braced, knees slightly bent and one rope end in each hand.
Begin with arms reaching forward toward the low pulley and a small forward lean from the hips.
Pull both elbows backward and draw the rope ends toward your waist as your torso comes upright.
Extend your arms slowly and return to the forward-reaching position.
description: Pull a cable rope toward the abdomen from a seated position above the low pulley. The back and biceps row the hands toward the waist while the feet brace against the station.

name: Chest-Supported Incline Cable Rope Row
instructions: Place an incline bench facing a low cable pulley and attach a rope.
Lean chest-first against the bench with feet planted wide and hold one rope end in each hand.
Pull your elbows backward to bring the rope toward the sides of your ribs while keeping your chest supported.
Extend your arms slowly toward the pulley.
description: Row a cable rope toward the ribs while the chest rests on an incline bench. The back and biceps pull the arms backward with the torso supported.
aliases: Cable Rope Extension Incline Bench Row

name: Cable Rope Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low pulley with a rope attached.
Rest both upper arms on the pad and hold one rope end in each hand with palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to raise the rope ends toward your shoulders without lifting your upper arms.
Lower slowly until the elbows are nearly straight.
description: Curl a cable rope with the upper arms supported on a preacher pad and palms facing each other. The elbow flexors lift the rope while the shoulders remain supported.

name: Leaning High-Cable Rope Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing away from it.
Take a staggered stance, lean forward from your hips and hold the rope ends beside your head with elbows bent.
Keep your upper arms near your head as you straighten your elbows to reach forward.
Bend the elbows slowly to bring your hands back beside your head without changing your torso position.
description: Extend both elbows forward with a rope attached to a high pulley behind the body. The triceps straighten the arms while the torso leans forward in a staggered stance.
aliases: Cable Rope High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension

name: Incline-Bench Cable Rope Triceps Extension
instructions: Place an incline bench with its head end toward a low pulley and attach a rope.
Lie back on the bench with feet planted and hold the rope ends above your upper chest.
Keep your upper arms raised and bend your elbows to lower your hands behind your head through a comfortable range.
Straighten the elbows to return the hands upward without moving your shoulders.
description: Extend both elbows with a rope attached to a low pulley behind an incline bench. The triceps raise the hands while the back stays on the bench and the upper arms remain steady.

name: Floor-Lying Cable Rope Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and lie on your back with your head toward the pulley.
Bend your knees, plant your feet and hold one rope end in each hand above your chest.
Keep your upper arms raised as you bend the elbows to lower the hands beside your head.
Straighten your elbows slowly to lift the rope back above your chest.
description: Straighten both elbows while lying on the floor with a cable rope above the chest. The triceps move the hands while the upper arms remain raised.
aliases: Cable Rope Lying on Floor Tricep Extension

name: Single-Arm Cable Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable and sit at a preacher bench facing the pulley.
Hold one end of the rope with your thumb pointing up. Rest the back of your upper arm on the pad.
Bend your elbow to bring your hand toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm on the pad.
Lower your hand slowly until your elbow is nearly straight without forcing it backward.
Finish the repetitions on one arm, then switch arms.
description: Curl a cable rope with one arm while your upper arm rests on a preacher pad. The thumb-up grip works the biceps and forearms.
aliases: Cable Rope One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl

name: Seated Cable Rope Row
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley of a seated row station. Sit with your feet on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing each other and reach forward with your arms.
Pull your elbows back beside your body and bring the rope toward your abdomen as you sit tall.
Let your arms straighten slowly, allowing your shoulder blades to move forward without rounding your lower back.
Continue with a controlled pull and return, avoiding a forceful swing of your torso.
description: Pull a low cable rope toward your abdomen while seated at a rowing station. This movement works the upper back, lats, and biceps.

name: Cable Russian Twist on Stability Ball
instructions: Position a stability ball beside a high cable pulley. Hold the handle with both hands and carefully lower your upper back onto the ball.
Plant your feet apart on the floor, bend your knees, and lift your hips so your trunk is supported between your shoulders and feet.
Extend your arms above your chest with a slight bend in your elbows.
Turn your shoulders and arms away from the pulley, keeping your hips steady and your feet planted.
Return slowly toward the pulley without letting the cable pull you off balance.
After completing one side, reposition the ball and repeat facing the other direction.
description: Rotate your upper body against cable resistance while your upper back rests on a stability ball. Your obliques turn your torso while your hips stay lifted.

name: Seated Cable Chest Press
instructions: Sit at a cable chest press station with your back against the pad and your feet on the floor.
Hold a handle in each hand beside your chest, with your elbows bent and pointing out and slightly down.
Keep your back against the pad and press both handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Bend your elbows slowly to return the handles beside your chest.
Keep your wrists straight and control the return before pressing again.
description: Press two cable handles forward from a supported seated position. The chest drives the press with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Seated Cable Crunch
instructions: Place a flat bench in front of a high pulley with a rope attached. Sit facing away from the pulley with your feet planted.
Hold the rope ends beside your head and keep your hips on the bench.
Gently tighten your abdomen, then curl your upper body forward to bring your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your hands beside your head instead of pulling the rope down with your arms.
Raise your chest slowly to the starting position without leaning backward.
description: Curl your chest toward your thighs while seated in front of a high cable. Your abdominal muscles bend your trunk against the cable resistance.

name: Seated Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to a low cable. Sit on a flat bench facing the pulley with your feet apart.
Lean forward and hold the bar with your palms facing up. Brace your upper arms against the insides of your thighs.
Bend both elbows to curl the bar upward, keeping your upper arms supported.
Lower the bar slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.
Keep your torso still as you continue curling.
description: Curl a low cable bar while seated with your upper arms braced against your inner thighs. This supported curl works both biceps together.

name: Seated High Cable Row with V-Handle
instructions: Attach a V-handle to a high pulley and sit on a flat bench facing it with your feet planted.
Hold the handle with your palms facing each other and reach your arms upward toward the pulley.
Pull your elbows down and back, bringing the handle toward your upper chest as you lean back slightly.
Keep the lean controlled and avoid jerking your torso to move the weight.
Straighten your arms slowly and return your torso toward upright.
description: Pull a close-grip handle from a high pulley toward your upper chest. This seated row works the lats and upper back with a controlled backward lean.

name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit on a flat bench facing the cable pulley with your feet planted on the floor.
Hold a single handle in one hand and reach your arm forward. Rest your other hand on your thigh.
Pull your elbow back beside your body and bring the handle toward your waist.
Reach forward slowly again, keeping your torso steady rather than twisting to pull.
Complete the repetitions with one arm, then switch hands.
description: Pull a cable handle toward your waist with one arm while seated on a bench. The upper back, lats, and biceps work on one side at a time.
aliases: Cable Seated One Arm Alternate Row

name: Single-Arm Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench beside a low pulley with your feet apart. Hold the handle in one hand.
Lean forward and rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of the same-side thigh, just above your knee.
Turn your palm upward and curl the handle toward your shoulder without moving your upper arm.
Lower your hand slowly until the elbow is nearly straight.
Complete one side, then reposition yourself to work the other arm.
description: Curl a low cable handle while seated with one upper arm supported against your thigh. This setup limits upper-arm movement as your biceps bend the elbow.
aliases: Cable Seated One Arm Concentration Curl

name: Seated High Cable Curl
instructions: Place a flat bench between two high cable pulleys with a handle on each side.
Sit tall with your feet planted. Hold both handles and raise your upper arms out to the sides, slightly above shoulder height.
Keep your upper arms in place and bend your elbows, bringing your hands toward the sides of your head.
Straighten your elbows slowly to reach back toward the pulleys.
Keep your torso still and avoid dropping your elbows as you repeat.
description: Curl two high cable handles toward your head while seated with your upper arms held out to the sides. Your biceps work while your shoulders hold the arm position.

name: Seated Bent-Over Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Place a flat bench between two low cable pulleys. Sit with your feet planted and hold the opposite cable handle in each hand.
Lean forward from your hips until your chest is close to your thighs. Let your hands hang below your shoulders.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides until they are roughly in line with your shoulders.
Lower the handles slowly beneath your chest.
Keep the forward lean and elbow bend steady throughout the movement.
description: Raise your arms out to the sides while leaning forward on a bench. The cables load the rear shoulders and upper back as your arms open.

name: Seated Cable Row with V-Handle
instructions: Sit at a low cable row station with your feet on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the V-handle with your palms facing each other. Reach forward from your hips without rounding your lower back.
Pull the handle toward your abdomen and draw your elbows back beside your body as you sit tall.
Allow your arms to straighten slowly, returning to the forward reach.
Keep the forward and backward movement controlled rather than swinging to move the weight.
description: Pull a close-grip cable handle toward your abdomen from a seated rowing station. This row works the upper back, lats, and biceps.

name: Floor-Seated Cable Shoulder Internal Rotation
instructions: Sit on the floor beside a cable pulley with your legs extended. Set the pulley near elbow height and hold the handle in the hand nearest it.
Bend that elbow to a right angle and keep it tucked beside your waist. Start with your forearm pointing outward toward the cable.
Rotate at the shoulder to bring your hand across the front of your abdomen, keeping your elbow in place.
Return your forearm slowly toward the pulley without turning your torso.
Reposition yourself and repeat with the other arm.
description: Turn one forearm inward against a cable while keeping your upper arm beside your body. The movement works the shoulder muscles that rotate the arm inward, including part of the rotator cuff.

name: Seated Cable Torso Rotation
instructions: Sit sideways to a cable pulley at about chest height with your feet planted.
Hold the handle in both hands and extend your arms in front of your chest with a slight bend in your elbows.
Rotate your chest and arms away from the pulley, keeping your hips facing forward.
Return slowly toward the pulley without letting the weight jerk your arms back.
Reposition the seat so the pulley is on your other side, then repeat.
description: Turn your shoulders and arms across your body against cable resistance while seated. The obliques rotate your trunk while your hips remain on the seat.

name: Wide-Grip Seated Cable Row
instructions: Attach a wide bar to a low cable row station. Sit with your feet on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders and your palms facing down.
Sit tall and pull the bar toward your lower chest, letting your elbows move outward and back.
Bring your shoulder blades toward each other without shrugging your shoulders.
Straighten your arms slowly to return the bar, keeping your torso controlled.
description: Pull a wide cable bar toward your lower chest while seated. The wider elbow path emphasizes the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: Standing Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand between two low cable pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Bring the handles beside your shoulders with your elbows bent and pointing out. Plant your feet about hip-width apart.
Gently tighten your abdomen and press both handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower the handles slowly to shoulder height.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning backward as you press.
description: Press two low cable handles overhead while standing. Your shoulders and triceps lift the handles while your trunk holds you upright.

name: Cable Shrug
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley and stand facing it with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hold the bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing your body and your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears without bending your elbows or rolling your shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly and let them settle before repeating.
description: Lift and lower your shoulders while holding a low cable bar. This small movement works the upper trapezius muscles.

name: Standing Cable Side Bend
instructions: Stand sideways beside a low cable pulley. Hold the handle in the hand nearest the pulley and let that arm hang beside your thigh.
Plant your feet about shoulder-width apart and keep your chest facing forward.
Bend sideways away from the pulley, moving your ribs toward the opposite hip without turning your torso.
Return slowly toward the pulley through a comfortable range.
Finish the repetitions, then turn around and repeat on the other side.
description: Bend your trunk away from a low cable while keeping your hips steady. The muscles along the side of your waist work against the cable resistance.

name: Cable Side Crunch on Bosu Ball
instructions: Place a BOSU ball dome-side up beside a low cable pulley. Sit in front of it and lean your lower back onto the dome with your knees bent and feet planted.
Hold the cable handle in the hand nearest the pulley, keeping that arm beside your hip.
Curl your ribs toward that hip in a small sideways crunch, letting the handle move with your torso.
Return slowly to the reclined starting position without pulling the handle with your elbow.
Reposition yourself to repeat on the other side.
description: Curl your upper body toward one hip while your lower back rests on a BOSU ball. A low cable adds resistance to the movement through the side of your waist.

name: Standing High-Cable Side Crunch
instructions: Stand beside a high cable pulley with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hold the handle in the hand nearest the pulley and keep it beside your head with your elbow bent.
Bend sideways to bring that elbow and the same-side hip closer together, keeping your hips steady.
Return slowly to an upright position without pulling the handle with your arm.
Complete one side, then turn around to work the other side.
description: Bring one side of your ribs toward your hip while holding a high cable beside your head. The side of your waist bends your trunk against the cable.

name: Cable Squat to Rope Row
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable around waist height. Face the pulley and hold one rope end in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Step back, set your feet about shoulder-width apart, and lower into a squat with your arms extended toward the pulley.
Push through your feet to stand while pulling your elbows back and bringing the rope toward your waist.
Extend your arms as you bend your knees and hips to return to the squat.
Keep the rise, pull, and return controlled as one coordinated sequence.
description: Combine a squat with a standing cable row. Your thighs and glutes raise your body as your upper back and arms pull the rope toward your waist.

name: Cable Curl in Deep Squat
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to a low pulley. Face the cable and hold the bar with your palms facing up.
Lower into a comfortable deep squat with your feet planted and knees apart.
Brace your upper arms against the insides of your thighs near your knees.
Bend your elbows to curl the bar toward your face while keeping your squat position steady.
Lower the bar slowly until your elbows are nearly straight. Stay in the squat for the remaining curls.
description: Curl a low cable bar while holding a deep squat with your upper arms braced against your thighs. The biceps move the bar while your legs hold the squat position.

name: Behind-The-Back Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley. Stand facing away from the cable with the bar behind your hips.
Hold the bar with your palms facing backward and your arms hanging straight.
Keep your forearms still and bend your wrists to curl the bar upward toward the backs of your thighs.
Lower the bar slowly by letting your wrists straighten.
Keep a secure grip and move only through a comfortable wrist range.
description: Curl a cable bar upward behind your hips by bending your wrists. This small movement works the muscles on the palm side of your forearms.

name: Cable Belt Calf Raise
instructions: Use a cable calf raise station with a waist belt and a secure foot platform. Fasten the belt around your hips and connect it to the low cable.
Place the balls of your feet on the platform with your heels free to move. Hold the station handles for balance.
Keep your knees nearly straight and raise your heels as high as you can without rolling your ankles outward.
Lower your heels slowly through a comfortable range below the platform.
Continue lifting and lowering at the ankles without bouncing or pulling yourself up with your arms.
description: Rise onto the balls of your feet while a cable belt pulls down on your hips. The raised platform lets your heels move below your toes during the return.

name: Standing High Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Stand facing two high cable pulleys. Hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left so the cables cross.
Reach your hands forward at about shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull your arms out to the sides and slightly down, bringing your shoulder blades toward each other.
Stop when your arms are roughly in line with your torso.
Return slowly to the crossed position without changing your elbow bend.
description: Open your arms outward against crossed high cables. This movement works the rear shoulders and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
aliases: Cable Standing Cross-Over High Reverse Fly

name: Standing Cable Crunch with Bar
instructions: Attach a short bar to a high pulley. Stand facing away from it with your feet about hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the bar with both hands just above your head, keeping your elbows bent.
Gently tighten your abdomen and curl your ribs toward your pelvis, lowering your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms in the same position relative to your head rather than pulling the bar down with your elbows.
Uncurl slowly to stand tall without leaning backward.
description: Curl your upper body forward while holding a cable bar above your head. The abdominal muscles bend your trunk against the high cable.

name: Standing Cable Rope Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Stand facing away from the machine with your feet planted and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the rope ends beside your head with your elbows bent.
Curl your upper body forward, bringing your ribs toward your pelvis and your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your hands beside your head and avoid turning the movement into an arm pull.
Return slowly to an upright position without arching backward.
description: Curl your chest toward your thighs while holding a cable rope beside your head. This standing abdominal exercise uses resistance from a high pulley.

name: Standing High-To-Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set both cable pulleys above shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand between the pulleys with your feet apart and lean forward slightly from your hips.
Open your arms upward and out to the sides with a small bend in your elbows.
Bring your arms down and forward in an arc until your hands meet in front of your hips.
Reverse the arc slowly, keeping the same elbow bend and avoiding a backward swing of your torso.
description: Bring two high cable handles down and together in front of your hips. Your chest moves the arms while a steady elbow bend keeps the motion focused at the shoulders.

name: Standing Cable Hip Extension
instructions: Fasten an ankle strap to a low cable and stand facing the pulley.
Hold the machine frame for balance. Keep your supporting knee slightly bent and your working leg nearly straight.
Move the strapped leg backward from your hip while keeping your pelvis facing forward.
Stop before you need to arch your lower back to move farther.
Bring the leg forward slowly, then complete the repetitions and switch legs.
description: Move one leg backward against a low cable while standing. The glutes extend your hip, with help from the hamstrings.

name: Standing High Cable Curl
instructions: Stand between two high cable pulleys and hold one handle in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides at about shoulder height, with your palms facing upward.
Keep your upper arms in place and bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your head.
Straighten your elbows slowly to reach back toward the pulleys.
Keep your shoulders level and your torso still throughout the curls.
description: Curl two high cable handles toward the sides of your head while keeping your upper arms out to the sides. This variation works the biceps with the arms raised.

name: Standing Low-To-High Cable Lift
instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle in both hands near the hip closest to the pulley.
Lift your hands diagonally across your body toward the opposite shoulder, turning your chest with the movement.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and avoid leaning backward to finish the lift.
Lower your hands slowly along the same diagonal, then reposition yourself to repeat on the other side.
description: Lift a cable handle diagonally from one hip toward the opposite shoulder. The obliques help turn your trunk while your shoulders guide the upward movement.

name: Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and stand facing the cable.
Hold the handle in one hand with your palm facing up, elbow bent and tucked beside your ribs.
Straighten your elbow to move the handle downward toward your thigh without moving your upper arm forward or back.
Let your elbow bend slowly as the handle rises to the starting position.
Keep your wrist steady, finish the repetitions, and switch arms.
description: Straighten one elbow to move a high cable handle down beside your thigh with an underhand grip. The triceps move the handle while your upper arm stays close to your body.
aliases: Cable Standing One Arm Triceps Extension

name: Single-Leg Cable Belt Calf Raise
instructions: Fasten a cable belt around your hips and connect it to a low pulley. Stand facing the machine and hold its frame for balance.
Place the ball of one foot on a secure raised plate or platform, leaving the heel free. Lift the other foot off the floor.
Keep the working knee nearly straight and rise onto the ball of that foot.
Lower your heel slowly through a comfortable range without bouncing.
Finish the repetitions before switching to the other leg.
description: Raise and lower your heel on one leg while a cable belt adds resistance at your hips. A small raised platform supports the front of the working foot.
aliases: Cable Standing One Leg Calf Raise

name: Standing High Cable Rope Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold one rope end in each hand and reach your arms upward toward the pulley, keeping your palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms raised and bend your elbows to bring the rope ends toward your forehead.
Straighten your elbows slowly to return your hands toward the pulley.
Keep your torso still and avoid pulling the rope down toward your waist.
description: Bend your elbows to draw a high cable rope toward your forehead. The biceps work while your upper arms stay raised in front of you.

name: Standing Cable Rope Face Pull
instructions: Attach a rope to a pulley around upper-chest height. Face it and hold a rope end in each hand.
Step back with your arms extended and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating your hands and moving your elbows outward and back.
Keep your shoulders down and your torso steady as your hands reach either side of your face.
Extend your arms slowly to return the rope.
description: Pull a cable rope toward your face with your elbows out to the sides. This row works the rear shoulders and upper back.
aliases: Cable Standing Rear Delt Row (With Rope)

name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley. Hold it in one hand and stand facing away from the machine.
Raise your upper arm beside your head and bend your elbow so your hand is behind your head.
Keep your upper arm steady and straighten your elbow to lift the handle overhead.
Bend your elbow slowly to lower the handle behind your head again.
Keep your torso upright, finish the repetitions, and switch arms.
description: Straighten one elbow overhead while a low cable pulls from behind you. The triceps move the handle while your upper arm stays beside your head.
aliases: Cable Standing Reverse Grip One Arm Overhead Tricep Extension

name: Standing Cable Row with V-Handle
instructions: Attach a V-handle to a cable around lower-chest height and stand facing it.
Hold the handle with your palms facing each other. Step back with your arms extended and your knees slightly bent.
Pull your elbows back beside your body to bring the handle toward your abdomen.
Keep your chest upright and avoid leaning backward to finish the pull.
Straighten your arms slowly and let your shoulder blades move forward.
description: Pull a close-grip cable handle toward your abdomen while standing. Your upper back and lats move the arms, with help from the biceps.

name: Standing Cable Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set around elbow height. Hold the handle in the hand farther from the pulley.
Bend that elbow to a right angle and tuck it beside your waist. Start with your forearm across your abdomen.
Rotate your forearm outward away from the pulley without moving your elbow away from your body.
Return slowly across your abdomen while keeping your chest facing forward.
Turn around and repeat with the other arm.
description: Turn one forearm outward while keeping your elbow beside your waist. This cable exercise works the shoulder muscles that rotate the arm outward, including the rotator cuff.

name: Standing Cable V-Handle Row with Rotation
instructions: Attach a V-handle to a cable around chest height and stand facing it with your feet planted.
Hold the handle with your palms facing each other and reach your arms toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward one side of your lower chest as you turn your shoulders in that direction.
Keep your hips steady and avoid forcing the twist farther than you can control.
Extend your arms and turn your chest back toward the pulley. Complete one side, then repeat toward the other side.
description: Pull a close-grip cable handle toward one side of your torso while turning your chest. This combines a row for the upper back with a small trunk rotation.

name: Upright Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between two cable pulleys set around shoulder height and hold one handle in each hand.
Keep your torso upright with your feet planted and a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring both arms down and inward in a wide arc, crossing your hands slightly in front of your hips.
Open your arms slowly to return to the starting position.
Keep the elbow bend steady and alternate which hand passes in front when you cross them.
description: Bring two cable handles down and across each other in front of your hips while standing tall. Your chest draws the arms inward against the cables.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown with Bar
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down and hands about shoulder-width apart. Step back until your arms reach forward and upward.
Keep a small, steady bend in your elbows and pull the bar in an arc toward your thighs.
Raise the bar slowly along the same arc, stopping before the cable pulls your torso out of position.
Keep your ribs from flaring upward and avoid turning the movement into an elbow curl.
description: Pull a high cable bar down toward your thighs with your elbows nearly straight. The lats move your upper arms downward while your torso stays steady.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Rope Pulldown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it with your feet planted.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing each other and reach your arms forward and upward.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and pull your upper arms down, bringing the rope ends beside your hips.
Let your arms rise slowly toward the pulley without bending your elbows more.
Keep your torso steady rather than leaning backward to finish the pull.
description: Sweep a high cable rope down beside your hips while keeping your elbows nearly straight. This movement works the lats through shoulder extension.

name: Upright Seated Cable Row with V-Handle
instructions: Sit at a low cable row station with your feet on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the V-handle with your palms facing each other and sit tall with your arms extended.
Pull your elbows back beside your body and bring the handle toward your abdomen.
Straighten your arms slowly, allowing your shoulder blades to move forward.
Keep your torso upright through both phases instead of rocking forward and back.
description: Row a close-grip cable handle toward your abdomen while keeping your torso upright. The upper back and lats move your arms while your biceps bend the elbows.

name: Lying Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Place a flat bench between two high cable pulleys. Take the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left.
Lie on your back with your head supported and your feet on the floor. Hold your arms above your chest so the cables cross.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and lower your arms out to the sides until they are roughly level with your torso.
Bring your hands back above your chest slowly as the cables draw them inward.
Keep your back on the bench and avoid lowering your arms beyond a comfortable shoulder range.
description: Open your arms out to the sides while lying on your back beneath crossed high cables. Your rear shoulders and upper back pull against the cables.

name: Standing Cable Kayak Row
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley. Stand facing it with your feet apart and hold the bar with both hands.
Reach the bar forward and upward with your elbows slightly bent.
Pull the bar down toward one hip while turning your shoulders slightly toward that side.
Return the bar slowly to the raised position.
Sweep the bar toward the other hip, then continue alternating sides with your feet planted.
description: Sweep a cable bar down toward one hip and then the other, like moving a kayak paddle. The lats pull the arms downward while the obliques help turn your trunk.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown with V-Bar
instructions: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley and stand facing the cable.
Hold the angled grips from above with your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Straighten both elbows to press the bar down toward your thighs.
Bend your elbows slowly to let the bar rise without moving your upper arms forward.
Keep your wrists steady and avoid leaning your body weight onto the bar.
description: Press an angled cable bar down by straightening your elbows. The triceps work while your upper arms stay beside your ribs.

name: Cable V-Bar Triceps Pushdown with Arm Blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster so its curved plate rests across your torso and supports the backs of your upper arms.
Attach a V-bar to a high pulley, face the machine, and hold the angled grips from above.
Keep your upper arms against the support and straighten your elbows to press the bar down.
Let the bar rise slowly by bending your elbows while keeping your arms against the plate.
Stand steady and avoid lifting your shoulders or rocking your torso.
description: Press a cable V-bar downward while an arm blaster supports the backs of your upper arms. Your triceps straighten the elbows against the cable resistance.

name: Dual-Cable Tuck Crunch
instructions: Set up two low cable pulleys facing each other, with ankle straps on one cable and a rope on the other.
Fasten the ankle straps and lie on your back between the pulleys, with your feet toward the ankle cable. Hold the rope ends beside your head.
Start with your legs extended close to the floor and your upper back lowered.
Bend your knees toward your chest as you curl your shoulders and pelvis off the floor, bringing your ribs and knees closer together.
Keep the rope beside your head without pulling on your neck.
Lower your shoulders and pelvis slowly as you extend your legs toward the opposite pulley. Stop the leg extension before your lower back arches away from the floor.
description: Curl your shoulders and pelvis toward each other while tucking your knees, with one cable at your feet and another held beside your head. Your abdominal muscles curl the trunk while your hip flexors draw the legs inward.

name: Standing Cable Torso Rotation
instructions: Stand sideways to a pulley set around chest height with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle in both hands and extend your arms in front of your chest with a slight bend in your elbows.
Turn your chest and arms away from the pulley, keeping your feet planted and your hips steady.
Return slowly toward the pulley without letting the cable jerk you around.
Finish the repetitions, then turn around to work the other side.
description: Turn your chest and arms across your body against a cable at chest height. Your obliques rotate your torso while your hips remain mostly forward.

name: High-To-Low Cable Wood Chop
instructions: Stand sideways to a high cable pulley with your feet apart. Hold the handle in both hands near the shoulder closest to the pulley.
Keep your arms slightly bent and draw the handle diagonally down across your body toward the opposite hip.
Turn your chest and hips with the movement, allowing the foot nearest the pulley to pivot.
Return slowly along the same diagonal as your body turns back toward the pulley.
Complete one side, then turn around and repeat in the opposite direction.
description: Pull a high cable diagonally down toward the opposite hip while turning your torso. This coordinated movement works the obliques with help from the shoulders.

name: Bent-Over Single-Arm Cable Row with Rotation
instructions: Face a cable pulley set in front of your torso. Hold the handle in one hand and step back into a wide staggered stance.
Bend your knees and lean forward from your hips, reaching the working arm toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward the side of your chest, drawing your elbow back as that shoulder turns upward slightly.
Keep your hips steady and your lower back from rounding.
Reach forward slowly and let your chest turn back toward the floor. Finish one arm before switching sides.
description: Row one cable handle while leaning forward and turning your chest slightly. The lats and upper back pull the arm back as the obliques help control the turn.

name: Incline Bench Cable Curl with Arms Out
instructions: Place an incline bench between two cable pulleys with a handle on each side.
Lie back against the pad with your feet on the floor. Hold the handles with your palms facing up and your arms extended out to the sides.
Keep your upper arms in that open position and bend your elbows to curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Lower the handles slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.
Keep your head and back on the pad and avoid letting your elbows swing forward.
description: Curl two side cable handles while reclining on an incline bench with your arms open to the sides. Your biceps bend the elbows while the bench supports your torso.
aliases: Cable Two Arm Curl on Incline Bench

name: Two-Arm Cable Triceps Kickback
instructions: Stand facing two low cable pulleys and hold a cable grip in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips until your torso is nearly level with the floor.
Raise your elbows beside your torso and keep them bent, with your hands below your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten both elbows to move your hands back beside your hips.
Bend your elbows slowly to return the grips without changing your torso position.
description: Straighten both elbows backward while holding a bent-over position. The triceps move the cable grips while the upper arms remain beside your torso.

name: Underhand Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station with your feet on the floor and your thighs secured beneath the pad.
Hold the bar with your palms facing you and your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Sit tall with a slight backward lean and pull the bar toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down beside your body.
Raise the bar slowly until your arms are extended overhead.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging backward to move the weight.
description: Pull a cable bar toward your upper chest with your palms facing you. The lats and biceps bring your arms down from overhead.

name: Upward Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between two cable pulleys around shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Open your arms out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows and your feet planted.
Bring your arms upward and inward until your hands meet above the front of your head.
Lower your arms slowly out to the sides along the same arc.
Keep the elbow bend steady and avoid arching your back as your hands rise.
description: Bring two cable handles upward and together above your chest. This upward arc works the chest and front shoulders while your torso stays upright.

name: Seated Cable High-Elbow Row
instructions: Sit at a low cable row station with your feet planted and your knees bent.
Hold the bar from above with your hands about shoulder-width apart and extend your arms toward the pulley.
Sit tall and pull the bar toward your upper chest, lifting your elbows outward to about shoulder height.
Straighten your arms slowly to return the bar toward the low pulley.
Keep your torso upright without shrugging or leaning back to finish the pull.
description: Pull a low cable bar toward your upper chest with your elbows out to the sides. This seated row works the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley and stand facing it with your feet planted.
Hold the bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing your body.
Raise your elbows outward and upward, letting the bar travel close to your torso.
Stop around upper-chest height or earlier if needed to keep the movement comfortable.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs without shrugging sharply or rocking your torso.
description: Lift a low cable bar close to your body by raising your elbows out to the sides. The shoulders and upper trapezius lift the arms while the elbows bend.

name: Wide-Grip Behind-The-Neck Cable Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station with your feet planted and your thighs beneath the restraint pad.
Hold the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands wider than your shoulders.
Sit upright and bend your elbows down and out to bring the bar behind your head toward the top of your shoulders.
Stop within a range that lets you keep your neck comfortable without forcing your head forward.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are extended overhead.
description: Pull a wide cable bar down behind your head while seated. The lats and upper back lower the arms in a position that requires substantial shoulder mobility.
aliases: Cable Wide Grip Rear Pulldown behind Neck

name: Seated Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley and sit on a flat bench facing the cable.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up. Lean forward and rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just beyond your knees.
Keep your forearms supported and bend your wrists to raise the bar toward you.
Lower the bar slowly by letting your wrists extend through a comfortable range.
Keep a secure grip and avoid lifting your elbows from your thighs.
description: Curl a low cable bar upward with your wrists while your forearms rest on your thighs. The movement works the muscles on the palm side of the forearms.

name: Toes-Against-Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands against it for support.
Set the toes and ball of one foot up against the wall with that heel on the floor. Keep the other foot slightly behind you.
Keep the front leg nearly straight and move your body gently toward the wall until you feel a mild calf stretch.
Hold without bouncing, then ease back and switch feet.
description: Place the front of one foot against a wall and lean toward it to stretch that calf. Your heel stays on the floor while the wall holds your toes upward.
aliases: Calf Push Stretch with Hands Against Wall

name: Standing Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Place your hands on a wall and step one foot behind the other.
Point both feet forward and keep the back knee straight with the heel on the floor.
Bend the front knee and move your hips toward the wall until you feel a gentle stretch in the back calf.
Hold without bouncing, then step back out of the stretch and switch legs.
description: Lean into a wall with one leg behind you to stretch the rear calf. The back knee stays straight and the heel stays down.
aliases: Calf Stretch with Hands Against Wall

name: Lying Rope-Assisted Calf Stretch
