instructions: Lie on your back and loop a rope around the ball of one foot. Hold one end in each hand.
Bend and draw that knee toward your body while the other leg rests on the floor.
Gently pull the rope to bring the toes toward your shin, keeping the foot relaxed.
Hold at a mild calf stretch without jerking the rope, then ease the pull and lower the leg.
Repeat with the other foot.
description: Use a rope around one foot to draw the toes toward your shin while lying on your back. The rope helps you control a gentle stretch through the calf.

name: Cambered Bar Seal Row
instructions: Place a cambered bar beneath a raised flat bench with enough clearance for the plates to move.
Lie face down with your torso and legs supported on the bench and your feet raised behind you.
Reach down and hold the bar from above with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar toward your chest, bringing your elbows back while keeping your body on the bench.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are extended below you.
description: Row a cambered bar toward your chest while lying face down on a raised bench. The curved bar allows room for the bench as your upper back and arms pull.

name: Captain's Chair Straight-Leg Raise
instructions: Step onto the captain's chair and place your forearms on the pads, holding the handles with your back against the support.
Lift your feet clear of the steps and let your legs hang beneath you.
Gently tighten your abdomen and raise both legs forward with your knees nearly straight, stopping around hip height.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging your body or letting your lower back arch.
Keep your shoulders steady over the arm pads throughout the movement.
description: Raise both legs in front of you while your forearms and back rest against a captain's chair. The hip flexors lift the legs while the abdominal muscles help keep your trunk steady.

name: Seated Bodyweight Knee Extension
instructions: Sit on a sturdy bench with your feet on the floor and hold the seat beside your hips.
Keep one thigh on the seat and straighten that knee to lift your foot in front of you.
Pause with the leg nearly straight without forcing the knee backward.
Bend the knee slowly to lower the foot, then repeat on the other leg after finishing the first side.
description: Straighten one knee to lift your foot while seated. The quadriceps on the front of the thigh raise the lower leg against its own weight.

name: Wide-Grip Bar Shoulder Mobility
instructions: Stand tall and hold a light exercise bar in front of your hips with your palms facing down and your hands well outside shoulder width.
Keep your elbows nearly straight and raise the bar forward and overhead.
Continue only slightly behind your head, within a range that lets your ribs stay down and your neck remain relaxed.
Return the bar slowly along the same path to the front of your hips.
Use a wider grip if needed rather than forcing your shoulders through a tight range.
description: Lift a widely held bar from in front of your hips to above and slightly behind your head. This controlled movement takes the shoulders through an overhead range and opens the front of the chest.
aliases: Chest and Front of Shoulder Stretch

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip the dip handles and support your body above them with your arms nearly straight and your feet clear of the floor.
Bend your knees and lean your chest slightly forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are roughly level with the floor, or stop sooner to stay comfortable.
Press through the handles to straighten your arms and raise your body.
Keep your shoulders controlled and avoid dropping quickly into the bottom position.
description: Lower and raise your body between dip bars with a slight forward lean. The chest, triceps, and front shoulders work together to press your body upward.

name: Chest Dip on Tower
instructions: Use the tower steps to reach the dip handles. Press yourself into a supported position with your arms nearly straight.
Lift your feet clear of the steps and lean your chest slightly forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your body between the handles through a comfortable range.
Press through your palms to raise yourself until your arms are nearly straight again.
Keep the movement controlled, then return your feet to the steps when finished.
description: Perform a forward-leaning dip using the handles of a dip and pull-up tower. The chest and triceps lower and raise your body while your feet remain off the steps.

name: Straight-Bar Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself above one secure horizontal bar with both hands on top, about shoulder-width apart.
Keep the bar in front of your hips and your feet clear of the floor.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar, letting your legs move forward enough to maintain balance.
Press down into the bar to straighten your arms and raise your body.
Keep the descent controlled and use only a comfortable shoulder range.
description: Lower your chest toward a single horizontal bar and press back above it. Keeping both hands in front of your body changes the support compared with parallel-bar dips.

name: Kneeling Chest Stretch on Stability Ball
instructions: Kneel beside a stability ball and place one hand and forearm across its top.
Place your other hand on the floor for support and keep the supported arm extended out from your shoulder.
Lower your chest toward the floor while letting the ball roll outward slightly.
Pause at a gentle stretch across the chest and shoulder, then push lightly through your floor hand to rise.
Reposition the ball and repeat with the other arm.
description: Lower your chest while one arm rests on a stability ball. The raised arm lets you gently stretch the chest and front of that shoulder.

name: Explosive Chest-Tap Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press forcefully through both hands so they leave the floor together.
Briefly bring both hands to your chest, then return them beneath your shoulders before landing.
Land with your elbows slightly bent to absorb the impact and regain control before the next repetition.
description: Push away from the floor fast enough to lift both hands and briefly tap your chest. This advanced explosive push-up requires a controlled landing with both hands.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grip a secure overhead bar with your palms facing you and your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let your body hang with your arms extended and your feet off the floor.
Pull your elbows down toward your sides to raise your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are extended again.
Keep your body steady and avoid swinging your legs to start the next pull.
description: Pull your body toward an overhead bar with your palms facing you. The lats and biceps lift you while your trunk stays steady.

name: Narrow Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grip a pair of close parallel pull-up handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms extended and your feet off the floor.
Pull your elbows down beside your body to bring your upper chest toward the handles.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are extended again.
Keep your legs steady and avoid swinging to start the pull.
description: Pull your body upward using two close parallel handles. With your palms facing each other, the lats and biceps lift your body toward your hands.

name: Standing Knee Circles
instructions: Stand with your feet close together and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your weight balanced across both feet.
Move both knees together through a small, slow circle, allowing your hips and ankles to move naturally with them.
Reverse the direction and repeat without forcing a twist at the knees.
description: Move your bent knees through small circles while standing with your feet close together. This is a gentle lower-body mobility drill involving the knees, hips, and ankles.

name: Clapping Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press forcefully through both palms so your hands leave the floor.
Clap your hands briefly, then separate them and return them beneath your shoulders.
Land with your elbows slightly bent and regain control before continuing.
description: Push explosively from the floor and clap your hands before landing. This advanced push-up combines upper-body pressing with a quick, controlled return of the hands.

name: Clock Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with both hands on the floor and your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest by bending your elbows, then press back up.
At the top, reposition your hands and feet to turn your body a short distance to one side.
Set both hands firmly and perform the next push-up facing the new direction.
Continue with controlled changes of direction, keeping your hips from sagging during each repositioning.
description: Perform push-ups while changing the direction your body faces, like moving around a clock. Your chest and arms press while your trunk helps you hold a straight body position during each turn.

name: Close-Grip Chin-Up
instructions: Hold a secure pull-up bar with your palms facing you and your hands closer than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms extended and your feet off the floor.
Pull your elbows down beside your body until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to the extended-arm position.
Keep your body steady and avoid kicking or swinging.
description: Pull toward an overhead bar with a narrow underhand grip. The lats and biceps lift your body while your hands remain closer together than in a standard chin-up.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands close together beneath the middle of your chest and extend your legs behind you onto your toes.
Hold a straight line from your head to your heels and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend your elbows back close to your sides to lower your chest toward your hands.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms without letting your hips sag.
Keep your hands planted as you continue the controlled lowering and pressing motion.
description: Perform a push-up with your hands close together beneath your chest. The narrower hand position increases the role of the triceps while the chest and shoulders also press.

name: Kneeling Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands close together beneath your chest and rest both knees on the floor behind you.
Move your knees back enough to form a straight line from your head through your hips to your knees.
Bend your elbows back beside your ribs and lower your chest toward your hands.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms while keeping your hips in line with your torso.
Keep your knees on the floor and control the next descent.
description: Perform a close-grip push-up with your knees resting on the floor. The triceps, chest, and shoulders press with less body weight supported by the hands than in the toe-supported version.

name: Cocoon Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lift your shoulders as you bend your knees toward your chest.
Bring your arms forward around your knees to form a compact tuck without pulling hard on your legs.
Uncurl slowly, reaching your arms overhead and extending your legs again.
Keep the return controlled and shorten the reach if your lower back starts to arch.
description: Curl your shoulders and knees toward each other from an extended lying position. The abs bend your trunk while the hip flexors draw the legs inward.

name: Crab Toe Touch
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and your feet flat. Place your hands on the floor behind your hips.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips into a low reverse tabletop position.
Raise one leg and reach the opposite hand toward its toes, turning your chest slightly as you balance on the other hand and foot.
Return that hand and foot to the floor with control.
Complete the repetitions, then switch the reaching hand and raised leg.
description: Reach one hand toward the opposite foot while holding your hips off the floor in a crab position. The abs and obliques help you turn and balance as the hip flexors lift the leg.

name: Cross-Body Crunch with Knee Lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the floor. Rest your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you curl the opposite shoulder off the floor and turn toward that knee.
Keep your hands light so you are not pulling on your neck. Your elbow does not need to touch the knee.
Lower your shoulder and foot slowly back to the floor.
Repeat on the other side, keeping each lift controlled.
description: Curl one shoulder toward the opposite knee as that knee lifts toward your chest. The abs and obliques bend and turn your trunk while the hip flexors lift the leg.

name: Overhead-Arm Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet planted.
Reach both arms overhead along the floor beside your ears, keeping your elbows nearly straight.
Gently tighten your abdomen and curl your shoulders upward, keeping your arms in line with your upper body.
Keep your lower back on the floor and avoid swinging your arms to lift yourself.
Lower your shoulders and arms slowly to the starting position.
description: Curl your shoulders off the floor while keeping both arms extended beside your ears. The longer arm position changes the load on the abdominal curl.

name: Stability Ball Crunch with Arms Crossed
instructions: Sit on a stability ball, then walk your feet forward until your lower back rests on the ball.
Plant your feet apart with your knees bent and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis to lift your shoulders, keeping your hips and the ball steady.
Lower your upper back slowly over the ball through a comfortable range.
Continue without pushing through your feet to roll the ball forward and back.
description: Curl your upper body while your lower back rests on a stability ball. Crossing your arms over your chest keeps them out of the movement as the abs shorten.

name: Stability Ball Crunch with Upward Reach
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward until your lower back is supported by the ball.
Keep your knees bent and feet planted. Extend both arms above your chest toward the ceiling.
Curl your shoulders upward while continuing to reach your hands upward.
Lower your shoulders slowly without dropping your arms behind your head.
Keep your hips and the ball steady as you repeat.
description: Curl your upper body on a stability ball while reaching both arms toward the ceiling. The abs move your rib cage toward your pelvis while your feet steady the ball.

name: Floor Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Rest your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows open.
Gently tighten your abdomen and curl your shoulders off the floor, bringing your ribs toward your pelvis.
Keep your lower back down and avoid pulling your head forward with your hands.
Lower your shoulders slowly back to the floor.
description: Curl your shoulders off the floor while keeping your feet planted. The abs bend your upper trunk through a small, controlled range.

name: Curl-Up with One Leg Extended
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Slide both hands beneath your lower back without pressing your back flat.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lift your head and shoulders a small distance, keeping your neck in line with your chest.
Lower slowly without changing the position of your lower back.
After finishing the repetitions, switch which knee is bent.
description: Lift your head and shoulders slightly while one leg is straight and the other knee is bent. Your hands support the natural curve beneath your lower back as the abs hold the small curl.

name: Alternating Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and your hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot diagonally behind the other, placing the toes on the floor.
Bend both knees to lower your body while keeping most of your weight over the front foot.
Press through the front foot to stand and bring the rear foot back beside it.
Repeat to the other side, using a small enough cross-behind step to keep the front knee controlled.
description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and bend both knees, then return to standing. The front thigh and glutes work while the crossed stance adds a balance demand.

name: Air Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee remains slightly bent when its pedal is farthest from you.
Sit on the saddle, place your feet on the pedals, and hold the moving handles.
Begin pedaling smoothly while pushing one handle forward and pulling the other back.
Keep your torso steady and choose a pace you can maintain with coordinated arm and leg movement.
Slow the pedals and handles gradually before stepping off.
description: Pedal a fan-resistance bike while pushing and pulling its moving handles. The legs and arms work together to produce a continuous cardiovascular effort.

name: Dead Bug with Leg Extension
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your knees above your hips with both knees bent. Reach both arms toward the ceiling.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lift your head and shoulders slightly, keeping your lower back supported by the floor.
Keep both arms raised as you slowly straighten and lower one leg toward the floor.
Stop before your lower back arches, then bring that knee back above your hip.
Complete the repetitions, then switch legs while maintaining the same arm and trunk position.
description: Extend one leg at a time while lying on your back with both arms reaching upward. The abs hold your trunk steady as the hip flexors control the moving leg.

name: Decline Crunch
instructions: Secure your feet in a decline bench and lie back with your knees bent and your head at the lower end.
Rest your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows open.
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis to lift your shoulders from the pad.
Keep your lower back on the bench and avoid pulling your neck forward.
Lower your shoulders slowly to the pad.
description: Curl your shoulders off a decline bench while your feet remain secured above your head. The abs bend the upper trunk without a full rise to sitting.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place your toes on a stable flat bench and your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from your head to your heels with your abdomen gently tightened.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor without letting your hips sag.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your feet secure on the bench and control the next descent.
description: Perform a push-up with your feet raised on a flat bench. Elevating the feet shifts more of your body weight toward the hands while the chest, shoulders, and triceps press.

name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back with your knees bent and your head lower than your hips.
Place your hands lightly behind your head and keep your elbows open.
Curl your upper body off the pad, then continue raising your torso toward your thighs.
Keep your hands from pulling on your neck and stop before you need to jerk yourself higher.
Lower your torso slowly back onto the bench.
description: Raise your torso toward sitting while your feet are secured on a decline bench. The abs curl your trunk and the hip flexors help bring it toward your thighs.

name: Deep Push-Up on Dumbbells
instructions: Place two stable dumbbells on the floor just wider than your shoulders and check that they will not roll or slide.
Grip the handles with your palms facing each other and extend your legs behind you onto your toes.
Keep your body straight and bend your elbows to lower your chest between the dumbbells.
Go only as low as you can control comfortably through your shoulders.
Press through the handles to straighten your arms while the dumbbells remain still.
description: Use two dumbbells as raised hand supports to lower your chest between your hands. The dumbbells stay on the floor while your body supplies the resistance.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands beneath the middle of your chest, bringing your thumbs and index fingers together to form a diamond.
Extend your legs behind you onto your toes and keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows back beside your body to lower your chest toward your hands.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms without letting your hips sag.
Keep your neck in line with your torso and control the return.
description: Perform a push-up with your thumbs and index fingers close enough to form a diamond beneath your chest. This narrow hand position places a substantial demand on the triceps.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Place the balls of both feet on a secure step with your heels free to move.
Bend forward at your hips and put both hands on a stable flat bench in front of you.
Keep your knees nearly straight and raise your heels as high as you can while staying balanced.
Lower your heels slowly through a comfortable range below the step.
Keep the bend at your hips steady and avoid bouncing at the bottom.
description: Raise your heels while bent forward with your hands on a bench. The calves lift your body as the front of each foot stays on a raised platform.

name: Drop Push-Up Between Benches
instructions: Place two stable benches parallel to each other with enough space between them for a push-up on the floor.
Start with one hand on each bench, your feet behind you, and your body held straight.
Push upward, move both hands inward off the benches, and land on the floor with your elbows bent to absorb the drop.
Lower your chest between your hands, then press forcefully enough to lift both hands from the floor.
Return one hand to each bench and absorb the landing with a slight elbow bend.
Regain control before starting another drop.
description: Drop both hands from raised benches to the floor, then push explosively back onto the benches. This advanced plyometric push-up requires controlled landings at two support heights.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms beside your body, palms facing inward.
Bend one elbow to raise that dumbbell toward your shoulder, turning the palm upward as it rises.
Lower the dumbbell slowly while beginning the curl with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating the rising and lowering arms without swinging your torso.
Keep your elbows beside your ribs and your wrists in line with your forearms.
description: Curl one dumbbell as the other lowers, turning the rising palm upward. The biceps and forearms move the weights while your upper arms stay beside your body.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl with Arm Blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster so its curved plate rests across your torso beneath the backs of your upper arms.
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing forward.
Keep one upper arm against the plate and bend that elbow to curl its dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower that dumbbell slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Repeat with the other arm, keeping your torso still as you alternate.
description: Curl one dumbbell at a time while an arm blaster supports the backs of your upper arms. The support helps you keep your elbows in place during the biceps curl.
aliases: Dumbbell Alternate Biceps Curl (With Arm Blaster)

name: Alternating Dumbbell Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand and the backs of both upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other and your thumbs pointing upward.
Curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder while lowering the other slowly.
Continue alternating the arms, keeping both upper arms supported and the thumb-up grip unchanged.
Lower only until each elbow is nearly straight without forcing it backward.
description: Curl dumbbells with a thumb-up grip while your upper arms rest on a preacher pad. The arms alternate as the biceps and forearms move the weights.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold the weights with your palms facing upward as the elbows bend.
Curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder without lifting the upper arm from the pad.
Lower it slowly until the elbow is nearly straight.
Repeat with the other arm and continue alternating.
description: Alternating preacher curls train the biceps with the upper arms supported on a pad.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit with your back against an upright bench, feet planted and a dumbbell beside each hip.
Keep your palms facing your torso and your upper arms still.
Bend one elbow to bring that dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it with control, then curl with the other arm.
Continue alternating without swinging the weights.
description: Seated alternating hammer curls work the biceps and forearms with the palms facing inward.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Side Press
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder.
Press one dumbbell overhead, allowing a small controlled shift of your torso beneath it.
Lower that dumbbell to shoulder height as you press the other one overhead.
Continue alternating with your feet planted and your back steady.
description: Alternating overhead presses train the shoulders and triceps while the torso shifts slightly beneath each raised arm.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Curl on Stability Ball with Leg Raised
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball, holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Plant one foot and extend the other leg in front of you, keeping it off the floor.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso and curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly, then curl with the other arm.
Continue alternating without rocking the ball, then change the supporting leg.
description: Alternating curls train the biceps while sitting on a stability ball with one leg held off the floor.
aliases: Dumbbell Alternating Bicep Curl with Leg Raised on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Alternating Seated Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with both feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand beside your body with palms facing forward.
Bend one elbow to curl that dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm still.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating while keeping the ball steady.
description: Alternating curls work the biceps while the seated position on a stability ball requires steady trunk control.
aliases: Dumbbell Alternating Seated Bicep Curl on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press with Back Support
instructions: Sit with your back supported and feet planted, holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders with palms toward you.
Move your elbows outward as you begin pressing upward.
Continue overhead, turning your palms forward as your arms extend.
Lower along the same path, bringing your elbows forward and palms toward you again.
description: The Arnold press combines an outward arm rotation with an overhead press to work the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press on Flat Bench
instructions: Sit tall on a flat bench with both feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your shoulders, palms toward you.
Press upward while moving your elbows outward and turning your palms forward.
Extend your arms overhead without leaning back.
Lower with control, reversing the rotation to the starting position.
description: This Arnold press uses an upright seated position on a flat bench and works the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Around-The-World on Bench
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the weights near your hips and a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep both arms outward and around toward the space behind your head, keeping the elbow bend steady.
Reverse the arc to bring the dumbbells back toward your hips.
Use a controlled range that keeps your shoulders comfortable and your back supported.
description: A wide circular arm path moves two dumbbells around the head while lying on a bench, working the chest and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing toward your feet.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells to either side of your chest, keeping the forearms under the weights.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are extended.
Lower with control for the next repetition.
description: The flat-bench dumbbell press works the chest, triceps and shoulders by pressing two weights above the torso.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press on Flat Bench
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Hold dumbbells beside your shoulders with palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells overhead while keeping your torso steady.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
description: A seated overhead press on a flat bench trains the shoulders and triceps without a backrest.

name: Dumbbell Squat to Bench
instructions: Stand in front of a bench facing away from it, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Bend your knees and hips to lower toward the bench, keeping your feet planted and knees aligned with your toes.
Lightly touch the bench with your hips without dropping onto it.
Push through your feet to stand upright, keeping the dumbbells beside you.
description: Squatting to a bench with dumbbells at the sides works the quadriceps and glutes while giving a consistent depth reference.

name: Dumbbell Bent over Row
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms toward your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at your hips until your torso leans forward.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, keeping your back steady.
Pull your elbows back to bring the dumbbells toward the sides of your lower chest.
Lower slowly until your arms extend without rounding your back.
description: The bent-over dumbbell row trains the upper back and lats while the hips hold the torso in a forward lean.

name: Dumbbell Curl with Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms forward.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders while standing upright.
Lower the weights as you step forward and bend both knees into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat the curl and lunge sequence, changing the lead leg between repetitions.
description: This combination alternates an upright curl with a forward lunge, working the biceps, quadriceps and glutes.
aliases: Dumbbell Bicep Curl Lunge with Bowling Motion

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl on Stability Ball with Leg Raised
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand.
Plant one foot and extend the other leg forward, keeping it off the floor.
With palms forward and upper arms still, curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly without rocking the ball.
Complete the set, then change the supporting leg.
description: Both arms curl together while one leg stays extended off the floor, combining biceps work with seated balance.
aliases: Dumbbell Bicep Curl on Exercise Ball with Leg Raised

name: Dumbbell Curl in Single-Leg Hinge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and shift your weight onto one leg.
Hinge forward at your hips as the other leg lifts behind you; keep a small bend in the supporting knee.
Hold this balanced position with the weights hanging below your shoulders, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells without swinging your upper arms.
Lower slowly, then stand upright before changing the supporting leg.
description: The biceps curl is performed while balancing in a forward-leaning single-leg hinge, engaging the arms and hip stabilizers.
aliases: Dumbbell Bicep Curl with Stork Stance

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand, arms beside your body and palms forward.
Keep your upper arms still as you bend both elbows.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders without leaning backward.
Lower with control until your elbows are nearly straight.
description: Standing dumbbell curls train the biceps by bending both elbows while the upper arms stay beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Curl with Arm Blaster
instructions: Fit the arm blaster against your torso with its strap over your neck and the pads behind your upper arms.
Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms forward.
Keep your upper arms on the support and curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Lower with control until your elbows are extended without locking them forcefully.
description: An arm blaster supports the upper arms during dumbbell curls, focusing the movement at the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms down and palms facing behind you.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso as you bend both elbows.
Raise the weights toward your shoulders, keeping your palms facing downward as your forearms rise.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.
description: Reverse curls use a palms-down grip to train the elbow flexors, including the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Squat and Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells beside your body with palms forward.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat while keeping your feet planted.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders as you rise to standing.
Lower the dumbbells as you begin the next squat.
Keep the movements controlled rather than swinging the weights.
description: A squat combined with a dumbbell curl works the quadriceps, glutes and biceps in one coordinated sequence.

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl on Balance Dome with Legs Extended
instructions: Sit on the rounded side of a balance dome with a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your legs forward with your heels on the floor and keep your torso steady.
Hold the weights beside you with palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders without rocking backward.
Lower the weights with control.
description: Seated curls on a balance dome train the biceps while the legs extend forward and the torso stays steady.
aliases: Dumbbell Biceps Curl V Sit on Bosu Ball

name: Dumbbell Burpee with Jump
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, using weights that stay stable when placed on the floor.
Squat down and place the dumbbells under your shoulders, keeping hold of the handles.
Jump your feet back into a straight-body plank with your arms extended.
Jump your feet forward beneath you.
Rise and jump vertically with the dumbbells held at your sides.
Land with bent knees and continue into the next controlled repetition.
description: This weighted burpee combines a jump back into a straight-arm plank with a vertical jump while the dumbbells stay beside the body.

name: Dumbbell Clean to Squat
instructions: Stand with dumbbells beside your legs and feet about hip-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the weights, keeping your back steady.
Extend your hips and knees briskly to drive the weights upward close to your body.
Move underneath them and bend your knees into a squat, catching the dumbbells beside your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells under control to reset.
description: The dumbbell clean brings two weights from a low position to the shoulders using coordinated leg drive and a quick catch.

name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights close together above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your chest, keeping your upper arms close to your torso.
Press both dumbbells upward until your arms are extended.
Lower with control without bouncing the weights against your body.
description: Pressing two dumbbells with the elbows close to the torso trains the triceps along with the chest and shoulders.

name: Single-Dumbbell Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell toward the center of your chest, keeping your upper arms close to your torso.
Press it upward until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly to repeat.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell above the chest in this close-grip press for the triceps and chest.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet apart and a dumbbell in one hand.
Lean forward and brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
With your palm facing upward, bend the elbow to curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly until the elbow is nearly straight, keeping the upper arm supported.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: A concentration curl trains one biceps at a time with the upper arm braced against the inner thigh.

name: Single-Dumbbell Opposite-Hand Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell at your side.
Step forward with the leg opposite the loaded hand.
Bend both knees to lower into a lunge, keeping your torso steady and front foot planted.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete the set, then switch the dumbbell to the other hand and lunge with the other leg.
description: Holding a dumbbell opposite the forward leg adds an uneven load to a lunge for the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell at each side and palms facing inward.
Bend one elbow to bring that dumbbell across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your torso still and the other arm down.
Lower the weight slowly, then repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating sides.
description: Each dumbbell curls across the body toward the opposite shoulder, alternating sides to work the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
Curl one weight diagonally across your body, keeping its thumb side upward.
Lower it back to your side without turning your torso.
Repeat with the other arm and continue alternating.
description: Alternating cross-body curls lift one dumbbell toward the opposite shoulder while the other stays beside the body.
aliases: Dumbbell Cross Body Hammer Curl V. 2

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise and Overhead Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell beside each thigh with your torso upright.
Keep your elbows nearly straight and raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells to your thighs.
Raise both arms forward and continue overhead within a comfortable shoulder range.
Lower along the forward arc and repeat the two-part sequence without swinging.
description: A lateral raise alternates with a straight-arm front raise to overhead, working the shoulders through two different arcs.

name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at your sides with your knees relaxed.
Lift your elbows outward until the upper arms are around shoulder height and the weights hang below them.
Rotate your shoulders to bring the weights above your elbows without changing the elbow bend.
Press overhead, then lower back to the bent-elbow position.
Reverse the shoulder rotation and lower the arms to your sides.
description: This shoulder sequence raises the elbows, rotates the forearms upward and finishes with an overhead press.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms toward you.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the weights toward the floor, keeping them close to your legs.
Keep your back steady as you push through your feet and extend your knees and hips.
Stand upright without leaning backward, then lower into the next repetition.
description: Dumbbell deadlifts work the glutes and legs as the hips and knees extend to lift the weights.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back with your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing toward your feet.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your chest, keeping the forearms under the weights.
Press upward until your arms are extended.
Lower with control for the next repetition.
description: A decline dumbbell bench press works the chest and triceps with the head below the hips.

name: Dumbbell Decline Fly
instructions: Secure your legs on the decline bench and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights over your chest with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open both arms in a wide arc, keeping the elbow bend steady and stopping within a comfortable shoulder range.
Bring the weights back together above your chest along the same arc.
description: The decline fly works the chest by bringing the arms together in an arc while lying on a decline bench.

name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your chest, keeping the elbows near your torso.
Press both weights upward until the arms are extended.
Return slowly to chest level.
description: The palms face each other during this decline press for the chest and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Decline Fly
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back with one dumbbell above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in the working elbow and the palm facing inward.
Open the arm to the side in a controlled arc without twisting your torso.
Bring the dumbbell back above your chest with the elbow bend unchanged.
Finish the set, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm decline fly moves one dumbbell through a wide arc to train the chest while the torso stays steady.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Decline Neutral-Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and one dumbbell beside your chest.
Hold the dumbbell with the palm facing inward and the elbow near your torso.
Press the weight upward until your arm is extended.
Lower slowly to the side of your chest while keeping your torso still.
Repeat, then switch arms.
description: One arm presses a dumbbell above the chest on a decline bench, working the chest and triceps.
aliases: Dumbbell Decline One Arm Hammer Press

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Shrug
instructions: Rest your chest against an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Let a dumbbell hang from each hand with your arms straight.
Draw your shoulder blades together and slightly upward without bending your elbows.
Release slowly so the weights return to the starting position.
Keep your chest on the pad throughout.
description: With the chest on an incline bench, small shoulder-blade movements lift the dumbbells to train the trapezius and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Shrug
instructions: Lie face down against an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Allow the arms to hang straight beneath the shoulders.
Lift the shoulders and draw the shoulder blades inward while keeping the elbows straight.
Lower the shoulders slowly without lifting your chest off the bench.
description: This chest-supported shrug uses straight arms and a short shoulder-blade motion to work the trapezius and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Decline Rolling Triceps Extension
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights above your chest with palms facing each other.
Bend the elbows and let your upper arms angle back as you lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Reverse that arc, bringing the upper arms forward as you straighten the elbows.
Return the weights above your chest with control.
description: On a decline bench, the elbows bend as the upper arms move toward the head, then both actions reverse to lift the dumbbells above the chest.

name: Dumbbell Decline Fly with Rotation
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with legs secured and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights above your chest with palms toward your feet and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc, rotating your palms upward as you lower the dumbbells.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, keeping the elbow bend steady.
Bring the weights together above your chest while turning the palms toward your feet again.
description: This decline chest fly adds a turn of the arms as the dumbbells open and close above the chest.

name: Dumbbell Finger Curls
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the forearms on your thighs with palms upward and hands clear of the knees.
Carefully let the handles roll toward the fingers without releasing them.
Close your fingers to draw the dumbbells back into the palms.
Keep the forearms supported and repeat with control.
description: Finger curls train the forearm gripping muscles by rolling two dumbbells toward the fingers and closing the hands again.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights above your chest with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms outward in a wide arc while keeping the elbow bend steady.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, then bring the dumbbells together over your chest.
description: A flat-bench fly trains the chest by opening and closing the arms while maintaining a small elbow bend.

name: Dumbbell Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Position your upper back on a stability ball with feet planted and hips lifted.
Keep your neck steady and hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
With elbows slightly bent, open your arms in a wide arc.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, then bring the weights together above your chest.
Keep the ball and your torso steady throughout.
description: Chest flyes on a stability ball combine a wide arm arc with a held bridge position.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge with Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, upper arms beside your head and elbows bent so the weights sit behind your head.
Step forward and bend both knees into a lunge while keeping the elbows bent.
Hold the lunge as you straighten both elbows to lift the dumbbells overhead.
Push back to standing while bending your elbows to return the weights behind your head.
Repeat with the other leg, keeping your torso steady.
description: A forward lunge combines with an overhead elbow extension to work the legs and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms toward you.
Keep a small bend in your elbows and lift both arms forward to shoulder height.
Keep your torso upright rather than swinging backward.
Lower both dumbbells slowly to your thighs.
description: Front raises lift two dumbbells to shoulder height to work the front of the shoulders.

name: Two-Hand Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell with both hands around its handle in front of your thighs.
Keep your torso steady and lift the dumbbell forward with both arms.
Stop at shoulder height with your elbows slightly bent.
Lower the dumbbell along the same path with control.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell as the arms raise it in front of the body. The front of the shoulders lifts the weight.

name: Dumbbell Full-Can Raise
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells beside your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and turn your hands so your thumbs point upward.
Raise both arms outward and slightly forward to about shoulder height without shrugging.
Lower along the same path with control.
description: A thumbs-up raise lifts the arms outward and slightly forward to work the shoulders and rotator cuff.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keep your chest lifted as you bend your knees and hips into a squat.
Lower within a comfortable range while keeping your heels on the floor and knees aligned with your toes.
Push through your feet to return to standing.
description: The goblet squat holds one dumbbell at the chest while the knees and hips bend, working the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell at each side and palms facing inward.
Keep the upper arms beside your torso and curl one weight toward its shoulder.
Lower it with control as you begin curling the other arm.
Continue alternating without rotating the palms forward or swinging your torso.
description: Alternating hammer curls train the biceps and forearms with the thumbs facing upward as each weight rises.

name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with both feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells beside you with palms facing inward.
Bend both elbows to bring the weights toward your shoulders without moving the upper arms.
Lower slowly while keeping the ball steady.
description: Seated hammer curls use an inward-facing grip to train the biceps and forearms while balancing on a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell Hammer Curl on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Simultaneous Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells beside your thighs with palms facing inward.
Keep your upper arms still and bend both elbows to raise the weights toward your shoulders.
Keep the palms facing each other throughout the lift.
Lower both weights slowly to your sides.
description: Both weights rise together in this neutral-grip curl for the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl with Arm Blaster
instructions: Fit the arm blaster so its pads support the backs of your upper arms.
Stand holding dumbbells with palms facing inward.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders without lifting the upper arms from the support.
Lower slowly, keeping the same inward-facing grip.
description: The arm blaster supports the upper arms during simultaneous hammer curls for the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell High-Arm Curl
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells with palms upward.
Raise your upper arms out to the sides near shoulder height and keep them there.
Bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
Extend the elbows slowly without dropping the upper arms.
Lower the arms to finish the set.
description: Holding the upper arms out to the sides changes the curl setup while the elbows bend to train the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell beside each shoulder.
Press one dumbbell upward while the other remains near your chest.
Lower the raised weight with control, then press with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating while keeping your back on the bench.
description: Alternating presses on an incline bench work the chest, shoulders and triceps one arm at a time.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet planted.
Hold dumbbells beside your upper chest with forearms beneath the weights and palms facing toward your feet.
Press both weights above your chest until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly to the starting position without bouncing.
description: An incline dumbbell press trains the chest with support from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Biceps Curl
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell hanging beside each hip.
Turn your palms forward and keep your upper arms beside your torso.
Bend both elbows to curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping your back on the pad.
description: Incline curls train the biceps with the back reclined and the upper arms hanging beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights above your chest with a small bend in the elbows.
Open your arms outward in an arc without changing the elbow bend.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, then bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
description: An incline fly opens the arms in a wide arc and brings the weights together to train the chest.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Incline Curl
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell hanging at each side.
Turn the palms forward and keep the upper arms beside your torso, clear of the bench.
Curl one weight toward its shoulder without moving the upper arm.
Lower slowly, then curl the other weight.
Continue alternating while keeping your back supported.
description: Alternating curls on an incline bench work one biceps at a time while the back remains supported.

name: Dumbbell Simultaneous Incline Curl
instructions: Lie back against an incline bench with both feet on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell beside each hip, palms facing forward.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms forward.
Lower the dumbbells with control while keeping your back supported.
description: Both dumbbells curl together with the back reclined on an incline bench, training the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and dumbbells above your chest.
Face the palms toward one another and keep a slight bend in each elbow.
Lower the weights outward in a wide arc, stopping before your shoulders feel strained.
Bring the weights together along the same arc without turning the movement into a press.
description: The incline fly trains the chest by moving nearly straight arms through a wide arc above an inclined torso.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball holding dumbbells close to your torso.
Walk your feet forward until your back rests diagonally against the ball, keeping both feet planted and hips below your shoulders.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest, palms inward and elbows slightly bent.
Open the arms outward within a comfortable range without rolling the ball.
Bring the weights back together above your chest.
description: This chest fly uses a stability ball to support the back in an inclined position.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with your feet planted and a dumbbell hanging beside each hip.
Keep your palms facing your torso and your upper arms still.
Bend both elbows to curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly, keeping your back on the pad.
description: An incline hammer curl trains the biceps and forearms with inward-facing palms and a supported, reclined torso.

name: Dumbbell Incline Neutral-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell beside each shoulder.
Turn your palms toward each other and keep your forearms beneath the weights.
Press the dumbbells above your upper chest until your arms extend.
Lower them slowly to shoulder level without lifting your back.
description: An incline press with palms facing each other works the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Neutral-Grip Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Recline against a stability ball with your back supported diagonally and feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside each side of your chest with palms facing inward.
Press both weights above your chest without rolling the ball or lifting your hips out of position.
Lower slowly, allowing the elbows to bend beside the torso.
description: With the back inclined against a stability ball, both dumbbells press upward to work the chest and triceps.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Incline Outward Curl
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the upper arms hang beside the bench and turn the palms outward and forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward the outer sides of your shoulders while keeping the upper arms still.
Lower with control until the elbows are extended without locking them forcefully.
description: The arms angle slightly outward during these incline curls, which train the biceps with the back supported.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Fly
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and one dumbbell above your chest.
Keep your working elbow slightly bent and palm facing inward.
Open the arm outward within a comfortable shoulder range without rotating your torso.
Bring the weight back above the chest along the same arc.
Finish the set, then switch arms.
description: One arm opens and closes above an incline bench to train the chest while the other side remains still.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on the ball holding one dumbbell close to you, then walk forward until your back is supported at an incline.
Keep both feet planted and hold the dumbbell above your chest with the palm inward.
With a slight elbow bend, lower the arm outward without twisting or rolling off the ball.
Bring the dumbbell back above your chest.
Repeat, then change arms.
description: A single-arm fly trains the chest while the back rests diagonally against a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Neutral-Grip Press
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with feet planted and hold one dumbbell beside your upper chest.
Face the palm inward and keep the forearm beneath the weight.
Press the dumbbell above your chest while keeping your torso still.
Lower it slowly to the starting position.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: A one-arm incline press with the palm inward trains the chest and triceps while the torso stays supported.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Hammer Press

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Neutral-Grip Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Recline diagonally against a stability ball with both feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell beside your chest with the palm facing inward.
Press it upward above the chest while keeping your torso and ball still.
Lower it slowly to the starting position.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: The chest and triceps press one dumbbell while the back rests at an incline on a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Hammer Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie on your side against an incline bench with your feet planted for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the upper hand with that arm beside your body.
Keep a slight elbow bend as you lift the arm outward until it points nearly straight upward.
Lower slowly along the same arc without rolling your torso.
Complete the set, then change sides.
description: Lying on one side on an incline bench supports the torso while the upper arm raises a dumbbell to train the shoulder.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Lateral Raise

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and one dumbbell beside your upper chest.
Turn your palm toward your feet and keep the forearm beneath the weight.
Press the dumbbell above your chest without rotating your torso.
Lower slowly, then complete the set before switching arms.
description: One dumbbell presses above an incline bench to train the chest, shoulder and triceps on the working side.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball holding one dumbbell, then walk forward until your back rests diagonally against the ball.
Plant both feet and keep your hips below shoulder level.
Hold the weight beside your upper chest with the palm facing toward your feet.
Press above your chest without rolling the ball, then lower slowly.
Finish the set before switching arms.
description: A one-arm press works the chest and triceps while the inclined ball support requires a steady torso.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Incline Neutral-Grip Press
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights beside your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Press both dumbbells above your chest, keeping your back on the bench.
Lower with control until the weights return beside your upper chest.
description: The palms face inward during this two-dumbbell incline press for the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on the ball with dumbbells held close to your chest.
Walk forward until your back rests at an incline against the ball and keep both feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells beside the upper chest, palms facing toward your feet.
Press both weights above your chest without changing your torso angle.
Lower slowly to the starting position.
description: Two dumbbells press above the chest while a stability ball supports the back at an incline.
aliases: Dumbbell Incline Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell beside each hip and your feet planted.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows and palms facing down as the arms rise.
Lift both dumbbells forward until the arms reach about shoulder height relative to your torso.
Lower slowly beside your body without lifting your back from the bench.
description: Reclining on an incline bench supports the torso while straight-arm front raises work the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Reverse Fly
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted and dumbbells hanging below the shoulders.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows and palms facing inward.
Raise both arms outward until they are roughly in line with your torso.
Lower the weights slowly without lifting your chest from the pad.
description: With the chest supported on an incline bench, the arms open outward to work the rear deltoids and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Row
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell hanging from each hand.
Bend your elbows and pull the weights toward the sides of your chest.
Keep your chest on the pad as the shoulder blades move together.
Lower slowly until your arms hang beneath your shoulders again.
description: The incline bench supports the chest during rows that train the upper back, lats and biceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Serratus Punch
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest with arms extended.
Keep the elbows straight and reach the weights slightly upward by moving the shoulder blades forward around the rib cage.
Let the shoulder blades return to the bench under control.
Repeat the small reach without turning it into an elbow-bending press.
description: A short reach through the shoulders moves the shoulder blades forward while the elbows stay straight, working the serratus anterior.

name: Dumbbell Back-Supported Incline Shrug
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell hanging beside each hip.
Keep your arms straight and lift your shoulders toward your ears.
Lower the shoulders slowly without bending your elbows.
Keep your back supported throughout.
description: Shrugs with the back resting on an incline bench train the trapezius while the arms hang beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline T-Raise
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench and plant your feet.
Hold light dumbbells beneath your shoulders with arms nearly straight.
Raise both arms out to the sides to form a T with your torso.
Lower slowly without shrugging or lifting your chest off the bench.
description: A T-shaped arm raise works the rear deltoids and upper back with the chest supported on an incline bench.

name: Dumbbell Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Recline on an incline bench with your feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms above your head with palms facing each other.
Keep the upper arms steady as you bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside and behind your head.
Straighten your elbows to return the weights above you.
description: Incline triceps extensions bend and straighten the elbows while the upper arms remain raised beside the head.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly with Rotation
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights above your chest with palms toward your feet and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc, turning the palms upward as you lower the weights.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range without increasing the elbow bend.
Bring the dumbbells together above your chest while turning the palms toward your feet again.
description: This incline fly adds an arm rotation as the weights open and close, training the chest and shoulders.

name: Single-Dumbbell Incline Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Recline against an incline bench with your feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands and extend your arms above your head.
Keep your upper arms beside your head and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind it.
Straighten the elbows to return the dumbbell overhead.
Lower with control without moving your upper arms forward.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell during an incline overhead extension for the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Y-Raise
instructions: Lie with your chest on an incline bench and feet planted.
Let light dumbbells hang below your shoulders with palms facing inward.
Raise the arms diagonally forward and outward to form a Y, keeping the elbows nearly straight.
Stop around the line of your torso and lower the weights slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed and chest on the pad.
description: A Y-shaped raise trains the shoulders and upper back while the incline bench supports the chest.

name: Dumbbell Iron-Cross Squat
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend your hips and knees into a squat as you bring the arms forward, keeping them near shoulder height.
Rise to standing while opening the arms back out to the sides.
Keep a small elbow bend and control the weights throughout.
Lower the weights to your sides when the set is finished.
description: A squat with the arms forward transitions to standing with the arms spread, combining leg work with shoulder raises.

name: Dumbbell Bench-Supported Single-Arm Kickback
instructions: Place one knee and the hand on the same side on a flat bench, with the other foot planted.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand and bring that upper arm beside your torso, elbow bent.
Keep the upper arm still and straighten the elbow to move the weight behind you.
Bend the elbow slowly to return the weight beneath it.
Finish the set, then change sides.
description: A bench-supported kickback works one triceps while the upper arm stays beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Kickback on Stability Ball
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and rest your chest on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and raise your upper arms beside your torso, elbows bent.
Keep the upper arms still as you straighten both elbows behind you.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the dumbbells beneath them.
Keep the ball steady throughout.
description: Kneeling over a stability ball supports the chest while both elbows extend to train the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Curl Kneeling on Stability Ball
instructions: Kneel on the top of a stability ball with your toes down beside it for support.
Keep your torso upright and hold a dumbbell beside each hip, palms forward.
Keep your upper arms still as you curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly while keeping the ball steady.
description: Both arms curl dumbbells while the knees rest on a stability ball and the toes help steady the position.
aliases: Dumbbell Kneeling Bicep Curl Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell beside each thigh with palms inward.
Keep a small bend in your elbows and your torso steady.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height.
Lower the weights slowly without shrugging or swinging.
description: Lateral raises move the dumbbells outward to shoulder height to train the side of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lateral to Front Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells beside your thighs and elbows slightly bent.
Raise the weights out to the sides to about shoulder height.
Keeping the arms raised, bring both dumbbells together in front of your chest.
Lower them slowly in front of your thighs.
Repeat the outward raise and inward sweep without swinging.
description: A lateral raise flows into an inward sweep at shoulder height before lowering, working the shoulders through several directions.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell beside each hip with your feet together.
Step forward with one leg and bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Keep your torso upright and the front foot planted.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete the set, then change the lead leg.
description: A forward step and controlled return train one lead leg at a time while dumbbells hang beside the body.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge with Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms forward.
Step forward with one leg and bend both knees while curling the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Push through the front foot to return to standing as you lower the weights.
Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging the dumbbells.
Complete the set, then change the lead leg.
description: A curl performed during the forward lunge combines biceps work with quadriceps and glute work.

name: Dumbbell Lying Cross-Face Triceps Extension with Opposite-Arm Hold
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Hold one arm steady while bending the other elbow outward to lower its dumbbell across the space above your face.
Stop clear of your face and keep the working upper arm raised.
Straighten that elbow to return its weight above your chest.
Complete the set, then change the working arm.
description: One elbow bends across the face and straightens while the opposite arm holds its dumbbell above the chest, emphasizing the working triceps.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend both arms above your chest with palms facing each other.
Keep one arm raised as you bend the other elbow to lower that weight beside your head.
Straighten the working elbow to lift the weight again.
Repeat on the other side, keeping the upper arms steady.
description: Alternating elbow extensions train one triceps at a time while the other arm holds its dumbbell above the chest.

name: Dumbbell Elbow-Out Triceps Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Bend your elbows outward and lower the dumbbells toward your upper chest, allowing your upper arms to lower beside your torso.
Press the weights upward by straightening your elbows and bringing your upper arms back above your chest.
Lower with control without bouncing the dumbbells against your body.
description: Lower the dumbbells toward the upper chest with the elbows out, then press them upward as the upper arms move back above the torso. The triceps work with the chest and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side on the floor with your head comfortably supported by the lower arm.
Hold a light dumbbell in the upper hand, keeping that elbow bent and tucked against your side.
Rotate the upper arm so the forearm lifts away from your abdomen without moving the elbow.
Lower slowly through a comfortable range.
Complete the set, then turn over and change arms.
description: Rotating the upper arm outward while lying on one side trains the shoulder external rotators of the rotator cuff.

name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your knees near its end and hold the bench for stability.
Secure a light fixed dumbbell between your feet before lifting it, keeping the feet pressed together throughout.
Bend both knees to curl the dumbbell toward your hips without lifting your thighs from the bench.
Lower slowly until the legs are nearly straight.
Set the dumbbell down under control before releasing it.
description: A dumbbell held between the feet adds resistance as the knees bend to train the hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Flat Neutral-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and dumbbells above your chest.
Keep the palms facing each other and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your chest.
Press both weights upward until the arms are extended.
Return slowly to chest level.
description: A palms-in press on a flat bench trains the chest and triceps while the elbows travel beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Rear-Delt Raise on Floor
instructions: Lie on your side on the floor with legs together and support your head with the lower hand.
Hold a dumbbell in the upper hand in front of your torso with the elbow slightly bent.
Raise that arm through an upward arc until it points nearly straight toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly along the same path without rolling your body.
Complete the set, then change sides.
description: The upper arm moves across the front of the torso and upward while side lying, working the rear shoulder.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying on Floor Rear Delt Raise

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Bent-Arm Rear-Delt Raise on Bench
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your legs together and lower hand planted on the floor beside the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in the upper hand in front of your chest with that elbow bent about a right angle.
Keep the elbow bend steady as you lift the upper arm until the elbow is above the shoulder.
Lower slowly toward the starting position without rolling your torso.
Complete the set, then change sides.
description: A bent upper arm lifts while lying on the side, working the rear shoulder as the lower hand braces against the floor.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Deltoid Rear

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with both feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside one side of your chest, palm facing toward your feet.
Press the weight above your chest without turning your torso.
Lower slowly until it is beside your chest again.
Complete the set, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm flat-bench press trains the chest and triceps while the torso resists turning.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in one hand.
Hold the weight beside your chest with palm toward your feet and forearm beneath it.
Press the dumbbell above your chest until your arm extends.
Lower with control while keeping your torso still.
Finish the set, then change arms.
description: One dumbbell presses from beside the chest to an extended arm while the back remains on the bench.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Press V. 2

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Across-Face Triceps Extension with Overhand Grip
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell above the working shoulder with the palm facing toward your feet.
Use your free hand to steady the working upper arm near the elbow.
Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell across the front of your face toward the opposite shoulder, keeping clear of your head.
Keep the upper arm raised as you straighten the elbow.
Repeat slowly, then switch arms.
description: A single dumbbell lowers across the face toward the opposite shoulder as the elbow bends, then rises through triceps extension. The other hand steadies the upper arm.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Pronated Triceps Extension

name: Dumbbell Prone Single-Arm Bent-Arm Rear-Delt Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with feet planted and one dumbbell hanging beneath your shoulder.
Keep the elbow bent about a right angle and raise the upper arm outward until it is roughly in line with your torso.
Lower the weight slowly without lifting your chest or turning your body.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: One arm raises a dumbbell outward while the chest is supported on a flat bench, training the rear deltoid.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Rear Lateral Raise

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Lying Reverse-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Raise one dumbbell above the working shoulder with the palm turned toward your head.
Use your free hand to steady the working upper arm near the elbow.
Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell beside your head toward the working-side shoulder, keeping the weight clear of your head.
Keep the upper arm raised and straighten the elbow to return.
Keep the dumbbell clear of your face and change arms after the set.
description: One arm lowers a dumbbell beside the head with a reverse grip, then straightens the elbow. The free hand steadies the working upper arm.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Supinated Triceps Extension

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Forearm Pronation on Bench
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench and support the working elbow in front of your torso.
Hold a light dumbbell with the working elbow supported on the bench and the forearm and hand free to turn.
Rotate the forearm to turn the palm downward without curling the elbow or moving the shoulder.
Reverse the rotation slowly.
Change sides after the set.
description: Forearm pronation turns the hand palm-down while the elbow stays supported, training the forearm rotators.

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Forearm Pronation on Floor
instructions: Lie on your side on the floor, support your head with the lower hand and bend the upper elbow beside your torso.
Use a light adjustable dumbbell loaded at only one end, with the plate secured, and hold the middle of the handle with your wrist straight.
Keep the working elbow against your side and rotate the forearm to raise the weighted end through an arc without bending your wrist.
Return slowly to the starting orientation.
Repeat, then change arms.
