description: Forearm pronation rotates a dumbbell loaded at one end while lying on the side. The off-center load resists the forearm rotation.

name: Single-Dumbbell Pullover on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on the ball holding one dumbbell, then walk forward until your upper back is supported. Keep your neck steady.
Plant both feet and hold your hips up so the torso stays level.
Hold the dumbbell with both hands above your chest and keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower it behind your head in a controlled arc without dropping your hips.
Bring it back above your chest along the same path.
description: A two-hand pullover works the chest and lats while the upper back rests on a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell Lying Pullover on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Rear-Delt Row
instructions: Rest your chest against an incline bench with feet planted and dumbbells hanging below you.
Pull the weights toward your upper ribs while moving the elbows outward.
Keep your chest on the pad as your shoulder blades move together.
Lower the weights slowly until the arms hang beneath the shoulders.
description: Rowing with the elbows out works the rear deltoids and upper back while the chest rests on an incline bench.

name: Dumbbell Prone Flat-Bench Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang beneath the shoulders with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise both arms outward until they are roughly in line with your torso.
Lower slowly without lifting your chest from the bench.
description: Both arms open outward from beneath a flat bench to train the rear deltoids and upper back.

name: Single-Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell securely in both hands above your upper chest.
Keep the upper arms raised and bend the elbows to lower the dumbbell toward the top of your head without touching it.
Straighten the elbows to return the weight above you.
Move slowly and keep the grip secure.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell as the elbows bend and extend while lying on a flat bench.

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Forearm Supination on Bench
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench and support the working elbow in front of your torso.
Hold a light dumbbell with the hand free to turn and the wrist straight.
Rotate the forearm until the palm faces upward without bending the elbow further.
Reverse the rotation slowly.
Change sides after the set.
description: Forearm supination turns the hand palm-up while the elbow remains supported on the bench.

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Forearm Supination on Floor
instructions: Lie on your side with the lower forearm supporting your torso and the upper elbow bent beside your body.
Use a light adjustable dumbbell loaded at only one end, with the plate secured, and hold the middle of the handle with your wrist straight.
Keep the working elbow against your side and rotate the forearm to raise the weighted end through an arc without bending your wrist.
Return slowly to the starting orientation.
Repeat, then change arms.
description: Forearm supination rotates a dumbbell loaded at one end while lying on the side. The off-center load resists the forearm rotation.

name: Dumbbell Supine Curl with Rising Elbows
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Let the dumbbells hang beside the bench with palms facing toward your head.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders, allowing the elbows to rise while your back stays on the bench.
Lower the weights and upper arms slowly to the starting position.
description: Curl two dumbbells toward the shoulders while lying on a flat bench, allowing the elbows to rise as the weights approach the chest. The biceps bend the elbows while the shoulders help lift the upper arms.

name: Dumbbell Supine Curl with Rising Elbows
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and one dumbbell in each hand.
Let the arms hang beside the bench, with palms turned toward your head.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders, allowing the elbows to rise while your back stays on the bench.
Lower the weights and upper arms slowly to the starting position.
description: Curl two dumbbells toward the shoulders while lying on a flat bench, allowing the elbows to rise as the weights approach the chest. The biceps bend the elbows while the shoulders help lift the upper arms.

name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold dumbbells above your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Keep the upper arms raised and bend the elbows to lower the weights beside your forehead.
Straighten your elbows to raise the dumbbells again.
Keep the movement controlled and the weights clear of your head.
description: Lying triceps extensions keep the upper arms raised while the elbows bend and straighten to move two dumbbells.

name: Dumbbell Supine Wide-Arm Curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and dumbbells in both hands.
Angle the upper arms outward beside the bench with palms turned upward toward your head.
Keep the upper arms still and curl the dumbbells toward the shoulders.
Lower slowly without pulling the elbows inward.
description: The upper arms angle outward beside a flat bench while the elbows bend to train the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Lying Neutral-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Keep the upper arms raised and bend both elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten the elbows to return the weights above you.
Control the descent and keep the dumbbells clear of your face.
description: The dumbbells lower beside the head through elbow bending, then rise as the triceps straighten the arms.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Flat-Bench Fly
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and one dumbbell above your chest.
Keep the palm facing inward and the elbow slightly bent.
Lower the arm outward in an arc without rolling your torso.
Bring the weight back above your chest, keeping the elbow bend steady.
Complete the set before changing arms.
description: A single-arm fly opens one arm outward and returns it above the chest while the torso stays supported.

name: Dumbbell Hand-And-Knee-Supported Row
instructions: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a flat bench, with the other foot planted.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand and let it hang below your shoulder.
Pull the weight toward your hip, keeping the elbow close to your torso and your back steady.
Lower it slowly without twisting your body.
Finish the set, then change sides.
description: One hand and knee support the torso on a bench while the free arm rows a dumbbell to train the back and biceps.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball, plant your feet, and raise your hips in line with your torso. Keep your neck steady.
Hold one dumbbell above your chest with the palm facing inward and elbow slightly bent.
Lower the arm out to the side in a controlled arc without rotating your body.
Bring the weight back above your chest while keeping the elbow bend steady.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: A single-arm fly trains the chest while the upper back rests on a stability ball and the hips stay raised.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Chest Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with feet wide and firmly planted.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest that upper arm against the inside of the same-side thigh.
With your palm facing up, curl the weight toward your shoulder without lifting the upper arm.
Lower it slowly until your elbow is extended.
Finish the set, then change arms.
description: A seated concentration curl supports the working elbow against the inner thigh to isolate the elbow bend.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Concentration Curl (On Stability Ball)

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Decline Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs in the decline bench supports and lie back with your head at the lower end.
Hold one dumbbell beside your chest with the palm facing toward your feet.
Press the weight above your chest while keeping your torso steady.
Bend the elbow slowly to lower it beside your chest.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A single-arm decline press trains the chest and triceps while the body lies on a downward-sloping bench.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Decline Chest Press

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Fly on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball and plant your feet. Keep your neck steady.
Raise your hips to align with your torso and hold one dumbbell above your chest, palm inward.
Keep a slight elbow bend as you lower the weight out to the side.
Bring it back above your chest without letting your torso roll.
Complete the set, then switch arms.
description: One arm opens outward and returns above the chest while the ball supports the upper back and the feet support raised hips.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Lying Single-Arm Triceps Extension on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with feet planted and hips raised. Keep your neck steady.
Hold one dumbbell above your shoulder with the palm facing inward.
Keep your upper arm raised and bend the elbow to lower the weight beside your head.
Straighten the elbow to return the weight above you without moving your upper arm.
Finish the set and switch arms.
description: The upper back rests on a stability ball while one elbow bends and straightens to train the triceps.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm French Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Preacher Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest one upper arm on the pad.
Hold the dumbbell with your thumb pointing upward.
Bend the elbow to curl the weight toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm on the pad.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbow straight.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A neutral-grip preacher curl works the biceps and forearms with the upper arm supported on the pad.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Neutral-Grip Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with feet planted and hips in line with your torso. Keep your neck steady.
Hold one dumbbell beside your chest with your palm facing inward.
Press the dumbbell above your chest without twisting your body.
Lower it slowly beside your chest.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: A neutral-grip chest press trains one arm while the upper back rests on a ball and the hips stay raised.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside one shoulder with the palm facing toward your feet.
Press the weight upward above your upper chest without twisting your body.
Lower it slowly to the starting position.
Finish the set, then switch arms.
description: An incline bench supports the torso during a single-arm press for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Incline Chest Press

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Kickback with Thigh Support
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance, hinge forward, and rest your free hand on the front thigh.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your upper arm beside your torso and elbow bent.
Keep that upper arm still as you straighten the elbow behind you.
Bend the elbow slowly to return the weight beneath it.
Finish the set and switch sides.
description: A forward lean and a hand on the thigh stabilize the body while the working elbow extends to train the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell beside one thigh, with the free hand on your hip.
Keep a small bend in the working elbow and lift the arm out to the side.
Stop around shoulder height without leaning or shrugging.
Lower slowly to your side.
Finish the set and switch arms.
description: One arm lifts a dumbbell out to the side to work the shoulders while the torso stays upright.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Lateral Raise with Bench Support
instructions: Stand beside a raised bench backrest and hold it with your free hand.
Hold a dumbbell beside your opposite thigh with the elbow slightly bent.
Lift the weight out to the side to about shoulder height, keeping your torso steady.
Lower it slowly to your side.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: The free hand rests on a bench while the working arm raises a dumbbell sideways to train the shoulder.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Lateral Raise with Support

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Chest Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball, plant your feet, and raise your hips in line with your torso. Keep your neck steady.
Hold a dumbbell beside one side of your chest, palm facing toward your feet.
Press the weight above your chest without letting your body rotate.
Lower with control until the weight is beside your chest again.
Finish the set, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm chest press combines upper-body pressing with a steady, raised-hip position on a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Press on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Single-Arm Curl
instructions: Rest your chest against an incline bench and plant your feet.
Let one arm hang below your shoulder, holding a dumbbell with the palm turned forward.
Keep the upper arm still as you curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until the elbow is extended.
Complete the set and switch arms.
description: An incline bench supports the chest while one arm curls a hanging dumbbell to work the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Single-Arm Hammer Curl
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with your feet braced on its base and your free hand holding the frame.
Hold one dumbbell below your shoulder with the palm facing inward.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder while keeping the upper arm hanging still.
Lower it slowly without swinging.
Finish the set and switch arms.
description: A chest-supported hammer curl works one arm with the palm facing inward throughout the elbow bend.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Prone Hammer Curl

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Pullover on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball, with feet planted and hips raised. Keep your neck steady.
Hold one dumbbell above your chest with a slight bend in the elbow.
Lower the arm toward the space behind your head, keeping your ribs and hips steady.
Bring the weight back above your chest without changing the elbow bend.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: A single-arm pullover moves a dumbbell behind the head and back above the chest while the upper back rests on a ball.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Pullover on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm along your thigh with the wrist beyond the knee.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Lift the back of your hand by extending the wrist, keeping your forearm still.
Lower the weight slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
Complete the set and change hands.
description: With the forearm supported palm down, the wrist lifts a dumbbell to train the forearm extensors.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Bench-Supported Single-Arm Reverse Fly
instructions: Stand beside an incline bench, hinge forward, and rest your free hand on its backrest.
Let the working arm hang with a dumbbell below your shoulder and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise the arm out to the side while keeping your torso still.
Lower the weight slowly without turning your body.
Complete the set and switch sides.
description: The free hand supports a forward lean while one arm lifts sideways to train the rear shoulder and upper back.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Fly (With Support)

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside your chest with the palm facing toward your head.
Press the weight upward above your chest, keeping your elbow relatively close to your torso.
Lower it slowly without rolling your body.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A single-arm chest press uses a palm-toward-head grip while the body lies on a flat bench.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Grip Press

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the working upper arm resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Curl it toward your shoulder without lifting the upper arm.
Lower slowly until the elbow is nearly straight.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: The upper arm rests on a preacher pad while a palms-down grip emphasizes the elbow flexors and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Single-Arm Reverse Curl
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted.
Let one arm hang below your shoulder holding a dumbbell with the palm facing backward.
Keep the upper arm still and curl the weight toward your shoulder with the palm facing down.
Lower it slowly to the hanging position.
Complete the set and switch arms.
description: A chest-supported reverse curl keeps the palm down as one elbow bends, training the elbow flexors and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Spider Curl

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with both feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell beside your torso with the palm forward.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder without moving the upper arm or rocking the ball.
Lower it slowly to your side.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One arm performs a curl while the seated body stays steady on a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Bicep Curl on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit with your back supported by an upright bench and your feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside your torso with the palm facing inward and rest the free hand on your thigh.
Keep the upper arm beside your body as you curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: A seated hammer curl bends one elbow while the palm faces inward to work the biceps and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Hammer Curl

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Thumb-Up Wrist Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench and support your forearm along your thigh with the wrist beyond the knee.
Hold a dumbbell with your thumb pointing upward.
Keep the forearm still and bend the wrist toward the thumb side to lift the weight.
Lower slowly through a small comfortable wrist range.
Complete the set and switch hands.
description: A supported forearm and thumb-up grip allow the wrist to raise the dumbbell toward the thumb side, a movement called radial deviation.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Overhead Press with Opposite-Arm Hold
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell beside each shoulder and palms facing forward.
Keep one dumbbell at shoulder height as you press the other overhead.
Lower the working dumbbell slowly to shoulder height.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
Complete the set, then press with the other arm.
description: One arm presses overhead while the other holds a dumbbell at shoulder level, training the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell beside one shoulder, palm forward, and your free hand on your hip.
Press the weight overhead without leaning to the side or arching your back.
Lower it slowly to shoulder height.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One dumbbell presses from shoulder height to overhead while the free hand stays on the hip.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Shoulder Press V. 2

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell and bend your hips and knees to take the handle with one hand.
Keep the weight close as you extend your hips and knees briskly.
Guide it upward, then move beneath it and straighten the arm overhead with a small knee bend.
Stand tall with the weight steady overhead.
Lower it under control and reset your stance before the next repetition.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A single-arm snatch uses leg and hip drive to bring a dumbbell from a low position to an overhead catch.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell beside one thigh with the palm forward.
Keep your upper arm still as you curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until the elbow is extended.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One arm curls a dumbbell while the upper arm stays beside the torso to train the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand upright with one dumbbell beside your thigh and the palm facing inward.
Keep your upper arm beside your body and curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly without swinging.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A single dumbbell curls with the palm facing inward, working the biceps and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Standing Hammer Curl

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with feet planted and the free hand on your hip.
Raise one dumbbell overhead with the palm facing inward.
Keep your upper arm raised as you bend the elbow to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten the elbow to return the weight overhead.
Finish the set and change arms.
description: One elbow bends behind the head and straightens overhead while the body sits upright on a bench.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension (On Bench)

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Upright Row
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell in front of your thigh with the palm toward your body.
Lift your elbow out to the side to draw the weight toward your upper torso.
Stop within a comfortable range, with the elbow no higher than shoulder level.
Lower slowly to the start.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One elbow lifts out to the side as the dumbbell travels close to the torso, working the shoulders and upper trapezius.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm along your thigh with your palm up and wrist beyond your knee.
Steady the working forearm with your free hand, hold the dumbbell securely and lower it by extending your wrist.
Curl the palm upward while keeping the forearm against your thigh.
Lower slowly without lifting your elbow.
Complete the set and change hands.
description: A supported palm-up forearm lets the wrist curl a dumbbell to work the forearm flexors.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Curl over Incline Bench
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench and rest one upper arm along its raised backrest.
Hold the dumbbell with a comfortable grip and keep that hand position throughout the movement.
Bend the elbow to curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder without lifting the upper arm from the pad.
Lower slowly until the elbow is nearly straight.
Complete the repetitions, then change arms.
description: Curl one dumbbell while resting the upper arm on an incline bench. The biceps bend the elbow as the supported arm stays steady.
aliases: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl
Dumbbell Single-Arm Zottman Curl over Incline Bench

name: Dumbbell Fly on Stability Ball with Single-Leg Support
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with a dumbbell above each side of your chest. Keep your neck steady.
Plant one foot, raise your hips, and extend the other leg off the floor.
With palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent, lower both arms outward in an arc.
Bring the weights back above your chest without twisting or dropping your hips.
Complete the set, then change the supporting leg.
description: Both arms perform a chest fly while the upper back rests on a stability ball and only one foot supports the raised hips.
aliases: Dumbbell One Leg Fly on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Thumb-Up Wrist Raise over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest both forearms on it with wrists just beyond the edge.
Hold the dumbbells with thumbs pointing upward.
Bend both wrists toward the thumb side to lift the weights without moving your forearms.
Lower slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
description: Both supported forearms stay still as the wrists raise the dumbbells toward the thumb side, training the forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell over Bench Neutral Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single-Arm Thumb-Up Wrist Raise over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest one forearm on it with the wrist beyond the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with the thumb pointing upward and steady the forearm with your free hand.
Bend the wrist toward the thumb side to raise the weight without lifting your forearm.
Lower slowly through a comfortable range.
Complete the set and change hands.
description: A forearm rests on a bench while the wrist lifts one dumbbell toward the thumb side to train the forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell over Bench One Arm Neutral Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single-Arm Reverse Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest one forearm on it with the wrist beyond the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with the palm down and keep your forearm against the bench.
Extend your wrist to lift the back of your hand.
Lower the weight slowly without moving your elbow.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: The forearm rests palm down on a bench while the wrist lifts a dumbbell to work the forearm extensors.
aliases: Dumbbell over Bench One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single-Arm Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and support one forearm on it with your wrist beyond the edge.
Hold the dumbbell with your palm facing up and steady the forearm with your free hand.
Curl your palm upward without lifting your forearm.
Lower the dumbbell slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
Finish the set and change hands.
description: A palm-up forearm rests on a bench while one wrist curls a dumbbell to train the forearm flexors.
aliases: Dumbbell over Bench One Arm Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Reverse Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest your forearms on it with wrists beyond the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms down.
Lift the backs of your hands by extending both wrists, keeping the forearms still.
Lower the weights slowly through a comfortable range.
description: Both forearms rest palm down on a bench while the wrists extend to lift the dumbbells.
aliases: Dumbbell over Bench Reverse Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wrist Curl over Bench
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest both forearms on it, with wrists just beyond the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing up.
Curl the palms upward while keeping the forearms against the bench.
Lower slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
description: Both supported wrists curl palm-up dumbbells to work the forearm flexors.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row with Grip Rotation
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, bend your knees slightly, and hinge forward at the hips.
Let the arms hang below your shoulders with the palms facing backward.
Pull the weights toward your waist while turning the palms forward.
Keep your torso still and your elbows near your sides.
Lower slowly, reversing the hand rotation.
description: A bent-over row adds forearm rotation as the dumbbells rise, working the back and elbow flexors.
aliases: Dumbbell Palm Rotational Bent over Row

name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted.
Hold dumbbells beside your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Press both weights upward above your upper chest without arching away from the bench.
Lower them slowly with your elbows near your torso.
description: A palms-in incline press trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while the bench supports the torso.
aliases: Dumbbell Palms in Incline Bench Press

name: Dumbbell Preacher Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other.
Curl both weights upward without lifting the upper arms from the pad.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbows straight.
description: The preacher pad supports both upper arms while a thumbs-up grip works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and toes turned slightly outward.
Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands in front of your hips.
Bend your hips and knees to lower between your legs, keeping the knees aligned with your toes.
Keep your feet planted and stand by extending your knees and hips.
Lower with control for the next repetition.
description: A wide-stance squat with one dumbbell held between the legs works the quadriceps, glutes and inner thighs.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with one upper arm resting on the pad and your free hand on your thigh.
Hold a dumbbell with the palm up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder without lifting the upper arm.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbow straight.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One upper arm rests on a preacher pad while a palm-up curl trains the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Preacher Curl over Stability Ball
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and lean your upper arms over it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing up.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms supported.
Lower slowly without rolling the ball away or forcing the elbows straight.
description: Both upper arms rest on a stability ball while the elbows bend and straighten to work the biceps.
aliases: Dumbbell Preacher Curl over Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Chest Press on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with feet planted and hips raised in line with your torso. Keep your neck steady.
Hold the dumbbells beside your chest with palms facing toward your feet.
Press both weights upward above your chest while keeping the ball steady.
Lower slowly beside your chest.
description: Both dumbbells press above the chest while the upper back rests on a stability ball and the hips remain raised.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronated-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest with palms facing toward your feet.
Keep the upper arms raised and bend the elbows to lower the weights beside your forehead.
Straighten the elbows to return the weights above you.
Move slowly and keep the dumbbells clear of your face.
description: Both elbows bend and straighten with a palms-toward-feet grip while the upper arms stay raised above a flat bench.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Curl
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted.
Let both arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders while keeping the upper arms still.
Lower slowly to the hanging position without swinging.
description: An incline bench supports the chest while both arms curl palm-up dumbbells to train the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Lie face down against an incline bench with your feet braced on its base.
Let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders with palms facing each other.
Curl both weights upward while keeping the upper arms still.
Lower them slowly without lifting your chest from the bench.
description: A chest-supported curl uses a palms-in grip to train the biceps and forearms.

name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover Across Bench
instructions: Rest your upper back across the width of a flat bench, with feet planted and hips supported by your legs.
Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands above your chest.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head through a comfortable shoulder range, allowing your elbows to bend.
Bring your upper arms forward and straighten the elbows to return the weight above your chest.
Keep your hips and ribs steady throughout.
description: Rest the upper back across a bench and lower one dumbbell behind the head, allowing the elbows to bend. The chest, lats and triceps bring the weight back above the chest as the elbows straighten.

name: Dumbbell Pullover on Stability Ball with Hips Raised
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with feet planted. Keep your neck steady.
Lift your hips in line with your torso and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend as you lower the weight behind your head within a comfortable shoulder range.
Bring it back above your chest without lowering your hips.
Maintain the same supported position throughout the set.
description: A pullover trains the chest and lats while the upper back rests on a ball and the hips stay extended throughout.
aliases: Dumbbell Pullover Hip Extension on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Pullover on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball, plant both feet, and keep the hips raised. Keep your neck steady.
Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands above your chest.
With a slight elbow bend, lower the weight toward the space behind your head.
Bring it back above your chest while keeping your torso steady.
description: One dumbbell moves behind the head and above the chest while the upper back rests on a stability ball.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at shoulder level and feet planted.
Bend your knees in a short dip while keeping your torso upright.
Drive through your legs and press both dumbbells overhead in one movement.
Stand tall with the weights steady, then lower them under control to shoulder level.
Reset before repeating.
description: The push press uses a short leg drive to help press two dumbbells overhead, working the shoulders, triceps and legs.

name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Stand upright holding the dumbbells beside your thighs with palms facing inward.
Bend and lift both elbows out to the sides, drawing the weights upward close to your ribs.
Stop with the elbows around shoulder height and keep your torso still.
Lower slowly until your arms return beside you.
description: Bent elbows lift beside and slightly behind the torso as the dumbbells rise close to the ribs, training the shoulders and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell beside each thigh and palms facing inward.
Lift your elbows outward and slightly backward as you draw the weights beside your ribs.
Keep your torso upright and stop around shoulder height.
Lower the weights slowly to your sides.
description: A palms-in upright row raises the elbows beside and behind the torso while the weights stay near the body.

name: Dumbbell Bench-Supported Single-Arm Rear-Delt Row
instructions: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a flat bench, keeping the other foot planted.
Hold a dumbbell below your opposite shoulder.
Bend the working elbow and lift it out to the side to row the weight toward your upper ribs.
Lower slowly without rotating your torso.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: A high-elbow row works the rear shoulder and upper back while one hand and knee support the torso on a bench.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent-Over Rear-Delt Raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with feet planted and lean forward from your hips.
Hold the dumbbells beneath your thighs with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows bent as you lift both upper arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly without lifting or swinging your torso.
description: A seated forward lean allows both arms to lift sideways to train the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Reverse Fly
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent and hinge forward, keeping your back steady.
Let the dumbbells hang beneath your shoulders with palms facing each other.
Keep a small elbow bend and lift both arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly without raising your torso.
description: Both arms lift out to the sides from a hip hinge, working the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Head-Supported Reverse Fly
instructions: Set an incline bench at a height that lets you hinge forward and rest your forehead lightly against its padded top.
Plant your feet, bend your knees slightly, and hold the dumbbells below your shoulders.
Keep a small elbow bend and lift your arms out to the sides without pressing heavily through your head.
Lower the weights slowly while keeping your torso steady.
description: The forehead rests lightly against an incline bench while the arms lift sideways to train the rear shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot backward and bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Keep the front foot planted and the front knee aligned with its toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions, then switch legs.
description: Stepping backward into a lunge works the quadriceps and glutes while dumbbells stay beside the body.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs and palms facing backward.
Curl both weights upward with the palms facing down, keeping your upper arms still.
Stop near shoulder level without leaning backward.
Lower slowly until your elbows are extended.
description: A palms-down curl works the elbow flexors and forearms while both upper arms stay beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells beside your chest with palms facing toward your head.
Press both weights above your chest, keeping the elbows relatively close to your torso.
Lower slowly along the same path.
description: A palms-toward-head grip changes the arm position during a flat-bench press for the chest and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Incline Rear-Delt Raise
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells below your shoulders with palms facing inward.
Keep your elbows bent as you lift both upper arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly without lifting your chest from the pad.
description: The chest rests against an incline bench while both arms open sideways to train the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Row
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted and use your free hand to steady yourself on the bench.
Let the working arm hang with the palm facing forward.
Pull the dumbbell toward your waist with the elbow near your torso.
Lower slowly without lifting your chest or twisting.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A chest-supported row uses a palm-forward grip to train one side of the back and its elbow flexors.
aliases: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench One Arm Row

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Reverse-Grip Row
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench and plant your feet.
Let both dumbbells hang below your shoulders with palms forward.
Pull the weights toward your waist, keeping elbows near your torso.
Lower slowly until your arms are extended without lifting your chest.
description: Both arms row palm-forward dumbbells while an incline bench supports the chest.
aliases: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Two Arm Row

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Reverse-Grip Row
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent and hinge forward while keeping your back steady.
Hold the dumbbells below your shoulders with palms facing forward.
Pull both weights toward your waist with elbows near your torso.
Lower slowly without changing your torso angle.
description: A palms-forward grip and forward hip hinge allow both arms to row dumbbells toward the waist.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms down.
Curl the weights upward without lifting your upper arms.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbows straight.
description: The preacher pad supports both upper arms during a palms-down curl for the elbow flexors and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Reverse Curl
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted.
Let both arms hang, holding the dumbbells with palms facing backward.
Curl the weights upward with palms down, keeping the upper arms still.
Lower slowly to the hanging position.
description: Both arms curl with a palms-down grip while the chest rests against an incline bench.

name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet planted.
Rest your forearms on your thighs with wrists beyond the knees, holding dumbbells palms down.
Lift the backs of your hands without moving your forearms.
Lower the weights slowly through a comfortable range.
description: Both forearms rest on the thighs while palms-down wrist extensions work the forearm extensors.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with feet about hip-width apart.
Soften your knees and push your hips backward, keeping the weights close to your legs.
Lower only as far as you can maintain a steady back and feel tension in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall without leaning backward.
description: A Romanian deadlift lowers the dumbbells through a hip hinge and uses the glutes and hamstrings to stand again.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Reverse Fly with Rotation
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted and dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.
Begin with the dumbbells held horizontally end to end in front of the bench and keep a comfortable bend in your elbows.
Lift your upper arms out to the sides and rotate the arms so the thumb sides of your hands point upward near the top.
Lower slowly, reversing the rotation to return to the starting grip.
description: An incline bench supports a reverse fly that adds arm rotation as the dumbbells lift, working the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Standing Scott Press
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your face, palms toward you and elbows bent.
Move your elbows outward as you raise the dumbbells above head level.
Keep a bend in the elbows instead of straightening the arms fully.
Reverse the path, bringing the elbows forward and the weights in front of your face.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
description: The Scott press raises and rotates the upper arms while the elbows stay bent. The shoulders move the dumbbells upward through a shorter range than a full overhead press.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Front Raise
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with your feet planted and a dumbbell beside each hip.
Lift one arm forward to about shoulder height, keeping a small bend in the elbow.
Lower it slowly as the other arm begins to rise.
Continue alternating without rocking your torso.
description: The arms alternate forward raises while sitting on a flat bench, training the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Hammer Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with feet planted and dumbbells beside your body.
Keep both palms facing inward and curl one weight toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly while keeping the upper arm still.
Repeat with the other arm and continue alternating without rocking the ball.
description: Alternating palms-in curls work the biceps and forearms while the seated body balances on a stability ball.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Hammer Curl on Exercise Ball

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Neutral-Grip Overhead Press with Back Support
instructions: Sit against an upright bench backrest with feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells in front of your shoulders with palms facing each other and elbows pointing forward.
Press one dumbbell overhead while the other stays at shoulder level.
Lower it with control, then press the other one.
Continue alternating while keeping your back supported.
description: The arms alternate overhead presses with an inward-facing grip while the back rests against an upright bench.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Overhead Press with Back Support
instructions: Sit against an upright bench backrest with feet planted and dumbbells beside your shoulders, palms forward.
Press one dumbbell overhead while keeping the other near shoulder level.
Lower that weight to shoulder level, then press with the other arm.
Continue alternating without leaning back or sideways.
description: Alternating palms-forward overhead presses train the shoulders and triceps while an upright bench supports the back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with both feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell securely in both hands and lift it overhead.
Keep your upper arms beside your head as you bend the elbows to lower the dumbbell behind it.
Straighten your elbows to return the weight overhead without arching your back.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell while the elbows bend behind the head and straighten overhead to train the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent-Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend the elbows and hold the weights beside your waist, palms inward.
Keep that elbow bend as you lift your upper arms out to the sides to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging your torso.
description: Both upper arms lift sideways while the elbows stay bent, working the shoulders.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Bent Arm Lateral Raise

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Kickback
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet planted and lean forward from your hips.
Hold the dumbbells with upper arms beside your torso and elbows bent.
Keep one upper arm still as you straighten that elbow behind you.
Bend it slowly to return the weight beneath the elbow.
Repeat with the other arm and continue alternating.
description: A seated forward lean holds the upper arms beside the torso while the elbows extend one at a time.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Bent over Alternate Kickback

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent-Over Kickback
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet planted and lean forward from your hips.
Hold the dumbbells with upper arms beside your torso and elbows bent.
Keep the upper arms still as you straighten both elbows behind you.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the weights beneath them.
description: Both elbows straighten behind the body from a seated forward lean, working the triceps.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Bent over Triceps Extension

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl with Back Support
instructions: Sit with your back supported and feet planted, holding dumbbells beside your body.
Turn your palms forward and keep your upper arms still.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly without lifting your back from the support.
description: Both arms curl palm-up dumbbells while the torso rests against an upright bench backrest.

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with both feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells beside your body with palms forward.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms still.
Lower slowly without rocking the ball.
description: Both elbows bend together while sitting upright on a stability ball to train the biceps and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Biceps Curl (On Stability Ball)

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl to Overhead Press
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with feet planted and dumbbells beside you, palms forward.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Move your elbows outward and turn the palms forward to set up the press.
Press both dumbbells overhead without leaning backward.
Lower to shoulder level, reverse the arm rotation, and lower the curl to your sides.
description: A curl transitions into an overhead press to work the biceps, shoulders and triceps while seated.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Biceps Curl to Shoulder Press

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with the balls of both feet on a stable weight plate and your heels free to move.
Rest a dumbbell upright on each thigh near the knee and hold both weights securely.
Raise your heels by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Lower the heels slowly while keeping your forefeet on the plate.
description: With a dumbbell resting on each thigh, both heels rise and lower while the forefeet stay on a raised support.

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl on Flat Bench
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with feet planted and dumbbells at your sides.
Turn your palms forward and keep your upper arms beside your torso.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly without swinging your body.
description: Seated curls work both biceps while the upper arms stay beside the torso and no backrest is used.

name: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise with Back Support
instructions: Sit with your back against an upright bench and your feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside each thigh with palms facing backward.
Keep a slight elbow bend and lift the weights forward to shoulder height, palms down.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
description: Both arms lift dumbbells forward while an upright backrest supports the seated torso.

name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl with Back Support
instructions: Sit against an upright bench backrest with feet planted.
Hold dumbbells beside you with palms facing inward.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms still.
Lower slowly without lifting your back from the support.
description: A supported seated position keeps the torso steady during palms-in curls for the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Seated Outward Curl
instructions: Sit with your back against an upright bench and feet planted.
Hold dumbbells at your sides, turning your palms forward and slightly outward.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso and curl the weights upward along the outward arm path.
Lower slowly without pulling the elbows inward.
description: The forearms angle outward during a seated curl while the upper arms remain beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Seated Kickback
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet planted, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward from your hips and bring your upper arms beside your torso with elbows bent.
Keep the upper arms still as you straighten both elbows to move the weights behind you.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the weights beneath them.
description: Both elbows extend behind the body from a seated forward lean to train the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise on Flat Bench
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with your feet planted and a dumbbell beside each hip.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and lift both arms out to the sides.
Stop around shoulder height without shrugging or rocking your torso.
Lower slowly to your sides.
description: Both arms lift sideways while sitting upright on a flat bench to train the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise with Back Support
instructions: Sit with your back supported and feet planted, holding dumbbells beside your body.
Keep a small elbow bend and raise both arms out to the sides.
Stop around shoulder height without shrugging.
Lower slowly to your sides.
description: An upright backrest supports the torso as both arms raise dumbbells sideways.

name: Dumbbell Seated Thumb-Up Wrist Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with forearms resting along your thighs and wrists beyond the knees.
Hold the dumbbells with thumbs pointing upward.
Keep the forearms still and bend both wrists toward the thumb side to lift the weights.
Lower slowly through a small comfortable range.
description: Both supported wrists lift the weights toward the thumb side in radial deviation, working the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Curl on Stability Ball with Leg Raised
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball holding one dumbbell beside your body, palm forward.
Plant one foot and extend the other leg in front of you, keeping it off the floor.
Keep the working upper arm still and curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly without rocking the ball.
Complete the set, then change arms and the supporting leg.
description: One arm curls a dumbbell while sitting on a stability ball with one leg extended off the floor.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Bicep Curl on Exercise Ball with Leg Raised

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Kickback
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet planted and lean forward, resting your free hand on your thigh.
Hold one dumbbell with the upper arm beside your torso and elbow bent.
Keep the upper arm still as you straighten the elbow behind you.
Bend the elbow slowly to return the weight beneath it.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A seated forward lean allows one elbow to straighten behind the body to train the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Forearm Rotation
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm along your thigh with the wrist beyond the knee.
Hold the dumbbell with a straight wrist and the palm facing down.
Rotate the forearm to turn the palm upward while keeping the forearm supported.
Reverse the rotation slowly through a comfortable range.
Complete the set and switch hands.
description: A supported forearm turns a dumbbell from palm-down toward palm-up without lifting the elbow.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with the ball of one foot on a stable raised block and the other foot on the floor.
Rest a dumbbell across the working thigh near the knee and hold it securely.
Raise that heel while keeping the forefoot on the block.
Lower the heel slowly through a comfortable range.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: One heel rises and lowers from a raised forefoot support while a dumbbell loads the working thigh.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise with Upright Dumbbell
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with the ball of one foot on a stable weight plate and the other foot on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell upright by its handle and rest its lower end on the working thigh near the knee.
Raise the working heel while keeping the forefoot on the plate.
Lower slowly through a comfortable range.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: An upright dumbbell rests on one thigh while that heel rises and lowers from a raised forefoot support.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Hammer Grip

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise with Palm-Up Hold
instructions: Sit on a flat bench and place the ball of one foot on a stable weight plate, keeping the other foot on the floor.
Rest a dumbbell across the working thigh near the knee and hold it securely with the palm facing up.
Keep that knee bent and raise the heel by pressing through the forefoot.
Lower the heel slowly while keeping the forefoot supported.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: A palm-up hold steadies a dumbbell across the working thigh while one heel rises and lowers.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Palm Up

name: Dumbbell Seated Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your forearms along your thighs with palms up and wrists beyond your knees.
Curl the palms upward without lifting your forearms.
Lower the dumbbells slowly through a comfortable wrist range.
description: Both forearms rest on the thighs while palm-up wrist curls train the forearm flexors.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Palms Up Wrist Curl

name: Dumbbell Seated Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with feet planted and both upper arms on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing up.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders without lifting the upper arms.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbows straight.
description: Both upper arms rest on a preacher pad during simultaneous palm-up curls for the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet apart and lean forward.
Rest the working upper arm against the inside of your thigh and hold a dumbbell with the palm down.
Curl the weight upward while keeping the upper arm braced.
Lower slowly until the elbow is extended.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One upper arm braces against the inner thigh during a palms-down curl for the elbow flexors and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip Concentration Curl

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit with your back supported and feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell overhead with your palm facing backward.
Keep the upper arm raised and bend the elbow to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten the elbow to return the weight overhead.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A reversed grip changes the hand orientation during a seated single-arm overhead triceps extension.
aliases: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip One Arm Overhead Tricep Extension

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press with Back Support
instructions: Sit against an upright bench backrest with both feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder with palms forward.
Press both weights overhead while keeping your torso steady.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
description: An upright backrest supports the torso during a two-arm overhead press for the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral-Grip Overhead Press
instructions: Sit with your back supported and feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells beside your shoulders with palms facing each other and elbows pointing forward.
Press both weights overhead while keeping the palms facing inward.
Lower them slowly to shoulder level without leaning backward.
description: A palms-in overhead press trains the shoulders and triceps while the back rests against an upright bench.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension with Back Support
instructions: Sit with your back against an upright bench and feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell securely in both hands above your head.
Keep your upper arms beside your head as you bend the elbows to lower the weight behind it.
Straighten your elbows to return the dumbbell overhead without arching your back.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell while the elbows extend overhead and an upright bench supports the back.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand upright with a dumbbell at each side and palms facing inward.
Keep your elbows straight and lift your shoulders toward your ears.
Pause briefly without rolling your shoulders.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
description: Straight arms hold the dumbbells at the sides while the shoulders rise and lower to train the upper trapezius.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand at your side and the free hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways away from the dumbbell through a comfortable range, letting the weight rise slightly.
Keep your hips facing forward and avoid twisting.
Return slowly to upright, allowing the dumbbell to lower.
Complete the set and switch sides.
description: A side bend away from a single dumbbell loads the side of the trunk as the torso bends and returns upright.

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying Lateral Raise on Bench
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your head supported by your lower arm.
Hold a dumbbell in the upper hand near the outside of your top thigh.
Keep a small elbow bend and lift the arm away from your side toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly toward your thigh without rolling your torso.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: Lying on the side changes the starting angle of a one-arm shoulder raise on a flat bench.
aliases: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise

name: Dumbbell Rotating High-Plank Raise
instructions: Start in a high plank with one palm under its shoulder, both feet on the floor, and a dumbbell in the other hand.
Keep the supporting arm straight as you lift the dumbbell out to the side and rotate your chest toward that side.
Finish with the dumbbell above the shoulder and hips held off the floor.
Reverse the movement slowly to face the floor again.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: One hand supports a plank while the opposite arm lifts a dumbbell and the torso rotates open, combining shoulder work with trunk control.
aliases: Dumbbell Side Plank with Rear Fly

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Overhead Carry
instructions: Stand tall and bring a dumbbell into a steady overhead position with one arm extended.
Gently tighten your abdomen and keep your ribs aligned over your hips.
Walk forward with controlled steps, keeping the weight above the shoulder.
Stop walking before lowering the dumbbell under control.
Change arms and repeat.
description: Walking with one dumbbell held overhead challenges shoulder and trunk stability while the legs alternate steps.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side and shift your weight onto the same-side foot.
Bend the other knee to lift that foot clear of the floor.
Raise the working heel to balance on the ball of the foot without hopping.
Lower the heel slowly to the floor.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: A single-leg calf raise lifts the heel from the floor while one dumbbell adds resistance.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand and shift your weight onto one leg.
Keep a small bend in that knee and lean forward from your hip while the free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbells beneath your shoulders without twisting your hips or rounding your back.
Drive through the standing leg to return upright.
Complete the set and switch legs.
description: Two dumbbells lower during a single-leg hip hinge while the free leg reaches behind, working the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Rear-Foot-Supported Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand in front of a low step and rest your rear toes on it.
Hold one dumbbell beside the front leg, rest your free hand behind your back and keep most of your weight through the front foot.
With the front knee slightly bent, push your hips back to lower the dumbbell.
Keep the rear toes on the step and your back steady throughout.
Extend the front hip to stand upright, then complete the set before changing sides.
description: The rear toes rest on a step while one dumbbell adds resistance as the torso leans forward over the front leg. The front-leg hamstrings and glutes control the movement.
aliases: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift with Stepbox Support

name: Dumbbell Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Stand facing away from a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the top of one foot behind you on the bench and keep the front foot planted.
Bend the front knee and hip to lower your body, keeping the knee aligned with your toes.
Push through the front foot to return upright without hopping.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: The rear foot rests on a bench while the front leg bends and straightens to work the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Squat with Side Hold
instructions: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell at your side in the same-side hand.
Extend the free arm and the other leg forward.
Bend the standing knee and hip to lower through a controlled range while keeping the raised foot off the floor.
Push through the standing foot to return upright.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: A single-leg squat holds one dumbbell beside the body while the free arm and leg reach forward for balance.

name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell beside each hip.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat, keeping your feet planted.
Lower within a comfortable range while keeping your chest lifted and knees aligned with your toes.
Push through your feet to return to standing.
description: Dumbbells hang beside the body while both hips and knees bend and straighten to train the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Hammer Curl to Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing inward.
Curl one weight to shoulder height while keeping the upper arm beside your torso.
Continue by pressing that weight overhead.
Lower it to the shoulder, then lower the curl to your side.
Complete the repetitions with that arm, then change sides.
description: One arm connects a palms-in curl to an overhead press while the other hand holds a dumbbell at the side. The working biceps, shoulder and triceps perform the sequence.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Hammer Curl and Press
Dumbbell Standing Alternating Hammer Curl to Press

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternating Neutral-Grip Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet planted and dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing each other and elbows pointing forward.
Press one dumbbell overhead while keeping your torso upright.
Lower it to shoulder height, then press with the other arm.
Continue alternating without leaning backward.
description: The arms take turns pressing overhead with palms facing inward and elbows forward while the torso stays upright.

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternating Front Raise
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing backward.
Keep a slight elbow bend and raise one weight forward to shoulder height, palm down.
Lower it slowly without leaning back.
Repeat with the other arm and continue alternating.
description: The arms alternate forward raises to shoulder height while the torso remains upright.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Alternating Kickback
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent, push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Hold dumbbells with upper arms beside your torso and elbows bent.
Straighten one elbow behind you without swinging the upper arm.
Bend it slowly to return the weight beneath the elbow.
Repeat with the other arm and continue alternating.
description: A standing hip hinge holds the torso forward while the elbows extend behind the body one at a time.

name: Dumbbell Standing Around-The-World Raise
instructions: Stand upright with dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep a small elbow bend and sweep both arms outward to shoulder height.
Continue the arc overhead while turning the hands to bring the dumbbells above you.
Lower the weights slowly in front of your body to the starting position.
Keep your torso still and use a comfortable shoulder range.
description: Both arms sweep out to the sides and overhead, then lower in front of the body to train the shoulders through a wide arc.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Single-Arm Kickback
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent and lean forward from your hips, resting your free hand on your thigh for support.
Hold one dumbbell with the upper arm beside your torso and elbow bent.
Straighten the elbow behind you without moving the upper arm.
Bend it slowly to return the weight beneath the elbow.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One elbow straightens behind the body while a standing hip hinge holds the upper arm beside the torso.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing Bent over One Arm Triceps Extension

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Kickback
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent, push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Hold the dumbbells with upper arms beside your torso and elbows bent.
Straighten both elbows without swinging the upper arms.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the weights beneath them.
description: Both upper arms remain beside the torso while the elbows straighten behind the body to work the triceps.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing Bent over Two Arm Triceps Extension

name: Dumbbell Standing Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell at each side, palms facing forward.
Keep the upper arms still and curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly without leaning backward.
Lower slowly until your elbows are extended.
description: Both elbows bend together to lift palm-up dumbbells while the upper arms remain beside the torso.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise on Raised Support
instructions: Stand with the balls of both feet on a stable raised support and heels free to move.
Hold a dumbbell at each side and keep your knees nearly straight.
Raise both heels without bouncing.
Lower slowly below the top of the support through a comfortable range.
description: The forefeet stay elevated while both heels rise and lower to work the calves with added dumbbell resistance.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Concentration Curl
instructions: Stand with feet apart, soften your knees and lean forward from your hips.
Let the working arm hang between your legs with your palm facing forward.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder while keeping the upper arm still.
Lower slowly without swinging your torso.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: A deep standing hip hinge leaves one arm hanging below the torso for a controlled biceps curl.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise to Overhead
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing backward.
Keep a small elbow bend and raise both arms forward, continuing overhead through a comfortable range.
Keep your ribs down rather than leaning backward.
Lower the weights slowly along the same path.
description: Both dumbbells travel forward from thigh level to overhead while the elbows remain nearly straight.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head

name: Dumbbell Standing Outward Curl
instructions: Stand upright with dumbbells at your sides.
Turn the palms forward and slightly outward while keeping the upper arms beside your torso.
Curl the weights upward along the outward arm path.
Lower slowly without swinging or pulling the elbows inward.
description: Both forearms angle outward during a standing curl for the biceps and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing Inner Biceps Curl V. 2

name: Dumbbell Standing Bent-Over Kickback
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent, push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with upper arms beside your torso and elbows bent.
Keep your upper arms still as you straighten the elbows behind you.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the weights beneath them.
description: A standing hip hinge holds the upper body steady as both elbows extend to work the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Single-Arm Concentration Curl
instructions: Stand with feet apart and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back steady.
Rest the free hand on a thigh and let the working arm hang beneath your torso, palm forward.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder without moving the upper arm.
Lower it slowly to the hanging position.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: The torso leans forward and the free hand braces on the thigh while one arm performs a palm-up curl.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Concentration Curl

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Curl over Incline Bench
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench and rest the back of one upper arm on its raised pad.
Hold a dumbbell with the palm up and steady yourself with the free hand on the bench.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder without lifting the upper arm.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbow straight.
Complete the set and switch arms.
description: The working upper arm rests on an incline bench pad while a palm-up curl trains the biceps.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Curl (Over Incline Bench)

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Curl over Incline Bench
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench with the working upper arm resting along its raised backrest.
Hold one dumbbell with the palm up and use your free hand to steady yourself.
Curl the weight upward while keeping the upper arm against the pad.
Lower slowly through a comfortable elbow range.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: An incline bench supports one upper arm for a standing preacher-style biceps curl.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Curl over Incline Bench

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand upright with one dumbbell held overhead, palm facing inward.
Keep your upper arm raised and bend the elbow to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten the elbow to bring the weight overhead again.
Keep your torso steady throughout.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One elbow bends behind the head and straightens overhead to train the triceps while standing.

name: Dumbbell Supported Single-Arm Neutral-Grip Overhead Press
instructions: Stand beside an upright bench and hold its backrest with your free hand.
Hold a dumbbell beside your free shoulder with the palm facing inward.
Press the weight overhead without leaning sideways.
Lower it slowly to shoulder level.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: The free hand rests on a bench backrest while one arm presses a dumbbell overhead with the palm inward.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Palm in Press

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell in front of your thigh with the palm facing backward.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the weight upward with the palm facing down.
Lower it slowly until your elbow is extended.
Complete the set and change arms.
description: One elbow bends with the palm facing down to train the elbow flexors and forearms.
aliases: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Reverse Curl

name: Dumbbell Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet planted and a dumbbell beside each shoulder, palms forward.
Press both weights overhead while keeping your torso upright.
Extend your arms without leaning backward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to shoulder height.
description: Both arms press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height while the torso stays upright.

name: Dumbbell Standing Neutral-Grip Overhead Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells beside your shoulders with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your torso steady.
Press both weights overhead without arching your back.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
description: A palms-in overhead press trains both shoulders and triceps from a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Standing Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind a preacher bench with both upper arms against its pad.
Hold the dumbbells with palms facing up.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders without lifting your upper arms.
Lower slowly without forcing your elbows straight.
description: Both upper arms rest on a preacher pad while simultaneous curls train the biceps from a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs and palms facing backward.
Keep the upper arms still and curl both weights upward with palms down.
Pause briefly near shoulder level without leaning back.
Lower slowly until the elbows are extended.
description: Both dumbbells curl with the palms facing down while the upper arms stay beside the body.

name: Dumbbell Standing Two-Hand Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand upright and hold one dumbbell securely with both hands overhead.
Keep the upper arms raised as you bend both elbows to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten the elbows to return it overhead.
Keep the torso steady and lower the weight carefully when finished.
description: Both hands hold one dumbbell as the elbows bend behind the head and straighten overhead.

name: Dumbbell Standing Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind a preacher bench with both upper arms resting on the pad.
Curl the dumbbells upward with palms facing up.
At the top, rotate the forearms until your palms face down.
Lower the weights slowly with palms down.
Turn the palms up again at the bottom before repeating.
description: Both arms curl palm-up dumbbells, then rotate to a palms-down grip for the descent while supported on a preacher pad.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up with Knee Raise and Curl
instructions: Stand facing a stable bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the bench and push through it to stand up.
Raise the trailing knee and curl both weights toward your shoulders while balancing on the lead leg.
Lower the weights as you step the trailing foot back to the floor.
Reset and repeat, then change the lead leg.
description: A step-up finishes with a raised knee and two-arm curl, combining leg strength, biceps work and single-leg balance.
aliases: Dumbbell Step Up Single Leg Balance with Bicep Curl

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Stand facing a stable bench with a dumbbell beside each hip.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Push through that foot to rise until the lead leg is straight and the other leg comes up beside it.
Lower the trailing foot back to the floor with control, keeping the lead foot on the bench.
Complete the set, then step down and change the lead leg.
description: Stepping onto a bench with dumbbells at the sides works the quadriceps and glutes of the lead leg.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up with Rear Foot Supported on Second Bench
instructions: Set two stable benches apart so you can stand between them with the top of one foot resting on the rear bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and keep the rear foot supported throughout.
Step the front foot onto the bench ahead and extend that leg to lift your body.
Lower the front foot back to the floor under control while the rear foot remains on its bench.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: The rear foot stays on one bench while the front foot steps onto a second bench, combining a supported split stance with a step-up.

name: Dumbbell Rear-Foot-Supported Split Squat and Step-Up
instructions: Stand between two stable benches with the front foot on the floor, the rear foot supported on the bench behind you and a dumbbell at each side.
Bend the front hip and knee to lower into a split squat while keeping the rear foot supported.
Rise and place the front foot fully on the bench ahead, then extend that leg to lift your body between the benches.
With both feet now supported on the benches, bend both knees to lower into an elevated split squat.
Bring the front foot back to the floor under control and return to the starting stance.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: With the rear foot supported on one bench, a floor-level split squat leads into a step onto a second bench and another split squat before returning to the floor.

name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with knees slightly softened.
