Keep that small knee bend as you push your hips backward and lower the weights close to your legs.
Stop before your back rounds or the hamstring stretch becomes uncomfortable.
Extend your hips to stand upright without leaning backward.
description: A hip hinge with nearly straight knees lowers the dumbbells and loads the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Straight-Arm Pullover on Bench
instructions: Lie on your back along a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight as you lower the weight behind your head through a comfortable range.
Bring it back above your chest without arching your lower back.
description: One dumbbell arcs behind the head and returns above the chest while the body lies lengthwise on a bench.

name: Dumbbell Straight-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs and a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips backward and lower the weights close to your legs while keeping your back steady.
Keep the knee angle nearly unchanged and stop within your controlled range.
Extend your hips to return upright.
description: The hips hinge while the knees stay nearly straight, working the glutes and hamstrings as the body lowers and rises.

name: Dumbbell Wide-Stance Pull-Through
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes slightly outward, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the weight between your legs, keeping your back steady.
Extend your hips and knees to stand as the weight moves forward to thigh level.
Lower into the next repetition without swinging the weight above your hips.
description: One dumbbell moves between the legs and returns to the front of the hips as a wide-stance squat and hinge extend.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat with Lower-Leg Support
instructions: Stand in the squat support with your ankles under the front rollers and calves against the rear pad.
Hold one dumbbell at your chest with both hands.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat while keeping the lower legs against the supports.
Extend your knees and hips to return upright without pulling away from the pads.
description: A lower-leg support device holds the shins in place while a goblet-held dumbbell adds resistance to a supported squat.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with palms facing toward your feet.
Bend both elbows outward to lower the ends of the dumbbells toward your upper chest.
Straighten your elbows to bring the weights back above your chest.
Keep the movement controlled and avoid bouncing the dumbbells on your body.
description: The elbows bend outward as the dumbbells lower toward the chest, then extend to work the triceps while lying on a bench.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Bent-Over Kickback
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and shift your weight onto one leg.
Lean forward from your hip and lift the other leg behind you, keeping a small bend in the standing knee.
Bring the upper arms beside your torso with elbows bent.
Straighten both elbows behind you, then bend them slowly without moving your upper arms.
Stand upright before changing the supporting leg.
description: Both elbows extend behind the body while the torso balances in a single-leg hip hinge.
aliases: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback with Stork Stance

name: Dumbbell Rotating-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells beside your chest with palms facing each other.
Press both weights upward while rotating the forearms until your palms face toward your feet.
Lower slowly while reversing the rotation.
Keep wrists straight and your torso supported throughout.
description: The forearms rotate during a flat-bench chest press, changing the palm direction between the bottom and top.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms toward your body.
Lead with your elbows to lift the weights close to your torso.
Stop within a comfortable range with elbows around shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: Both elbows lift outward as the dumbbells travel close to the torso to work the shoulders and upper trapezius.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs and palms facing your body.
Bend and lift the elbows outward to raise the weights toward your upper torso.
Keep your torso upright and stop with the elbows around shoulder height.
Lower slowly along the same path.
description: An upright row raises the elbows out to the sides while the weights stay close to the torso.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Stand holding one light dumbbell and raise the upper arm out to the side to shoulder level.
Bend the elbow so the forearm angles downward in front of you, staying within a comfortable shoulder range.
Keep the upper arm still and rotate at the shoulder to bring the forearm upright.
Reverse slowly toward the starting forearm position without dropping the elbow.
Complete the set and switch arms.
description: A raised upper arm stays still while the bent forearm rotates upward to train the shoulder external rotators.

name: Dumbbell Waiter Curl
instructions: Stand upright and hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms supporting the underside of its upper end.
Keep the upper arms beside your torso and the dumbbell in front of you.
Bend both elbows to lift the dumbbell toward your chest.
Lower it slowly without leaning backward or letting the weight slip.
description: Both palms support the upper end of one vertical dumbbell as the elbows bend to work the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Standing W Press
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in front of each shoulder, palms facing inward and elbows bent.
Press the weights upward and outward so your arms open into a wide overhead position.
Keep your torso upright and stop within a comfortable shoulder range.
Lower along the same path, bringing the elbows forward beside your torso.
description: Both dumbbells press upward and outward from in front of the shoulders, opening into a wide overhead position to work the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and palms forward.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Rotate the forearms at the top until your palms face down.
Lower slowly with palms down.
Turn the palms forward again at the bottom before repeating.
description: Both weights rise with palms up and lower with palms down, combining a biceps curl with forearm rotation.

name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms on the pad and palms facing up.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders.
Turn the forearms at the top until your palms face down.
Lower slowly with palms down without forcing the elbows straight.
Turn the palms up at the bottom before repeating.
description: Seated preacher curls lift palm-up dumbbells and lower them palm down while the upper arms stay supported.

name: Two-Dumbbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit with your back supported and feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep the upper arms raised and bend both elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Straighten the elbows to return the weights overhead without arching your back.
description: A dumbbell in each hand lowers behind the head as both elbows bend, then rises as the triceps extend the arms.

name: Standing Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with feet planted and arms extended in front of your chest.
Open both arms out to the sides through a comfortable range.
Bring them back across the front of your chest.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm without forcing the shoulders backward.
description: The arms open and close across the front of the body in a controlled dynamic chest and shoulder movement.

name: Parallel-Bar Russian Dip
instructions: Support yourself between parallel bars with arms straight and feet off the floor.
Bend the elbows to lower into a dip.
Shift backward under control until your forearms rest along the bars.
Shift forward onto your hands again, then straighten the elbows to return to the top.
Keep your body controlled throughout the transition.
description: A dip transitions onto the forearms and back to the hands on parallel bars, combining elbow extension with shoulder control.

name: Elbow Reverse Push-Up Between Padded Supports with Legs Raised
instructions: Set two stable, equally high padded supports far enough apart for one elbow on each, with room for your torso between them.
Face upward between the supports and place your bent elbows on the pads beside your torso.
Extend your legs forward and keep them clear of the floor, holding your abdomen firm.
Press through your elbows to lift your torso between the supports without straightening your elbows.
Lower your torso slowly while keeping your elbows supported and your legs raised.
description: Both elbows rest on separate padded supports while the legs stay extended off the floor. Pressing through the elbows lifts the torso between the supports, working the upper back and rear shoulders while the abdomen holds the body steady.

name: Alternating Elbow-To-Knee Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly beside your head and both feet lifted.
Curl one shoulder toward the opposite knee as that knee bends inward and the other leg extends.
Move through your torso without pulling your neck or forcing elbow-to-knee contact.
Change sides in a controlled alternating rhythm.
Lower your head and feet when the set is complete.
description: A twisting crunch brings one shoulder toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends, working the abs and obliques.

name: Gymnastic-Ring Elevator to Handstand
instructions: Begin in a controlled inverted hang on securely mounted rings with legs together and body straight.
Bend your elbows and pull the rings toward your shoulders while maintaining the inverted body line.
Continue the transition by pressing the rings downward and extending your elbows into the handstand position.
Reverse the press and pull slowly to return to the inverted hang.
Keep the rings close and avoid swinging throughout the sequence.
description: From an inverted hang, the arms pull and then press the straight body upward toward a ring handstand before returning.

name: Stability-Ball Alternating Arm Reach with Legs Raised
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with your abdomen supported and hands on the floor, then extend both legs behind you and lift your feet clear.
Keep your legs raised and torso steady as you lift one arm forward in line with your body.
Lower that hand to the floor under control before lifting the opposite arm.
Reach with the other arm and continue alternating without rolling the ball.
description: The abdomen balances on a stability ball with both legs held behind the body while the arms alternate forward reaches. The shoulders move while the back, hips and abdomen steady the body.

name: Stability-Ball Back Extension with Arms By Sides
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and rest your abdomen and lower chest across it.
Extend your arms alongside your torso toward your hips.
Lift your chest away from the ball until your back forms a comfortable straight line.
Lower slowly while keeping your knees on the floor and neck aligned with your torso.
description: The torso lifts from a face-down ball-supported position while the arms remain beside the body, working the lower back.
aliases: Exercise Ball Back Extension with Arms Extended

name: Stability-Ball Back Extension with Hands behind Head
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with your abdomen supported, legs extended and toes on the floor.
Place your hands lightly behind your head without pulling on your neck.
Lift your chest away from the ball until your torso reaches a comfortable straight line.
Lower slowly while keeping your toes planted and knees off the floor.
description: The upper torso lifts from a ball-supported position with extended legs and hands lightly behind the head, working the lower back.
aliases: Exercise Ball Back Extension with Hands behind Head

name: Stability-Ball Back Extension with Knees Raised
instructions: Lie face down across a stability ball with your toes on the floor and knees off the ground.
Extend your arms beside your torso toward your hips.
Lift your chest to bring your torso into line with your legs without overextending your back.
Lower slowly over the ball while keeping your toes planted.
description: The toes support extended legs while the torso lifts from a stability ball to work the lower back and hip extensors.
aliases: Exercise Ball Back Extension with Knees Off Ground

name: Stability-Ball Back Extension with Rotation
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with your toes on the floor.
Keep both arms alongside your torso.
Lift your chest and turn your upper torso toward one side, keeping your hips supported.
Return slowly to face the floor and lower over the ball.
Complete the set and change sides.
description: A ball-supported back extension adds a turn through the upper torso to work the lower back and obliques.
aliases: Exercise Ball Back Extension with Rotation

name: Stability-Ball Dip
instructions: Sit in front of a stability ball and place both hands on it behind your hips.
Extend your legs forward with heels on the floor and lift your hips clear.
Bend the elbows to lower your hips while keeping the ball steady.
Press through your hands to straighten your elbows and rise again.
description: Hands on a stability ball support the body as the elbows bend and straighten to work the triceps.

name: Stability-Ball Supported Hip-Flexor Stretch
instructions: Sit astride a stability ball with one foot forward on the floor and the other leg extended behind you.
Keep the forward knee bent, rear toes supported, and torso upright.
Gently shift your pelvis forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the rear hip.
Hold without arching your lower back, then ease out.
Change legs and repeat.
description: The ball supports the pelvis in a long split stance while the rear hip opens into a hip-flexor stretch.

name: Seated Stability-Ball Hug Stretch
instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor with a stability ball in front of you.
Wrap your arms around the ball and rest your chest against it.
Hold the gentle forward stretch through your back while breathing normally.
Ease back to an upright seated position.
description: Sitting on the floor and folding gently around a stability ball stretches the back in a supported forward position.

name: Stability-Ball Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel beside a stability ball and place one hand on top, keeping your other hand on the floor.
Roll the ball forward as you extend the reaching arm and lower your chest.
Pause at a gentle stretch along the side of your back without twisting sharply.
Roll the ball back toward you under control.
Complete the movement and change sides.
description: One hand rolls a stability ball forward while the other hand and both knees support a stretch along the reaching side of the back.

name: Stability-Ball Prone Back Stretch
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with your abdomen supported.
Place your hands and feet on the floor to steady the ball.
Allow your upper body to drape gently over the front of the ball and hold within a comfortable range.
Ease back out of the stretch using your hands and feet.
description: The abdomen drapes over a stability ball while the hands and feet support a relaxed forward curve through the back.

name: Stability-Ball Side-Lying Lat Stretch
instructions: Rest the side of your waist and ribs across a stability ball with both feet supported on the floor.
Steady yourself with the lower arm and reach the upper arm overhead.
Hold a gentle stretch along your side without rolling forward or backward.
Ease out of the stretch and change sides.
description: The side of the torso rests over a stability ball while the upper arm reaches overhead to stretch the lats and side of the trunk.
aliases: Exercise Ball Lying Side Lat Stretch

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise with Chest-Supported Stability Ball
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a stability ball between your upper chest and the wall.
Hold a dumbbell at each side and lean gently into the ball.
Keep your knees nearly straight and raise both heels from the floor.
Lower slowly while keeping the ball in place.
description: A stability ball between the chest and wall supports the torso while both heels rise with dumbbells at the sides.
aliases: Exercise Ball on the Wall Calf Raise

name: Dumbbell Ball-Supported Calf Raise with Tennis Ball Between Ankles
instructions: Face a wall with a stability ball between your chest and the wall.
Hold a dumbbell at each side and place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Keep gentle inward pressure on the tennis ball as you raise both heels.
Lower slowly while keeping both balls in place.
description: Both heels rise while a tennis ball stays between the ankles and a stability ball supports the chest against a wall.
aliases: Exercise Ball on the Wall Calf Raise (Tennis Ball Between Ankles)

name: Dumbbell Ball-Supported Calf Raise with Tennis Ball Between Knees
instructions: Face a wall with a stability ball between your upper chest and the wall.
Hold a dumbbell at each side and place a tennis ball between your knees.
Maintain gentle inward knee pressure as you raise both heels from the floor.
Lower slowly without dropping either ball.
description: A tennis ball stays between the knees while both heels rise and a stability ball supports the chest against a wall.
aliases: Exercise Ball on the Wall Calf Raise (Tennis Ball Between Knees)

name: Stability-Ball Single-Leg Twisting Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands on the floor and one lower leg supported on a stability ball.
Bend the free knee and draw it forward beneath your torso.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest as the bent knee turns across your body and your pelvis rotates slightly.
Press back up and reverse the rotation to return to the starting position.
Complete the set and change the supported leg.
description: A push-up with one lower leg on a ball adds a turn of the pelvis and a bent-knee reach across the body.
aliases: Exercise Ball One Leg Prone Lower Body Rotation

name: Stability-Ball Single-Leg Hamstring Curl with Diagonal Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with arms on the floor and heels on a stability ball.
Raise your hips and transfer the ball support to one heel.
Bend the supporting knee to roll the ball toward you while lifting the free leg upward on a slight diagonal.
Extend the supporting knee to roll the ball away as the free leg lowers toward the start.
Keep your hips raised, then complete the set and change legs.
description: One leg curls the ball inward while the free leg lifts diagonally and the hips remain raised.
aliases: Exercise Ball One Legged Diagonal Kick Hamstring Curl

name: Stability-Ball Push-Up to Pike
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands on the floor and shins on a stability ball.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest, then press back to a high plank.
Keep your elbows extended and lift your hips, rolling the ball toward your hands to form an inverted V.
Lower your hips and roll the ball back to the starting plank.
Repeat the push-up and pike sequence under control.
description: A horizontal push-up is followed by a straight-arm pike with the lower legs supported on a stability ball.

name: Stability-Ball Push-Up with Bent-Knee Leg Lift
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with your abdomen and pelvis supported, palms on the floor and both legs extended behind you.
Keep your hands planted and bend your elbows to lower your chest as you lift your thighs slightly and bend both knees, bringing your feet upward.
Keep the movement controlled and the ball beneath your pelvis without forcing your lower back to arch.
Straighten your elbows as you lower and straighten the legs to return to the starting position.
description: With the abdomen supported on a stability ball, both elbows bend as the legs lift behind the body and the knees bend. The movement combines supported pushing with leg and hip control.

name: Stability-Ball Seated Single-Leg Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with one foot planted.
Extend the other leg forward with its heel on the floor and toes pointing up.
Lean gently forward from your hips toward the extended leg until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Hold the gentle stretch while keeping the ball steady, then return upright.
Change legs and repeat.
description: A seated forward lean toward one extended leg stretches the hamstrings while the ball supports the pelvis.

name: Stability-Ball Seated Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with both feet planted.
Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so the hand reaches behind your upper back.
Use the opposite hand to guide the raised elbow gently backward until you feel a triceps stretch.
Hold the gentle stretch, then release the pressure and lower the arm.
Change sides and repeat.
description: One hand guides the opposite elbow during an unweighted overhead triceps stretch while sitting on a stability ball.

name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension on Stability Ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with feet planted and hips raised. Keep your neck steady.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms raised and bend both elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Straighten the elbows to return the weights above you while keeping the ball steady.
description: Both elbows bend and straighten while the upper back rests on a ball and the hips stay raised.

name: Ez-Bar Seated Overhead Triceps Extension on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with both feet planted.
Hold the angled grips of an EZ bar securely and raise it overhead.
Keep your upper arms raised as you bend both elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your elbows to return the bar overhead without arching your back.
description: Seated on a stability ball, both elbows bend behind the head and extend to lift an EZ bar.
aliases: EZ Bar French Press on Exercise Ball

name: Ez-Bar Bent-Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold an EZ bar above your chest using its angled grips, keeping the elbows bent.
Move the upper arms backward to lower the bar behind your head without changing the elbow bend much.
Bring the bar back above your torso while keeping your back supported.
description: An EZ bar moves behind the head and returns above the torso while the elbows remain bent, working the chest and lats.
aliases: EZ Bar Lying Bent Arms Pullover

name: Ez-Bar Lying Close-Grip Triceps Extension behind Head
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted and your head near the end.
Hold the inner angled grips of an EZ bar securely above your upper chest.
Keep the upper arms raised as you bend the elbows to lower the bar just behind your head.
Straighten the elbows to return the bar above you.
Control the bar throughout and keep it clear of your face.
description: A close grip holds an EZ bar while the elbows bend to lower it behind the head and extend to lift it above the chest.
aliases: EZ Bar Lying Close Grip Triceps Extension behind Head

name: Ez-Bar Reverse-Grip Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand holding the angled grips of an EZ bar with palms facing forward.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back and lean forward while keeping your back steady.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs with your elbows near your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms extend without changing your torso angle.
description: A palm-forward grip and forward hip hinge allow the EZ bar to row toward the waist to train the back and biceps.
aliases: EZ Bar Reverse Grip Bent over Row

name: Ez-Bar Seated Close-Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with feet apart and lean forward.
Hold the inner angled grips of an EZ bar with palms up and brace both upper arms against your inner thighs.
Curl the bar upward while keeping the upper arms supported.
Lower slowly without lifting your elbows away from your thighs.
description: Both upper arms brace against the inner thighs while a close grip curls an EZ bar to train the biceps.
aliases: EZ Bar Seated Close Grip Concentration Curl

name: Ez-Bar Standing Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand upright holding the angled grips of an EZ bar securely.
Raise the bar overhead and keep the upper arms raised.
Bend both elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten the elbows to return the bar overhead without leaning backward.
description: Both elbows bend behind the head and straighten overhead while standing to train the triceps.

name: Ez-Bar Chest-Supported Anti-Gravity Press
instructions: Rest your chest against an incline bench with your feet planted.
Hold an EZ bar near your shoulders using the angled grips.
Press the bar forward and upward in line with your torso, extending the elbows.
Bend your elbows to bring it back toward shoulder level without lifting your chest.
description: An incline bench supports the chest while the arms press an EZ bar forward in line with the torso.

name: Ez-Bar Seated Close-Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold the inner angled grips of the EZ bar with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without lifting your upper arms.
Lower slowly without forcing your elbows straight.
description: A close grip and preacher pad support a two-arm curl for the biceps and forearms.
aliases: EZ Barbell Close Grip Preacher Curl

name: Ez-Bar Close-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding the inner angled grips of an EZ bar with palms up.
Keep the upper arms beside your torso and curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly without leaning backward.
Lower slowly until the elbows are extended.
description: The inner angled grips bring the hands close together during a standing biceps curl.

name: Ez-Bar Standing Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding the angled grips of an EZ bar with palms up.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso and curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly without swinging your body.
Lower slowly until the elbows are extended.
description: Both elbows bend to lift an EZ bar while the upper arms stay beside the torso, training the biceps.

name: Ez-Bar Decline Close-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie with your head at the lower end.
Hold the inner angled grips of the EZ bar above your upper chest.
Keep the upper arms raised and bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, stopping clear of your face.
Straighten the elbows to raise the bar again.
description: A decline bench supports the body while a close grip controls the bar near the forehead during elbow extensions.
aliases: EZ Barbell Decline Close Grip Face Press

name: Ez-Bar Decline Triceps Extension
instructions: Secure your legs in a decline bench and lie back with your head lower than your feet.
Hold the angled grips of an EZ bar securely above your upper chest.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead while keeping the upper arms raised.
Straighten your elbows to return the bar above you, keeping it clear of your face.
description: Both elbows extend an EZ bar while the body lies on a decline bench with the legs secured.

name: Ez-Bar Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with feet planted.
Hold the angled grips of an EZ bar and raise it above your shoulders.
Keep the upper arms raised as you bend the elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten the elbows to return the bar above you without arching your back.
description: The torso reclines on an incline bench while an EZ bar lowers behind the head and rises through elbow extension.

name: Ez-Bar Jm Press with Feet on Bench
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with knees bent and feet supported on the bench.
Hold the inner angled grips of an EZ bar above your upper chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward the space above your chin, keeping the elbows elevated rather than dropping them beside your ribs.
Stop before the bar touches your face or neck, then extend the elbows to press upward.
Use a light, controlled load while learning the short path.
description: A short press and elbow-extension path lowers the EZ bar toward the chin and returns it above the chest to train the triceps.

name: Ez-Bar Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar in front of your thighs with palms toward your body.
Keep your upper arms beside your torso and curl the bar toward your shoulders, palms downward as the forearms rise.
Stop without leaning backward.
Lower slowly until the elbows are nearly straight.
description: A palms-down grip works the elbow flexors and forearms during a standing curl.

name: Ez-Bar Seated Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms on the pad.
Hold the angled grips of an EZ bar with palms facing down.
Curl the bar upward without lifting your upper arms.
Lower slowly without forcing your elbows straight.
description: Both upper arms rest on a preacher pad during a palms-down EZ-bar curl for the elbow flexors and forearms.
aliases: EZ Barbell Reverse Grip Preacher Curl

name: Ez-Bar Seated Curl
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold the EZ bar with palms up and elbows beside your torso, clear of your thighs.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping the upper arms still.
Lower slowly without leaning or resting your elbows on your legs.
description: An upright seated curl raises an EZ bar while the upper arms remain free beside the torso.

name: Ez-Bar Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold the EZ bar securely by its angled grips and raise it overhead.
Keep the upper arms raised as you bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten the elbows to lift the bar again without leaning backward.
description: Both elbows bend behind the head and extend overhead while the body sits upright on a flat bench.

name: Ez-Bar Standing Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind a preacher bench with both upper arms resting on its pad.
Hold the angled grips of the EZ bar with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without lifting the upper arms.
Lower slowly without forcing the elbows straight.
description: Standing behind a preacher pad supports both upper arms during a palm-up EZ-bar curl.

name: Ez-Bar Chest-Supported Spider Curl
instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench with feet planted.
Hold the EZ bar below your shoulders using a palms-up grip.
Keep your upper arms hanging still as you curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly without lifting your chest from the pad.
description: An incline bench supports the chest while the hanging arms curl an EZ bar to train the biceps.

name: Ez-Bar Curl with Arm Blaster
instructions: Fit the arm blaster against your torso with the strap over your neck and pads behind your upper arms.
Hold the angled grips of the EZ bar with palms up.
Keep your upper arms against the support and curl the bar upward.
Lower slowly until your elbows are extended without leaning backward.
description: An arm blaster supports both upper arms while the elbows curl an EZ bar.

name: Ez-Bar Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with feet planted.
Hold the inner angled grips of an EZ bar above your chest.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your chest, keeping the upper arms relatively close to your torso.
Press the bar upward until the arms are extended.
Lower with control without bouncing it on your chest.
description: A close-grip press lowers an EZ bar to the chest and presses it upward, working the triceps, chest and shoulders.

name: Ez-Bar Wide-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding the outer angled grips of an EZ bar with palms up.
Keep the upper arms beside your torso as you curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly without swinging.
Lower slowly until the elbows are extended.
description: The wider angled grips are used during a standing curl for the biceps and forearms.
aliases: Ez-Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl

name: Dumbbell Farmer Carry
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing inward.
Keep the weights beside you and walk forward with controlled steps.
Maintain a steady torso without letting the weights swing.
Stop walking, then bend your hips and knees to set the weights down under control.
description: Walking with a dumbbell at each side trains grip and whole-body load control while the legs alternate steps.

name: Barbell Seated Finger Curl
instructions: Sit astride the end of a flat bench with your forearms resting on the pad between your thighs and palms facing up.
Hold a barbell with your hands extending beyond the end of the pad.
Open your fingers slightly to let the bar roll toward them while maintaining control.
Close your fingers to draw the bar back into your palms without lifting your forearms.
description: The fingers open slightly to let the bar roll outward, then close to draw it back into the palms while the forearms stay supported.

name: Human Flag Hold
instructions: Grip a securely fixed vertical pole with one hand high and the other low, both arms extended.
Push through the lower arm and pull through the upper arm as you raise your legs and torso sideways.
Hold your body in a straight horizontal line with legs together and hips steady.
Lower your feet under control before releasing the pole.
Change sides between sets.
description: A vertical pole supports a sideways horizontal body hold using opposing arm forces and trunk stability.

name: Single-Leg Bent-Knee Tuck Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot planted, the other leg extended, and arms overhead.
Curl your torso upward as you bend and raise the extended leg toward your chest.
Reach both arms forward toward the raised knee without pulling your neck.
Lower your torso and extend the working leg under control.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: One knee draws inward as the torso curls up and the arms reach forward, while the other foot remains planted.

name: Single-Leg Straight-Leg V-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot planted, the other leg straight, and arms overhead.
Raise the straight leg as you curl your torso upward.
Reach both hands toward the raised foot without forcing contact.
Lower your torso and straight leg under control.
Complete the set and change legs.
description: One straight leg and the torso rise toward each other while both hands reach toward the raised foot and the other foot stays planted.

name: Rolling-Barbell Push-Up
instructions: Place two barbells with round plates parallel on the floor, one beneath each hand, with clear space to roll outward.
Grip their shafts and extend your legs into a high plank with toes on the floor.
Bend your elbows and roll the barbells apart as you lower your chest between them.
Press through the bars to straighten your elbows and roll them back beneath your shoulders.
Use only a range you can reverse without losing your body line.
description: Two separate barbells roll apart as the elbows bend and the chest lowers between them. Pressing back up brings the barbells inward while the trunk stays steady.

name: Prone Flutter Kicks on Bench
instructions: Lie face down along a flat bench with your hips near its end and hold the bench for support.
Extend both legs behind you with your knees nearly straight.
Lift one leg slightly as the other lowers, keeping your pelvis on the bench.
Continue alternating small, controlled kicks without arching your lower back.
description: Alternating straight-leg kicks from a face-down bench position work the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Standing Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and clear space ahead.
Bend your hips and knees while swinging your arms behind you.
Swing your arms forward and drive through both feet to jump forward.
Land on both feet with your knees and hips bent to absorb the landing.
Regain your balance before the next jump.
description: A forward jump uses a coordinated arm swing and leg drive to work the quadriceps, glutes and calves.

name: Bodyweight Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand upright with your hands on your hips.
Step forward with one foot and bend both knees to lower your body.
Keep your front foot planted and your front knee tracking with your toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg and continue alternating.
description: Alternating forward lunges train the quadriceps and glutes as each leg takes a turn leading.

name: Barbell Frankenstein Squat
instructions: Position a barbell across the front of your shoulders and raise both arms straight forward to help keep it in place.
Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and keep your chest lifted.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat while maintaining the shoulder shelf under the bar.
Push through your feet to stand, keeping your arms raised and the bar balanced.
Reset your balance before the next repetition.
description: The barbell rests across the front of the shoulders while straight arms reach forward during this front squat.

name: Frog Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees opened outward.
Place your hands lightly beside your head without pulling on your neck.
Curl your shoulders off the floor while lifting your feet and drawing your bent legs toward your torso.
Keep the feet together as the chest and knees move closer.
Lower your upper body and legs with control.
description: This crunch brings the upper body and bent legs toward each other with the feet together and knees apart.

name: Frog Stand
instructions: Crouch and place your palms flat on the floor about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and rest your knees against your upper arms.
Shift forward gradually until both feet lift, keeping the knees tucked beside your torso.
Hold the balance with your head clear of the floor.
Shift back and return your feet to the floor with control.
description: A tucked hand balance supports the body with bent arms while the knees rest against the upper arms.

name: Front Lever Hold
instructions: Grip a secure bar with palms facing away and arms straight.
Raise your legs and torso together into a horizontal, face-up position beneath the bar.
Keep your legs together and your body straight without bending your elbows.
Hold the position while maintaining steady shoulder and abdominal tension.
Lower out of the hold under control.
description: The front lever holds the body straight and horizontal below a bar, using the lats and abdominal muscles to resist dropping.

name: Front Lever Pull-Up
instructions: Grip a secure bar with palms facing away and establish a straight-body front lever beneath it.
Keep your legs together and your torso horizontal.
Bend your elbows to pull your chest toward the bar without letting your hips drop.
Extend your arms slowly to lower while maintaining the horizontal body line.
Lower your legs with control when the set is complete.
description: Pull-ups from a horizontal front lever position work the back and arms while the body stays straight and unsupported.

name: Forearm Plank with Side Rotation
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your elbows beneath your shoulders and body straight.
Shift onto one forearm and rotate your chest to the side, turning your feet with your body.
Reach the free arm upward while keeping your hips lifted.
Return that forearm to the floor with control.
Complete the repetitions on this side, then change sides.
description: Rotating from a forearm plank into a side plank trains the abdominals and obliques while the shoulders support the body.

name: Floor Maltese Hold
instructions: Place your hands widely beside your body with fingers angled outward.
Lean forward onto your hands and extend your legs together behind you.
Support your body clear of the floor with straight arms and a straight line from shoulders to feet.
Hold without allowing your hips to sag or your elbows to buckle.
Lower your feet to the floor under control.
description: This wide-arm floor balance holds the entire body horizontal on the hands, placing high demands on the chest, shoulders and trunk.

name: Full Planche Hold
instructions: Place your palms on the floor and extend your arms.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands while tightening your abdomen and glutes.
Lift your feet and hold your legs together so your body forms a straight horizontal line.
Keep your arms straight and press firmly through the floor during the hold.
Lower your feet with control.
description: The full planche balances a straight, horizontal body on the hands with both feet clear of the floor.

name: Full Planche Push-Up
instructions: Establish a full planche on your hands with arms straight, feet raised and body horizontal.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest while keeping your legs together and off the floor.
Keep your hips aligned with your torso as your chest approaches the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the high planche.
Lower your feet under control when finished.
description: A push-up performed with the feet suspended throughout trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while demanding full-body control.

name: Overhand Sternum Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with palms facing away and hands a little wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your legs together and begin pulling your elbows downward.
Lift your chest toward the bar while leaning back slightly.
Lower with control until your arms are extended.
Avoid kicking your legs to gain height.
description: This pull-up raises the upper chest toward the bar with a slight backward lean, training the lats and upper back.

name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet planted and arms at your sides.
Press through your feet to lift your hips into a bridge.
Keep your hips raised as you lift one foot and draw that knee toward your torso.
Put the foot down gently and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating without letting your pelvis drop or rotate.
description: Marching from a raised bridge works the glutes while each leg lifts in turn and the pelvis stays level.

name: Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back in front of a bench and place both heels on its top with knees bent.
Keep your upper back and arms on the floor.
Press your heels into the bench to lift your hips until your torso and thighs align.
Pause without arching your lower back.
Lower your hips toward the floor with control.
description: A bridge with the heels on a bench raises the hips while the upper back stays on the floor, working the glutes and hamstrings.
aliases: Glute Bridge Two Legs on Bench (Male)

name: Bench Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on the padded bench with your lower legs supported and ankles secured between the rollers.
Begin upright with knees bent and hands crossed at your chest.
Slowly straighten your knees to lower your torso and thighs together through a controlled range.
Bend your knees to draw yourself back upright, keeping your hips aligned with your shoulders.
Maintain a controlled pace without folding at the waist.
description: With the knees on a padded bench and ankles secured by rollers, the body lowers and rises around the knees to work the hamstrings.

name: Chin-Up with Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing toward you and knees slightly bent.
Pull upward by bending your elbows while drawing your knees toward your chest.
Bring your chin toward bar height as your knees rise.
Lower your torso and legs together with control.
Return to the hanging position without swinging into the next repetition.
description: This combination raises the knees toward the chest during a chin-up, working the abdominals, lats and biceps.

name: Butterfly Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open to the sides.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor without moving your feet.
Lower slowly until your upper back rests on the floor again.
description: A crunch with the soles together and knees open works the abdominals while the legs remain on the floor.

name: Hack Squat Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Set up against the hack squat machine pads and hold its handles.
Place the balls of both feet securely on the platform with your heels free to move.
Keep your knees nearly straight and raise your heels to push the sled upward.
Lower your heels slowly through a comfortable range.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.
description: A calf raise on a hack squat machine moves the loaded sled by rising onto the balls of both feet.

name: Single-Leg Hack Squat Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Position your back and shoulders against the hack squat machine pads and hold the handles.
Place the ball of one foot on the platform and lift the other foot clear.
Keep the working knee nearly straight and raise your heel to move the sled.
Lower the heel slowly while maintaining stable contact with the platform.
Finish the set and change legs.
description: One foot supports the load during this hack-machine calf raise, emphasizing one calf at a time.

name: Standing Alternating Knee March
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Lift one knee forward while moving the opposite arm forward.
Lower that foot and lift the other knee.
Continue alternating at a steady rhythm without leaning backward.
description: An upright march alternates knee lifts with opposing arm movement for a simple bodyweight cardio drill.

name: Straight-Leg Sit-Up with Arms By Sides
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight and together, heels on the floor.
Keep your arms beside your body.
Raise your torso to an upright sitting position while keeping your heels down and your arms beside your thighs.
Lower your back slowly to the floor without throwing your arms.
description: A straight-leg sit-up raises the torso to an upright sitting position while the arms remain beside the body.

name: Lying Active Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Raise one thigh and support its back with both hands, allowing the knee to bend.
Keep the thigh steady and slowly straighten the knee until you feel a gentle stretch behind the leg.
Bend the knee again under control and repeat the straightening movement.
Keep the other leg on the floor, then change sides.
description: The hands support one raised thigh while the knee bends and straightens, moving the hamstrings through a gentle stretch.

name: Seated Upper-Body Ergometer
instructions: Adjust the seat so you can reach the handles comfortably with a small bend in your elbows.
Sit upright with both feet on the machine foot platform.
Hold the handles and begin turning the cranks in a smooth circular motion.
Keep your torso steady as the arms alternate around the circle.
Slow the cranks before stopping.
description: Turning an arm-crank ergometer provides upper-body cardio exercise using the shoulders and arms.

name: Clasped-Hands Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet apart, hands clasped and arms extended overhead.
Bend forward and sweep your hands downward toward your toes.
Continue the circle across the front of your legs and upward to one side as your torso rises.
Return your arms overhead, then circle in the other direction.
Use a smooth, comfortable range without forcing the reach.
description: A standing arm and torso circle moves from an overhead reach down toward the toes and back up, mobilizing the trunk and shoulders.

name: Palms-Out Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and interlace your fingers, turning your palms away from your body.
Raise your joined hands overhead.
Bend forward and circle your hands down toward your toes, keeping the knees softly bent.
Sweep the arms across and upward as your torso returns upright.
Repeat in the opposite direction with a controlled, comfortable reach.
description: Clasping the hands with palms turned outward adds an arm reach to this continuous standing trunk circle.
aliases: Hands Reversed Clasped Circular Toe Touch (Male)

name: Freestanding Handstand
instructions: Begin standing with one foot forward and both arms overhead.
Lean forward and place your palms on the floor about shoulder-width apart.
Kick the rear leg upward and bring the other leg up to meet it, controlling the rise into balance.
Press firmly through your hands and keep your legs together above your hips and shoulders.
Hold briefly, then lower one leg at a time with control.
description: A freestanding handstand balances the inverted body on straight arms, using the shoulders, triceps and trunk.

name: Freestanding Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Establish a freestanding handstand with hands about shoulder-width apart and legs together.
Keep your abdomen tight and slowly bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor.
Stop before placing weight on your head.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms while maintaining balance.
Return your feet to the floor under control when finished.
description: This inverted press lowers and raises the body while balancing on the hands, emphasizing the shoulders and triceps.

name: Hanging Knee Raise with Pelvic Curl
instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing away and arms extended.
Bend your knees and raise them toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis upward slightly at the top rather than only lifting your thighs.
Lower your pelvis and legs slowly until you return to a steady hang.
description: Bent knees rise toward the chest with a pelvic curl at the top, training the abdominals and hip flexors.

name: Hanging Bent-Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with palms facing away and arms extended.
Bend your knees and lift them forward until your thighs are around horizontal.
Keep your torso steady without kicking or swinging.
Lower your legs slowly to the hanging position.
description: The hip flexors lift the bent knees to hip height while the abdominals steady the pelvis and the arms support the body from a bar.

name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms extended and palms facing away.
Bend your knees and lift them toward one side of your chest, turning your pelvis slightly.
Lower with control to a steady hang.
Raise your knees toward the other side.
Continue alternating without swinging.
description: Alternating diagonal knee raises combine hip flexion and a small pelvic rotation to work the abs and obliques.

name: Hanging Straight-Leg Pike Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing away and arms extended.
Keep your legs together and knees nearly straight.
Raise your legs toward the bar, curling your pelvis as your feet approach your hands.
Lower your legs slowly to a steady hang.
Avoid swinging to start the next repetition.
description: Straight legs rise high toward the bar in this demanding abdominal and hip-flexor exercise.

name: Hanging Straight-Leg Raise with High Pelvic Curl
instructions: Hang from a secure overhead bar with arms extended and legs together.
Lift your nearly straight legs forward and continue upward toward the bar.
Curl your hips upward at the top while keeping your grip secure.
Lower your pelvis and legs slowly without dropping into a swing.
description: The straight legs rise toward the bar and the pelvis curls upward while the hands support the body from overhead, working the abs and hip flexors.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with palms facing away and arms extended.
Hold your legs together with knees nearly straight.
Raise your legs forward until they are around parallel to the floor.
Lower slowly while keeping your torso from swinging.
description: Straight legs rise to hip height while hanging, training the hip flexors and abdominal control.

name: Hanging Windshield Wiper with Bent Arms
instructions: Grip a secure overhead bar with palms facing away, bend your elbows and hold your torso high.
Raise your nearly straight legs in front of you, curling your pelvis upward.
Keep your elbows bent as you turn your pelvis to guide the raised legs toward one side.
Bring the legs through the center and toward the other side without swinging or losing your grip.
Return to center, lower your legs and extend your arms under control when finished.
description: From a bent-arm hang, the raised legs move from side to side as the pelvis rotates, working the obliques while the arms maintain the hold.
aliases: Hanging Straight Twisting Leg Hip Raise

name: Wall-Supported High Knees
instructions: Face a wall and place your hands on it at shoulder height.
Step your feet back slightly and maintain a straight line through your torso.
Drive one knee forward while the other foot supports you.
Switch legs rhythmically, returning each foot to the floor beneath you.
Keep pressure through your hands and avoid sagging through your lower back.
description: Alternating knee drives against a wall support create a running-in-place cardio drill.

name: Bent-Knee Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms beside you, palms down.
Lift your feet and draw your knees toward your torso.
Use your abdominals to curl your hips a short distance off the floor.
Lower your pelvis first, then bring your legs back toward the starting position.
Keep the movement smooth instead of swinging your legs.
description: The reverse crunch curls the pelvis off the floor with the knees bent, emphasizing abdominal flexion.

name: Lying Double-Knee-To-Chest Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring your knees toward your chest and hold around your shins.
Gently draw the knees closer while keeping your shoulders relaxed.
Hold comfortably without bouncing.
Release your grip and return your feet to the floor.
description: Drawing both knees toward the chest gently stretches the glutes and lower back from a lying position.

name: Incline Low-To-High Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Sit back against a steep incline bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms extend down and slightly outward beside the bench, palms angled forward.
Keep a soft elbow bend and raise the weights forward and inward in a wide arc.
Bring the dumbbells close together above your upper chest and face without striking them.
Lower along the same path with control.
description: A low-to-high arm arc on an incline bench works the chest and front shoulders while the elbows stay slightly bent.

name: 45-Degree Back Extension
instructions: Adjust the angled back-extension bench so your thighs are supported and your feet are secured.
Cross your hands at your chest and begin with torso aligned with your legs.
Bend at your hips to lower your upper body toward the floor.
Raise your torso until it returns in line with your legs.
Avoid leaning backward past that line.
description: Supported hip and trunk extension raises the upper body against gravity, working the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

name: Flat-Bench Back Extension
instructions: Lie face down along a stable flat bench with your hips and lower abdomen supported and your chest extending beyond the end.
Rest your legs on the bench and place your hands lightly beside your head without pulling on your neck.
Lower your chest toward the floor through a comfortable range while keeping your lower body on the bench.
Lift your chest until your torso is aligned with your legs.
Lower again under control without arching beyond the body line.
description: With the lower abdomen and legs supported on a flat bench, lower and raise the chest beyond the bench edge. The lower back muscles control the trunk extension.

name: Parallel-Bar Impossible Dip
instructions: Support yourself above parallel bars with straight arms and legs together.
Keep your legs straight and slightly forward as you bend your elbows.
Lean your torso backward while the elbows travel down and behind your hands, lowering toward the bars.
Press through your hands to extend the elbows and bring the torso upright again.
Keep your feet clear of the floor throughout.
description: This advanced dip lowers with the torso leaning backward and the legs extended forward, placing a strong demand on the triceps.

name: Inchworm with Push-Up
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart, bend forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until your body is straight in a high plank.
Bend your elbows to perform a controlled push-up, then press back up.
Walk your hands toward your feet, allowing your hips to rise.
Stand upright to finish the repetition.
description: Walking the hands out from standing into a push-up combines hamstring mobility with chest, shoulder and abdominal work.

name: Traveling Inchworm
instructions: Bend forward from standing and place both hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until you reach a high plank.
Keep your hands planted and take small steps with your feet toward your hands, lifting your hips.
Walk your hands forward again to the next plank.
Continue traveling with controlled steps and soft knees as needed.
description: Alternating hand and foot walks move between a plank and a folded standing position, combining trunk control with hamstring mobility.

name: Incline Close-Grip Push-Up on Bar
instructions: Hold a secure waist-height bar with hands close together beneath your chest.
Walk your feet back so your body forms a straight inclined line.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to lower your chest toward the bar.
Press through your hands to straighten your arms.
Keep your hips aligned with your torso.
description: A narrow hand placement on an elevated bar emphasizes the triceps during an inclined push-up.

name: Incline Straight-Leg Raise with Hip Lift
instructions: Lie on your back on an incline bench with your head at the high end.
Hold the support behind your head and extend your legs down the bench.
Raise both legs together, keeping your knees nearly straight.
Curl your pelvis off the bench as your feet rise above your hips.
Lower your hips and then your legs slowly without pulling against your neck.
description: Straight legs rise and the pelvis curls from an incline bench, working the abdominals and hip flexors.

name: Feet-Elevated Depth Push-Up to Platforms
instructions: Place your feet on a stable bench and your hands on the floor between two low platforms, one on each side.
Keep your body straight and lower your chest by bending your elbows.
Push forcefully enough to lift both hands and place them on the platforms.
Bend your elbows to absorb the landing, then straighten your arms.
Push off the platforms to return your hands to the floor with controlled elbow bend.
Keep your feet on the bench throughout.
description: This plyometric push-up drives the hands from the floor onto two raised platforms while the feet remain supported on a bench.

name: Incline Push-Up on Low Step
instructions: Place your hands on a stable low step slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Extend your legs behind you and form a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the step.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your hips from dropping or lifting ahead of your chest.
description: A push-up with the hands on a low step trains the chest, triceps and shoulders with the upper body slightly elevated.

name: Incline Push-Up on Box
instructions: Place your hands on a stable box slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Step your feet back and hold your body in a straight inclined line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the box.
Press through your hands until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips aligned with your chest throughout.
description: An elevated hand position on a box trains the chest, shoulders and triceps through a controlled push-up.

name: Incline Underhand Push-Up on Bar
instructions: Grip a securely fixed bar with your palms facing upward and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Step your feet back and hold a straight line through your body.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to bring your chest toward the bar.
Push away from the bar until your arms straighten.
Keep your wrists aligned comfortably with your forearms.
description: An underhand bar grip changes the arm position during this inclined push-up for the chest and triceps.

name: Incline Scapular Push-Up on Bench
instructions: Place your palms on a flat bench and step your feet back into an inclined plank.
Keep your elbows straight and abdomen gently tightened.
Allow your chest to sink a short distance as your shoulder blades move toward each other.
Press the bench away to spread your shoulder blades and raise your chest.
Keep the motion small without bending your elbows.
description: With the elbows held straight, the shoulder blades move together and apart to train the serratus anterior.

name: Decline Twisting Sit-Up
instructions: Secure your feet at the high end of a decline bench and lie back.
Place your hands lightly beside your head without pulling on your neck.
Curl your torso upward and turn one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Return to center as you lower your back with control.
Repeat with the turn toward the other side.
description: A sit-up on a decline bench adds alternating torso rotation to train the abs and obliques.

name: Prone Quadriceps Stretch with Strap
instructions: Loop a strap around one foot and lie face down.
Bend that knee and bring the strap over your shoulder, holding its ends with both hands.
Gently pull to draw your heel toward your buttock.
Keep your pelvis resting on the floor and stop at a comfortable stretch.
Release slowly and change legs.
description: A strap draws the heel toward the hips while lying face down, stretching the front of one thigh.
aliases: Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch

name: Bench-Anchored Inverse Leg Curl
instructions: Kneel on the padded bench with your lower legs held securely under a fixed restraint.
Lean your torso forward from the hips and keep your hands resting on your thighs.
Keep that forward bend at your hips steady as your knees slowly straighten and your body moves down beyond the bench.
Bend your knees to draw your body back toward the starting position.
Keep the movement controlled and stay within the range you can reverse.
description: With the lower legs secured and knees supported, the torso lowers forward around the knees to train the hamstrings.

name: Hand-Assisted Nordic Curl on Pulldown Seat
instructions: Face away from a pulldown machine, kneeling on its seat with your ankles firmly held under the thigh pad.
Place a stable step in front of the seat within reach of your hands.
Keep your shoulders, hips and knees aligned as you slowly lower forward by straightening your knees.
Place your hands on the step to catch and control the bottom position.
Use a light hand push and your hamstrings to return upright.
description: The pulldown seat and pad anchor the legs during a Nordic curl, with the hands catching on a step to assist the return.
aliases: Inverse Leg Curl (On Pull-Up Cable Machine)

name: Straight-Leg Inverted Row
instructions: Lie beneath a securely fixed bar and grip it with palms facing away, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Extend your legs and rest your heels on the floor.
Keep your body straight as you pull your chest toward the bar.
Draw your shoulder blades together without jutting your head forward.
Straighten your arms slowly to lower.
description: Pulling the chest toward a low fixed bar trains the upper back and arms while the heels support a straight body.

name: Bent-Knee Inverted Row
instructions: Lie beneath a secure low bar and grip it with palms facing away.
Bend your knees and plant both feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your shoulders, hips and knees remain aligned.
Bend your elbows to pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips raised.
description: Bent knees bring the feet closer to the body during a bar row, reducing the leverage compared with the straight-leg version.

name: Feet-Elevated Inverted Row
instructions: Position a flat bench in front of a securely fixed low bar.
Lie beneath the bar, grip it with palms facing away and place your heels on the bench.
Keep your legs and torso straight as you pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause with your shoulder blades drawn together.
Lower under control until your arms extend.
description: Elevating the heels on a bench increases the demand of a horizontal bodyweight row from a fixed bar.

name: Inverted Tucked Hanging Row
instructions: Grip a secure overhead bar and raise your knees toward your chest.
Rotate into an inverted tuck with your hips above your shoulders and bent legs near the bar.
Keep the tucked shape as you bend your elbows to pull your torso closer to your hands.
Straighten your arms slowly without dropping your hips.
Return from the inverted position under control when finished.
description: This inverted row bends and straightens the elbows while the hips remain above the shoulders and the knees stay tucked.

name: Suspension Inverted Row
instructions: Secure the suspension straps overhead and hold one handle in each hand with palms facing inward.
Walk your feet forward and lean back with heels on the floor and arms extended.
Keep your body straight while pulling your chest toward the handles.
Let your elbows travel beside your torso and draw the shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly to lower.
description: A bodyweight row using suspended handles trains the upper back and arms while the torso stays aligned.

name: Lying Cross-Body Knee Lift
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended out to the sides and both legs straight.
Bend and lift one knee, guiding it across toward the opposite side of your body.
Allow a small turn of your pelvis while keeping both shoulders near the floor.
Reverse the movement and lower the leg back to its extended starting position.
Complete the repetitions, then change sides using a comfortable range.
description: One knee bends and lifts across the body while the opposite leg stays extended, mobilizing the hip and trunk.

name: Standing Palm-Press Chest Squeeze
instructions: Stand upright and bring your palms together in front of your chest with elbows bent.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and press your palms firmly against each other.
Hold the pressure while breathing normally.
Release gradually, then repeat.
description: Pressing the palms together in front of the chest creates a self-resisted isometric chest contraction.

name: Low Push-Up Side-To-Side Shift
instructions: Start in a wide-hand push-up position with legs extended and feet on the floor.
Bend your elbows to hold your chest low between your hands.
Shift your torso toward one hand while allowing the other arm to extend more.
Move across toward the opposite hand without raising your hips.
Continue controlled side-to-side shifts, then press up to finish.
description: Moving the chest from side to side in a low push-up position loads each arm in turn and works the chest and triceps.

name: Burpee with Plank Jack
instructions: From standing, squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump both feet back into a high plank with straight arms.
Jump your feet apart and back together while keeping your hips steady.
Jump your feet forward beneath your torso.
Rise into a vertical jump, reaching your arms overhead.
Land with bent knees and reset for the next repetition.
description: A burpee combines a plank jack and vertical jump for a continuous full-body cardio sequence.

name: Straddle Toe-Touch Jump
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides.
Bend your hips and knees to prepare, then drive upward into a jump.
While airborne, lift and spread your legs outward and reach your hands toward your feet.
Bring your legs back underneath you before landing.
Land on both feet with bent knees and regain your balance.
description: A high jump opens the legs into a wide straddle as the hands reach toward the feet.

name: Jackknife Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms reaching overhead.
Raise your torso and legs together while reaching your hands toward your feet.
Balance briefly on your hips without jerking your neck forward.
Lower your upper body and legs with control.
description: The torso and straight legs rise together into a V shape, working the abdominals and hip flexors.

name: Arms-Crossed Bent-Knee Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso upward toward your knees without throwing your arms.
Lower your back slowly to the floor.
description: A sit-up with arms crossed over the chest raises the torso while the feet remain planted.

name: Two-Foot Jump Rope
instructions: Hold one rope handle in each hand with elbows near your sides and feet close together.
Turn the rope forward using small wrist circles.
Jump just high enough for the rope to pass beneath both feet.
Land softly with knees slightly bent and keep the rope moving.
Continue at a steady rhythm, then slow down to stop.
description: Small repeated jumps clear a rotating rope for a continuous cardio exercise.

name: Squat Jump with Downward Arm Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hands in front of your chest.
Bend your knees and hips into a squat.
Drive through both feet to jump upward while sweeping your arms down beside you.
Land on both feet with knees and hips bent.
Regain control before repeating.
description: Jumping upward from a squat trains the quadriceps, glutes and calves while the arms sweep down beside the body.

name: Squat Jump with Upward Arm Swing
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and let your hands reach between your legs.
Push through both feet and swing your arms upward in front of you as you jump.
Land with bent knees and hips, bringing the arms down as you lower.
Keep each landing controlled before the next jump.
description: An upward arm swing accompanies a vertical squat jump to train lower-body power.

name: Kettlebell Windmill with Hand behind Back
instructions: Stand with feet apart and hold a kettlebell overhead in one straight arm.
Turn your feet slightly away from the raised arm and place the free hand behind your lower back.
Shift your hips back and toward the loaded side as your torso inclines toward the opposite leg.
Keep the kettlebell above your shoulder and look toward it throughout the descent.
Return upright through your hips while keeping the raised arm steady.
Complete the set before changing sides.
description: An overhead kettlebell stays above the shoulder while the hips move back and the torso bends and turns, training trunk and shoulder control.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Curl to Shoulder
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your torso and legs steady as you bend one elbow to bring the kettlebell toward that shoulder.
Turn your hand smoothly through the handle so the bell rests against your forearm without striking it.
Lower the kettlebell under control while the other arm stays down.
Finish the repetitions, then repeat with the other arm.
description: One kettlebell curls from thigh level to the shoulder while the other stays lowered, working the biceps and forearms.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Overhead Press with Opposite-Arm Hold
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell held at each shoulder and elbows below the handles.
Press one kettlebell overhead until that arm is straight while holding the other at your shoulder.
Lower the working kettlebell under control to the shoulder.
Complete the repetitions with that arm, then change arms.
Keep your legs still and torso upright.
description: One arm presses a kettlebell overhead while the opposite arm holds a second kettlebell at the shoulder throughout the set.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press with Opposite-Arm Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and a kettlebell in each hand.
Hold the weights above your chest with arms extended.
Bend one elbow to lower that upper arm gently toward the floor while the other arm stays raised.
Press the working kettlebell back up until both arms are straight, without bouncing your elbow on the floor.
Complete the set with the same arm, then switch arms.
description: One arm presses a kettlebell from the floor while the opposite arm holds another kettlebell above the chest. The chest and triceps move the working arm while both legs remain extended.
aliases: Alternating Kettlebell Floor Press with Legs Extended

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Renegade Row
instructions: Place two stable kettlebells on the floor and grip the handles in a high plank.
Set your feet wide enough to keep your hips steady.
Pull one kettlebell toward your lower ribs with the elbow close to your side.
Return it firmly to the floor under control.
Keep your chest and pelvis facing the floor, finish the repetitions and change arms.
description: Row one kettlebell from a supported plank while the other hand stays planted on its handle. The upper back pulls the weight while the trunk resists rotation.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Row with Opposite-Arm Hold
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand, bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips.
Keep your back steady and let the weights hang below your shoulders.
Pull one kettlebell toward your ribs, keeping its elbow close to your torso and the opposite arm extended.
Lower the working kettlebell under control without rocking your torso.
Complete the repetitions with that arm, then switch sides.
description: Row one kettlebell toward the ribs while the other arm holds its weight down. The upper back and lats pull the weight while the hips hold a steady forward lean.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Arnold Press
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell at one shoulder with your palm toward your face.
Press upward while moving the elbow outward and turning your palm forward.
Extend your arm overhead without leaning backward.
Lower with control, reversing the rotation toward the starting grip.
Complete the set, then change arms.
description: An outward arm rotation accompanies a one-arm overhead press to train the shoulder and triceps.

name: Kettlebell Bent Press
instructions: Stand with feet apart and a kettlebell held at one shoulder.
Turn your torso slightly away from the loaded arm, push your hips back and bend sideways beneath the weight.
Slide your free hand down the opposite thigh as the loaded elbow straightens.
Keep looking toward the kettlebell and maintain its position above the supporting shoulder.
Bring your torso upright as you guide the kettlebell back to shoulder height.
Repeat with control, then change sides.
description: Lowering and turning the torso beneath one kettlebell allows the loaded arm to straighten while the trunk and shoulder control the weight.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Curl and Raise
instructions: Stand holding one kettlebell beside your thigh with your palm facing inward.
Keep your legs and torso steady while bending your elbow and lifting your upper arm forward.
Turn the bell upside down so its round base is above the handle, with your elbow bent in front of your shoulder.
Hold the wrist steady to balance the bell, then lower it slowly along the same path.
Finish the set and change arms.
description: The arm curls and lifts a kettlebell into an inverted position in front of the shoulder, working the shoulder and biceps while the forearm controls the grip.
aliases: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Clean from the Hang Position

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Curl to Shoulder
instructions: Stand with your feet apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your hips and knees steady as you bend one elbow to curl the bell toward your shoulder.
Turn your hand through the handle so the bell settles gently against your forearm.
Lower it under control while the opposite arm remains extended.
Complete the repetitions with the same arm, then switch sides.
description: Curl one kettlebell to the shoulder, turning the hand through the handle so the bell rests against the forearm. The other arm holds its kettlebell down while the working biceps lift the load.

name: Double-Kettlebell Split Jerk
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell at each shoulder and elbows close to your torso.
Make a short knee dip, then extend your legs sharply to drive the weights upward.
Move one foot forward and the other backward as you straighten both arms overhead.
Receive the weights with both knees bent and keep the rear knee clear of the floor.
Bring your feet back under you while stabilizing the weights.
Lower both kettlebells to the shoulders with control.
description: Leg drive sends both kettlebells overhead as the feet split forward and backward to receive the load.

name: Kettlebell Double Push Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at each shoulder with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Bend both knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive through your feet and straighten your legs as you press both weights overhead.
Finish with arms straight and legs extended.
Lower the kettlebells to the shoulders with control.
description: A short leg drive assists both arms in pressing kettlebells overhead, working the shoulders, triceps and legs.

name: Kettlebell Double Snatch
instructions: Stand with feet apart and a kettlebell in each hand.
Push your hips back and lean forward, letting the bells swing back between your legs.
Drive your hips and knees straight to accelerate the weights upward close to your body.
Guide your hands through the handles as both arms straighten overhead, letting the bells settle against the forearms.
Lower the weights under control into the next backswing.
description: Two kettlebells move from a backswing to overhead in one coordinated lift powered by the hips and legs.

name: Double-Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Stand with one kettlebell overhead in a straight arm and another hanging from the opposite hand.
Angle your feet slightly away from the raised arm.
Shift your hips back toward the side with the overhead arm and lean your torso toward the lower kettlebell.
Keep the upper arm vertical as the lower bell approaches the floor beside your foot.
Return upright through your hips without letting the overhead bell drift.
Finish the set before switching sides.
description: One kettlebell stays overhead while the other lowers beside the opposite leg as the hips move back and the torso bends and turns.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Rolling Floor Press
