instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a weight plate above your chest.
Gently tighten your abdomen and sit up while moving the plate overhead.
Finish upright with your arms reaching toward the ceiling.
Lower your torso and bring the plate back above your chest with control.
description: An Otis sit-up combines a weighted sit-up with an overhead plate reach.

name: Push-Up with Side Knee Tuck
instructions: Begin with your hands and toes on the floor and your body straight, then lower into a push-up.
Press up, turn your torso to one side and draw the upper knee forward toward your chest while keeping it bent.
Keep the supporting hand and opposite foot planted as you turn.
Return the raised foot and free hand to the push-up position and lower again.
Finish the repetitions, then repeat on the other side.
description: This push-up combines a press with a side turn and bent-knee tuck while balancing on one hand and the other foot.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and raise one arm overhead.
Bend its elbow to place your hand behind your upper back.
Use the other hand to guide the raised elbow gently backward without arching your back.
Hold comfortably, release and change arms.
description: An overhead bent-arm stretch lengthens the triceps with gentle help from the opposite hand.

name: Pelvic Tilt Into Low Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and arms beside you.
Gently tighten your abdomen and roll your pelvis backward to bring your lower back toward the floor.
Press through both feet and lift your hips into a low bridge, keeping your shoulders on the floor.
Lower your hips slowly and release the tilt before repeating.
description: A backward pelvic tilt leads into a small hip lift. The glutes and hamstrings raise the pelvis while the abs help control the trunk.

name: Pelvic Tilt Into Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms beside you.
Tighten your abdomen and gently tilt your pelvis to reduce the arch in your lower back.
Press through your feet to lift your hips into a bridge.
Pause with your shoulders, hips and knees aligned, then lower your pelvis slowly.
description: A posterior pelvic tilt leads into a glute bridge with the feet and upper back remaining on the floor.

name: Seated Rope-Assisted Calf Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg forward and the other bent comfortably.
Loop a stretching rope around the ball of the forward foot and hold both ends.
Gradually straighten that knee while gently drawing the toes toward your shin.
Keep the foot aligned with the lower leg and hold a comfortable calf stretch.
Release the rope tension before bending the knee and changing sides.
description: A seated rope-assisted stretch extends one leg while drawing its forefoot back to stretch the calf.

name: Pike-To-Cobra Push-Up
instructions: Start on your hands and feet with your hips raised into a pike.
Bend your elbows and sweep your chest forward just above the floor.
Lower your hips as you straighten your arms and lift your chest, keeping your shoulders away from your ears.
Lift your hips up and back with control to return to the pike.
Use a range that lets you control your shoulders and lower back.
description: A flowing push-up moves from a pike through a low press into a lifted-chest position.

name: Plyometric Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest while keeping your body aligned.
Press explosively until your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land on both hands with elbows soft and lower under control before the next repetition.
description: An explosive push-up briefly lifts the hands from the floor and trains upper-body pressing power.

name: Reverse Step with Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Step one foot backward, keeping its heel raised.
Bend the front knee slightly while reaching both arms overhead.
Bring the rear foot forward and lower your arms.
Finish the repetitions, then repeat with the other foot stepping back.
description: A backward step and overhead reach combine a shallow lunge with shoulder mobility.

name: Seated Rope-Assisted Calf Stretch with Foot Turned Outward
instructions: Sit with one leg forward and the other folded comfortably.
Loop a stretching rope around the forward forefoot.
Gently straighten that leg and use the rope to draw the forefoot back and slightly outward.
Hold a comfortable lower-leg stretch without twisting the knee.
Release and change legs.
description: A rope assists a calf stretch with a small outward tilt of the forefoot.

name: Bodyweight Squat with Forward Reach
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and arms extended forward.
Bend your hips and knees to sit down between your feet.
Keep your heels planted and knees following your toes.
Press through both feet to stand, keeping your arms forward for balance.
description: A bodyweight squat with arms reaching forward trains the thighs and glutes.

name: Supported Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand facing the back of a stable incline bench and hold the top of its backrest with both hands.
Bend your hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your feet flat and use the support to steady your balance.
Push through both feet to stand while keeping your grip light.
description: A supported squat uses a fixed handhold for balance while the legs raise and lower the body.

name: Barbell Power Clean
instructions: Set a barbell on the floor over your midfeet and grip it just outside your legs.
Bend your hips and knees, gently tighten your abdomen and keep the natural shape of your back.
Push through the floor to lift the bar close to your shins and thighs.
Extend your hips and knees forcefully, then move underneath the rising bar.
Turn your elbows forward and receive the bar on your shoulders in a shallow squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control and reset.
description: A power clean moves a barbell from the floor to the shoulders with an explosive pull and a shallow squat catch.

name: High Plank with Alternating Single-Limb Raises
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet apart.
Lift one leg behind you while keeping both hands down, then replace the foot.
Reach one arm forward while the other hand and both feet support you, then replace the hand.
Repeat with the other leg and then the other arm.
Raise only one limb at a time and keep your hips level.
description: A high plank alternates separate leg and arm raises to challenge trunk stability.

name: Straight-Leg Prisoner Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands lightly behind your head.
Gently tighten your abdomen without pulling on your neck.
Curl your torso upward and continue into a seated position.
Lower slowly until your back returns to the floor.
description: A straight-leg sit-up keeps the hands behind the head throughout the rise and return.

name: Stability Ball Prone Trunk Twist
instructions: Lean your chest onto a stability ball and place your hands around its sides with elbows bent.
Extend your legs behind you and spread your feet on the floor for a stable base.
Rotate your upper body to one side, rolling the ball a short distance beneath your chest and arms.
Reverse the movement to the other side while keeping your feet planted and hips controlled.
Continue slowly through a range you can control.
description: With the chest and arms supported on a stability ball and the feet on the floor, the upper body rolls from side to side to work the obliques.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grip the parallel pull-up handles with your palms facing each other and hang with your arms long.
Tighten your abdomen and draw your shoulders down away from your ears.
Bend your elbows to pull your upper chest toward the handles, keeping your legs quiet.
Lower yourself steadily until your arms are long again, then repeat without swinging.
description: A pull-up with palms facing each other trains the lats and elbow flexors.

name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands on the floor and lower shins on a stability ball.
Gently tighten your abdomen and keep your shoulders over your hands.
Bend both knees to roll the ball toward your torso.
Extend your legs slowly to return to the plank without sagging at the hips.
description: Both knees tuck toward the chest while the feet roll a stability ball forward beneath a supported plank.

name: Overhand Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and arms straight.
Gently tighten your abdomen and draw your shoulders down away from your ears.
Bend your elbows to pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms without swinging.
description: An overhand pull-up lifts the body toward a fixed overhead bar using the lats and elbow flexors.

name: Standing Alternating Arm Push and Pull
instructions: Stand upright with elbows bent at chest height.
Reach one arm forward as you draw the opposite elbow backward.
Reverse the arms smoothly, keeping them near shoulder height.
Continue alternating without shrugging or forcing your torso to twist.
description: An unloaded standing arm drill alternates forward reaches and backward elbow pulls.

name: Alternating Knee-Drive Front-Kick Run
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent in a running position.
Lift one knee, briefly extend that lower leg forward, then bring the foot down.
Repeat the knee drive and forward kick with the other leg.
Continue alternating with light steps and opposite arm swings.
Keep your trunk upright and land under control.
description: A running drill combines alternating high knees with brief forward leg extensions.

name: Bosu Dome-Up Push-Up
instructions: Set the BOSU with its dome facing up and place both hands on the dome.
Extend your legs into a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the dome.
Press back to straight arms while keeping your trunk aligned.
description: This BOSU push-up places the hands on the rounded side for an unstable hand support.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width on the floor and extend your legs behind you, balancing on your toes.
Gently tighten your abdomen to keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest just above the floor.
Press through your hands to straighten your arms while keeping your hips aligned.
description: A floor push-up trains the chest and triceps while the trunk remains in a straight plank.

name: Bosu Flat-Side-Up Push-Up
instructions: Place the BOSU on the floor with its flat platform facing up.
Hold the outer edges of the platform and extend your legs behind you onto your toes.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the platform.
Press back to straight arms while keeping the BOSU steady.
description: A push-up with hands on the flat BOSU platform challenges pressing strength and stability.

name: Push-Up with Hands on Stability Ball
instructions: Place both hands shoulder-width apart on a stable exercise ball.
Extend your legs behind you and balance on your toes.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the ball, keeping your body straight.
Press back to straight arms while keeping the ball steady.
description: A push-up with hands supported by a stability ball trains the chest, triceps and trunk control.

name: Push-Up with Feet on Stability Ball
instructions: Place your lower legs on a stability ball and your hands on the floor.
Gently tighten your abdomen to hold a straight plank.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up while keeping the ball steady beneath your legs.
description: This push-up elevates the feet on a stability ball while both hands stay on the floor.

name: Close-Hand Wall Push-Up
instructions: Face a wall and place your hands close together at chest height.
Step back enough to lean toward the wall with a straight body.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to bring your chest toward the wall.
Press away until your arms straighten.
description: A wall push-up with the hands close together trains the chest and triceps.

name: Wall Push-Up
instructions: Face a wall and place your hands at shoulder height, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step back with your feet hip-width apart so your body leans toward the wall.
Gently tighten your abdomen to keep a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Press through your hands to straighten your arms.
description: A standing wall push-up loads the chest and triceps through a forward lean.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up on Upright Dumbbell
instructions: Stand a stable flat-ended dumbbell upright on a nonslip floor.
Place both hands together on its upper end and step back into a plank.
Bend your elbows beside your torso to lower your chest toward your hands.
Press up, keeping the dumbbell stable and your body aligned.
description: Both hands share one upright dumbbell during this close-grip bodyweight push-up.

name: Push-Up with Kick-Through
instructions: Start with your hands and toes on the floor and your body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower into a push-up while turning your hips and threading one leg beneath your torso toward the opposite side.
Keep both hands planted as the leg reaches across.
Press back up and return that foot to the starting position.
Finish your repetitions, then repeat with the other leg.
description: A push-up adds a same-side leg reach beneath the torso during the lowering phase, then returns the foot as the arms straighten.

name: Offset Medicine Ball Push-Up
instructions: Place one hand on a stable medicine ball and the other on the floor.
Step back into a plank with feet apart.
Lower your chest between your hands by bending both elbows.
Press back up while keeping your shoulders and hips controlled.
Switch the ball to the other hand after the set.
description: An offset push-up places one hand on a medicine ball and the other on the floor.

name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
instructions: Start in a plank with palms on the floor slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Gently tighten your abdomen as you bend both elbows to lower your forearms.
Press through your palms to lift the elbows and straighten your arms.
Repeat without letting your hips sag.
description: A bodyweight elbow extension moves between palm and forearm support while the feet remain planted.

name: Push-Up Plus
instructions: Set up in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor while keeping your trunk aligned.
Press back to straight arms.
Keep your elbows straight and push the floor away a little farther so your shoulder blades spread across your upper back.
Let your shoulder blades move back to their starting position, then begin the next push-up.
description: A push-up finishes with an extra shoulder-blade reach that engages the serratus anterior.

name: Push-Up to Side Plank
instructions: Start on your hands and toes with your body straight.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bend your elbows to lower your chest.
Press back up, shift your weight onto one hand and turn your body to the side.
Reach your free arm toward the ceiling while keeping your hips lifted.
Return that hand to the floor and repeat the sequence.
Finish the repetitions, then turn to the other side.
description: A push-up leads into a side plank with an upward arm reach, then returns to both hands.

name: Bodyweight Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat on Bench
instructions: Stand in front of a bench and place one foot behind you on it.
Keep the front foot planted and lower by bending its knee and hip.
Let the rear knee move downward while your trunk stays controlled.
Push through the front foot to rise.
Finish the set and change legs.
description: A bench-supported rear foot allows the front leg to perform a bodyweight split squat.

name: Straight-Leg Reach Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms reaching along your thighs.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lift your head, shoulders and upper back.
Reach your hands toward your knees without sitting fully upright.
Lower slowly to the floor.
description: A short-range straight-leg crunch reaches forward while the pelvis stays on the floor.

name: Quick Feet
instructions: Stand with feet apart, knees softly bent and elbows bent in front.
Rapidly lift and replace one foot, then the other.
Keep the steps short and light while staying in place.
Maintain a steady rhythm and slow to a stop.
description: Fast alternating steps in place train footwork and cardiovascular endurance.

name: Push-Up with Forward Arm Raise
instructions: Begin on your hands and toes with your body straight, then lower into a push-up.
Press up and reach one arm forward while keeping your hips level.
Replace that hand on the floor and lower into the next push-up.
Finish the repetitions, then raise the other arm for the next set.
description: A push-up finishes with a single-arm forward reach while the other hand supports the body.
aliases: Push-Up with Alternating Forward Arm Raise

name: Forearm-Supported Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit with knees bent and feet flat, then lean back onto your forearms.
Keep your elbows beneath your shoulders and gently tighten your abdomen.
Press through your feet to lift your hips until your thighs and torso align.
Lower your hips slowly while keeping the forearms planted.
description: This bridge supports the upper body on the forearms while the hips lift and lower.

name: Cross-Body Rear Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your right arm across your chest, placing your left hand on your right elbow.
Gently pull your right arm towards your left shoulder, feeling a stretch in your right shoulder.
Hold a comfortable stretch, then release slowly.
Repeat on the other side.
description: Bringing one arm across the chest stretches the rear shoulder.

name: Behind-The-Neck Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with your hands wider than your shoulders and palms facing away.
Pull upward with your elbows moving out and down.
Bring the back of your neck toward the bar only as far as your shoulder motion comfortably allows.
Lower slowly to a controlled hang without forcing your head forward.
description: A wide-grip pull-up raises the body with the bar passing behind the head.

name: Supine Rope-Assisted Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Loop a stretching rope around the ball of one foot and hold both ends.
Raise that leg toward your chest while keeping its knee nearly straight and drawing its toes toward your shin.
Use gentle rope tension to hold a comfortable stretch while the other leg stays on the floor.
Release the tension, lower slowly and change legs.
description: A rope helps hold one straight leg raised while the opposite leg remains on the floor.
aliases: Reclining Big Toe Pose with Rope

name: Kneeling Band Hip Thrust
instructions: Secure a resistance band to a low anchor and position it around your hips.
Kneel facing away from the anchor with your knees planted.
Sit your hips back toward your heels while keeping your trunk controlled.
Squeeze your glutes to extend your hips into tall kneeling against the band.
Return slowly without lifting your knees.
description: An anchored band resists hip extension from a seated-back kneel to tall kneeling.
aliases: Resistance Band Hip Thrusts on Knees (Female)

name: Seated Band Single-Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with a loop band around both ankles.
Keep one foot planted to anchor the band.
Straighten the other knee to raise that foot against the band.
Bend the working knee slowly to return.
Switch legs after the set.
description: A seated one-leg knee extension uses the other ankle to anchor a resistance band.

name: Seated Band Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit upright on a stable chair with the middle of the band secured beneath your hips on the seat.
Hold one end in each hand, palms up and arms beside you.
Keep your elbows close to your sides as you curl both hands toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are extended.
description: A band held beneath the hips on a chair resists a seated two-arm curl.

name: Seated Band Chest Press
instructions: Sit tall on a stable chair and route the band behind your upper back, below your shoulders.
Hold an end in each hand at chest height with your elbows bent.
Press both hands forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Return both hands slowly toward your chest while keeping your torso steady.
description: A seated chest press pushes both hands forward against a band routed behind the upper back.

name: Seated Band Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with a loop band above your knees and your feet below them.
Hold the sides of the bench and keep your trunk still.
Move both knees apart against the band, allowing your lower legs to follow the movement.
Bring your knees inward slowly, keeping tension in the band.
description: A loop band above the knees resists moving the thighs apart while seated.

name: Seated Band Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall on a stable chair with a band securely routed beneath its seat.
Hold the band ends at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press both hands overhead without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
description: A band anchored beneath the chair resists a seated overhead press.

name: Bench-Seated Band Row
instructions: Sit on the bench and extend your legs forward with a band securely looped around the midfoot area.
Hold both ends with palms facing inward and arms long.
Keep your torso upright as you pull your elbows backward toward your waist.
Extend your arms slowly without allowing the band to slip from your feet.
description: A seated band row uses the feet as an anchor while the body rests on a bench.
aliases: Resistance Band Seated Straight Back Row

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet until your thighs point upward.
Tighten your abdomen and curl your pelvis off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor while keeping your knees bent.
description: A reverse crunch curls the pelvis off the floor while the knees remain bent.

name: Kneeling Cobra Press-Up
instructions: Lie face down with palms beside your lower chest and knees on the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your elbows and raise your chest.
Keep your hips low and use a comfortable back-extension range.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest with control.
description: A knees-supported press-up lifts the chest into an extended position with the hips low.

name: Underhand Machine Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with your thighs beneath the pads and feet flat.
Hold the overhead handles with your palms facing you.
Keep your trunk steady as you pull the handles toward your upper chest.
Allow your elbows to straighten slowly on the return.
description: An underhand machine pulldown trains the lats and elbow flexors from a seated position.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grip the bar with your palms facing you and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend your elbows to pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower slowly to straight arms without kicking or swinging.
description: An underhand pull-up raises the chin above a fixed bar using the lats and elbow flexors.

name: Stability Ball Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down across a stability ball with hips near its rear edge and hands on the floor.
Gently tighten your abdomen and let your legs hang down behind you.
Lift both legs until they align with your torso, squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly without swinging or overextending your lower back.
description: The hips extend to lift both legs while a stability ball supports the torso.

name: Flat Bench Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at its edge.
Grip the bench and let your legs hang beyond the end.
Raise both legs until they are approximately in line with your torso.
Lower with control without swinging your back.
description: A flat bench supports the torso while both legs lift through hip extension.

name: Reverse Tabletop with Alternating Leg Lift
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet flat and hands planted behind your hips.
Press through your hands and feet to raise your hips into a tabletop.
Extend and lift one leg while the other foot remains planted beneath its bent knee.
Replace the foot, then lift the other leg.
Keep your hips from dropping as you alternate.
description: A reverse tabletop supports the body while alternating straight-leg lifts challenge hip and trunk stability.

name: Ring Dip
instructions: Begin in straight-arm support above securely anchored rings, with the rings beside your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body between the rings.
Keep the rings close and lower only through a controlled shoulder range.
Press down into the rings to straighten your elbows and return to support.
description: A ring dip lowers and raises the body between unstable ring supports.

name: Rocking Frog Stretch
instructions: Kneel with your knees spread comfortably wide and lower onto your forearms.
Keep the inner edges of your feet supported and your knees on the floor.
Rock your hips gently backward to stretch the inner thighs.
Move forward again without forcing the hip range.
description: A wide-knee forearm-supported rock stretches the hip adductors.

name: Lean-Back Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with your palms facing away and hands wider than your shoulders.
Gently tighten your abdomen and pull your elbows down and back.
Raise your upper chest toward the bar with a controlled backward lean, without throwing your head back.
Lower slowly to straight arms and repeat without swinging.
description: An overhand pull-up raises the upper chest toward the bar with a backward torso lean.

name: Kneeling Foam Roller Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel with a foam roller in front of you and place your forearms on it.
Keep your hips over or slightly behind your knees.
Roll your arms forward and let your chest sink gently between them.
Return slowly by drawing the roller back toward you.
description: A kneeling forward reach on a roller stretches the lats and shoulders.

name: Foam Roller Body Saw
instructions: Set your forearms on the floor and lower shins on a foam roller.
Lift into a straight plank and gently tighten your abdomen.
Shift your whole body slightly backward so the roller moves under your lower legs.
Pull your body forward to the starting plank without bending at the hips.
description: A forearm plank slides forward and backward with the shins supported by a foam roller.

name: Outer Thigh Foam Roll with Top Foot Support
instructions: Lie on your side with the outer thigh resting across a foam roller.
Support yourself on the lower forearm and place the top foot on the floor in front.
Use your arms and planted foot to roll a short distance along the outer thigh.
Keep pressure comfortable and avoid rolling directly over the knee or hip bone.
Change sides after the set.
description: Supported side rolling applies controlled pressure along one outer thigh.

name: Inner Thigh Foam Roll
instructions: Lie face down on your forearms and move one bent knee out to the side.
Place the foam roller under the inner thigh of that leg.
Use your supporting arms and opposite foot to move a short distance over the roller.
Stay on the thigh muscles and keep the pressure comfortable.
Reset and roll the other inner thigh.
description: A bent leg rests sideways across the roller to apply pressure along the inner thigh.

name: Seated Knee Tuck with Heels on Foam Roller
instructions: Sit with hands on the floor behind your hips and heels on a foam roller.
Lean back slightly and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend your knees to roll your heels toward your body.
Extend the legs slowly to roll the heels away while keeping your trunk controlled.
description: A supported seated knee tuck rolls both heels toward and away from the body.

name: Seated Hamstring Foam Roll
instructions: Sit with a foam roller beneath both thighs and your hands behind you.
Press into your palms to lift your hips slightly.
Move your body forward and backward so the roller travels along the backs of your thighs.
Keep pressure comfortable and avoid the backs of your knees.
Lower your hips to finish.
description: Both hamstrings pass over the roller while the hands support and move the body.
aliases: Roller Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor

name: Seated Single-Calf Foam Roll
instructions: Sit with one lower leg on a foam roller and the other foot planted.
Place both hands behind you and lift your hips slightly.
Move your body so the roller travels a short distance along the calf.
Avoid rolling directly over the ankle or back of the knee.
Lower your hips and change legs.
description: A supported seated roll applies pressure along one calf at a time.
aliases: Roller Seated Single Leg Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor

name: Outer Thigh Foam Roll with Legs Stacked
instructions: Lie on your side with the lower outer thigh on a foam roller and legs stacked.
Support your upper body on the lower forearm and the opposite hand.
Move slowly so the roller travels a short distance along the outer thigh.
Keep pressure comfortable and avoid the knee and hip bone.
Change sides after the set.
description: Stacked legs increase the supported body pressure during an outer-thigh foam roll.

name: Arms-Only Rope Climb
instructions: Grip a securely anchored climbing rope with both hands, one above the other.
Pull your body upward and reach the lower hand above the upper hand.
Continue hand over hand while keeping your hanging legs controlled.
Climb only as high as you can maintain a secure grip and control the return.
Descend slowly by reversing the hand-over-hand sequence.
description: An arms-only rope climb uses alternating hand grips to raise and lower the body while the legs remain hanging.

name: Running
instructions: Start upright with elbows bent and shoulders relaxed.
Alternate strides, pushing off one foot and landing on the other.
Let the opposite arm swing naturally with each leg.
Keep your head level and maintain a comfortable rhythm.
Slow gradually to finish.
description: Running uses alternating strides and arm swings for cardiovascular exercise.

name: Treadmill Running
instructions: Set up the treadmill and attach its safety clip if provided.
Begin walking, then increase to a running pace you can control.
Run near the center of the belt with relaxed arms and alternating strides.
Keep your gaze forward and avoid holding the rails during the running phase.
Reduce the speed gradually before stepping off.
description: Running on a treadmill uses alternating strides on a moving belt.

name: Standing Crossed-Leg Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand with one foot crossed slightly in front of the other.
Keep both knees nearly straight and lean forward from your hips.
Reach toward the floor only as far as comfortable, feeling the stretch behind the legs.
Return upright slowly and reverse the crossed stance.
description: A forward fold from a crossed stance stretches the hamstrings.

name: Feet-Supported Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and both feet resting on the floor.
Lean your torso back slightly and clasp your hands near your chest.
Rotate your shoulders and hands to one side while keeping your hips steady.
Turn through the center to the opposite side with control.
description: A seated trunk rotation keeps the feet supported while the obliques turn the torso.

name: Bench Scapular Dip
instructions: Sit at the edge of a bench with hands beside your hips and feet on the floor.
Press into the bench and shift your hips just off the edge, keeping your elbows straight.
Let your shoulders rise slightly toward your ears to lower your torso a small distance.
Press the shoulders down to lift your torso without bending your elbows.
description: A straight-arm bench support moves through shoulder-blade elevation and depression rather than an elbow dip.

name: Scapular Push-Up
instructions: Hold a high plank with your hands beneath your shoulders.
Keep both elbows straight as you let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades and raise your upper back.
Repeat the small shoulder-blade movement without bending your elbows or sagging at the hips.
description: During a straight-arm plank, the shoulder blades move together and apart. The serratus anterior helps spread the shoulder blades as the upper back rises.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with your palms facing away and elbows straight.
Draw your shoulder blades down to lift your body a short distance.
Keep your arms straight and avoid swinging.
Release slowly back to the full hang.
description: A short straight-arm pull trains shoulder-blade depression from a hanging position.

name: Scissor Jumps
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and the other back.
Jump lightly and switch which foot is forward.
Land softly in the opposite split stance, keeping the knees slightly bent.
Continue switching front and back while your arms swing naturally.
description: Scissor jumps repeatedly exchange a forward and backward foot position.

name: Seated Hand-Assisted Calf Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other bent comfortably.
Reach forward and hold the forefoot of the straight leg.
Draw the toes gently toward your shin without forcing the knee.
Hold comfortably, release and change sides.
description: Holding the forefoot assists a seated calf stretch with one leg straight.

name: Floor-Seated Figure-Four Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit with both hands on the floor behind you.
Cross one ankle over the other thigh just above the knee.
Bend the supporting leg and bring your hands onto the floor beside your legs as you lean toward the crossed leg.
Hold comfortably without pushing on the knee.
Ease upright, release and switch legs.
description: A supported floor-seated figure-four position stretches the glutes and deep hip rotators.

name: Seated Bench Knee Tuck
instructions: Sit near the edge of a flat bench and grip beside your hips.
Lean back slightly and extend both legs in front of you with your feet clear of the floor.
Bend both knees and draw them toward your chest as you curl your torso toward them.
Extend both legs forward and lean back under control to return to the starting position.
description: Draw both knees toward your chest while curling the torso forward on a bench, then extend the legs together as you recline. The abs and hip flexors control the tuck and return.

name: Seated Overhead Side Stretch
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with both feet planted.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand beside you for support.
Lean gently away from the raised arm to lengthen that side of your torso.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.
description: A seated overhead side bend stretches the lats and side of the trunk.

name: Chair-Seated Figure-Four Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit near the front of a stable chair with both feet planted.
Rest one ankle across the opposite thigh above the knee.
Lean forward gently from your hips until you feel a stretch in the crossed-leg hip.
Hold without pressing forcefully on the knee.
Sit upright and switch sides.
description: Leaning forward from a chair-seated figure-four position stretches the glutes and deep hip rotators.

name: Wall Sit with Alternating Side Bend
instructions: Set your back against a wall and slide into a wall sit with feet planted.
Keep your hips off the floor and arms hanging beside your body.
Bend your torso slightly to one side, reaching that hand toward the same-side heel.
Return through the center and bend toward the other heel.
Keep your pelvis at a steady height.
description: A wall sit adds alternating lateral trunk bends while the legs hold the squat position.

name: Seated Straddle Stretch Toward One Foot
instructions: Sit with your legs comfortably wide and toes pointing upward.
Turn toward one leg and lean forward gently from your hips, reaching both hands along that leg.
Hold a comfortable stretch without bouncing or forcing your reach.
Return upright slowly, then repeat toward the other foot.
description: A seated straddle stretch reaches both hands toward one foot to lengthen the back of that thigh.

name: Hand-Assisted Nordic Curl on Raised Station
instructions: Kneel on the station pad with your ankles securely fixed beneath its restraint.
Keep your shoulders, hips and knees aligned as you lean forward from the knees.
Use your hamstrings to slow the descent.
Place your hands on the floor to catch your body and help push back toward upright.
Return to tall kneeling under control.
description: A raised Nordic station anchors the ankles while the hamstrings control a forward body lean and the hands assist the return.

name: Hand-Assisted Nordic Curl on Bench
instructions: Kneel on a padded bench with your ankles secured beneath a fixed restraint.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lean forward from your knees, keeping your hips in line with your shoulders and knees.
Lower as slowly as you can with your hamstrings.
Place your hands on the floor beside the bench to catch and assist the return.
Pull your body back into tall kneeling.
description: A bench-based Nordic curl keeps the ankles fixed and uses the hands to assist the return.

name: Hand-Assisted Floor Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your ankles firmly secured under a suitable fixed restraint.
Gently tighten your abdomen and keep your hips in line with your shoulders and knees.
Lean forward from the knees, lowering your body as one unit.
Catch your weight with your hands and use them to help push back.
Return to upright kneeling with controlled hamstring effort.
description: A floor Nordic curl uses fixed ankles and hand assistance during the forward lean and return.
aliases: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl (On Floor)

name: Partial Squat Jump
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a shallow squat and swing your arms back.
Extend your hips and knees to jump upward.
Land softly with both feet and bend your knees to absorb the landing.
Regain control before the next jump.
description: A short squat dip leads into a two-foot jump and controlled landing.

name: Short-Stride Run
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent.
Begin running with quick, short steps.
Swing your arms in opposition to your legs and keep your feet landing beneath your body.
Maintain the rhythm, then slow gradually to finish.
description: A short-stride run uses quick alternating foot contacts and compact arm swings.

name: Shoulder-Width Overhand Pull-Up
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar with your palms facing away and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend your elbows and pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms without swinging.
description: A shoulder-width overhand pull-up trains the back and elbow flexors.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
instructions: Place your hands beneath your shoulders, extend your legs and balance on your toes with your body straight.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lift one hand to touch the opposite shoulder.
Set that hand down before lifting the other hand to tap the other shoulder.
Continue alternating while keeping your hips level and torso steady.
description: Alternating opposite-shoulder taps challenge trunk stability from a high plank.

name: Push-Up with Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start on your hands and toes with your body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press up and lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return that hand to the floor before the next push-up, keeping your hips steady.
Finish the repetitions, then tap with the other hand for the next set.
description: Each bilateral push-up finishes with one hand tapping the opposite shoulder.

name: Side Plank Hip Lift with Top-Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked, supporting your upper body on the lower forearm.
Press through the forearm and lower foot to lift your hips while raising your top leg.
Keep the top knee nearly straight and avoid rolling backward.
Lower the top leg and hips together with control.
Finish the repetitions, then change sides.
description: The hips and top leg rise together from side support, combining a side-plank lift with hip abduction.

name: Side Plank Hip Lift
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your lower forearm beneath the shoulder.
Gently tighten your abdomen and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly toward the floor.
Repeat, then switch sides.
description: Repeated side-plank hip lifts work the lateral trunk muscles.

name: Captain Chair Bent-Knee Twist
instructions: Place your forearms on the captain chair pads and grip the handles.
Support your back against the pad and raise both bent knees in front of you.
Keep your knees together and turn them toward one side while your shoulders remain steady.
Move through the center toward the other side with control.
Lower your feet onto the station supports to finish.
description: Supported on the forearms, the body holds both knees raised while turning the knees and pelvis from side to side.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your head supported.
Keep your hips stacked and the top knee nearly straight.
Lift the top leg without rolling your pelvis backward.
Lower slowly and repeat before changing sides.
description: A side-lying top-leg raise trains the hip abductors.

name: Side-Lying Overhead Reach Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your body lengthened and arms reaching overhead along the floor.
Reach your upper hand farther away from your hips.
Let the side of your torso lengthen without lifting your legs or forcing your shoulder.
Relax and repeat on the other side.
description: An overhead reach from side lying stretches the lats and side of the trunk.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side and place the top foot on the floor in front of the lower leg.
Keep the bottom leg extended and support your torso with your lower forearm.
Lift the bottom leg toward the ceiling through a small controlled range.
Lower it slowly without moving the upper leg.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The bottom leg lifts while the upper foot stays planted to train the hip adductors.

name: Copenhagen Side Plank Hip Lift
instructions: Place your upper foot on a stable flat bench and your lower forearm on the floor beneath your shoulder.
Let your hips and lower leg lower toward the floor while keeping the upper foot supported.
Press through the upper foot and forearm to lift your hips, bringing the lower leg up toward the upper leg.
Lower your hips and lower leg together with control.
Finish the repetitions, then change sides.
description: With the upper foot on a bench, the hips and lower leg lift together into a side plank, loading the hip adductors.
aliases: Copenhagen Side Plank with Lower-Leg Lift

name: Hand-Assisted Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head gently toward one shoulder.
Rest that hand over the opposite side of your head to guide a light stretch without pulling forcefully.
Hold comfortably, release and repeat on the other side.
description: Light hand assistance guides a sideways neck stretch.

name: Side-Lying Single-Arm Triceps Push-Up
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and the lower arm wrapped across your torso.
Place the upper hand on the floor in front of your chest.
Press through that hand to lift your upper torso by straightening the elbow.
Bend the elbow to lower slowly.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The upper arm presses across the body to lift the torso from side lying.

name: Standing Wrist Stretch with Hand Assistance
instructions: Bring one arm across the front of your chest with the elbow nearly straight.
Hold that hand with your other hand.
Gently guide the hand sideways until you feel a comfortable stretch around the wrist and forearm.
Hold without forcing the wrist, release and switch hands.
description: One hand gently guides the opposite wrist into a forearm stretch.

name: Pull-Up Toward One Hand
instructions: Hang from a bar with your palms facing away and hands wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and pull upward toward one hand, keeping both grips secure.
Bring your chin toward bar height without kicking.
Lower slowly to a centered hang.
Finish the repetitions, then pull toward the other hand.
description: A two-hand pull-up shifts the upper body toward one hand during the rise, increasing the demand on that side.

name: Standing Toe Reach Sequence
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward from your hips and reach both hands toward one foot.
Stay bent forward as you move your reach through the center and toward the other foot.
Stand slowly and raise both arms overhead again.
Use a comfortable range without bouncing.
description: A standing mobility sequence reaches both hands toward one foot, through the center and toward the other foot before returning overhead.

name: Single-Arm Push-Up
instructions: Set one palm on the floor beneath your shoulder and spread your feet for balance.
Place the nonworking hand behind your lower back.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bend the supporting elbow to lower your chest.
Press back up without letting your hips sag or twist excessively.
Complete the set and switch arms.
description: A one-arm push-up keeps the free hand behind the back while the working arm presses the body.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge with Leg Extended
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend one leg forward and keep it raised while the other foot stays planted.
Press through the planted foot and lift your hips until the supporting thigh and torso form a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly while keeping the free leg extended.
Finish the repetitions, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg bridge keeps the free leg extended while the planted foot drives hip extension.
aliases: Single Leg Bridge with Outstretched Leg

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise on Dumbbell
instructions: Place a stable flat-ended dumbbell on the floor and hold a fixed support.
Set the ball of one foot on the dumbbell handle and lift the other foot.
Raise your working heel while keeping the knee nearly straight.
Lower the heel slowly through a comfortable range.
Repeat with the other leg.
description: A dumbbell beneath the forefoot provides a small raised surface for a supported single-leg calf raise.
aliases: Single Leg Calf Raise (On a Dumbbell)

name: Supine Heel Slide
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight and your arms beside you.
Keep your hips and the other leg resting on the floor.
Slide one heel toward your buttock, bending that hip and knee through a comfortable range.
Slide the heel away to straighten the leg again.
Finish the repetitions, then change legs.
description: Lying on the back, one heel slides toward the hips and away again as the hip and knee bend and straighten.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg and extend the other leg forward, reaching your arms ahead for balance.
Bend the supporting hip and knee to lower into a deep squat while keeping the free foot off the floor.
Keep your supporting heel planted and use a depth you can control.
Press through the supporting foot to stand without setting the other foot down.
Finish the repetitions, then switch legs.
description: A deep single-leg squat keeps the free leg extended forward and requires strength, balance and ankle mobility.

name: Supported Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand beside a stable incline bench and hold its backrest with one hand.
Rise onto the balls of your feet and let your knees move forward.
Lean your torso backward in line with your thighs as you bend your knees.
Lower only as far as you can control, then straighten your knees to rise.
Keep the support grip light and your hips aligned with your shoulders and knees.
description: A supported sissy squat bends the knees with raised heels and a backward torso lean to emphasize the quadriceps.

name: Bent-Knee Prisoner Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your torso up toward a seated position without pulling your neck.
Lower your back slowly to the floor.
description: A bent-knee sit-up holds the hands behind the head while the trunk rises and lowers.

name: Arms-Crossed Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Gently tighten your abdomen and curl your torso forward into a seated position.
Lower your back slowly to the floor.
description: A bent-knee sit-up crosses both arms over the chest during the rise and return.

name: Skater Hops
instructions: Stand with your knees slightly bent and shift your weight onto one leg.
Push sideways and land on the other foot with that knee bent.
Swing the trailing leg behind the supporting leg while keeping it off the floor.
Push back across and land on the other foot, letting your arms swing for balance.
Continue alternating with controlled landings.
description: Alternating lateral hops land on one foot as the trailing leg crosses behind the body.

name: Ski Ergometer
instructions: Stand facing the machine with feet about shoulder-width apart and grip both overhead handles.
Begin the pull with your hands high and elbows softly bent.
Drive the handles downward while pushing your hips back, leaning forward and bending your knees slightly.
Finish with the hands beside your thighs.
Stand tall and let the handles return overhead under control.
description: A standing ski ergometer combines a downward arm pull with a forward bend at the hips for full-body conditioning.

name: Ski Steps
instructions: Stand upright with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward as the other moves backward.
Quickly exchange the front and rear foot positions with light steps.
Continue the alternating pattern while keeping your trunk steady.
description: Ski steps alternate the feet forward and backward in a compact standing cardio drill.

name: German Hang on Rings
instructions: Grip securely anchored rings and use a controlled tucked backward rotation to bring your arms behind your torso.
Lower into the hang only through a shoulder range you can control, with your elbows straight and feet clear of the floor.
Extend your legs downward and hold the position without bouncing or forcing the shoulder stretch.
Tuck your legs and reverse the entry slowly to return to a normal hang.
description: A German hang holds the body below the rings with the arms extended behind the torso, placing a deep stretch across the shoulders and chest.

name: Single-Leg 45-Degree Sled Leg Press
instructions: Sit against the back pad and place one whole foot on the sled platform.
Press the sled away and release the stops using the machine handles.
Bend the working knee and hip to lower the sled without lifting your pelvis.
Press through that foot until the leg is nearly straight.
Secure the sled before changing legs or leaving the machine.
description: One leg presses a guided angled sled while the torso remains supported.

name: 45-Degree Sled Calf Press
instructions: Sit against the machine pads with the balls of both feet on the platform edge.
Extend your legs and keep the knees softly bent at a steady angle.
Press through your forefeet to move the sled by extending your ankles.
Lower your heels slowly through a controlled range.
Secure the sled before dismounting.
description: An angled sled calf press moves through the ankles while the knee angle remains nearly fixed.

name: 45-Degree Sled Leg Press
instructions: Sit against the machine pads with your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Grip the handles, press the sled away and release its stops while supporting the load.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the sled without lifting your pelvis from the pad.
Press through both feet until your legs are nearly straight.
Secure the stops before leaving the machine.
description: Both legs press an angled sled to train the quadriceps and hip extensors.

name: 45-Degree Sled Leg Press, Rear View
instructions: Sit against the machine pads with your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the sled stops while supporting the load.
Bend your knees and hips to lower the sled without lifting your pelvis.
Press through both feet until your legs are nearly straight.
Secure the sled at the end of the set.
description: A rear-view demonstration of the two-leg 45-degree sled press.

name: 45-Degree Sled Leg Press, Side View
instructions: Sit with your back and pelvis against the pads and both feet flat on the platform.
Support the sled and release the stops.
Bend your hips and knees to bring the platform toward you through a controlled range.
Press away without forcefully locking your knees.
Secure the sled before leaving the machine.
description: A side-view demonstration of the two-leg 45-degree sled press.

name: Wide-Stance 45-Degree Sled Leg Press
instructions: Sit against the pads and place your feet wider than shoulder-width on the platform.
Turn the toes slightly outward and release the stops while supporting the load.
Bend your knees in line with your toes to lower the sled.
Press through both feet to return to nearly straight legs.
Secure the sled to finish.
description: A wide stance changes the hip position during an angled sled leg press.

name: Calf Press on 45-Degree Leg Press
instructions: Sit against the leg press pads with both forefeet securely on the platform edge.
Extend the sled and maintain nearly straight knees.
Push through the balls of your feet to extend your ankles.
Let your heels return slowly while keeping the knees still.
Secure the sled after the set.
description: Both calves move the sled through ankle motion while the legs remain almost straight.
aliases: Sled Calf Press on Leg Press

name: Close-Stance Hack Squat
instructions: Set your shoulders beneath the pads and back against the hack-squat carriage.
Place your feet close together on the platform and release the stops.
Bend your knees and hips to lower while keeping your heels planted.
Push through both feet to stand without locking the knees forcefully.
Reengage the stops to finish.
description: A close-stance hack squat guides the torso along a sled track while the legs bend and extend.

name: Forward-Facing Angled Sled Calf Raise
instructions: Face the angled sled and position your shoulders beneath its pads.
Place the balls of both feet on the platform edge with heels free.
Keep your knees nearly straight as you lift your heels.
Lower slowly through your available ankle range.
Secure the carriage before stepping away.
description: Facing into the sled, the calves raise and lower the heels against the shoulder-supported load.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on the hack-squat platform with back and shoulders against the pads.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart and release the stops.
Bend your hips and knees to lower, keeping your heels planted.
Extend both legs to return to standing.
Secure the carriage before leaving.
description: A guided sled squat trains the quadriceps and glutes with the back supported.

name: Supine Horizontal Calf Press
instructions: Lie on the machine pad with your shoulders supported and forefeet on the platform edge.
Keep your knees softly bent and steady.
Push through your forefeet to extend your ankles and move the carriage.
Allow the heels to return slowly without changing your knee angle.
description: A lying horizontal sled setup loads ankle extension while the torso stays flat.

name: Supine Horizontal Sled Leg Press
instructions: Lie on the carriage pad and place both feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Grip the handles and keep your back and pelvis supported.
Push through both feet to extend your hips and knees, moving the carriage away.
Bend your legs slowly to return without lifting your pelvis.
Secure the machine before dismounting.
description: A supine horizontal sled press moves the supported torso away from the footplate through leg extension.

name: Single-Leg Calf Press on 45-Degree Leg Press
instructions: Sit against the machine pads with one forefoot on the platform edge.
Support and release the sled with the working leg nearly straight.
Press through that forefoot to extend your ankle while keeping the knee angle steady.
Lower the heel with control.
Secure the sled before changing legs.
description: A single calf moves the angled sled through ankle motion with the knee nearly fixed.
aliases: Sled One Leg Calf Press on Leg Press

name: Sledgehammer Tire Strike
instructions: Stand facing a stable tire with clear space around you and hold a sledgehammer in both hands.
Raise the hammer over one shoulder while maintaining a firm grip.
Turn your torso and bend slightly at your hips as you drive the hammer into the tire.
Control the rebound and reset your stance before the next strike.
Change the lead hand and striking side between sets.
description: A two-handed sledgehammer strike combines trunk rotation and an overhead swing into a tire.

name: Smith Machine Behind-The-Back Shrug
instructions: Stand in front of the Smith bar and grip it behind your thighs.
Unhook the bar and keep your elbows straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears without rolling them.
Lower your shoulders slowly, then secure the bar on its supports after the set.
description: The Smith bar stays behind the thighs during a straight-arm shoulder shrug.

name: Seated Smith Machine Behind-The-Neck Press
instructions: Position a bench beneath the Smith bar and sit with both feet planted.
Take a wide grip with your palms facing forward and unhook the bar above your head.
Lower it behind your head through a comfortable shoulder range without pushing your neck forward.
Press the bar up along the rails until your arms are nearly straight.
Rehook the bar to finish.
description: A seated behind-the-neck press follows the Smith machine rails and requires substantial shoulder mobility.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Position a flat bench so the Smith bar lowers toward the middle of your chest.
Lie back with feet planted and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and lower it toward your chest with controlled elbows.
Press along the rails until your arms straighten.
Rehook the bar securely after the set.
description: A flat-bench chest press uses the guided bar of a Smith machine.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Knee Good Morning
instructions: Set the Smith bar across your upper back and unhook it from a stable stance.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips backward as you lean forward from your hips.
Keep your back in its natural shape and lower only as far as you can control.
Extend your hips to stand tall, then rehook the bar after the set.
description: Lean forward from the hips with bent knees while the Smith bar rests on the upper back, then straighten the hips to stand.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
instructions: Grip the Smith bar with your palms facing your legs and unhook it.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back and lean forward while keeping your back in its natural shape.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows backward.
Lower slowly until your arms lengthen, keeping your torso steady.
Stand and rehook the bar to finish.
description: A bent-over row pulls the Smith bar toward the torso along its guided track.

name: Smith Machine Feet-Forward Squat
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and place your feet slightly forward of the bar.
Unhook the bar and gently tighten your abdomen.
Bend your knees and hips to lower as if sitting backward, keeping the feet planted.
Push through both feet to stand along the rails.
Rehook the bar after the set.
description: A feet-forward Smith squat uses the guided bar path while the hips move back into a chair-like squat.

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench beneath the Smith bar with both feet planted.
Grip the bar about shoulder-width or slightly closer and unhook it.
Lower toward your chest through a controlled, comfortable range.
Press the bar up along its rails and rehook it when finished.
description: A close-grip Smith bench press emphasizes elbow extension while also training the chest.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar near lower-shin height and stand close to it.
Bend your hips and knees and grip outside your legs with your palms facing your legs.
Gently tighten your abdomen, keep your back in its natural shape and push through both feet to stand, straightening your hips and knees together.
Lower the bar under control by bending your hips and knees.
Secure the bar at the end of the set.
description: A Smith deadlift raises a low bar to standing using hip and knee extension along a guided track.

name: Smith Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench beneath the Smith bar with your feet secured under the bench pads.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with your palms toward your feet.
Unhook the bar and bend your elbows to lower it toward your chest.
Press along the rails until your arms are nearly straight.
Rehook the bar securely before getting up.
description: Press the Smith bar from the chest while lying on a decline bench. The chest drives the press with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Decline Underhand Bench Press
instructions: Secure a decline bench under the Smith bar and set the catches for your range.
Lie back with your feet secured under the bench pads.
Hold the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with your palms facing toward your head, and release the hooks.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your lower chest, keeping your wrists over your forearms.
Press the bar back up under control, then repeat. Rehook the bar before getting up.
description: An underhand grip distinguishes this decline Smith press. The chest, triceps and shoulders work together to move the bar.

name: Smith Front Squat with Clean Grip
instructions: Set the Smith bar at upper-chest height and position the safety stops.
Place the bar across the fronts of your shoulders, bend your wrists back to support it with your fingers, and lift your elbows forward.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and release the hooks without walking the bar away from its rails.
Keep your abdomen firm and heels down as you bend your knees and hips into a squat.
Lower as far as you can while keeping your torso controlled and elbows lifted.
Push through your feet to stand, then repeat and rehook the bar when finished.
description: The bar rests across the front shoulders as you squat along the Smith rails. This front-loaded variation works the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Smith Deep Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar near shoulder height with the safety stops below your intended squat depth.
Position the bar across your upper back and grip it outside your shoulders.
Release the hooks and set your feet about shoulder width apart with toes turned slightly out.
Bend your hips and knees, lowering into a deep squat while keeping your heels down and back controlled.
Drive through your feet to straighten your legs and hips.
Repeat within a depth you can control, then rehook the bar.
description: This Smith squat uses a deep lowering phase while the feet stay planted. The quadriceps and glutes extend the knees and hips to stand.

name: Smith Behind-The-Back Hack Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar low behind you and position the safety stops.
Stand with feet about hip width apart, bend your knees and hips, and grasp the bar behind your legs with both arms straight.
Release the hooks and hold the bar behind your thighs with your chest lifted.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into the squat, keeping the bar behind you and your feet planted.
Push through both feet to stand while your arms remain long.
Repeat under control, then secure the bar.
description: Hold the Smith bar behind the legs throughout this squat. The quadriceps and glutes work to lower and raise the body along the guided bar path.

name: Smith Weighted Reverse Crunch
instructions: Set the Smith bar low enough to reach securely with both feet while lying on your back, and set its safety stops before getting underneath.
Lie on your back with your arms beside you and raise both legs so the soles of your feet press against the underside of the bar.
Keep your knees nearly straight and tighten your abdomen.
Curl your pelvis upward a short distance, lifting your hips off the floor and pushing the bar upward with your feet.
Slowly lower your pelvis back to the floor without letting the bar drop.
Repeat the small controlled curl while keeping your head and shoulders down.
description: The feet press against a Smith bar while the pelvis curls off the floor. This loaded abdominal reverse crunch keeps the knees nearly straight.

name: Smith Incline Bench Press
instructions: Secure an incline bench beneath the Smith bar and set the safety stops.
Lie back with your head and back on the pad and feet planted on the floor.
Hold the bar just wider than shoulder width, palms toward your feet, and release the hooks.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your upper chest.
Press the bar upward until your arms are extended without lifting your hips.
Repeat with control, then rehook the bar.
description: An inclined bench changes the pressing angle while the Smith rails guide the bar. The chest, shoulders and triceps perform the press.

name: Smith Incline Underhand Bench Press
instructions: Place an incline bench under the Smith bar and set the safety stops.
Lie back on the bench with your feet on the floor.
Take a grip slightly wider than shoulder width with your palms facing your head, and release the bar hooks.
Lower the bar toward your upper chest with your wrists supported over your forearms and elbows close to your sides.
Press upward along the rails without lifting your back from the bench.
Repeat and secure the hooks when finished.
description: This incline press uses an underhand grip on the Smith bar. It works the chest with the shoulders and triceps assisting.

name: Smith Incline Scapular Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench under the Smith bar with your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and hold it above you with your elbows straight.
Keep your elbows straight as you reach upward, allowing your shoulder blades to move forward around your ribs.
Lower your shoulders back toward the pad to reverse the small movement.
Repeat without bending your elbows into a bench press.
description: A short reaching motion moves the shoulder blades while the arms remain straight. This incline scapular press emphasizes the serratus anterior.

name: Smith Supine Leg Press
instructions: Before lying underneath, position the Smith bar where you can reach it securely with both feet and set the safety stops below the planned lowering range.
Lie on your back with both soles placed securely against the underside of the bar and your arms resting beside you.
Bend your knees and hips to bring the bar toward your body without lifting your head or losing foot contact.
Press through both feet to extend your legs along the rails, avoiding a forceful knee lockout.
Lower slowly and repeat within a range you can control.
description: This vertical leg press is performed on the floor with the feet against the Smith bar. The quadriceps and glutes extend the legs to raise the load.

name: Smith Low-Bar Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar and safety stops for your squat height and depth.
Position the bar across the muscular shelf at the back of your shoulders, below the usual high-bar position, and grip it securely.
Release the hooks and plant your feet about shoulder width apart with toes slightly out.
Tighten your abdomen and bend at the hips and knees, allowing your torso to lean forward as the bar follows the rails.
Lower within a controlled range while keeping your heels planted.
Push through your feet to stand, then repeat and rehook the bar.
description: A lower bar position across the rear shoulders changes the torso angle of this Smith squat. The quadriceps and glutes work together to stand.

name: Smith Standing Biceps Curl
instructions: Set the Smith bar at thigh height and stand close to it with your feet planted.
Grip the bar about shoulder width apart with your palms facing forward and release the hooks.
Bend your elbows to raise the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your torso still as your elbows adjust to the guided path.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Repeat without swinging your body, then secure the bar.
description: Curl the guided Smith bar from the thighs toward the shoulders. The biceps bend the elbows while the forearms maintain the grip.

name: Smith Decline Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench beneath the Smith bar with your feet secured under its pads.
Grip the bar with your palms toward your feet and your hands slightly narrower than shoulder width.
Release the hooks and lower the bar toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows near your sides.
Press the bar upward by straightening your elbows.
Lower with control for the next repetition, then rehook the bar when finished.
description: A close grip on the decline Smith press emphasizes elbow extension by the triceps. The chest and shoulders also help press the bar.
aliases: Smith Machine Decline Close Grip Bench Press

name: Smith Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Position an incline bench so the Smith bar can lower behind your head, and set the safety stops for your range.
Lie back with your feet planted. Grip the bar narrowly with your palms toward your feet, unhook it and hold it above and slightly behind your head.
Keep your upper arms angled upward as you bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your elbows to raise the bar, keeping your upper arms as still as the guided path allows.
Rehook the bar securely after the set.
description: Bending and straightening the elbows against the Smith bar works the triceps. An incline bench supports the torso throughout the movement.

name: Smith Decline Close Underhand Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench under the Smith bar and secure your feet beneath the pads.
Hold the bar with your hands close together and your palms facing toward your head.
Release the hooks and lower the bar toward your lower chest through a controlled, comfortable range.
Press the bar back up along the rails while keeping your wrists aligned with your forearms.
Repeat under control and secure the hooks when finished.
description: This decline Smith press combines a close hand position with an underhand grip. The triceps, chest and shoulders share the pressing effort.
aliases: Smith Machine Reverse Decline Close Grip Bench Press

name: Smith Narrow-Grip Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand facing a low Smith bar and grip it with your palms toward your legs and hands close together.
Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back and lean forward from your hips with your back held steady.
Let your arms extend toward the floor, then bend your elbows to pull the bar toward your abdomen.
Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid jerking your torso upward.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.
description: A narrow-grip row pulls the Smith bar toward the abdomen from a bent-over stance. The lats and upper back work with the elbow flexors.

name: Smith Single-Arm Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand side-on to the low Smith bar with your feet staggered and knees softly bent.
Lean forward from your hips and grasp the bar with the hand nearest it; rest your other hand on your thigh for support.
Keep your torso steady as you pull your elbow back and raise the bar toward your hip.
Lower the bar slowly to straighten your arm.
Complete the set, then turn around and repeat with the other arm.
description: One arm rows the Smith bar while the free hand supports the bent-over torso on the thigh. The lats, upper back and biceps perform the pull.

name: Smith Single-Leg Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Place the Smith bar across your upper back, grip it with both hands and release the hooks.
Stand on one foot on the floor and bend the other knee to lift that foot behind you.
Keeping the supporting knee nearly straight, push through the ball of that foot to lift your heel.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your heel to the floor under control.
Repeat on that leg, then switch sides.
description: This floor-based calf raise uses one leg at a time with the Smith bar across the shoulders. The calf lifts the heel against the added load.
aliases: Smith One Leg Floor Calf Raise

name: Smith Rear-Delt Row
instructions: Stand facing the low Smith bar with your feet planted and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward and grip the bar wider than shoulder width with your palms toward your legs.
Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen or lower chest, letting your elbows travel outward.
Keep your torso still as you draw your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms extend and repeat.
description: Flared elbows make this bent-over Smith row a rear-shoulder and upper-back movement. The biceps assist as the elbows bend.

name: Smith Standing Toe Raise
instructions: Set a sturdy low platform under the Smith bar and place the bar across your upper back.
Position both heels on the platform edge so your forefeet extend beyond it, and release the hooks.
Keep your knees nearly straight and lower your forefeet under control.
Lift your toes and forefeet toward your shins while your heels remain supported.
Repeat the small ankle movement without rocking your hips.
description: The heels stay supported while the forefeet lift and lower. This dorsiflexion movement works the tibialis anterior at the front of the shin.

name: Smith Behind-The-Back Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Stand with the Smith bar behind your thighs and grasp it with both hands, keeping your arms straight.
Release the hooks and plant both feet on the floor about hip width apart.
Keep your knees nearly straight as you push through the balls of your feet to lift both heels.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Repeat without swinging the bar or bending your elbows.
description: Hold the Smith bar behind the hips while performing a calf raise from the floor. The load is carried by the hands throughout the heel lift.

name: Smith Underhand Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand facing the low Smith bar and grip it about shoulder width apart with your palms facing forward.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back steady.
Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen with your elbows close to your sides.
Pause briefly without lifting your torso, then extend your arms to lower the bar.
Repeat with controlled movement.
description: An underhand grip keeps the elbows close during this Smith row. The lats and upper back pull the arms back while the biceps bend the elbows.
aliases: Smith Reverse Grip Bent over Row

name: Smith Flat Underhand Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench beneath the Smith bar and set the safety stops.
Lie on your back with your feet planted and take a grip just wider than shoulder width with palms facing your head.
Release the hooks and lower the bar toward your chest with your elbows close to your torso.
Press upward while keeping your wrists aligned with your forearms and your back supported.
Repeat under control, then secure the hooks.
description: This flat-bench Smith press uses an underhand grip. The chest, triceps and shoulders work together to raise the bar.

name: Smith Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench beneath the Smith bar and place one foot flat on the floor beneath your knee.
Position the bar across the thigh of the working leg just above the knee and steady it with your hands.
Keep the other foot on the floor as you lift the working heel as high as you can control.
Lower the working heel back to the floor without letting the bar shift.
Repeat, then reposition the bar and foot to work the other calf.
description: The Smith bar rests on one thigh while that heel rises and returns to the floor. The bent knee changes the calf-raise position from the standing variations.
aliases: Smith Seated One Leg Calf Raise

name: Smith Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench under the Smith bar with your back supported and feet on the floor.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width with your palms forward and release the hooks.
Lower the bar in front of your face toward shoulder level, keeping your forearms beneath it.
Press overhead until your arms extend without lifting your back from the pad.
Lower slowly for the next repetition and rehook the bar when finished.
description: An upright bench supports the torso during this Smith overhead press. The shoulders raise the arms and the triceps straighten the elbows.

name: Smith Seated Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench facing the low Smith bar with your feet planted.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just beyond your knees.
Keep your forearms down as you bend your wrists to raise the bar toward your forearms.
Lower the bar slowly through the same small wrist movement.
description: Rest the forearms on the thighs and curl the Smith bar with the wrists. The wrist flexors in the forearms produce the small movement.

name: Smith Seated Wide-Grip Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench beneath the Smith bar with your back supported and both feet planted.
Grip wider than shoulder-width with your palms facing forward and release the bar hooks.
Start with the bar in front of your upper chest and your elbows out to the sides.
Press the bar upward along the rails until your arms are extended.
Lower under control in front of your face, repeat, and secure the bar when finished.
description: This seated Smith press uses a wide hand position. The shoulders and triceps press the bar overhead while the bench supports the back.

name: Smith Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the Smith bar in front of your thighs with your palms toward you.
Release the hooks and keep your elbows straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears without rolling them or bending your elbows.
Lower your shoulders slowly, then secure the bar after the set.
