description: Lift and lower the shoulders while holding the Smith bar at arm length in front of the thighs. The trapezius elevates the shoulder blades.

name: Smith Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Place a bench behind you inside the Smith machine and set the bar across your upper back.
Grip the bar, release the hooks and place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Keep your front foot planted far enough forward to lower into a split squat.
Bend the front knee and hip as your rear knee moves toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise without moving the bench-supported rear foot.
Complete the set and repeat with the other leg in front.
description: The rear foot rests on a bench while the front leg performs most of the squat. The Smith bar adds load across the upper back for the quadriceps and glutes.

name: Smith Split Squat
instructions: Place the Smith bar across your upper back and hold it securely with both hands.
Release the hooks and set a split stance with one foot forward and the other behind, rear heel raised.
Keep both feet in place as you bend your knees and lower your rear knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to straighten your legs and return to the top of the split stance.
Repeat, then change legs after securing the bar.
description: Both feet stay in a split stance while you lower and raise the body under the Smith bar. This variation works the front leg quadriceps and glutes.

name: Smith Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar near shoulder height and adjust the safety stops below your planned squat depth.
Step under the bar so it rests on your upper back and hold it outside your shoulders.
Release the hooks and plant your feet about shoulder width apart, toes slightly out.
Bend your hips and knees to lower while keeping your heels down and abdomen firm.
Drive through both feet to stand tall without forcefully locking your knees.
Repeat and secure the hooks before stepping away.
description: Squat with the bar supported on Smith-machine rails and the feet planted throughout. The quadriceps and glutes work together to straighten the legs and hips.

name: Smith Behind-The-Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand with the Smith bar behind your hips and hold it with both hands, palms facing backward.
Keep your arms straight and the bar close behind your thighs.
Bend only your wrists to curl the bar upward in your hands.
Lower the bar through the same small wrist movement under control.
Repeat without bending your elbows or moving your shoulders.
description: The wrists flex while the Smith bar is held behind the hips. The forearm muscles move and support the bar through a small range.

name: Smith Standing Behind-The-Neck Press
instructions: Set the Smith bar near shoulder height and stand with it behind your head.
Hold the bar wider than shoulder width, palms forward, and release the hooks while keeping your feet planted.
Tighten your abdomen and press the bar overhead until your elbows extend.
Lower the bar behind your head only through a range your shoulders can control without pushing your head forward.
Repeat, then secure the hooks before stepping away.
description: Press the Smith bar overhead from behind the head while standing. This shoulder and triceps exercise requires control of a wide, externally rotated arm position.
aliases: Smith Standing behind Head Military Press

name: Smith Calf Raise with Bar Held at Thighs
instructions: Stand inside the Smith machine and hold the bar at thigh level with both arms straight.
Release the hooks and plant both feet about hip width apart on the floor.
Keeping your knees nearly straight, push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels.
Pause briefly, then lower both heels to the floor.
Repeat without using your arms to lift the bar.
description: The Smith bar is held at arm length while both heels rise from the floor. The calves lift the body and load together.

name: Smith Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Stand under the Smith bar with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your abdomen gently tightened.
Hold the bar just wider than shoulder-width with your palms facing forward and release the hooks.
Lower the bar in front of your face toward shoulder level.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight, keeping your torso steady.
Lower under control and secure the hooks after the set.
description: A standing overhead press raises the Smith bar from the front shoulders. The shoulders and triceps press while the abdomen steadies the torso.

name: Smith Sumo Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar near shoulder height and place it across your upper back.
Grip the bar, release its hooks and take a stance wider than shoulder width with your toes turned outward.
Keep your heels planted as you bend your knees and hips, guiding your knees in the direction of your toes.
Lower into a squat within your controlled range.
Push through both feet to stand, then repeat and rehook the bar.
description: A wide stance distinguishes this Smith squat. The quadriceps, glutes and adductors work together as you lower and stand.

name: Smith Seated Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Sit on a flat bench under the Smith bar with both feet flat on the floor and knees bent.
Position the bar across your thighs just above the knees and steady it with your hands.
Push through the balls of both feet to lift your heels and raise the bar.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Repeat while keeping your feet in place and the bar balanced across your thighs.
description: A seated calf raise lifts the Smith bar from the thighs as the heels rise off the floor. The knees remain bent throughout.

name: Smith Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet planted and hold the Smith bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing your thighs.
Keep your torso upright as you lift the bar close to your body, moving your elbows outward and upward.
Stop at a comfortable height without shrugging your head forward or forcing the wrists.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms extend.
Repeat with the same controlled path.
description: The elbows rise outward as the Smith bar travels up the front of the body. The shoulders and trapezius work with the elbow flexors.

name: Smith Wide-Grip Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench beneath the Smith bar with your feet planted.
Grip well outside shoulder-width with your palms toward your feet and wrists aligned above your forearms.
Release the hooks and lower the bar slowly toward your chest, letting your elbows move outward.
Press the bar up until your arms are nearly straight.
Secure the hooks before getting up.
description: A wide hand position is used to press the Smith bar from a flat bench. The chest performs the main pressing action with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Smith Wide-Grip Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench beneath the Smith bar with your feet secured under the pads.
Grip well outside shoulder-width with your palms toward your feet and wrists aligned above your forearms.
Release the hooks and lower the bar slowly toward your chest with your elbows moving outward.
Press the bar up until your arms are nearly straight.
Secure the hooks before getting up.
description: Press the Smith bar while lying on a decline bench with a wide grip. The chest, triceps and shoulders raise the guided load.
aliases: Smith Wide Grip Decline Bench Press

name: Barbell Snatch Pull
instructions: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and grip widely with your palms facing your legs and your arms outside your knees.
Bend your knees and hips to reach the bar while keeping your back firm and shoulders above the hips.
Push through the floor to lift the bar close past your shins and knees, keeping your arms long.
As the bar reaches the upper thighs, extend your hips and knees quickly and rise through your ankles.
Shrug your shoulders as the bar rises, without turning it over into an overhead catch.
Lower the bar close to your legs and reset on the floor for the next repetition.
description: The snatch pull trains the floor pull and explosive extension of a snatch without an overhead catch. The legs and hips drive the bar while the upper back completes the shrug.

name: Dumbbell Spell Caster
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and turn your torso so both dumbbells are lowered beside one hip.
Straighten upward and rotate toward the front as you sweep both dumbbells diagonally up to about shoulder height.
Keep your elbows softly bent and move your trunk and arms together without jerking your lower back.
Reverse the path to the starting hip and repeat, then perform the movement from the other side.
description: Both dumbbells move together from one hip toward the front of the body in this diagonal lift. The obliques rotate the torso while the shoulders lift the arms.

name: Prone Sphinx Lift
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and forearms on the floor beside your chest.
Press gently into your forearms to lift your chest, keeping your pelvis and legs resting on the floor.
Lengthen through your neck and stop at a comfortable amount of back extension.
Pause briefly, then lower your chest under control and repeat.
description: The upper body lifts from a prone position using forearm support while the pelvis stays down. This is a gentle back-extension mobility movement.

name: Low Push-Up Spider Knee Drive
instructions: Support yourself on your palms and toes with your elbows bent and chest held close to the floor.
Keep your abdomen firm and lift one foot from the floor.
Bring that knee outward toward the elbow on the same side while maintaining the low upper-body position.
Extend the leg back to the starting position under control.
Repeat the knee drive and then work the other side, keeping your hips level.
description: A knee draws outward toward the same-side elbow while the upper body holds a low push-up position. The chest and triceps support the body as the abdomen and hip flexors control the leg.

name: Seated Spine Stretch Forward
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended in front and slightly apart.
Reach both arms forward at shoulder height.
Tuck your chin gently and round your upper body forward, reaching your hands toward your feet without bouncing.
Hold a comfortable stretch with your hips resting on the floor.
Slowly lift your torso back to an upright seated position.
description: From a seated position with straight legs, reach forward and gently round your back to stretch the back and hamstrings.

name: Seated Spine Twist
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended in front.
Bend your elbows and hold your forearms across the front of your chest.
Keep your pelvis and legs still as you turn your upper body to one side.
Return to the centre without leaning backward.
Complete the repetitions, then turn toward the other side.
description: Turn the torso to one side and return while sitting with the legs extended. The obliques guide the rotation and the abdomen helps maintain the upright position.

name: Bodyweight Split Squat
instructions: Set a split stance with one foot forward and one behind, keeping enough sideways space to balance.
Keep both feet in place as you bend the knees and lower your rear knee toward the floor.
Maintain a controlled torso and keep the front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to the top of the split stance.
Repeat, then change which foot is forward.
description: Lower and raise the body while keeping the feet in a split stance. The front-leg quadriceps and glutes perform most of the work.

name: Barbell Squat Jerk
instructions: Stand with the bar supported on the fronts of your shoulders, hands just outside the shoulders and feet under your hips.
Keep your torso upright and make a short dip by bending your knees.
Drive forcefully through your legs to propel the bar upward.
Move quickly under the rising bar and lock your arms overhead as you descend into a deep squat with both feet beneath you.
Stabilize the bar over your shoulders and midfoot, then stand by extending your knees and hips.
Lower the bar to the shoulders under control and reset before the next repetition.
description: The squat jerk uses a short leg drive followed by a deep squat catch with the bar overhead. It combines lower-body power with demanding overhead balance and control.

name: Bosu Dome Squat
instructions: Place the BOSU with its flat base on the floor and dome facing upward.
Step onto the dome with both feet and establish your balance before moving.
Hold your arms forward and bend your knees and hips into a controlled squat.
Keep your feet supported and your knees aligned with your toes as you lower only as far as you can balance.
Press through both feet to stand and repeat.
description: Squat while standing on the rounded dome of a BOSU. The quadriceps and glutes move the body while the unstable surface adds a balance challenge.

name: Squat to Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, extend your arms overhead, reaching towards the ceiling.
Return to the starting position by lowering your arms and bending your knees to squat down again.
Repeat.
description: Move from a squat into a tall standing reach. This bodyweight mobility drill combines leg extension with an overhead arm movement.

name: Squat to Overhead Reach with Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Bend your knees and push your hips back into a squat.
Stand up, reach both arms overhead and turn toward one side, allowing the opposite heel to rise.
Turn back to the front as you lower your arms and squat again.
Complete the repetitions, then turn toward the other side.
description: Rise from a squat into an overhead reach and a turn to one side, then return to the squat. The drill combines leg movement with shoulder and trunk mobility.

name: Stability Ball Full-Range Crunch
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward until the ball supports your lower and middle back.
Plant your feet apart on the floor and place your hands lightly behind your head.
Let your upper back extend over the ball within a comfortable range.
Tighten your abdomen and curl your chest toward your pelvis without pulling on your neck.
Lower your upper back over the ball again under control and repeat.
description: The ball supports the back as the torso extends and then curls forward. The abs work through a longer trunk movement than a floor crunch.
aliases: Stability Ball Crunch (Full Range Hands behind Head)

name: Stalder Press to Handstand
instructions: Begin in a straddle support on the floor, with your straight legs spread outside your arms and palms planted beside your hips.
Press firmly through your hands and keep your elbows straight as you lift your hips and feet clear of the floor.
Lean your shoulders forward enough to shift your hips over your hands, lifting your straddled legs upward.
Bring your legs together as you reach a balanced handstand with the body stacked above the hands.
Reverse the movement slowly, separating the legs and lowering them outside the arms back to the straddle support.
description: A straight-arm press lifts the body from a straddle support into a handstand. It requires advanced shoulder strength, hip compression and balance.

name: Standing Archer Mobility
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and your knees relaxed.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height.
Keep one arm reaching ahead while you bend the other elbow and draw it back, turning your chest toward the drawing arm.
Return the arms forward and lower them to your sides.
Repeat, then change which arm draws backward.
description: Raise both arms in front, then draw one elbow backward as if pulling a bowstring. The shoulders and upper back move through a controlled range as the torso turns.

name: Barbell Standing Behind-The-Neck Press
instructions: Stand with your feet planted and the bar behind your head, with a wide grip and palms facing forward.
Keep your abdomen firm and your head aligned with your torso.
Press the bar upward until your arms extend overhead without using a leg dip.
Lower behind your head within a range your shoulders can control, avoiding a forced forward head position.
Repeat with control.
description: Press a barbell overhead from behind the head while standing. The shoulders and triceps work through a wide-arm overhead position.

name: Standing Calf Raise on Step
instructions: Stand with the balls of both feet on a sturdy step and your heels beyond its edge.
Use a railing or wall for balance if needed.
Keep your knees nearly straight and lift your heels through a controlled range.
Lower your heels slowly below the edge, then repeat.
description: Raise and lower the heels while the balls of the feet stay on a step. The calves lift the body through the ankle movement.

name: Wall-Supported Calf Raise
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place both hands against it for balance.
Keep both feet on the floor and your knees nearly straight.
Press through the balls of your feet to lift both heels.
Pause briefly, then lower your heels to the floor under control.
Repeat without pushing your body upward with your hands.
description: Use the wall for balance while raising and lowering both heels from the floor. The calves perform the lift.

name: Bench-Supported Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a bench and place one heel on its surface with that knee bent.
Lean forward and hold the front of the raised foot with your hands.
Gently draw the toes toward your shin while gradually straightening the raised knee to the extent you can control.
Pause when you feel a comfortable stretch in the calf, keeping the heel supported.
Release gently and repeat on the other leg.
description: A bench supports the heel while the hands draw the toes back toward the shin. Straightening the raised leg also lengthens the back of the thigh.

name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch with Strap
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly forward and loop a strap around the ball of that foot.
Keep the front heel down and hold the strap ends in both hands.
Lean forward from the hips with the front knee nearly straight, gently pulling the toes toward the shin.
Pause at a comfortable stretch through the calf and back of the thigh.
Release the pull, stand upright and change legs.
description: A strap draws the toes upward as you lean forward over an extended leg. This standing stretch lengthens the hamstrings and calf of one leg at a time.

name: Standing Overhead Side Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet apart and knees relaxed.
Raise one arm overhead and bend that elbow so your hand rests behind your head.
Keep both feet planted as you bend your torso gently away from the raised arm.
Pause at a comfortable stretch along the raised-arm side, without turning your chest toward the floor.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.
description: An overhead arm position lengthens the side of the torso as you bend away from it. The stretch reaches the lats and side waist.

name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip width apart and knees softly bent.
Place your hands near your hips to help feel the movement.
Gently tip your pelvis forward to increase the curve in your lower back, then tuck it back to reduce the curve.
Keep the movement small and avoid shifting your whole body forward and backward.
Continue slowly between the two positions with relaxed breathing.
description: Small forward and backward pelvic tilts change the curve of the lower back. This standing mobility drill uses abdominal and lower-back control.

name: Standing Bodyweight Leg Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one leg and lift the other foot off the floor.
Keep that thigh beside the supporting thigh as you bend the knee to bring your heel toward your buttock.
Lower the foot slowly, then repeat before switching legs.
description: Bend one knee to bring the heel toward the buttock while balancing on the other leg. The hamstrings perform the unloaded knee curl.

name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Stand with your feet planted and bend forward to grasp the ab wheel handles on the floor.
Tighten your abdomen and roll the wheel away as you extend your hips and shoulders, keeping your knees off the floor.
Stop before your lower back sags or you lose control of the wheel.
Pull the wheel back toward your feet while lifting your hips to return to the folded starting position.
Repeat with a range you can control throughout.
description: The ab wheel rolls forward from the feet-supported position into a long body line. The abs resist back extension as the shoulders and lats help return the wheel.

name: Star Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet near each other and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, then jump upward.
In the air, spread your legs and lift your arms out to form a star shape.
Bring your feet back under you before landing softly with your knees bent.
Reset your balance and repeat.
description: Jump upward and spread the arms and legs in the air, then bring the feet together for landing. This explosive bodyweight drill raises the cardiovascular demand.

name: Seated Indoor Cycling
instructions: Adjust the saddle so your knee remains slightly bent when the pedal is farthest from you.
Sit on the saddle, place your feet on the pedals and hold the handlebars with relaxed shoulders.
Pedal smoothly while keeping your hips settled on the seat.
Choose a pace and resistance that let you maintain that rhythm.
Slow your pedaling gradually before stopping.
description: Seated cycling on an indoor bike provides continuous cardiovascular exercise. The legs alternate through each pedal revolution.

name: Upright Stationary Cycling
instructions: Adjust the saddle height so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Sit upright on the saddle with your feet on the pedals and hands resting on the handlebars.
Begin pedaling smoothly, alternating the work of both legs.
Maintain a comfortable posture and controlled rhythm for the planned duration.
Reduce your pace gradually before coming to a stop.
description: Pedal an upright stationary bike while supported on the saddle. This is a cycling exercise for the cardiovascular system and legs.

name: Floor Straddle Maltese Hold
instructions: Place your palms on the floor in a wide position beside and behind the shoulder line, with your legs spread apart.
Keep your elbows straight and lean forward until your hands support your body.
Lift your legs clear of the floor and hold your torso low and roughly parallel to the ground.
Maintain the straddle and steady shoulder position for the hold.
Lower your feet to the floor under control to finish.
description: This advanced floor hold supports the body on widely placed straight arms with the legs straddled off the ground. The shoulders and chest resist the long body lever while the abdomen holds alignment.

name: Straddle Planche Hold
instructions: Plant your hands about shoulder width apart and spread your legs behind you.
Keep your elbows straight as you lean your shoulders forward beyond your wrists.
Press through your hands and lift both feet clear of the floor.
Hold your torso and legs roughly parallel to the ground with your hips level and abdomen firm.
Lower your feet gently when ending the hold.
description: Hold the body horizontally on straight arms with the legs spread apart. The shoulders support the body while the abdomen and hips maintain the line.

name: Standing Straight-Leg Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand tall with your feet close together and transfer your weight onto one leg.
Keep your pelvis level and the other knee nearly straight.
Lift the free leg out to the side without leaning your torso away.
Lower the leg slowly back beside the standing leg.
Repeat on the same side, then change legs.
description: One straight leg moves out to the side while you balance on the other. The outer hip muscles, especially the gluteus medius, perform the lift.

name: Long-Lever Superman Push-Up
instructions: Lie face down with both palms on the floor well in front of your shoulders and toes tucked under.
Tighten your abdomen and keep your body aligned from shoulders to heels.
Press into both palms and toes to raise your torso away from the floor while keeping your hands in the forward position.
Lower your body slowly without letting your lower back sag.
Repeat with both hands and both feet supported throughout.
description: With the hands far ahead of the shoulders, the body rises and lowers on the palms and toes while the elbows stay nearly straight. The abdomen keeps the trunk steady as the shoulders and upper-body muscles support the long lever.

name: Ring Abdominal Fallout
instructions: Set securely anchored rings at about waist height and stand facing away from the anchor with a ring in each hand.
Hold your arms in front and keep a straight line through your torso and legs.
Allow your body to lean forward as your straight arms reach overhead along the straps.
Stop before your lower back sags, keeping your abdomen tight.
Pull your arms back down and return your body to the upright starting position.
description: The body leans forward while the ring-supported arms extend overhead. The abs resist back extension and the shoulders and lats help draw the body upright.

name: Ring Push-Up
instructions: Secure two rings overhead and adjust them to hang a short distance above the floor, at equal height.
Grip the rings and step your feet back until your body forms a straight line supported by your hands and toes.
Keep your abdomen firm as you bend your elbows and lower your chest between the rings.
Press through the rings to straighten your arms without letting them drift apart.
Repeat with controlled lowering and a steady body line.
description: Push-ups on rings use moving hand supports while the toes stay on the floor. The chest and triceps press as the shoulders and abdomen stabilize the body.

name: Suspension Knee Tuck
instructions: Set the suspension straps low and place both feet in the foot cradles.
Put your palms on the floor beneath your shoulders and straighten your arms into a plank.
Tighten your abdomen, bend both knees and draw them toward your chest as your hips rise slightly.
Extend your legs back to the plank slowly without letting your back sag.
Repeat while keeping your shoulders supported over your hands.
description: Suspended feet slide forward as both knees tuck under the torso. The abs control the pelvis while the hip flexors draw the thighs forward.

name: Ring Inverted Row
instructions: Grip securely anchored rings with your palms facing each other and walk your feet forward.
Lean back with your arms straight and heels on the floor, keeping your body in a firm line.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest toward the rings.
Draw your shoulder blades together without lifting your chin or dropping your hips.
Extend your arms slowly to lower and repeat.
description: Pull the chest toward the rings while the heels stay grounded. The upper back, lats and biceps raise the body from the inclined position.

name: Suspension Rear-Foot Split Squat
instructions: Stand facing away from the suspension anchor and place one foot in a low foot cradle behind you.
Plant the other foot in front and find your balance with an upright torso.
Bend the front knee and hip as the suspended rear foot moves backward and your rear knee lowers.
Push through the front foot to return to standing without pulling yourself up with the rear leg.
Complete the set, then change legs.
description: The rear foot rests in a suspension strap while the front leg performs the split squat. The quadriceps and glutes work against bodyweight with an added balance demand.

name: Prone Alternating Swimmer
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs long.
Tighten your abdomen gently and keep your gaze toward the floor.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg a short distance while keeping the other pair lower.
Lower that pair as you lift the opposite arm and leg.
Continue alternating without jerking your neck or forcing your lower back.
description: Opposite arms and legs lift alternately from a prone position. The back, glutes and shoulders coordinate the small swimming motion.

name: Bar Swing 360
instructions: Use a secure high bar with clear space around it and start in a controlled two-hand hang.
Build a swing by moving your legs and hips together while keeping a secure grip.
At the rising part of the swing, release the bar and turn your whole body through a full rotation.
Spot the bar as you complete the turn and catch it again with both hands.
Absorb the return into a controlled hang and settle the swing before another attempt.
description: This advanced freestyle bar skill combines a swing, full-body release turn and regrasp. The shoulders, lats and abdomen coordinate the movement around the bar.

name: Three-Bench Dip
instructions: Arrange two stable benches beside your hips and a third in front for your feet.
Place one hand on each side bench and both heels on the front bench, with your legs extended.
Support your body on your hands and heels, keeping your hips between the side benches.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips within a comfortable shoulder range.
Press through both palms to straighten your arms and repeat.
description: Each hand rests on a separate bench and both heels rest on a third. The triceps extend the elbows to raise the body between the supports.

name: Tire Flip
instructions: Stand close to the tire with your feet apart and bend your hips and knees to reach under its near edge.
Grip the lower tread securely and keep your back firm with your chest close to the tire.
Drive forward and upward through your legs and hips to raise the tire.
As it approaches upright, move your hands from underneath to a pushing position on the tread.
Push the tire away to tip it over, releasing your hands and staying clear as it lands.
Reset your stance on the next repetition.
description: Lift one edge of a tire and then push it over onto the opposite side. The legs and hips start the lift before the upper body completes the push.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar with your feet about hip width apart.
Bend your hips and knees to grip the handles beside your legs, palms facing inward.
Tighten your abdomen and keep your back steady as you push through the floor.
Stand by extending your hips and knees together, keeping your arms straight.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower the bar to the floor, then reset for the next repetition.
description: Lift a trap bar while standing inside its frame and holding the side handles. The glutes and quadriceps extend the hips and knees as the back maintains position.

name: Parallel-Bar Triceps Dip
instructions: Grip the parallel dip handles and press up until your feet are clear of the floor.
Keep your torso fairly upright and bend your knees behind you.
Bend your elbows to lower your body between the handles within a comfortable shoulder range.
Press down through the handles to straighten your elbows and return to the top.
Repeat without swinging your legs.
description: Support the body between parallel handles and lower and raise it through the arms. An upright torso keeps the emphasis on the triceps, with the chest and shoulders assisting.

name: Bench Dip with Heels Elevated
instructions: Place two stable benches opposite each other.
Sit on the edge of one bench, grip beside your hips and put both heels on the other bench with legs extended.
Move your hips just clear of the hand-supporting bench and hold your body on your hands and heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips, staying close to the bench and within a comfortable shoulder range.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and repeat.
description: Elevating the heels on a second bench increases the demand of a bench dip. The triceps move the body while the shoulders and chest assist.

name: L-Sit Dip Between Benches
instructions: Place two stable benches parallel to each other with enough room for your body between them.
Place one palm on each bench beside your hips and press through your hands to support your body.
Raise both legs straight in front of you and keep your heels clear of the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your torso between the benches through a controlled shoulder range.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms while keeping the legs raised.
description: Support each hand on a separate bench and hold both legs straight in front, clear of the floor, while bending and straightening the elbows. The triceps press the body up while the abdomen and hip flexors hold the legs.

name: Floor Triceps Dip
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet planted and palms beside and slightly behind your hips.
Point your fingers toward your feet and press through your hands to lift your hips a little.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor through a short range.
Straighten your elbows to lift again while your feet remain planted.
Repeat without pushing your shoulders into an uncomfortable position.
description: The hands and feet stay on the floor during this short-range dip. Bending and straightening the elbows works the triceps.

name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension on Bar
instructions: Grip a firmly fixed bar around waist height with both hands about shoulder width apart.
Step your feet back and lean forward so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your upper arms directed toward the bar as you bend your elbows, bringing your forehead toward and just below the bar.
Straighten your elbows to press your body away without bending at the hips.
Repeat slowly while maintaining the body line.
description: The body tilts against a fixed bar as the elbows bend and straighten. The triceps move the body while the abdomen keeps it aligned.

name: Standing Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your shoulders relaxed.
Bring one arm across the front of your chest at about shoulder height.
Use the opposite hand or forearm to draw that upper arm gently closer to your body, without pressing directly on the elbow joint.
Hold a comfortable stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Release and repeat with the other arm.
description: Drawing an arm across the chest stretches the rear shoulder. The opposite arm supplies gentle assistance.

name: Tuck Crunch with Arms Crossed
instructions: Lie on your back and raise your legs with both hips and knees bent, keeping your feet off the floor.
Cross your hands over your chest and keep your neck relaxed.
Tighten your abdomen to curl your head and shoulder blades upward toward your knees.
Lower your shoulders under control while keeping the legs bent and elevated.
Repeat without extending the legs or pulling your head forward.
description: Curl the upper body while holding the legs in a raised bent-knee position. The abs perform the crunch and the hip flexors help hold the legs.

name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit on a flat bench between two high pulleys with your feet planted.
Hold one handle in each hand with your palms facing each other and arms reaching upward.
Keep your torso steady as you draw both elbows down and pull the handles toward your upper chest.
Slowly extend your arms upward without letting the load lift you off the bench.
description: Two separate high-cable handles provide a palms-facing grip for a seated pulldown. The lats draw the upper arms down while the biceps bend the elbows.
aliases: Twin Handle Parallel Grip Lat Pulldown

name: Glute Bridge with Overhead Reach
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Bend your elbows beside your body and tighten your abdomen.
Press through your feet to lift your hips while reaching one arm overhead and across toward the opposite side.
Allow your upper body to turn slightly onto the opposite shoulder while keeping both feet planted.
Return the reaching arm and lower your hips, then repeat and change sides.
description: An overhead cross-body reach adds trunk rotation to a glute bridge. The glutes extend the hips while the obliques help control the turn.

name: Captains Chair Diagonal Straight-Leg Raise
instructions: Place your forearms on the station pads, grip the handles and let your legs hang with your back supported.
Tighten your abdomen and raise both nearly straight legs forward on a diagonal toward one side.
Lift to about hip height without swinging your shoulders away from the pads.
Lower your legs slowly back beneath you.
Repeat on that side, then work the opposite diagonal.
description: Both straight legs lift diagonally from a forearm-supported upright position. The hip flexors lift the thighs and the abdomen controls the angled pelvis position.

name: Captains Chair Diagonal Leg Raise
instructions: Support your forearms on the station pads and hold the handles with your legs hanging beneath you.
Keep your back supported and gently tighten your abdomen.
Raise both legs together on a diagonal toward one side, keeping the knees nearly straight.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.
Repeat, then change the diagonal to work the other side.
description: The legs move together diagonally while the forearms support the body on a captains chair. The hip flexors lift the legs and the abs and obliques control the torso and pelvis.

name: Standing Double Toe Touch with Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand tall with your feet close together and reach both arms overhead.
Lower your arms as you fold forward toward your toes, letting your knees soften slightly.
Rise a short distance within the forward fold, then reach toward your toes a second time without bouncing or forcing the range.
Rise slowly back to standing and extend your arms overhead again.
Repeat the two controlled toe reaches followed by the overhead reach.
description: Perform two controlled reaches toward the toes before standing and reaching both arms overhead. This mobility drill moves the hamstrings, spine and shoulders.
aliases: Standing Toe Touch with Overhead Reach

name: Standing Upper-Back Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet planted and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Reach your hands forward at shoulder height, turning your palms away if comfortable.
Gently round your upper back and let your shoulder blades spread apart.
Hold the stretch while keeping your shoulders away from your ears.
Release slowly and repeat as needed.
description: Reach the hands forward to spread the shoulder blades and lengthen the upper back. The movement stays in front of the body.

name: Upward-Facing Dog with Toes Tucked
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and your toes tucked under against the floor.
Place your palms beside your lower ribs and draw your elbows close.
Press through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your chest, supporting your body through your palms and feet.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and lengthen through your neck without forcing the gaze upward.
Pause comfortably, then lower with control.
description: This supported back-extension position lifts the chest between straight arms. The front of the torso lengthens while the arms and back maintain the posture.

name: Floor L-Sit to V-Sit Raise
instructions: Sit with your legs extended in front and plant your palms beside your hips.
Press down with straight arms to lift your hips and heels clear of the floor into an L-sit.
Keep your knees straight and raise both legs toward your face, folding more deeply at the hips.
Pause in the high V position without bending your elbows.
Lower your legs back to the L-sit under control and repeat.
description: Straight arms support the body as both legs rise from an L-sit toward a V-sit. The hip flexors lift the legs and the abs control the pelvis.

name: Captains Chair Knee Raise
instructions: Place your forearms on the support pads, grip the handles and rest your back against the pad.
Let your legs hang beneath you and tighten your abdomen.
Bend your knees and draw them upward toward your chest, allowing the pelvis to curl at the top.
Lower slowly and extend your legs back beneath you without swinging.
Repeat while maintaining steady forearm support.
description: The knees tuck upward from a captains chair with the forearms supported. The hip flexors lift the thighs and the abs curl and stabilize the pelvis.

name: Elliptical Cross Trainer
instructions: Step onto the elliptical pedals and hold the moving handles lightly.
Begin moving the pedals in a smooth alternating rhythm while pushing and pulling the handles.
Keep your feet on the pedals and your torso upright without hanging your weight on the handles.
Adjust resistance to maintain a controlled pace for your planned duration.
Gradually slow the pedals before stepping off.
description: The feet follow an elliptical path while the arms move the handles in opposition. This continuous whole-body movement trains the cardiovascular system.

name: Walking Lunge with High Knee
instructions: Stand tall with your feet under your hips.
Lift one knee toward your chest, then step that foot forward into a lunge.
Bend both knees to lower while keeping your chest upright.
Push through the front foot to rise and bring the rear leg forward into a high knee lift.
Step into the next lunge with that leg and continue alternating as you move forward.
description: A high knee lift links each step of a walking lunge. The quadriceps and glutes drive the lunges while the hip flexors lift the advancing leg.

name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right leg, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your torso controlled and guide the front knee in the same direction as your toes.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left foot forward, stepping into a lunge position with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs and walking forward, maintaining a controlled and steady pace.
description: Step forward into alternating lunges while traveling across the floor. The quadriceps and glutes lift the body from each split stance.

name: Incline Treadmill Walking
instructions: Start the treadmill at a slow walking pace and establish a steady stride.
Increase the incline to your chosen level while keeping your body upright.
Walk with natural alternating steps and relaxed arm movement.
Use a pace and incline that let you avoid leaning on the front console.
Reduce the incline and speed gradually, then stop the belt before stepping off.
description: Walk on a treadmill with its belt inclined upward. The legs alternate to maintain a continuous cardiovascular workload.

name: Stepmill Stair Climbing
instructions: Step onto the stationary stepmill and use its rails while setting your starting pace.
Climb the moving steps by placing one foot and then the other on each tread.
Keep your torso upright and use the rails lightly for balance.
Continue with steady alternating steps at a controlled pace.
Slow and stop the machine before stepping down.
description: Climb continuously on a rotating staircase. The quadriceps and glutes move the body while the repeated stepping trains the cardiovascular system.

name: Weighted Bench Dip with Heels Elevated
instructions: Arrange two stable benches facing each other and sit on the edge of one with your hands beside your hips.
Place both heels on the opposite bench with your legs extended and position a weight plate securely across your upper thighs.
Move your hips clear of the hand-supporting bench and support your body through your hands and heels.
Bend your elbows to lower within a comfortable shoulder range, keeping the plate stable.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and repeat.
Remove the plate before leaving the supported position.
description: A plate across the thighs adds resistance to a bench dip with elevated heels. The triceps raise the body between the two benches.

name: Weighted Close-Grip Chin-Up
instructions: Fasten a dip belt around your hips and secure the weight plate so it hangs between your legs.
Grip the straight center section of the pull-up bar with your hands close together and palms toward you.
Hang with your arms extended and feet clear of the floor.
Pull your chest upward by bending your elbows, keeping the plate from swinging.
Lower under control until your arms extend, then repeat.
description: A close underhand grip distinguishes this weighted chin-up. The lats and biceps lift the body and a plate suspended from a dip belt.
aliases: Weighted Close Grip Chin-Up on Dip Cage

name: Plate-Loaded Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and hold a weight plate close to your chest with both hands.
Shift toward one leg and bend that knee deeply while keeping the other leg extended.
Keep the bent-leg heel grounded and allow the toes of the straight leg to turn upward.
Push through the bent leg to return toward the middle.
Shift to the other side and continue alternating with a depth you can control.
description: Deep side-to-side squats move the load from one leg to the other while a plate is held at the chest. The quadriceps, glutes and adductors share the work.

name: Weighted Crunch with Legs Raised
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent and both feet elevated.
Hold a weight plate with both hands above your chest and extend your arms toward the ceiling.
Keep the plate steady as you tighten your abdomen and lift your shoulder blades from the floor.
Lower your upper back slowly while your legs remain raised.
Repeat without swinging the plate toward your knees.
description: The upper body curls upward with a plate held above the chest and the legs held raised. The abs perform the crunch while the hip flexors support the legs.

name: Weighted Decline Sit-Up with Arms Extended
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads.
Hold a weight plate above your chest in both hands with your arms extended.
Curl your torso up from the bench while keeping the plate raised and your neck relaxed.
Continue to a controlled upright position without swinging the weight.
Lower your torso back along the bench slowly and repeat.
description: A plate held on extended arms adds resistance during a decline sit-up. The abs curl the trunk and the hip flexors help raise it toward the thighs.

name: Partner-Loaded Donkey Calf Raise on Floor
instructions: Stand on the floor facing a stable bench, lean forward from your hips and support your hands on the bench.
Have your partner sit securely across your hips while you keep your back steady and knees nearly straight.
Press through the balls of both feet to lift your heels and raise the load.
Lower your heels to the floor slowly without bending your knees.
Repeat with your partner remaining still, then have them dismount before you stand upright.
description: A partner seated across the hips supplies resistance while the heels rise from the floor. The bent-over torso is supported by the hands on a bench.

name: Weighted Drop Push-Up Between Benches
instructions: Set two stable benches apart so one hand can rest on each with floor space between them.
Position a weight plate securely across your upper back and establish a straight body line with your toes on the floor.
Perform a push-up on the benches, then move your hands inward to drop to the floor between them.
Bend your elbows to absorb the landing and lower your chest with control.
Push explosively from the floor and replace both hands on the bench tops.
Regain a steady position before repeating the cycle.
description: This weighted plyometric push-up moves the hands between two raised benches and the floor. The chest and triceps produce the push while the abdomen stabilizes the body.

name: Weighted Forearm Plank
instructions: Position a weight plate securely across your upper back before settling into the hold.
Place your forearms on the floor with elbows beneath your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Lift your body onto your forearms and toes, keeping a straight line from head to heels.
Tighten your abdomen and glutes while breathing steadily and keeping the plate still.
Lower your knees to finish and remove the plate before standing.
description: A plate adds resistance to a forearm plank. The abs resist back extension while the shoulders and glutes help maintain the body line.

name: Weight Plate Front Raise
instructions: Stand upright and hold the sides of one weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your abdomen firm.
Raise the plate forward to about shoulder height without leaning backward.
Pause briefly, then lower it slowly to the thighs.
Repeat without swinging the weight.
description: Both hands raise a single plate in front of the body. The front shoulders lift the arms while the forearms hold the plate.

name: Dumbbell Hanging Knee and Hip Raise
instructions: Grip a dumbbell securely between your feet and hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms straight.
Gently tighten your abdomen and bend your knees as you lift them toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis upward at the top without swinging your body.
Lower slowly, allowing the hips and knees to extend back to the hanging start.
Keep the dumbbell controlled between your feet throughout the movement.
description: A dumbbell held between the feet adds resistance to a hanging knee raise with a pelvic curl. The hip flexors lift the thighs and the abs complete the hip-curl phase.

name: Weighted Stability Ball Back Extension
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with the ball under your abdomen and hips and your toes braced on the floor.
Hold a weight plate close to your chest with both hands.
Lower your chest gently over the front of the ball.
Extend your back to raise your chest until your torso is aligned with your legs, keeping your neck long.
Lower under control and repeat without bouncing on the ball.
description: The lower back lifts the upper torso while the ball supports the hips and abdomen. A plate held at the chest adds resistance.

name: Kneeling Step with Plate Overhead Raise
instructions: Kneel upright on both knees and hold a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position as you lift the plate forward and overhead.
Keep your torso tall and abdomen firm with your arms extended at the top.
Lower the plate as you return the forward knee to the floor.
Repeat the step and raise with the other leg, alternating sides.
description: A forward step into half kneeling is paired with an overhead plate raise. The shoulders lift the plate while the hips and abdomen control the changing stance.

name: Forward Lunge with Plate Overhead Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet under your hips and hold one weight plate in both hands in front of your thighs.
Step forward into a lunge while lifting the plate forward and overhead.
Bend both knees and keep your torso controlled beneath the raised plate.
Push through the front foot to return to standing as you lower the plate.
Repeat with the other leg and continue alternating.
description: A forward lunge is combined with an overhead plate raise. The quadriceps and glutes move the legs while the shoulders raise the load.

name: Weighted Ring Pull-Up
instructions: Secure a weight plate to a dip belt so it hangs between your legs.
Grip a pair of securely anchored rings and hang with your arms extended.
Keep the plate steady as you pull your chest toward the rings, allowing the handles to turn naturally.
Stop at the top of the pull with your elbows bent and rings near your chest.
Lower slowly to the hanging start and repeat.
description: A dip-belt plate adds load to a ring pull-up. The lats and biceps lift the body until the rings approach chest height.

name: Weighted Bar Muscle-Up
instructions: Secure a weight plate to a dip belt and grip a high bar with your palms facing away from you.
Hang with your arms extended and keep the suspended plate controlled.
Pull strongly to bring your chest high toward the bar.
Move your chest over the bar as your wrists turn over it, transitioning from below the bar to support above it.
Press down to straighten your elbows and finish with the bar near your hips.
Reverse through the bent-arm support and lower to the hang under control before repeating.
description: A weighted bar muscle-up combines a high pull, turnover and straight-bar dip. The lats and biceps start the movement before the chest and triceps complete the press.

name: Weighted One-Arm Pull-Up
instructions: Grip the overhead bar with one hand and hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand beside your hip.
Hang from the working arm with your feet clear of the floor and the dumbbell arm straight beside your body.
Keep your abdomen firm and bend the working elbow to pull your body upward toward the bar.
Lower slowly until the arm extends, controlling any body rotation and dumbbell swing.
Complete the set and repeat with the other arm.
description: One arm lifts the body while the opposite hand holds a dumbbell beside the hip. The lats and biceps produce the pull while the torso resists unwanted rotation.

name: Stability Ball Crunch with Plate Held Above Chest
instructions: Sit on a stability ball, then walk your feet forward until the ball supports your lower and middle back.
Hold a plate with both hands above your chest, arms extended, with feet planted apart.
Tighten your abdomen and curl your upper body upward while keeping the plate lifted toward the ceiling.
Lower your upper back over the ball through a comfortable range.
Repeat without swinging the arms or pulling the hips off the ball.
description: Hold a plate on extended arms while performing a crunch over a stability ball. The abs curl the torso and the shoulders support the plate.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
instructions: Fasten a dip belt and secure a weight plate to hang between your legs.
Grip the pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with your palms facing away from you.
Hang with your arms extended and keep the plate from swinging.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar without craning your neck.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
description: A plate suspended from a dip belt adds resistance to an overhand pull-up. The lats and biceps raise the body while the forearms maintain the grip.

name: Weight Plate Steering-Wheel Rotation
instructions: Stand tall and hold the sides of a weight plate with both hands.
Lift the plate in front of you to about shoulder height and keep your elbows softly bent.
Turn the plate to one side like a steering wheel, moving one hand above the other.
Reverse the turn to the opposite side while keeping the plate raised.
Continue with controlled rotations, then lower the plate to finish.
description: Hold a plate at shoulder height and rotate it from side to side. The shoulders sustain the arm position while the forearms control the plate.

name: Weighted Russian Twist with Feet Anchored
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet secured under a stable low support.
Hold a weight plate in both hands in front of your torso and lean back slightly.
Rotate your chest and plate toward one side while keeping your pelvis steady.
Return through the center and turn to the other side.
Continue alternating without jerking the weight or collapsing your back.
description: Anchored feet support a reclined sitting position while the torso turns with a plate. The obliques rotate the trunk and the abs hold its angle.

name: Weighted Russian Twist with Feet Raised
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lift both feet from the ground.
Hold a weight plate with both hands in front of your chest and lean back slightly.
Turn your torso and plate toward one side while keeping your legs balanced.
Rotate through the center toward the other side.
Continue alternating under control with your feet elevated.
description: Rotate the torso with a plate while balancing on the hips with both feet raised. The obliques turn the trunk and the abs and hip flexors maintain the position.

name: Weighted Russian Twist with Bench Foot Support
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a bench and brace your feet under its stable lower support with your knees bent.
Hold a weight plate close to your torso in both hands and lean back slightly.
Turn your shoulders and the plate to one side while keeping your hips grounded.
Pass through the center and turn to the other side.
Repeat with smooth rotation and steady foot support.
description: A bench anchors the feet during this plate-loaded seated twist. The obliques control the turns while the abs stabilize the reclined torso.

name: Single-Arm Medicine Ball Curl on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with your feet planted apart.
Hold a small medicine ball securely in one hand beside your thigh with your palm facing forward.
Keep your upper arm close to your side as you bend the elbow to bring the ball toward that shoulder.
Lower the ball slowly without leaning your torso.
Complete the set, then change hands.
description: One arm curls a medicine ball while the body sits on a stability ball. The biceps bend the elbow and the forearm maintains the grip.
aliases: Weighted Seated Bicep Curl (On Stability Ball)

name: Seated Plate Twist on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with your feet planted apart.
Hold a weight plate close to your abdomen in both hands.
Keep your hips steady as you turn your chest and plate to one side.
Return to the centre without rolling your pelvis across the ball.
Complete the repetitions, then turn toward the other side.
description: Rotate the upper body while seated upright on a ball and holding a plate. The obliques guide the turns as the abs steady the torso.

name: Weighted Side Bend over Stability Ball
instructions: Position the side of your waist over a stability ball and extend your legs with both feet braced on the floor.
Hold a weight plate securely beside the upper side of your head without pulling on your neck.
Lower your upper body sideways over the ball within a comfortable range.
Contract the upper-side waist muscles to raise your torso back toward a straight line.
Repeat, then reposition on the other side.
description: The torso bends sideways over a ball while a plate adds resistance near the head. The obliques lift the upper body against the load.

name: Weighted Supported Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand beside a stable incline bench, hold its backrest with one hand and secure a weight plate against your chest with the other.
Keep your hips aligned with your shoulders and knees and gently tighten your abdomen as you rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward while leaning your torso backward in line with your thighs.
Lower only as far as you can control, using the support for balance.
Extend your knees to return upright and lower your heels before repeating.
description: The knees bend forward while the body leans backward as one line. A plate adds resistance to this quadriceps-focused supported sissy squat.

name: Belt Squat Between Raised Platforms
instructions: Place two stable raised platforms parallel with a gap between them.
Secure a weight plate to a squat belt around your hips, with the plate hanging through the gap.
Stand with one foot on each platform and hold your arms forward for balance.
Bend your hips and knees into a squat while the plate lowers freely between the platforms.
Push through both feet to stand, keeping your heels down and torso controlled.
Repeat, then unload the belt before stepping off.
description: A plate hangs from a hip belt between two platforms during the squat. The quadriceps and glutes raise the body with the load carried at the hips.

name: Standing Weight Plate Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold the sides of one weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your upper arms near your sides as you bend your elbows to raise the plate toward your chest.
Avoid leaning back or swinging the plate.
Lower slowly until your arms are extended and repeat.
description: Both hands curl a single plate toward the chest. The biceps bend the elbows while the forearms maintain the grip.

name: Single-Hand Weight Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Stand upright and hold a weight plate by its edge in one hand beside your thigh.
Pinch the plate between your thumb and fingers and keep your wrist steady.
Maintain the grip with your arm at your side and the plate clear of your foot.
Lower the plate carefully to finish, then repeat with the other hand.
description: One hand pinches the edge of a plate while the arm stays beside the body. The forearm and hand muscles sustain the grip.

name: Weighted Straight-Bar Dip
instructions: Secure a weight plate to a dip belt and support yourself above a fixed horizontal bar with straight arms.
Keep the bar in front of your hips and your feet clear of the floor.
Lean your chest slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower toward the bar.
Press down through both hands to return to straight-arm support.
Repeat while controlling the suspended weight.
description: The body dips above a single horizontal bar with additional weight at the hips. The chest and triceps press the body back into support.

name: Plate-Loaded Split Squat Pulse
instructions: Take a long split stance and hold a weight plate in each hand beside your hips.
Bend your front knee and lower your rear knee toward the floor, keeping the rear heel lifted.
With both feet staying in place, make a small controlled lowering and rising movement in this split squat position.
Keep your torso tall and the plates beside your body.
Finish the set, stand up and switch which leg is in front.
description: Two plates add resistance to small repeated movements in a low split stance. The front-leg quadriceps and glutes control the lowering and rising.

name: Weight Plate Svend Press
instructions: Stand tall and press a weight plate between your palms in front of your chest.
Keep inward pressure on the plate as you extend both arms forward.
Stop with your arms nearly straight without shrugging or leaning backward.
Bend your elbows to bring the plate back toward your chest while maintaining the squeeze.
Repeat at a controlled pace.
description: The palms squeeze a plate while the arms press it forward and draw it back. The chest sustains the inward pressure with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Weighted Three-Bench Dip
instructions: Arrange two stable benches for your hands and a third in front for your heels.
Place one hand on each side bench, extend your legs onto the front bench and secure a plate across your upper thighs.
Support your hips between the benches with your arms extended.
Bend your elbows to lower your body through a comfortable shoulder range.
Press through your hands to rise, keeping your heels supported and the plate steady.
Remove the plate before leaving the position.
description: Each hand has its own bench and both heels rest on a third. A plate across the thighs adds resistance to the triceps-led dip.

name: Weighted Parallel-Bar Triceps Dip
instructions: Attach a weight plate to a dip belt and grip the parallel dip handles.
Support yourself with arms extended and feet clear of the floor.
Keep your torso fairly upright as you bend your elbows and lower within a comfortable shoulder range.
Press down on the handles to straighten your arms.
Repeat while keeping the plate from swinging.
description: A belt-suspended plate loads a dip on parallel handles. An upright torso places emphasis on elbow extension by the triceps.

name: Weighted Triceps Dip on High Parallel Bars
instructions: Secure a weight plate to a dip belt and take a firm grip on the high parallel bars.
Lift into straight-arm support with your feet clear and the plate hanging steadily.
Bend your elbows to lower your body with your torso fairly upright.
Stop at a controlled, comfortable depth and press back to straight arms.
Repeat without swinging your legs or the weight.
description: Perform a weighted dip on high parallel bars with the torso held upright. The triceps extend the elbows with assistance from the chest and shoulders.

name: Kneeling Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on the floor and grip the ab wheel handles with the wheel beneath your shoulders.
Tighten your abdomen and keep your hips aligned with your torso.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, allowing your hips and shoulders to move forward together.
Stop before your lower back arches, then pull the wheel back toward your knees.
Bring the wheel back beneath your shoulders and repeat from the kneeling position.
description: The knees stay grounded while an ab wheel extends the body forward. The abs resist back extension and the shoulders and lats help control the wheel.

name: Wheel Running Drill
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent and prepare for a quick running rhythm.
Drive one knee forward and upward as the opposite arm swings forward.
Cycle that foot down beneath your body while the other knee rises.
Continue alternating legs in a rounded running action, staying light on your feet.
Maintain a controlled rhythm for your planned duration.
description: The legs cycle rapidly through a high-knee running action with opposite arm swings. This running drill combines coordination with cardiovascular work.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar wider than shoulder width with your palms facing away.
Hang with your arms extended and feet clear of the floor.
Pull your body upward by bringing your upper arms toward your sides.
Raise your chin above the bar without craning your neck.
Lower slowly until your arms extend and repeat.
description: A wide overhand grip accompanies the upward pull toward the bar. The lats bring the upper arms down while the biceps bend the elbows.

name: Wide-Grip Behind-Neck Pull-Up
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar widely with your palms facing away from you and hang with your feet clear.
Keep your head slightly forward of the bar as you begin pulling upward.
Draw your upper arms down to raise your body with the bar passing behind your head.
Use only a comfortable shoulder range and avoid forcing your neck forward to reach the bar.
Lower slowly to the hang and repeat.
description: This wide-grip pull-up brings the upper back toward a bar behind the head. The lats and elbow flexors perform the pull through the available shoulder range.

name: Wide-Hand Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands wider than shoulder width and extend your legs behind you onto your toes.
Hold a straight line from your head to your heels with your abdomen firm.
Bend your elbows diagonally outward to lower your chest between your hands.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.
Repeat without letting your hips sag.
description: Wide hand placement increases the shoulder movement in this floor push-up. The chest and triceps press the body while the abdomen maintains its line.

name: Wide-Grip Chest Dip on High Parallel Bars
instructions: Grip the wide parallel bars and lift into straight-arm support with your feet clear.
Lean your chest forward slightly and bend your knees as needed for clearance.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest between the bars through a comfortable range.
Press down into the bars to raise your body and straighten your arms.
Keep the motion controlled without swinging your legs.
description: A wide grip and forward torso angle emphasize the chest during a parallel-bar dip. The triceps assist in returning to straight-arm support.

name: Alternating Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with both arms extended and your feet clear of the floor.
Lift one bent knee toward your torso while the other leg stays lower with its knee bent.
Lower that thigh as you lift the other knee.
Continue alternating without swinging your torso.
Keep your grip firm and finish by returning both legs to the hanging position.
description: Alternate knee lifts while hanging from an overhead bar. The hip flexors raise the thighs and the abs steady the pelvis and trunk.

name: Lunge to Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Step one foot well forward into a long lunge and place your hands on the floor beside the front foot.
Lower your hips gently to feel a stretch around the front of the rear hip.
Keeping your hands supported, shift your hips upward and backward as you straighten the front knee.
Pause at a comfortable stretch behind the front thigh, then bend the knee to return to the low lunge.
Repeat slowly before changing legs.
description: Move between a low lunge and a straighter front leg with the hands on the floor. The sequence alternates emphasis between the rear hip flexors and front hamstrings.

name: Standing Wrist Circles
instructions: Stand comfortably with your elbows bent and hands held in front of you.
Keep your forearms mostly still as you circle both hands at the wrists.
Move through a comfortable range without forcing the joints.
Reverse the direction and continue with smooth circles.
description: Small circles move the wrists through several directions while the forearms remain supported by the bent arms. This is a gentle wrist mobility drill.

name: Standing Wrist Roller
instructions: Attach the load securely to the wrist roller rope and hold the handle with both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms lifted and your torso upright.
Turn the handle with alternating wrist movements to wind the rope and raise the weight.
Once the weight reaches the handle, reverse the wrist turns to lower it slowly.
Keep the rope controlled until the weight returns to its starting height.
description: Alternating wrist turns wind and unwind a rope supporting a weight. The forearms drive the roller while the shoulders sustain the arm position.

name: Standing Self-Resisted Neck Holds
instructions: Stand upright with your head facing forward and shoulders relaxed.
Place your hands against your forehead and gently press your head into them while your hands prevent movement.
Release the pressure, then place your hands behind your head.
Gently press the back of your head into your hands without tilting your head.
Release the pressure and lower your hands.
description: The neck holds the head still against gentle hand pressure at the forehead and the back of the head.
aliases: Standing Forward and Backward Neck Stretch

name: Prone Neck Bridge
instructions: Place your forehead on a padded surface with your hands nearby and your toes on the floor.
Lift your hips and knees, using your hands to control how much weight reaches your head.
Make a small, slow forward and backward rocking motion while keeping the neck movement controlled.
Keep the range comfortable and avoid sudden shifts of weight.
Use your hands to unload your head before lowering your knees to finish.
description: The forehead and feet support a raised body as small rocking movements load the neck. The hands can regulate the amount of bodyweight applied.

name: Standing Side Neck Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and hands resting on your hips.
Place one hand on the side of your head and gently guide that ear toward the same-side shoulder.
Keep the shoulder down and hold a gentle stretch along the opposite side of your neck without pulling hard.
Release the hand pressure, return to the center and repeat on the other side.
description: A hand gently guides a side tilt to stretch the opposite side of the neck. The torso and shoulders remain still.

name: Wall Sit with Alternating Foot Touches
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place your feet forward from it.
Slide down into a bent-knee wall sit and hold your back against the wall.
Lift one foot with the knee bent and reach the opposite hand toward that foot, extending the other arm to the side.
Lower the foot and return your arm, keeping your hips at the same height.
Repeat with the other leg and opposite hand, continuing to alternate sides.
description: Hold a wall sit while lifting one bent knee and reaching the opposite hand toward that foot, then switch sides. The quadriceps hold the seated position while the hip flexors and abdominal muscles help lift and control each reach.
aliases: Wall-Supported Single-Leg Squat with Toe Reach

name: Incline Side-Lying Neck Harness Raise
instructions: Secure the weighted head harness and lie on your side along an incline bench with your head free of its edge.
Keep your torso supported and your arms folded across your chest.
Allow your head to lower gently sideways through a comfortable range.
Raise your head away from the floor using the muscles along the side of your neck.
Lower slowly, then repeat on the other side after the set.
description: The torso lies sideways on an incline bench while a harness loads side bending of the neck. The movement stays small and controlled.
aliases: Weighted Lying Side Lifting Head (With Head Harness)

name: Seated Neck Extension with Head Harness
instructions: Fasten the weighted head harness and sit on a bench with your feet planted.
Lean forward slightly and support your forearms on your thighs.
Lower your head gently, allowing the hanging weight to remain clear of the floor.
Raise your head until it is aligned with your torso without throwing it backward.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A head harness provides resistance while the seated exerciser extends the neck from a forward-leaning position. The forearms rest on the thighs to steady the torso.
aliases: Weighted Seated Neck Extension (With Head Harness)

name: Band Prone Hip External Rotation
instructions: Anchor a resistance band to the outside of the working leg and secure it around that ankle.
Lie face down with the working knee bent about 90 degrees and the other leg extended.
Keep the working thigh on the floor as you rotate at the hip to move that foot inward against the band.
Return the foot slowly without lifting the pelvis or moving the knee sideways.
Complete the set, then change legs and anchor position.
description: With one knee bent in a prone position, the foot moves inward as the hip rotates outward. The band resists the hip rotators while the thigh stays supported.

name: Band Seated Hip External Rotation
instructions: Sit on a stable box with the working thigh supported and the knee bent about 90 degrees.
Secure a band around the working ankle and anchor it outside that leg.
Keep the knee pointing forward as you draw the foot inward under your body against the band.
Return slowly toward the starting position without lifting the thigh or turning your torso.
Finish the set and repeat on the other side.
description: The seated thigh stays supported as the foot moves inward through hip external rotation. A band anchored outside the leg resists the movement.

name: Bench Crunch with Plate behind Head
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your knees bent and feet supported on the bench.
Hold a weight plate securely behind your head with both hands without pressing it into your neck.
Tighten your abdomen and curl your shoulders off the bench.
Keep your lower back supported and avoid pulling your head forward.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: The shoulders curl upward from a bench with a plate held behind the head. The abs move the torso while the arms keep the load stable.

name: Lateral Wave Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Step onto the machine pedals and hold its fixed handrail.
Begin alternating the pedals in their lateral sweeping path.
Keep your torso upright and use the handrail for balance.
Maintain a smooth pace without hanging your bodyweight from your arms.
Slow the machine gradually before stepping off.
description: The feet sweep outward and inward on a wave-style elliptical trainer while the hands hold a fixed rail. Continuous alternating leg movement provides cardiovascular work.

name: Left Jab
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your left foot forward and both hands near your face.
Extend your left fist straight ahead at shoulder height while keeping your right hand near your cheek.
Let the left shoulder move forward with the punch without locking the elbow.
Draw the left hand straight back to your guard.
Repeat while maintaining your stance and balance.
description: A quick straight punch is delivered with the lead left hand and returned to guard. Repeated shadowboxing provides cardiovascular work and upper-body coordination.

name: Right Cross
instructions: Stand with your left foot forward and both fists near your face.
Turn your right hip and shoulder forward as you send the right fist straight ahead.
Allow the rear heel to pivot while the left hand stays near your face.
Pull the right hand back and return the hips to your starting stance.
Repeat smoothly without overreaching.
description: The rear right hand punches straight ahead with a coordinated hip and shoulder turn. The movement returns to the same guarded stance between repetitions.

name: Right Uppercut
instructions: Take a left-foot-forward boxing stance with both hands guarding your face.
Soften your knees and bring the right fist slightly down while keeping the elbow bent.
Turn through the hips as you drive the right fist upward in front of your body.
Keep the left hand guarding and avoid swinging the right arm far behind you.
Bring the right hand back to guard and reset.
description: A rising punch with the right hand combines a bent-arm lift with lower-body drive and trunk rotation. The left hand remains in a guarding position.

name: Left Uppercut
instructions: Stand with your left foot forward and both hands near your face.
Bend your knees slightly and lower the left fist a short distance with the elbow bent.
Drive the left fist upward in front of your body as your legs and torso turn into the punch.
Keep your right hand near your face and the movement compact.
Return the left hand to guard and repeat.
description: The lead left hand delivers a rising punch while the legs and trunk contribute to the movement. The arm stays bent as the fist travels upward.

name: Plate-Loaded Machine Neck Extension
instructions: Adjust the machine seat so the head pad contacts the back of your head and select a light, controllable load.
Sit with your feet planted and hold the handles to steady your torso.
Begin with your head tipped slightly forward, then press the back of your head into the pad to extend your neck.
Stop within a comfortable range without arching your torso.
Return slowly to the starting head position.
description: The seated exerciser presses the back of the head against a loaded lever pad. The neck extensors move the head while the torso stays supported.

name: Plate-Loaded Machine Left Neck Side Bend
instructions: Adjust the seat and head pad so the pad rests against the left side of your head above the ear.
Sit tall, plant your feet and grip the handles to keep your torso steady.
Press into the pad by tilting your left ear toward your left shoulder.
Keep the shoulder down and use a small comfortable range without turning your face.
Return slowly to the starting position.
